messages.mission.briefing.text:
Agents working for Guristas recently managed to infiltrate one of our outposts in a nearby system.  We have reliable information that they did manage to find classified information about our various operations in the area.  Fortunately one of the officers at the outpost managed to slip a tracking device into one of their ships before they escaped.  We know they are located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} at this very moment.  I would like you to fly over there and ambush them immediately.  Return to me once their ships have been turned to dust.  
But be careful, they are armed and dangerous.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You took out their leader?  That should be enough, their members are nothing but freelance mercs in it for the gold.  Without the Seven's commanders their forces will wither up and die.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Seven have showed their ugly faces again, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  They've set up an illegal brothel inside the system, which is being guarded by some of their top pilots, including a member of the Seven's elite circle.  I want that place shut down, immediately.  Do whatever it takes.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  With their commander out of the way, I don't expect any more incidents involving them for a while.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Seven have showed their ugly faces again, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They've set up a prison facility where they keep captured personnel working for {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} and random civilians for a ransom. The people that are put in there are rarely the same after they've been released. The Seven have somehow managed to get a hold on Sansha mind altering gadgets, which they use on those who they kidnap to erase their memory among other things. Rarely does this not have serious side effects ...

I want that place shut down, immediately. Do whatever it takes.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent!  With Zor out of the picture we'll hopefully have far less encounters with 'The Seven' in the near future.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Something urgent just came up. A convoy delivering foodstuffs to {[location]agentStationID.name} was ambushed in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} by pirates which we identified as members of 'The Seven'. These pirates have crossed our path before, and are not to be taken lightly. They belong to an organization which split itself from the Serpentis many years ago, and has grown quite large in a surprisingly short amount of time. Their leader uses the nickname 'Zazzmatazz', which you might have heard of if you're into Gallente films.

Anyway, the convoy escort drove off the pirate attack and chased them to their outpost. Only a handful of ships survived the battle that ensued. They report being attacked by none other than Zor, Zazzmatazz´s right hand man. If their tale is correct, then we have an excellent opportunity to strike at The Seven's top leadership. His death will be a serious blow to the organization, no doubt.

So your orders are: Fly to The Seven outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy their forces. Zor must not escape. Good luck.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Recently a thief stole some valuable documents from a high ranking officer and friend of mine in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.  These documents are very sensitive and we fear they were stolen by someone working for an enemy of ours.  
Fortunately, the information stored within the documents was encrypted using the very latest encryption software.  The thief probably did not expect this, and we believe the information has not yet been revealed to him or his 
employer.  Should it leak out however then the leader of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will be ... less than forgiving.  Would you please save my friends career?  I have been told by a reliable source of a shady 
person who docked here yesterday and was spotted near my friends apartment, and is most likely the thief of whom I speak.  This person has very recently left this station.  I will pay you {[numeric]rewardQuantity} 
{[item]rewardTypeID.name} if you intercept the thief, destroy his ship if he offers resistance and bring the documents back to me.  I know you probably do not want to harm someone who may not be guilty, but I assure you 
that this scoundrel has a history of criminal offenses within {[location]agentRegionID.name}.  The people of {[location]agentRegionID.name} will be glad to know of his demise.  You have only 24 hours to complete the mission, but 
he will most likely be located in this very constellation.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Your timing couldn't be better, {[character]player.name}. We‘ve just uncovered a breach of security in our administrative offices, an inside job during which some sensitive reports were stolen. All information points to a disgruntled former employee with contacts in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. You‘ll probably find the culprit in a local – please forgive the term – "roadhouse."

messages.root.agentsays.text: Have you found that worthless bastard yet?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I should have listened to my superiors and taken care of this internally instead of thinking for a second that a capsuleer would be willing to help.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: It's alright. I'll find another capsuleer willing to bathe in all this ISK I have to offer.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Small, independent trade hubs throughout New Eden are sometimes referred to by a most peculiar and archaic term: “Roadhouses.” Though no one quite remembers why they're called that, it's common knowledge that roadhouses are ideal locations for moving stolen goods, making underworld contacts, or getting hurt. Needless to say, these establishments are frequented by unscrupulous roughnecks for whom pain doesn't hurt.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Thank you for this. You have no idea how much this means to {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Travel to the designated system and retrieve the reports from the thief.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: It was just as we all suspected. Please accept our thanks and all the rewards that come from loyal service to {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}. Keep this up and you‘ll have more ISK than you know what to do with – I promise you that.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} recently sacked one of its employees after a routine inspection revealed a large amount of indecent pictures stored in his personal database.  Sadly, this ex-employee wasn't all too pleased with our 
decision, and has resorted to camping outside of our headquarters and harassing our customers.  Fortunately though, we dug up some old offenses this guy made and revealed them to the authorities, who promptly lowered his security rating quite a bit.  In effect, he's fair game.  Please warp over to the location on the bookmark I'm about to give you and squash this little pest.  I doubt he will survive for long, as some of our customers are 
heavily armed.  So hurry up and take him out if you want your reward.

He was working as a deep cover agent for us, and now he is threatening to release all the information to DED about what we have been doing. We cannot have this happen. If he does make it to the DED headquarters in Yulai, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will face serious repercussions. Eliminate this threat as soon as possible to ensure that he doesn't get the information to DED agents. I'll put into your way-points where he was last seen. Return here and let me know that he is dead.

localizedName.text: Failing The Angel Cartel Comes At A Cost

messages.mission.briefing.text: As you probably know, the pirate profession is a risky business.  A pirate can only afford to make so many mistakes.  If you mess up too often, you're out, literally.  One such case happened recently, where an employee of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} failed to accomplish a vital mission we had given him in time.  This was the 4th time he screwed up.  This particular failure cost us millions.  Unlike other businesses, we can't simply lay him off.  He knows too much.  I will give you a bookmark to his current location, jump over there and meet up with him and his ragtag band of renegades.  He knows what's coming for him, and will probably attack you on sight.  You know what to do.

A few years ago we kidnapped a few people on a remote planet that we raided. One of their relatives has been on our backs ever since. He keeps hiring bounty hunters to retrieve them and bring them back to their former home. Little does he know that most of them are already dead *chuckle*.

Anyway, get yourself ready for some action; The latest bounty hunter assigned on another one of those pathetic rescue attempts has been spotted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Take care of him.

A CONCORD scout drone was just spotted in this system by one of our men. As usual, these drones should always be eliminated before they cause any damage. I'm not sure why this lone drone has entered our territory. Might just be an accident, or maybe it's on some secret mission.

Either way, I'd like you to head out there and get rid of it before it manages to escape. Leave no trace of it behind. Don't be long!

Today is a sad day, {[character]player.name}. One of our freelancers, working on a simple reconnaissance job in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, was brutally murdered by Guristas thugs while on duty. He was well liked in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and we will miss his loyal service to us greatly.

Now, you might be thinking, "How does this affect me?" Well I'll tell you. We aren't letting this outrage go unpunished. I want the people behind this brutal murder taken care of immediately. I will supply you with a bookmark to their hideout, which is heavily guarded by Guristas fighters. Head out there and avenge your colleague by destroying their habitation module; it's the primary residence of their leaders. Leave no pirate survivors behind.

Oh, and one other thing: They have an asteroid colony out there which is used to house their workers, miners, and such. I suggest you leave them in one piece, for we have no quarrel with them. We'll send a personnel transport to pick them up shortly after you return, as long as you have eliminated all of the pirates.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Recent reports from the Federal Intelligence Office give us reason to believe that the UDI terrorist organization has begun setting up outposts in the names of front corporations at deadspace forward points within our sovereign space, with the intention of spying on Gallente corporations. I've just gotten word that there's one such suspected outpost in this system. The problem is that we cannot be fully sure whether the outpost in question is indeed a UDI hive. Obviously this means we can't go in flying our own banner, so non-contracted free agents such as yourself will be of paramount importance in the staging of preliminary operations. True, it is a harsh risk to take, attacking installations that haven't been absolutely proven to be hostile, but the UDI simply present too much of a threat for us to have the luxury of dilly-dallying.

Should you choose to accept this mission, I will upload this outpost's coordinates to your Neocom. Your primary target will be a subspace data miner thought to have been picking up on our communications frequencies. Once it is destroyed, report back to us and we will send in another team for the next stage of the operation.

You will probably encounter some mercenary resistance in the area. Orders are to kill on sight, and refrain from any and all communication that may uncover your involvement with us. Should you be captured, we will disavow any knowledge of your actions.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Recent reports from the Federal Intelligence Office give us reason to believe that the UDI terrorist organization has begun setting up outposts in the names of front corporations at deadspace forward points within our sovereign space, with the intention of spying on Gallente corporations. We recently managed to confirm the existence of one such outpost in this system.

Operatives have already been sent in to cripple key outpost structures, and the UDI's response has been to call in a great deal of mercenary reinforcements, with our intel telling us more are on the way. We believe they may be planning a large-scale strike against this station sometime within the next 24 hours, so we need someone to go in there and put a dent in their current forces. This should delay their attack long enough for us to call in reinforcements of our own to take out the installation.

Should you accept, your mission would be to go in and take out every one of the mercenary ships you currently see at the installation. I would advise you to set up the most powerful combat fitting you possibly can, as according to our previous experience these people are not to be trifled with unless you know what you're doing. So what do you say?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I knew you'd come through.  Take this reward, and our gratitude.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I have dire news, {[character]player.name}.  One of our deadspace asteroid belts in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has been infested by rogue drones!  We lost contact with the miners working there a few days ago, after they had reported sightings of mysterious craft nearby.  Our reconnaissance team then confirmed our suspicions, the entire belt has been infested with those pests.  Not only that but they have already erected a Drone Silo there, which the drones often use as the first building block for an actual Drone Hive.  We need to act fast before they manage to grow in numbers, {[character]player.name}.  Your job is to see to it that their silo is completely destroyed.  I'll send in ships later to clean up the mess.  However I warn you, the drones roaming the belt will no doubt all come to aid their silo once it is attacked, so it would be advisable to try and split them up and clear out the guards before you attempt to finish your objectives.

We just received an incoming transmission from one of our personnel convoys traveling through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They reported that they were under attack by unidentified craft which refused to reply to their attempts at communication. Soon afterwards the transmission was cut off, and we haven't heard from them since.

Normally I would send a reconnaissance mission to the last known location of the convoy and scout the area before attempting any further action, but this situation is different. The convoy that was destroyed was carrying a very valuable artifact which must be retrieved at all cost. It is sealed in a booby-trapped special delivery package. I require you to head out there and look for it, if fortune shines on us today then the attacker and our artifact will still be close by. Do this for me and you shall be rewarded, {[character]player.name}.

I have grave tidings this time, {[character]player.name}. One of the ancient station ruins out in the fringes of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has been reportedly infested with rogue drones. They have made it their hive, and are busily producing more and more rogue drones. From there they have been launching attacks on our convoys and outposts nearby, some of which have been totally overrun. I request that you fly to the station ruins and eliminate their hive.

Rogue drones are a constant menace to our assets. They have no allegiance to any nation that we know of and their only purpose seems to be expansion and destruction of anything in their path. Once they have started infesting a system, it is very hard to exterminate the infestation for good. But it is possible to reduce the threat they pose by destroying their hives, fortunately.

We've just been informed of an official complaint from the mining division working in one of the asteroid fields in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, about their haulers being attacked on sight by roaming rogue drones in the area. At first it started with just a few unsuccessful attacks, but the situation has worsened greatly and the hauler pilots, along with the miners themselves, are on the verge of a strike. This is the perfect opportunity for someone like you to take care of business and earn your reward, {[character]player.name}. I'll supply you with a bookmark to the location of the asteroid belt, eliminate the rogue drone threat there and then report back to me.

Please note that this mission requires you to use acceleration gates. Please use them to get farther into the deadspace pocket to eliminate all of the drones.

We believe the goods are being transported to the outpost as we speak, in an industrial, a Bestower to be exact. I want you to fly out there immediately and find the equipment and bring it back to us. It may still be located in the same sealed containers as when it was stolen.

You have full authority to shoot anything that threatens you near the outpost, {[character]player.name}. They might send some of their mercenary ships to intercept you, once they know what you're after. After all, if we can prove the tycoon who owns that place had anything to do with the theft, we'll have the perfect excuse to bring that scrapheap down for good.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those guys were nothing. What's for dessert?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Fine, I'll find someone else. Be gone from my sight, peon.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Very well, then.  It will be a tough task finding someone as talented as you to take this on, but oh well - that's my job, I suppose.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Bring it on.  Oh yes, bring it on.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: UDI you say?  I, uh, I ... look behind you! A three-headed fedo!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is too much for me.  I'm sorry, but you'll just have to find someone of stronger moral fibre.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could count on you.  Show those terrorists the price of messing with us.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'd like something to kill, please.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Recent intelligence reports give us reason to believe that the UDI terrorist organization has begun setting up outposts in the names of front corporations at deadspace forward points within our sovereign space, with the intention of spying on Gallente corporations. We recently managed to confirm the existence of one such outpost in this system.

Operatives have already been sent in on two separate occasions and a good deal of the outpost's frontal defenses have been crippled or weakened. Our intelligence sources have reported, however, that the terrorists have another base hidden away in another location in system. It now appears that the first outpost was no more than a red herring which they intended us to expend resources finding and destroying, leaving us vulnerable to a full attack later on. Now, they don't know that we're aware of the real installation, and we believe they're calling in reinforcements to mount a large-scale offensive against this station within the next 24 hours. Currently they have only a few brass stationed there, guarding the premises. We need to nip this in the bud.

Should you accept, your mission will be to go in and neutralize every hostile you can find at the installation, then take out their armory. This should buy us the time we need to send in a demolitions force from HQ to destroy the outpost and fend off their coming reinforcements. Should you accept, I would advise you to pack as much firepower as you possibly can, as according to our previous experience these people are not to be trifled with unless you know what you're doing. So what do you say?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, soldier.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A couple of bold Guristas pirates just ambushed a convoy of ours, overwhelming the escort ships in no time. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, and are now lurking in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them; bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show them no mercy {[character]player.name}.

A couple of bold and extremely dangerous Guristas just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, wiping out the escort ships in no time. As usual, they left few survivors ― nothing but charred wreckage was left behind. The pirates managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show them no mercy {[character]player.name}.

A couple of Sansha freaks just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, overwhelming the escort ships in no time. As usual, they left few survivors and lots of charred wreckage behind. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who responded to the distress signals and are now lurking in an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them; then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show these scum no mercy, {[character]player.name}.

A couple of pilots of the Sansha's Nation just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, wiping out the escort ships in no time. As usual, there were no survivors ― nothing but charred wreckage was left behind. The pirates managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show them no mercy {[character]player.name}.

As you well know, {[character]player.name}, we have an unfortunate amount of illegal Angel Cartel activity in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Well I believe we have found a target that will cripple their operations here for quite some time.

After countless hours of investigation, our agents have finally discovered their primary armory facility. This is a storage facility for their ship modules and weaponry for ground troops, and would explain how quickly their lost equipment is replaced in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

We believe that if we strike hard and fast, and take out this armory before they know what hit 'em, then we stand a good chance of seriously damaging their supply of spare weaponry, which will greatly impede their operations in this sector. Of course you are the pilot that I feel is most suited for this job, {[character]player.name}. Just remember, we get one shot at this. If you fail, they will undoubtedly relocate their armory and be far more prepared for us next time. So don't screw this one up!

We've been wondering for some time now why the Guristas strikes on our convoys have been so well timed and coordinated, considering our people usually take the utmost caution when it comes to security and secrecy. But I think we've found the answer.

Some time ago our surveillance team stumbled across a hidden Guristas base located in a deadspace pocket not far from here. We didn't think much of it at first ... until we actually sent in one of our undercover agents to investigate. He did not return with his life, but we did manage to salvage his report from the wreckage of his ship. And from what he discovered, the area is being used to cover up a gigantic telescope, which the Guristas are apparently using to spy on our assets here in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. This telescope is so powerful that it's illegal to use in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space without a permit, and those are hard to come by. The interference from the deadspace pocket hides it from our scanners, but it is still able to scan everything outside. An ingenious method of espionage, don't you think?

Your task is simple. Since we've located the base already, all we require you to do is warp over there and destroy it. But although it may sound simple, you should expect heavy resistance. They wouldn't leave such vital equipment lightly guarded. Good luck, {[character]player.name}.

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - Ambush in the Dark (1 of 10)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will do my best, you can count on that.

messages.mission.timeout.emailheader.text: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. I see that, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members, my theory was correct. After we've given them proper trauma counseling, we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.

And don't you leave just yet. I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So what's this important stuff you keep yammering about?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I've heard good things about you, {[character]player.name}. They say you are a loyal servant of {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}, and that you have served us well in the past. I hope that my information is correct, for our sake ... and for yours.

The reason I sent for you is simple, we have visitors, and we need someone to give them a 'warm' welcome. These particular visitors are up to something, but we don't know what yet. And that's where you come in.

Bring us their leader. We need him for interrogation ... and to discover the meaning behind their activities here. Your job is a simple one, and I expect the one we seek here in no less than a day.

They are hauled up in an asteroid belt not far from here, incidently in a deadspace pocket which is blocking our long-range scanners. I will supply you to a bookmark to the acceleration gate leading into it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}, you have served us well as always.  We will begin the interrogation of our prisoner immediately.  I also presume you left the structure they were building intact, we'd like to investigate it.  Whatever they were building out there, it would almost certainly become a threat to our assets in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good, I knew I could count on you.  But just one other thing, I have a feeling that these mercs will fight for their leader, to the death.  Be prepared for a grueling fight.  If you fail, we might not get another chance at this, so do your very best.  That is all I expect of you, friend of {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
While we are interrogating the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to clear up the remnants of the merc forces you defeated in your last mission. I want you to enter the deadspace pocket from a different angle this time, using the other acceleration gate leading into it should put you right next to their base. It's a jumble of structures inside small asteroids connected to each other, which we call an asteroid colony. Destroy it and report back to me.

I'm sure the mercenaries still have a few ships left at their disposal, so be prepared for a fight. Their remaining forces, crippled from your last strike at them, should not cause you any serious problems.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the reports you asked for, and I have taken care of the imperial scum.  Now I expect my reward.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've finally finished with the interrogation of the prisoner you captured in a previous mission, and our suspicions were confirmed. It took some ... convincing, to extract the information we needed from the poor, misguided soul. Which is quite ordinary, considering him being an undercover operative of the Amarr Empire. And a high ranking one at that.

Now you might ask, how could we possibly know that he is high ranking? After all, the Empire is very thorough when it comes to purging all records of the people who join their intelligence agency, to keep it from falling into the 'wrong' hands. Agents such as these tend to 'vanish', as if they had never existed. Quite difficult to track down, I tell you.

But when a large group of Amarrian cruisers appears at our doorstep, demanding the release of a certain individual ... well it's not hard to put 2 and 2 together.

This small fleet of imperial ships was spotted entering the same deadspace pocket which we sent you into on your two previous missions. They are here to investigate the disappearance of their agent, and are most likely ready for a fight. And I expect you to make sure they leave our space, feet first.

We also have reason to believe that they have control over a small outpost inside the asteroid belt. On your last two trips there we gave you bookmarks to two acceleration gates into the vast deadspace area our enemy has been hiding in. Well there is a 3rd gate which we just recently discovered, and we suspect the imperial raid force is located in there, planning their next move. Our sources tell us that their leader brought with him documents detailing their orders from the Empress. We would very much like to get our hands on these documents. Destroy their ships if you can, but your primary objective is to retrieve the reports from their leader. They might be located with him on his ship, or inside their base. Find them and bring them to me, this will be your final assignment for a while.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent, {[character]player.name}.  Your success will not go unnoticed within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have some grave news, {[character]player.name}. A squadron of imperial ships just managed to lay waste to one of our supply depots in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. This was a hit and run attack, aimed at our drug smuggling business into the Amarr territories. I can understand their attacks inside their own sovereign space, but this cowardly act must not go unpunished.

The squadron is still located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We managed to block off all exits leading out of the system, and our ships are just waiting for the order to attack. I want you to personally deal with them, {[character]player.name}, and save us from possible casualties. Do this and you shall be well rewarded.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I need you for a simple courier mission, {[character]player.name}, as well as another job afterwards. It's fairly straight forward, nothing you wouldn't be able to handle.

Recently we acquired a heap load of sensitive Gallente Federation logs, which we want transferred to this station a.s.a.p.. We've made a deal with their government to return this data over to them, without breaking the seal covering the container which they came in, in exchange for a few million ISK. Now all we need is you to bring the stuff here, and then meet their agents at a rendezvous point for the payment.

The Gallente attacked you on sight? Interesting ... I expected as much, they have not been known to deal with us when their back is against the wall, so to speak. Well we have other uses for these logs anyway, blackmailing their citizens will fetch us a much better price.

You've done your job, take your reward and enjoy yourself.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Now that we have the transaction logs here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, it's time to finish the deal.  We arranged for a meeting with some of their forces in a remote deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  Meet them there and retrieve the payment they promised us, then report back to me.  If they try anything funny, then you have my permission to defend yourself.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Now that we have the transaction logs here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, it's time to finish the deal.  We arranged for a meeting with some of their forces in a remote deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  Meet them there and retrieve the payment they promised us, then report back to me.  If they try anything funny, then you have my permission to defend yourself.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I call upon you, {[character]player.name}, for an important task that I need accomplished. We have had numerous cases recently of rogue Minmatar miners exploiting our natural resources in the area. Our gangs have made sure most of them left our space feet first, but there is this one group of them that has caused us great pains. They have apparently brought with them a small group of highly skilled Minmatar Fleet pilots, who apparently will defend them with their lives. We can't afford to lose any more of our ships, so I ask you to do us a favor and eliminate the escort ships guarding the miners.

Once you have eliminated the Fleet vessels, my boys will come in and clean up the rest of the mess. Your objective is not to destroy the miners, but I won't hold it against you if you do.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.  You've done us a great service by taking care of this business.  This won't be forgotten.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have some bad news, {[character]player.name}. The Republic wasn't all too pleased with our attack on the last batch of miners they sent here, which you took part in. Apparently they sent in some reinforcements to the area, to stage a counter-offensive. They must have been deployed nearby already, as it took them a very short time to get here.

I require you to take care of them. We can't afford to lose more ships in these never-ending skirmishes with their forces. Our lines are already thinning from constant battles with freelancers intent on exploiting our valuable resources.

Once you have eliminated the threat they pose, return to me for your reward.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work! Our forces are gathering even as we speak in preparation for the final attack. And it's all thanks to your quick work on that control tower.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
What I'd like you to do is take care of a heavily fortified outpost located on the outskirts of the territory in which their forces are located. They have a number of these outposts guarding their territory, and by removing some of them we hope to open up their defenses enough for us to launch a full-scale attack at their headquarters. Because it's located in the middle of a large deadspace pocket, we haven't been able to do so thus far.

Now, all you have to do is destroy the control tower at the center of the outpost. By doing that, you effectively render the outpost useless, at least till they manage to erect a new tower. By that time, though, our forces will have moved in for the final attack.

Luck be with you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I have a very important and risky assignment for you, {[character]player.name}. Considering your reputation, I'm sure you can handle it.

A few weeks ago, we discovered that the Caldari State was up to something big inside {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, but we didn't know what. Even the officers we have on our payroll among their navy didn't know what was going on. Then, just recently, one of our patrols stumbled upon an encoded signal coming from an area inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We traced the signal and sent a squadron of our best men to investigate, but we soon lost Comlink contact with them; they never came back.

We're almost positive that the State is building a massive military base where that signal came from, probably from where they intend on launching a major offensive against our positions here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. Now, I'd say we have the travel routes through the systems in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} covered pretty well, so this expedition of theirs must be costing them a fortune. If we strike hard and fast before they manage to complete the project, we might be able to convince them that such a foolhardy operation is not in their best interests.

But I'd like to reassure you of one thing, {[character]player.name}. I have no intention of sending you headfirst into the center of their operations ― that would be suicide even for someone with your skills. However, what I'd like you to do is take care of a heavily fortified outpost located on the outskirts of the territory in which their forces are located. They have a number of these outposts guarding their territory, and by removing some of them we hope to open up their defenses enough for us to launch a full-scale attack at their headquarters. Because it's located in the middle of a large deadspace pocket, we haven't been able to do so thus far.

Now, all you have to do is destroy the control tower at the center of the outpost. By doing that, you effectively render the outpost useless, at least till they manage to erect a new tower. By that time, though, our forces will have moved in for the final attack.

Luck be with you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Just make sure you remember to use all of the acceleration gates leading into the deadspace pocket to reach your target. There will probably be a couple defensive perimeters blocking your way to the control tower, so you will have to get by the Navy ships guarding those areas before you proceed to your target.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it in no time. Now please update me on how the investigation is going.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great work once again, {[character]player.name}. But I need you back here urgently for another assignment; something terrible just happened. I'll get you posted once you are ready.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.

messages.mission.briefing.text: After checking our logs, we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy. The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel. I need them transferred to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation; hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the niece of our CEO while she was visiting her uncle in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for an illegal organization called the Darkonnen. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in the mission details.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with a Darkonnen agent in the past; we hope this pirate will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Darkonnen agent and bring him back to me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, I did not say every job would be sunshine and pleasurehalls. Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Darkonnen is an organization that sprung up from rogue elements within the Khanid Kingdom, starting off as a small band of smugglers operating between lawless space and Khanid-controlled territory. They were renowned for their ruthlessness in dealing with their competitors, eliminating a good deal of small-time criminals within the Kingdom, as well as cleverly eluding the local authorities most of the time. A few years ago, their founder and leader, Michelin Adonnis, was captured by Khanid secret police and sentenced to life in prison for various offenses. His arrest caused a slight setback for the outlawed organization, but in the end it turned out to be not enough to halt their inevitable expansion. Today they are a well known pirate/smuggler network who base their operations in numerous systems in Amarr and Khanid space.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No, this does not interest me.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Well done. We will proceed immediately to interrogating the prisoner, so expect some results soon. Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

And don't go anywhere: I have another assignment for you.

localizedName.text: Whispers in the Dark - First Contact (1 of 4)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
So good to see you, {[character]player.name}. I've been on a pretty tight schedule for the past two weeks, ever since we discovered the strange, and increasing, Sansha activity in the system. Our CEO demands an explanation, yet we still don't know enough about the situation to determine what's really going on. And that's where you come in.

Sanshas activity on this scale in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} is unheard of, and quite frankly we aren't well enough prepared at the moment to deal with any major conflict with the Nation. Not only that, but those damned zombies give us the creeps, and news of their appearance around here has sent parts of the populace into a state of panic. People are leaving this station already, making my superiors ... less than content if you know what I mean. We're losing good people because of this unacceptable situation and we need to put an end to it.

The first thing I want you to do is undertake a reconnaisance mission for us into an area where we have witnessed most of the Sanshas activity. We've already lost a few patrols that ventured into this area, so be careful. If you do find any Sanshas ships out there, eliminate them. We don't want any prisoners, interrogating the creatures won't do us any good. Report your findings to me a.s.a.p.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You showed some class out there, {[character]player.name}.  Take your pay and report for your next assignment.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Watch your back out there, {[character]player.name}.  And whatever you do, don't let them take you prisoner, I've heard some mighty frightening stories about what happens to people that are taken alive by those monsters...

localizedName.text: Whispers in the Dark - Lay And Pray (2 of 4)

messages.mission.briefing.text: Because of your successful reconnaissance mission, we've managed to narrow down the location of the main Sanshas activity a bit.  The data that we extracted from your system scanner also revealed to us a few Sanshas ships that were not mentioned in your preliminary report.  It appears to be some sort of convoy, at least one of their ships was clearly an industrial.  Because of this we guess that it may be a routine shipment, meaning that they might get a convoy at regular intervals.  We'd like you to fly out there, preferably with a cloaking device, and lay in wait for any possible sign of another Sansha convoy.  If you do see one, destroy it and bring back the contents of the industrials to me for inspection.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Construction blocks?  I was afraid of that.  This doesn't seem to be a mere smuggling operation, but something much more sinister.  But we still don't know what they are building ... And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

localizedName.text: Whispers in the Dark - The Outpost (4 of 4)

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Magnificent job, {[character]player.name}.  Those Sansha really put up a fight didn't they?  However I believe you've done as much for us as we can possibly expect of you, the Sansha data sheets you brought back with you have confirmed our worst fears, the Sansha's Nation has a fully functional colony inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}!  It will take a massive force to take it out, and we can't expect you to handle a mission like that yet.  Good luck on your future endeavors.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
After reviewing the intel we received from the spy drones which you transferred for us in your last mission, we managed to pinpoint the location of a military outpost they are building in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It appears to be a part of a defensive perimeter that they are setting up around their territory, which has elevated our fears that they have actually managed to erect a large colony inside our solarsystem.

But for now let's keep our sights on the current task, to breach a hole in their defensive wall. We believe that the outpost in question hasn't been fully built, and therefore will be a fairly easy target for you if it's defensive installations aren't complete. Contact with the spy drones was cut off before we could fully analyze the Sansha forces in the area. But one thing's for sure, there will most certainly be guards nearby, and they will have to be dealt with. You will receive a bookmark to the location of the outpost, and your instructions are simple, destroy the habitat of their construction workers. That should slow them down a bit. Good luck.

localizedName.text: Whispers in the Dark - The Spy Drones (3 of 4)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Now that we've established the general location of the Sanshas activity within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, it's actually time to find out exactly what they are building. In your last mission you destroyed one of their construction block transports, but this brings us no closer to finding their base of operations. We've had no luck interrogating the mindless creatures before, and the surveillance teams we have sent to investigate the area have either found nothing or disappeared. This leaves us with very few options. But after brainstorming possible solutions to our problem, I came up with a devious plan.

We have in our possession so called 'spy drones', straight from our science labs, which attach themselves to a nearby ships hull and emits a low frequency signal which is picked up by one of our beacons which are strewn around {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, which in turn sends a high frequency signal to our control tower in {[location]agentStationID.name}.

Now we know that an agent of the Sansha's Nation regularly picks up shipments of Ectoplasm at a certain station near here. If we can place the spy drone into his next shipment, this might allow us to track his ship to its destination.

Our men have placed beacons throughout our constellation, so everything is in place. All you need to do is take these crates filled with ectoplasm, and our spy drones, to the station specified in the mission details, our agents there will take care of the rest. With luck we'll soon know the location of the Sansha base.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job {[character]player.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.briefing.text: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to transport a data chip we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. We need it deciphered, and I happen to know the perfect man for the job, who lives at that station. We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless. By the time you get back, I expect our interrogators will have found some more leads.

We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless. By the time you get back, I expect our interrogators will have found some more leads.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, then... Perhaps you should seek volunteer service with the Sisters of Eve?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to find out who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by a Darkonnen agent and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's niece. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also, the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Darkonnen agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting, which is to take place very soon now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Darkonnen goons at that location. Be quick: I don't know how long they will wait for their contact to arrive.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What?! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's niece executed! Don't bother coming back!!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: My ship is in need of some work, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Good work. I'm surprised, however, that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage. Pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.

Oh, hey, don't you take off just yet. If you're willing, I have another assignment for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Any news on the interrogation of the prisoner I brought to you?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: What?! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's niece executed! Don't bother coming back!!

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - The Flu Outbreak (6 of 10)

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've had a major influenza outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}. Because of it, our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon. We have a lot of personnel here; given the current state of affairs, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicine. I've taken the liberty of ordering the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}; I need you to transport them here.

Please hurry ― our staff is depending on you.

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - The Secret Meeting  (7 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's niece. I'm reluctant to send you, since this may be a trap, but I really have no choice. If I send someone else, though, I could be compromising the investigation. So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission. Be sure to record anything said to you and save it into your ship's database, and then return with it to me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds too risky for me. Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. Be sure to record anything said to you and save it into your ship's database, and then return with it to me.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Very interesting indeed. You've done us a great service, {[character]player.name}. Now let's just hope that these Blood Raider swine can give us the true location of our CEO's niece.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - Defend the Civilian Convoy (8 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: A Blood Raider strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: A Blood Raider strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job out there. Sadly, it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion; while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Blood Raider agents managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get those prisoners back, as we still don't know the location of their base! Let me know when you're ready for another assignment: I need you ASAP.

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - Retrieve the Prisoners (9 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from the Blood Raiders, a few of their agents broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from the Blood Raiders, a few of their agents broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Fantastic! You really showed some skill out there, {[character]player.name}. I'm proud to say I know you. And be sure to come see me again ― I have one more job for you!

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - The Final Battle (10 of 10)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of new evidence that apparently points to the girl being held in a Blood Raider stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our information, she is being held in their chapel and is going to be sacrificed in the near future in one of their bloody rituals. We must see that she is returned to her family safely before those despicable Blood Raider fanatics murder her.

There is a fundamental problem, however; the Blood Raiders are fully aware of our intention to free her and have sent in a fleet of their battleships to guard their outpost. Now, I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the girl, and escaping with your ship intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the chapel. Once you arrive at the final room, all you have to do is destroy the chapel and retrieve the girl from the ejected safety capsule. (All of their chapels have this mechanism in place to save their priests from death should the structure be obliterated.) If we send in a fleet of ships, the Blood Raiders will simply kill her as soon as they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, with a small force, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the girl alive after destroying the chapel, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall, then I will personally make sure the Raider scum pay the price. Good luck.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do my best.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You expect me to go out alone against a virtual armada of battleships, all for some snotty little girl? I expected more of you, {[character]agentID.name}. Be realistic.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Nice work. This victory of yours will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the Blood Raider leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be sacrificed in one of their rituals as punishment ― ha! A fitting end to one of those bloodthirsty maniacs.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's niece is now in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since her capture. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunately this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers, which he hopes you will enjoy.

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - Ambush in the Dark (1 of 10)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will do my best, you can count on that.

messages.mission.timeout.emailheader.text: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. I see that my theory held merit, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members. After we've given them proper trauma counseling, we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.

And don't you leave just yet. I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So what's this important stuff you keep yammering about?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it in no time. Now please update me on how the investigation is going.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great work once again, {[character]player.name}. But I need you back here urgently for another assignment; something terrible just happened. I'll get you posted once you are ready.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.

messages.mission.briefing.text: After checking our logs, we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy. The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel. I need them transferred to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation; hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the granddaughter of our CEO while she was visiting him in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for an illegal organization calling themeselves the "Komni Corporation."

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with this Komni agent in the past; we hope this pirate will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Komni agent and bring him back to me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, I did not say every job would be sunshine and pleasurehalls. Perhaps you are more suited for simple wreck-hauling missions?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No, this does not interest me.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Well done. We will proceed immediately to interrogating the prisoner, so expect some results soon. Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

And don't go anywhere: I have another assignment for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to find out who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by a Komni agent and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's granddaughter. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also, the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Komni agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting, which is to take place very soon now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Komni goons at that location. Be quick: I don't know how long they will wait for their contact to arrive.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I have some other business to attend to, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - The Flu Outbreak (6 of 10)

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've had a major influenza outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}. Because of it, our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon. We have a lot of personnel here; given the current state of affairs, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicine. I've taken the liberty of ordering the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}; I need you to transport them here.

Please hurry ― our staff is depending on you.

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - The Secret Meeting  (7 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's granddaughter. I'm reluctant to send you, since this may be a trap, but I really have no choice. If I send someone else, though, I could be compromising the investigation. So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission. Be sure to record anything said to you and save it into your ship's database, and then return with it to me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds too risky for me. Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}, but I´m outta here.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Masterfully done, {[character]player.name}.  We owe you one.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I'm glad you made your way here, {[character]player.name}. We had an amazing breach of security earlier today when a band of Blood Raider agents managed to infiltrate one of our shipyards and steal some very valuable equipment from its compounds. We've tracked them down to a Blood Raider supply depot in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, where they have set up a defensive perimeter in preparation for an attack. I know this might be a difficult assignment for you, {[character]player.name}, but it's vital that we retrieve the stolen goods from those blood-sucking vermin.

Our spies tell us that the equipment we're looking for is located in one of their storage facilities in the depot, still in its sealed container. Don't hesitate to destroy the structure, in order to retrieve the goods. And you can keep anything extra you find there. Good luck.

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - Defend the Civilian Convoy (8 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: A Guristas strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job out there. Sadly, it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion; while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Gurista scumbags managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get those prisoners back, as we still don't know the location of their base! Let me know when you're ready for another assignment: I need you ASAP.

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - Retrieve the Prisoners (9 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from the Guristas, a few of them broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

Our spies tell us that the equipment we're looking for is located in one of their storage facilities in the depot, still in its sealed container. Don't hesitate to destroy the structure, in order to retrieve the goods. And you can keep anything extra you find there. Good luck.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Amarrians are taken care of ― now, about my reward!

messages.mission.briefing.text: Ah, {[character]player.name}, good to see you. To business. We've just detected a hidden Amarrian reconnaissance outpost nearby. I don't need to explain the threat to you, do I? We must wipe them out before they are able to expand their operations further into our territory. If you can take care of this problem for me, you will be well rewarded.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't do it. It's too hard.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I'll get somebody else on it then.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You disappoint me: I guess I'll have to get someone else in here.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll show them who's boss.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The threat has been eliminated.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
High command asked me to pass this on to you ― they seem to think you're ideal for the job.

We've detected a small Amarrian reconnaissance outpost nearby and would like you to eliminate the threat as fast as possible. We can't allow these Amarrian scum to come near our homes unharassed. Make them pay.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You are not worthy.

messages.mission.briefing.text: For a few weeks now, we've known of a small Amarrian reconnaissance outpost in the system. So far we've left them alone because we wanted to know what they were up to. Now we know. This morning they were joined by a highly respected Amarr general; we are certain he is planning a strike on one of our stations in the system. I will update the coordinates to the mission details in your Opportunity interface: if you can go and bring their plans to a halt - I think you know what I mean - you will be handsomely rewarded.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You have failed us miserably.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I'll find someone else then.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Make haste.

localizedName.text: Guristas Strike - Ambush In The Dark (1 of 10)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I just received news of a very grave incident that just occured in the system {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser which was escorting our CEO, as we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, lacking the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any traces left behind by the pirates, which so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, please search the area for any clues which might help us, and bring any prisoners you manage to acquire back to us for interrogation.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will do my best, you can count on that.

messages.mission.timeout.emailheader.text: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well done, {[character]player.name}.  I see that my theory held merit, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members.  After we've given them proper counceling and trauma relief we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.

localizedName.text: Guristas Strike - Defend The Civilian Convoy (8 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: A Serpentis strike force was spotted entering this system earlier today, wiping out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault!  We received a distress signal, only moments ago, coming from one of our civilian convoys traveling towards a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, it has been attacked by these pirate forces.  Please undock immediately and fly to their rescue, before it's too late!  I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates.  Now hurry!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job out there. But sadly it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion, while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Serpentis agents managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get them back, we still don't know the location of their base! Tell me when you are ready, I need you for another assignment ASAP.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to extract out of him who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by an agent from the Odamian Renegades, a criminal organization which has been making quite a name for itself recently in these parts, and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's niece. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Odamian agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting which is to take place any minute now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Odamian goons at that location. Try to be quick, I don't know how long they will stay there waiting for their contact to arrive.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work.  Im surprised however that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage, pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.

localizedName.text: Guristas Strike - Retrieve The Prisoners (9 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: While we were scrambling to defend our convoys from attacks by the Serpentis, a few of their agents broke into our prison module and managed to escape with the prisoners.  Our interrogation of them was not complete, we still don't know where their base is located, so we are quite desperate to get them back here.  We know where their ships are headed, and we request that you intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system.  This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!
