localizedName.text: Guristas Strike - The Final Battle (10 of 10)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of fresh new evidence, which apparently points to the girl being held in a Serpentis stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our sources she is being held in the Central Hub structure of the base, where she will be executed if their demands aren't met. It is our civic duty to see to it that she is returned to her family safely before those despicable Serpentis villains murder her.

There is a fundamental flaw with our plan however, the Serpentis are fully aware of our intention to free her and have sent in a fleet of their battleships to guard their outpost. Now I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the girl and escaping with your ship, and life, intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the Central Control Hub. The Serpentis fleet guarding it will be expecting a large force of attackers, which will give you the advantage should you fly in there with a fast, agile ship, to avoid direct confrontation. Once you arrive at the final area, all you have to do is destroy the Central Control Hub and retrieve the girl from the ejected safety capsule, all of their Control Hubs have this mechanism to save their high-ranking personnel from death should the structure be obliterated. We hope that they consider the girl important enough to save in this way as well. If not ... well there is not much other choice. If we send in a fleet of ships they will simply kill her when they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the girl alive after destroying the Central Control Hub, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall then I will personally make sure the pirate scum pay the price. Good luck.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text:
Nice work. This will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the Serpentis leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be severely punished by Sarpati for failing in his duties.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's niece is now in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since she was captured. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunate this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers which he hopes you will enjoy.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do my best.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You expect me to go out on a limb for some snotty little girl?  I expected more of you, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect for you.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We need urgent help with intercepting a group of vile kidnappers who just managed to snatch the niece of our CEO while she was visiting her uncle in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for the illegal organization, the Odamian Renegades. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in the mission details.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, as we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with this Odamian agent in the past, who we hope will be able to lead you to him. The only catch is he will most likely require a bit of 'convincing' on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom, once you have extracted the information from the middleman then I expect you to find the Odamian agent and bring him back to me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and pie.  Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Odamian Renegades named themselves after the system where their organization was founded, in the Gallente controlled Placid region.  The founders themselves were mostly made up of adventurers traveling from the Gallente capital system, Luminaire, searching for fame and fortune in the frontier.  There they came into contact with Dakeur Hullan, a charismatic pirate veteran who had been working for the Serpentis organization until an unfortunate incident saw him outlawed from their territory, with a sizeable bounty on his head.  Despite his misfortunes, Dakeur still had numerous contacts throughout the criminal world, both inside Serpentis and Gallente controlled space.  With Dakeurs experience within the underworld of the Gallente Federation and his co-founders surprising piloting skills, the Odamian Renegades quickly garnered a reputation as a powerful and infamous drug smuggling syndicate within the Gallente territories.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No, this does not interest me.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well done.  We will proceed immediately to interrogate the prisoner, expect some results soon.  Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

localizedName.text: Guristas Strike - The Secret Meeting (7 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: Very interesting indeed.  You've done us a good service, {[character]player.name}.  Now let's just hope that these Serpentis scoundrels can reveal the true location of our CEO's niece.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds too risky for me, sorry {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}.  It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's niece.  I'm reluctant to send you, as this may be a trap, but I really have no choice.  If I send someone else I could be compromising the investigation.  So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission.  Upload anything said to you and save it into your ships database, return with it to me.  Do you accept?

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.

messages.mission.briefing.text: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured in your last mission to finish, I'd like you to transport a data chip that we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  We'd like it decyphered and I know of the perfect man for the job, who is residing on that station.  We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless.  When you get back, then hopefully our interrogators will have found some more leads.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well then.  Perhaps you should seek employment with the Servant Sisters of Eve?

localizedName.text: Guristas Strike - The Flu Outbreak (6 of 10)

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We have a major flu outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}.  Because of this our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon.  We have a lot of personnel here, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicines.  I ordered the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and would like you to transport them here.  Please hurry, our staff is depending on you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it in no time.  Now please keep me updated on how the investigation is going.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great work, {[character]player.name}.  But I need you back here urgently for another assignment, something terrible just happened.  I'll get you posted once you are ready.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.

messages.mission.briefing.text: After checking our logs we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy.  The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel.  I need them transfered to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation, hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract out of them the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The outpost is destroyed and the infidels eliminated. You mentioned a reward?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Okay, we have a situation here. A serious situation. A week ago, we detected a small Amarrian presence right next to the ruins of an old military station. Since then, they have been expanding in numbers; yesterday we found out that they have built an outpost. We believe they are trying to retrieve something from the station, something they could use against us.

Go, destroy the outpost and the ships protecting it. You will be well rewarded, I assure you.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This mission is damn near impossible! I can't do it.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Very well, then, pilot. I'll give this to somebody more competent.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Oh, dear! I've just remembered that I have a flan in the oven, so I'm afraid I can't complete this mission in time.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Good work. I'm surprised, however, that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage. Pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.

Oh, hey, don't you take off just yet. If you're willing, I have another assignment for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Any news on the interrogation of the prisoner I brought to you?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: What?! Coward!! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's daughter executed! Don't ever show your face here again!!

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - Retrieve the Prisoners (9 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from those Sansha's Nation pilots, a few of their assault troopers broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from those Sansha's Nation pilots, a few of their assault troopers broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Fantastic! You really showed some skill out there, {[character]player.name}. I'm proud to say I know you. And be sure to come see me again ― I have one more job for you!

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - The Final Battle (10 of 10)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of new evidence that apparently points to our CEO's daughter being held in a Sansha stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our information, she is being held in the base's Central Communication Tower; they will execute her if their leaders' demands aren't met. We must see that she is returned to her family safely before those mindless zombies murder her.

There is a big problem, however; the Sansha leaders are fully aware of our intention to free her, so they've sent in a fleet of battleships to guard their outpost. Now, I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the young woman, and escaping with your ship intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the Communication Tower. Once you arrive at the final room, all you have to do is destroy the tower and retrieve her from the ejected safety capsule. (All of their towers have this mechanism in place to save their leaders from death should the structure be obliterated.) If we send in a fleet of ships, they will simply kill her as soon as they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, with a small force, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the woman alive after destroying the tower, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall, then I will personally make sure the Raider scum pay the price. Good luck.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do my best.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You expect me to go out on a limb for some snotty oligarch's daughter? I mean, ISK is great, sure, but it's not much good if you're not alive to spend it, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect for you.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Nice work. This will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the Sansha leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be severely punished by Sansha for failing in his duties. The Communication Tower also serves as a ‘mother-brain' of sorts for a large portion of the Sansha fleet, with it destroyed their forces will be paralyzed for some time to come.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's niece is now in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since she was captured. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunate this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers which he hopes you will enjoy.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the daughter of our CEO while she was visiting her father in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for the Maru Rebels. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in the mission details.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it just so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with a Maru agent in the past; we hope he will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Maru agent and bring him back to me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and sweetplum pie. Perhaps you are more suited for managing sewer drones?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Maru Rebels were once part of a gang of pirates who turned into a sinister terrorist network claiming to fight for Minmatar freedom. In fact, they're little more a ruthless gang of criminals dealing in the black market, smuggling, and extortion and blackmail, even sometimes working as hired assassins. Their official agenda is to murder as many citizens of the Amarr nations as possible ― i.e., Amarr Empire, Ammatar, and Khanid Kingdom ― hoping to force them to withdraw eventually from historically Minmatar systems currently under Amarr control. The Minmatar Republic leadership has denounced them as being cutthroats and criminals even though they support Republic goals, and has put up a sizable bounty on their leader's head. But even so, the Rebels do maintain some support within the Minmatar Republic, which has allowed them certain freedoms other criminal networks do not have.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No, this does not interest me.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Well done. We will proceed immediately to interrogating the prisoner, so expect some results soon. Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

And don't go anywhere: I have another assignment for you.

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - The Secret Meeting  (7 of 10)

messages.mission.briefing.text: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's daughter. I'm reluctant to send you, since this may be a trap, but I really have no choice. If I send someone else, though, I could be compromising the investigation. So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission. Be sure to record anything said to you and save it into your ship's database, and then return with it to me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds too risky for me, {[character]agentID.name}. I´m out.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Very interesting indeed. Thanks for your good service, {[character]player.name}. Now let's just hope that these monsters will reveal the true location of our CEO's daughter.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.

messages.mission.briefing.text: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to transport a data chip we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. We need it deciphered, and I happen to know the perfect man for the job, who lives at that station. We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless. By the time you get back, I expect our interrogators will have found some more leads.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Oh, fair enough. Perhaps kitchen duty would be more to your liking?

localizedName.text: Kidnappers Strike - The Flu Outbreak (6 of 10)

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've had a major influenza outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}. Because of it, our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon. We have a lot of personnel here; given the current state of affairs, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicine. I've taken the liberty of ordering the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}; I need you to transport them here.

Please hurry ― our staff is depending on you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it in no time. Now please update me on how the investigation is going.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great work once again, {[character]player.name}. But I need you back here urgently for another assignment; something terrible just happened. I'll get you posted once you are ready.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.

messages.mission.briefing.text: After checking our logs, we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy. The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel. I need them transferred to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation; hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.

localizedName.text: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Unsuspecting Traveler (1 of 9)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I'm happy to announce that we just spotted a transport ship owned by the Archaeological Agency of Caille University not far from a stargate in this system. It is being escorted by some rather menacing Navy ships, and therefore we've been a bit wary to attack it. I'm sure it got lost and took a wrong jump somewhere along its travel route, no sane captain of a civilian transport ship would travel through these parts on purpose.

You probably guessed it but I'd like you to do the dirty work. Fly off to their current location and eliminate the escort. If the transport freighter puts up a fight then destroy it as well, but try to bring back as many of its passengers as you can. These civilian transport ships can be a goldmine for those in the kidnapping / ransom business, if you know what I mean. I'm sure the Gallenteans will pay a handsome amount of ISK for their precious archaeologists, if taken alive.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Count me in.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  I see you managed to bring back at least a few dozen of the passengers and crew members, now it's our turn to get them sorted out, to see who we sell to the slavers and who's worth keeping for ransom.  Ah what a fun job this is!  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good.  You will be adequately rewarded for your efforts when you get back of course.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
This one was issued from high command, specifically to be assigned to you.

Recently we have been picking up signals from an old ship wreckage nearby. We send a scout to go check it out and he reported a large Serpentis presence, led by a high-ranking colonel. They seem to be looting the wreckage and creating some sort of modified Megathron battleship. If you could go and eliminate this threat, we will reward you nicely.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: The Federation is disappointed.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm expecting you back alive.

localizedName.text: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Identification (2 of 9)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Welcome back {[character]player.name}. I'm excited here, we're pretty sure that the passengers you captured in a previous mission are of a very wealthy or important family. We can't say for certain yet, but there's something about them ...

Anyway, I'd like you to transfer a sample of their DNA to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where Zunbar Alefon, our expert on Gallentean internal affairs, is located. Hopefully he will be able to find a match for them in his gigantic DNA database and give us some information on their backgrounds. And don't tell ANYONE what you're up to, I'd rather keep a low profile on this for the time being, the fewer members of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} that know about this the better.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.

localizedName.text: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Bounty Hunter (3 of 9)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The morning prison guard shift met with a grisly scene.  All of the guards on the 5th deck on the last shift had been brutally murdered and some of the prison cells had been forcibly opened.  2 of the prisoners that you captured in a previous mission were missing.  We are quite certain that this was the work of a bounty hunter, as he obviously intended to rescue these specific prisoners.  We immediately banned all craft from leaving the station, but it was too late.  However we have compiled a list of those who left the station this morning and we've narrowed it down to 3 suspects.  We know the location of each of them, they haven't managed to leave the system yet.  I'll upload their locations one by one, do whatever it takes to bring back those prisoners!

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and pie.  Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well done.  I'll make sure the prisoners are kept at a more secure location this time, I've had enough of these screw ups.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Tsk, tsk.  Very well, I shall have to find some other lackey to do my work for me.

localizedName.text: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Results (4 of 9)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I received a response from Zunbar Alefon, the person that was supposed to identify the prisoners that you captured in a previous mission. Apparently, one of them is a very famous Gallente archaeologist, Karzath Pinazi, distantly related to Senator Tarek Pinazi! This is an incredible stroke of fortune for us, capturing a relative of a Gallente senator and famous icon is almost unheard of. I've no doubt that he will get us a mighty fine ransom. The only bad news is that this will probably bring a lot of bounty hunters into our backyard ... but hey, we have you to deal with that problem.

Now, on to your assignment. I need you to go to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} with a data chip that I'll have dropped off into your hangar. This chip contains all of our demands towards the Gallente Federation in exchange for the release of the prisoners. In it, we also threaten them with the slaying of their dear archaeologist team if they dare to launch a full scale assault on our station. I'm pretty sure that will keep them at bay for the time being.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well then.  Perhaps you should seek employment with the Servant Sisters of Eve?

localizedName.text: The Gallente Archaeologist - Sudden Strike (5 of 9)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
After you delivered the data chip in your last mission, I've been flooded with reports of Gallente Navy sightings in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. A number of our gangs have been wiped out, and it's not considered safe anymore for a pirate to venture too far out into space in these parts. I'm positive that this new offensive is the direct result of the data chip we sent falling into the hands of the Navy generals. They know what we're up to and it's only a matter of time before the Gallente media get a hold of the story.

I didn't expect the Navy to venture this close to our station, after all we've threatened to kill the prisoners. But they seem intent on keeping their distance, this is just a ploy of theirs to frighten us. But by disrupting our trade routes and ambushing our patrols in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, all they accomplish is raising the price on our demands.

I want you to head out into the outer reaches of this system and eliminate 4 Navy groups. After we have given them the taste of defeat, then it will be time to deliver our new demands. Off you go.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I see.  Well, perhaps you will be of some use next time.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll be off immediately.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: My ship is in need of repairs, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Hit em hard, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your attack on the Navy groups has had unforeseeable consequences.  Instead of backing off, they have taken their offensive to another level.  We've noticed an unusually large concentration of their ships at a location within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and a construction freight or two heading their way.  We're quite sure they are planning on building something there, probably a military outpost from which they intend to launch a major offensive against this station.  We can't let them start building that outpost!  I want you to personally see to it that their convoy and all of the ships defending the area are destroyed immediately.

localizedName.text: The Gallente Archaeologist - The New Demands (7 of 9)

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will do it.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your last strike against the Navy forces in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} sent them into a disarray.  That should keep them in check for a day or two.  Meanwhile, I'd like you to bring our new demands to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  This time they better comply, or we might just go through with all of our threats. messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds too risky for me.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Nice job mate.  Now let's keep our fingers crossed and hope those bastards cave in to our threats.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

localizedName.text: The Gallente Archaeologist - Final Attempt (8 of 9)

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'm glad you're back {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente Navy have gone mad!  They've sent an entire fleet of ships to attack this station.  They must be utterly insane, if even one of them steps foot in here the prisoners heads will roll!  I need you to undock at once and meet the Navy head on before they get within firing range of the station, bring everyone you can, I suspect you'll need all the help you can get.  You'll be supplied with a bookmark of course, now get moving!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I'm glad you're back {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente Navy have gone mad!  They've sent an entire fleet of ships to attack this station. messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Not bad, {[character]player.name}.  But this outrageous attack on our stronghold will not go unpunished.  I have personally ordered the execution of all of the prisoners save our prized possession, Karzath Pinazi.  The picture of the beheadings will be sent straight to the Gallente media.  This should teach them a lesson.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

localizedName.text: The Gallente Archaeologist - The Conclusion (9 of 9)

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done well, {[character]player.name}.  {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} will not forget this.  The piece of Neophite that I received in exchange for the prisoner will fetch me an absurd price on the black market.  And the look on the faces of the Gallente agents who picked him up, after they rummaged through the cargo container ... simply priceless!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Rejoice, {[character]player.name}, the Federation have finally caved in. They have vowed to meet our demands once the prisoner and his cargo have been transferred safely to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where their agents will pick it up. Ironically enough, we have no idea what cargo they were jammering about, everything that was on board the cargo ship containing the archeologists you captured originally was destroyed along with the ship. No wonder they were so adamant at retrieving whatever it was they were after. Karzath Nuoki was only a smokescreen, whatever he was transporting towards Gallente space was extremely valuable. It's unfortunate we will never find out what it was, as I'm sure you never saw anything suspicious in the wreckage of the cargo ship other than the stranded archeologists ... but just to be on the safe side, I had some of my men search your hangar just in case you have been less than honest with us. No hard feelings I hope.

And as you probably guessed, I want you to do the honors of transporting the prisoner to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where our agents will hand him along with a cargo container filled with various junk to our Gallente 'friends'. Once this final assignment has been completed, I ... err we will be able to enjoy the fruits of our hard work. In other words, I'll be rich!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I need work.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Republic needs you! Communications have been down all day, I need you to go and get me today's status reports, I have a feeling something big is going to happen today.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The Republic needs you! Communications have been down all day, I need you to go and get me today's status reports, I have a feeling something big is going to happen today.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm sorry, it's too hard, I can't do it.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You disappoint me soldier.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Those reports you just delivered to me were of great importance, it seems as though the Amarrians have made a huge mistake and want us to correct it for them. Before I can tell you more I need you to pass this info on to a nearby agent.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Those messages you delivered were essential, thank you. The Amarrians screwed up and want us to clean up their mess, what a day.

One of their generals has gone crazy. He ignored orders, broke communications with his commanding officers and then disappeared into thin air. They believe he might be heading our way, apparently he thinks an all-out war has started and wants to be a part of it. Anyway I'll have someone take care of the rest, thank you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Any more news on the Amarr troubles?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Some Amarr officer has gone crazy - he ignored orders, broke communications with his commanding officers, commandeered an Imperial Navy vessel, and then disappeared. Our intel says he's headed our way: apparently he's not willing to let freelance capsuleers handle the fight, and instead wants to be a part of it himself.

Fix this little problem for us and you will be well rewarded.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I want nothing to do with this.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I will give this to somebody more competent.

localizedName.text: The Numon Claim - First Attack (1 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A minor Amarrian noble has claimed ownership of a sizable portion of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, claiming one of his ancestors was given this part of space as a reward for his ancestor's duties to the emperor. The area includes a couple of planets, their satellites, and an asteroid field. Anyway, this guy has now sent us an official warning that any aggression against "his" assets will be met with an iron fist.

He completely underestimates our strength in the region, believing his small mercenary force sufficient to scare us off. Fly to the fool's position and destroy the Control Tower he's holding out there, along with the mercenary forces defending him. Let's put this idiot out of his misery.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We have a rather comical situation on our hands, {[character]player.name}. A foolhardy Amarrian noble named Kazar Numon has claimed ownership of a sizable portion of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, claiming one of his ancestors was given this part of space as a reward for his duties to the emperor. Turns out that, many centuries ago, {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} had just recently been discovered by an Amarrian exploration team, which apparently included a long-distant relative of his. The area includes a couple of planets, their satellites, and an asteroid field. Anyway, this guy has now sent us an official warning that any aggression against "his" assets will be met with an iron fist.

I want you to put this goofball out of his misery, {[character]player.name}. He completely underestimates our strength in the region, believing that his small mercenary force will scare us off. Fly to their position where they have set up a small outpost and destroy its Control Tower, along with the mercenary forces defending it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Nice work. He may have a clone somewhere, being a noble, but with his mercenary force eliminated, I'm sure Kazar will think twice before attempting anything like this again within our territory.

And don't you leave just yet: I have another assignment waiting for you!

localizedName.text: The Numon Claim - Imperial Intervention (3 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Amarr Empress has publicly declined to intervene officially in the territorial dispute between us and Kazar Numon. Sadly, she also expressly has not forbidden other Amarr Holders from acting privately in this matter.

As a result, the Sarum lords who originally campaigned for intervention have ordered an outlying fleet of Imperial Navy ships to aid Numon anyway. They are led by an Imperial Fleet Commander who's part of House Sarum, one Ishtai Sarum. We need to prevent him from moving his fleet into defensive positions around the area claimed by Numon. To do this, we must execute a number of hit-and-run attacks while they move through our territory.

We've located what seems to be a reconnaissance team of theirs, en route to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They are currently flying through {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, and we'd like you to intercept them immediately.

Leave no survivors - we don't want them reporting anything back to their commander.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I have some good and some bad news, {[character]player.name}. The good news is that the Amarr Empress has publicly declined to intervene officially in the territorial dispute between us and Kazar Numon. The bad news is that she also expressly has not forbidden other Amarr Holders from acting privately in this matter. It's a political game she's playing, and she plays it well.

As a result, the Sarum lords who originally campaigned for intervention have ordered an outlying fleet of Imperial Navy ships to aid Numon anyway. They are led by an Imperial Fleet Commander who's part of House Sarum, one Ishtai Sarum. We need to prevent him from moving his fleet into defensive positions around the area claimed by Numon. To do this, we must execute a number of hit-and-run attacks while they move through our territory.

We've located what seems to be a reconnaissance team of theirs, en route to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They are currently flying through {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, and we'd like you to intercept them immediately.

Leave no survivors - we don't want them reporting anything back to their commander.

localizedName.text: The Numon Claim - Ruffled Feathers (2 of 5)

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll fetch that data chip for you in no time.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Your successful attack on the Numon mercenary outpost seems to be sitting badly with certain factions in the Amarr Empire. A few members of the Sarum family have taken up Kazar's cause, and they've already started mobilizing their personal fleets to make a trip here to get involved in our little territorial dispute.

We've already sent out scan probes to collect data on any Imperial activity in the {[location]agentRegionID.name} region. This data will be stored in a computer disc which I expect you to fetch for me at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. Once we retrieve this data we will have a better picture of what we might be up against. But we still have our fingers crossed that this fiasco will die down before Empress Catiz herself gets involved.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
There has been an unfortunate turn of events. Your successful attack on the Numon mercenary outpost seems to be sitting badly with certain factions within the Amarr Empire. A few high-ranking members of the Sarum family have taken up Kazar's cause directly to the Empress, and they've already started mobilizing their personal fleets to make a trip here to get involved in our little territorial dispute.

We've already sent out scan probes to collect data on any Imperial activity in the {[location]agentRegionID.name} region. This data will be stored in a computer disc which I expect you to fetch for me at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. Once we retrieve this data we will have a better picture of what we might be up against. But we still have our fingers crossed that this fiasco will die down before Empress Catiz herself gets involved.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You disappoint both me and the Republic, shame on you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't care, give me something else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't do it, it's too hard!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't fail me now.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Seems like those Amarrians you took out were just scouts, we're not quite sure where this fugitive is hiding. What we do know is the presence of another similar nearby scout outpost. Perhaps if you went there you could get some information out of them as to the whereabouts of our target. We need to find him as soon as possible, before he is able to strike.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I am proud of you, nice work.

localizedName.text: The Numon Claim - Split The Fleet (4 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Our surveillance teams have reported a large force of Imperial Navy ships moving toward {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. If we let them all arrive safely at their destination, we will have a very difficult fight on our hands: We need to weaken them before they have a chance to settle in and fortify themselves at their destination.

Part of their fleet is currently in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. Their plan seems to be to move slowly between deadspace areas to prevent our heavy artillery from locking on to them. I want you to conduct an attack on the couple of squadrons that have already arrived at that deadspace pocket; I will provide you with bookmarks to the exact location.

Speed is crucial for your success here. You need to strike them hard and fast and get out of there before they know what hit them. Tarry too long, and you'll have the entire fleet on you.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our surveillance teams have reported another large force of Imperial Navy ships moving through {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, probably heading toward {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. If we let them all arrive safely at their destination, we will have a very difficult fight on our hands: We need to weaken their forces before they have a chance to settle in and fortify themselves at their destination.

A part of their fleet is currently amassed in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. Their plan seems to be to move slowly between deadspace areas to prevent our heavy artillery from locking on to them. I want you to conduct an attack on the couple of squadrons that have already arrived at that deadspace pocket; I will provide you with bookmarks to the exact location.

Speed is crucial for your success here. You need to strike them hard and fast and get out of there before they know what hit them. Tarry too long, and you'll have the entire fleet on your ass.

Good luck.

localizedName.text: The Numon Claim - Last Stand (5 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Our guerrilla tactics have worked well. The remainder of the Amarr fleet has reached its destination, but they are substantially weakened. Now it's time to launch our final attack.

The remaining forces have started to rebuild the defensive perimeter around the Numon claim. The remnants of Numon's mercenary force guards the area now, along with the partial Navy fleet.

Best, though, is the fact that Kazar, head of House Numon, has apparently decided to risk his own hide to defend his precious section of space. Killing him will be the icing on the cake for us. Your task is simple, {[character]player.name}. Attack the Numon and Amarr forces head on, and obliterate them completely. Leave no survivors.

But do bring me Numon's head. It will make a nice souvenir.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our guerrilla tactics have worked wonderfully, {[character]player.name}. The remainder of the Amarr fleet has reached its destination, but they are substantially weakened. Some were destroyed in your attacks, some were destroyed by other pirate marauders, and, subsequently, some deserted. Now it's time to launch our final attack.

The remaining forces have started to rebuild the defensive perimeter around the territory the Numon family claimed for themselves. The remnants of Numon's mercenary force guards the area now, along with the partial Navy fleet. Kazar, head of House Numon, has apparently decided to risk his own hide to defend his precious section of space. Killing him again will be the icing on the cake for us.

Your task is simple, {[character]player.name}. Attack the Numon and Amarr forces head on, and obliterate them completely. Leave no survivors - but do bring me Numon's head. It will make a nice souvenir.

localizedName.text: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - Nab The Consumer Electronics! (1 of 6)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I've got a lucrative mission for you this time, {[character]player.name}. I need a convoy taken out and looted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Sounds rather standard, but before you go running off I'd like to explain the situation a bit.

There is a merchant corporation near here, which is basically a small offshoot of the Caldari mega-corporation Sukuuvestaa, who own the vast majority of it's shares. These Sukuuvestaa merchants like to transport all sorts of goods throughout the {[location]agentRegionID.name} region, and regularly pay tribute to us for protection. But sadly sometimes their cargo is simply too enticing.

This convoy is loaded with Caldari consumer electronics, and only guarded with the standard Sukuuvestaa hired mercenary ships, as the Caldari Navy do not frequent these parts. You can't imagine how eager some of the people in these parts are at getting these things. And the price they are willing to pay ... well, it's something that we simply can't pass up so easily. For that reason I want the convoy destroyed and looted, and make sure you are discreet. I don't want any witnesses at the scene to survive, nor any equipment that might record what transpired. As long as the Caldari do not know who attacked their ships, the most they will probably do is send more combat ships with the next convoy.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

localizedName.text: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - The Neophyte (2 of 6)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Greetings, {[character]player.name}. Because of the success in your previous mission, my superiors have one extra task for you. The Sukuuvestaa seem to be completely oblivious as to who attacked their last convoy through this area, and have accepted their loss as merely a freak occurrence. A most fortunate turn of events for us, but there is just one more target that we simply cannot let pass through our grasp. Our cargo scanners in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} spotted some extremely expensive material in one of the latest Sukuuvestaa convoys traveling through {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. We simply must get our hands on that Neophyte, I don't care how many ships it takes. Just do it.

I'll supply you with a bookmark to the current location of the convoy. It seems to have stopped in a deadspace area in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, perhaps for repairs. Strike it hard and fast with everything you got, and bring me that Neophyte! Don't bother showing your face back here before the task is complete!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Interesting. This was all a trap set up by the Sukuuvestaa to find out who was behind the attack on the consumer electronics convoy earlier. Well, it was worth it. This piece of Neophyte will fetch us a fortune! And of course we have you, {[character]player.name}, to deal with any Caldari Navy threat that might materialize as a result. And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Now that we have the Neophyte, I need it transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Don't ask why, just do it.

Watch out for any Navy vessels on the way. Now that they know who was behind the latest heist, they're bound to be on the lookout for any ship loyal to {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}.

localizedName.text: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - In Defense (4 of 6)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have an urgent task for you this time, {[character]player.name}. The Caldari Navy have started a campaign of revenge attacks on our assets here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. They don't have the manpower to launch a full scale assault on us, but they do have various agents here and there setting up booby traps for our ships. This escapade is becoming a tad expensive, so we need to do something before it gets out of hand.

The first thing I want you to do is fly to one of our supply depots in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The Caldari have set up a trap there for any incoming ships, which has already cost us a fortune. Destroy the Caldari forces manning the guns, then report back to me. And stay away from our supply depot, they don't take kindly to un-invited visitors, ally or not.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work, that should put a dent in their plans.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

localizedName.text: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - The Caldari Agent (5 of 6)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Caldari Navy continue to harass us. They are famous for overreacting when it comes to minor incidents involving their fellow corporations. But I'm confident this will die down after you have completed your next mission.

The Caldari have sent a high profile agent of theirs, Whelan Machorin into {[location]agentConstellationID.name} to conduct a campaign of terror against our people. He must be stopped, at all costs. Kill him and bring me his head, which I will have stuck on a stake for all our men to view at their pleasure.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Caldari Navy continue to harass us. They are famous for overreacting when it comes to minor incidents involving their fellow corporations. But I'm confident this will die down after you have completed your next mission.

The Caldari have sent a high profile agent of theirs, Whelan Machorin into {[location]agentConstellationID.name} to conduct a campaign of terror against our people. He must be stopped, at all costs. Kill him and bring me his head, which I will have stuck on a stake for all our men to view at their pleasure.

localizedName.text: The Sukuuvestaa Incident - The Constellation Scanner (6 of 6)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
From data we've collected, the Caldari Navy forces have set up some kind of constellation scanner in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} to monitor our activities in preparation for a sneak attack. We believe this is what has allowed them to use their small force in these areas so effectively. This also allows them to more effectively monitor the movements of the Caldari convoys flying through here and respond faster to any attacks.

I want you to destroy this high-tech telescope of theirs. It will be heavily guarded, so this is no small task for even you, {[character]player.name}. Once you have completed your mission, we will have dealt a devastating blow to the Caldari Navy plans in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, which I doubt they will recover from anytime soon.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
From data we've collected, the Caldari Navy forces have set up some kind of constellation scanner in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} to monitor our activities in preparation for a sneak attack. Once you have completed your mission, we will have dealt a devastating blow to the Caldari Navy plans in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, which I doubt they will recover from anytime soon.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Not a problem, I'll take care of it.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We have a problem, for the past few weeks the Blood Raiders have been growing increasingly aggressive. They seem to have set up a small base nearby and every few days our convoys, miners and even military personel get attacked. This structure also serves as sacrifical grounds for the Covenant and they believe it to be holy, hence extremely tight security.

My superiors told me to find somebody competent to deal with the threat, and that's why I'm asking you. I suggest you find someone to help you with this, as I fear you will not return should you go alone.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not risking myself for that.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Make haste, before they kill even more innocents!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have an assignment for you this time that you'll probably enjoy, {[character]player.name}. Some of our fighters recently stumbled upon a rogue settlement in a cluttering of asteroids in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. The settlers are of Minmatar origin, and apparently are here to steal some of our precious arkonor ore. We can't have that, now can we ...

You have been entrusted with the task of eliminating these pests. We know that they have a small militia guarding their fledgling colony, but that should be no trouble for an experienced vet as yourself.

Once you have destroyed the settlement, capture any survivors and bring them to me. They'll fetch us a decent price on the black market, alive or dead.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I have an assignment for you this time that you'll probably enjoy, {[character]player.name}. messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Hmmph, the prisoners you captured look a bit scrawny to me.  I guess they must have evacuated the old and young first, which seem to be the only ones who survived the destruction of their colony.  We'll have to make due ... but this is a slight disappointment nonetheless.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

localizedName.text: Nomads - Request From The Republic (2 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text: We have been informed by agents of the Minmatar Republic that they have sent an encoded data disc to {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, with information that must be transported to our leaders at all cost.  I have personally taken it upon me to investigate this information, and I'd like you to get the disc for me.  A simple task, just don't lose it on your way back, or I'll have your head delivered to me on a silver platter!  Understand?!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: We have been informed by agents of the Minmatar Republic that they have sent an encoded data disc to {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}, with information that must be transported to our leaders at all cost.  I have personally taken it upon me to investigate this information, and I'd like you to get the disc for me.  A simple task, just don't lose it on your way back, or I'll have your head delivered to me on a silver platter!  Understand?!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work.  I'll take a look at the disc's contents immediately.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
After decyphering the data disc, we learned that the Minmatar Republic have issued a direct threat against us in retaliation for our attack on the colony in a recent mission of yours, {[character]player.name}. They claim there will be dire consequences if we do not hand over the prisoners you captured. Unfortunately I've already had these prisoners executed and either turned into biomass or sold their organs, so we have no option but to decline their request.

Now we have to prepare for their attack. Reports have indicated that 3 Fleet squadrons have entered our territory, probably heading to where they believe the captives are being held. We must prevent them from reaching their destination in full force.

One of our spies alerted us to an old secret military installation in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, guarded by Minmatar ships, which contains a large stockpile of weapons and ship modules. Apparently this was normally used by Minmatar Freedom Fighters to resupply their fighter ships after successfull attacks against our slave pens and drug convoys. This armory of theirs must be destroyed, before they can utilize it in their military offensive. Do this for me and you shall be well rewarded.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: The destruction of the Minmatar armory should be a serious blow for any long-term military offensive in the area.  Keep up the good work, {[character]player.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Your last attack on the Minmatar armory seems to have missed one of the targets that I hoped would be there. Yaekun Ogdin is a long-time enemy of ours, and self proclaimed 'freedom fighter'. His vicious attacks on our slave traders has resulted in a huge loss of revenue. To top it off, he obliterated at least five of our major drug convoys in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} in retaliation for our attack on the Minmatar settlement.

I have coordinates to Yaekun's other hideout, in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. If you find him there, show no mercy.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will take care of these Minmatar dogs, you have my word {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Minmatar squadrons have arrived in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, and they mean business. We've been avoiding them thus far, but we can't ignore the threat they pose any longer. We aren't aware of their destination, but our spies have managed to locate them in a remote deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. Apparently they've been moving through deadspace to escape detection and our long-range artillery, although it would be foolish of them to expect to remain completely undetected in our backyard.

There is not much that I can tell you about their forces, other than the fact their commander is a seasoned veteran of the Minmatar Fleet. I am not familiar with their combat ability, and therefore I would advise you to hit them with everything you have. Do not underestimate them, bring everyone you can muster with you. This is no small task, even for you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You never cease to amaze me, {[character]player.name}. This victory of yours will send a powerful message to the Republic, their Fleet has no business in these parts. As long as we can keep our territory free of military threat, our people will prosper.

I bid you farewell, I have no need of further assistance ... for the time being.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I like your enthusiasm, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It's those damned rogue drones again! They never seem to get enough!
This time it's big. Two of our main mining facilities in the system have been completely overrun by rogue drones. If you can go clear them out we can save some of the miners and perhaps even the facilities themselves. Please don't fail me on this one. Those facilities provide a large portion of both our incomes and it would be a big loss to both of us if they were lost

localizedName.text: A Mad Scientist's Dream - Payment (1 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Good of you to stop by, {[character]player.name}! And you couldn't have chosen a better time to show up ― I've got some things that need to be taken care of, and you seem like the perfect pilot for the job.

It has been my goal for the past two decades to terraform this beautiful planet, Otomainen V, which we locals call Oshuron. Its temperature is extremely hostile to human life at present, but I believe its position in the solar system and its abundant supply of frozen H20 and CO2 makes it perfect for terraforming. I've even come to the conclusion that scientists residing in this once prosperous community here, in Rush Town, had plans to start the terraforming themselves, but never got around to it before the exodus.

To start the process, I need to acquire a form of extremely simple microorganism that has the ability to survive the terrible conditions on the icy planet. I've located a number of hot springs far beneath the surface that are ideal for harvesting microorganisms, and I believe they will eventually cause a chain reaction on the planet that will lead to a thickening of the atmosphere and thence to global warming.

Now, I´m sure you´re thinking, "Where do I fit into your marvelous scheme?" Well, all I need you to do is bring this stack of sealed containers, filled with old goods I scavenged from the ruins in the area, to an acquaintance of mine at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. Once that task is complete, I will receive a passcard to a stash of viral agents that have been genetically modified to withstand extreme temperatures, which is exactly what I need to start the terraformation process. But enough of that.

Finish your first task and then I will tell you what to do next. Just don't lose the passcard!!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent! Now make sure you have Tsuna's passcard in your possession before your next assignment. You'll need it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Oh, and if you're on time, I might even give you some ISK for your troubles!

localizedName.text: A Mad Scientist's Dream - Simple Microorganisms (2 of 5)

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Infiltrate Tsuna Qayse's compound in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} and retrieve the potent viral agents, then bring them to {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Alright, now that we have the passcard, it's time to get the goods. The viral agents that I need are located in a small secluded area near our moon, guarded by Mordu's ships. The Legionnaires were hired by Tsuna Qayse, an obnoxiously wealthy Caldari State citizen who happens to be a major shareholder in the Nugoeihuvi Corporation. She hired the mercenaries to protect her assets, which include the viral agents you are to retrieve for me. My source within the Mordu's Legion ― the same person who provided us with the passcard ― tells me Qayse intends to sell the viral agents on the black market. Unfortunately I don't have the kind of money she's asking for, but that's where you come in.

I want you to fly to her compound in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} and retrieve the stash. You might encounter some resistance from Mordu's guards within the complex, but just try avoiding any direct confrontation. The viral agents are located in a secure location within a high-tech science laboratory in the first area of the complex. The passcard will get you through the acceleration gate.

When you find the science labs, destroy them and retrieve the viral agents. They won't be harmed in the explosion, as they are protected by a safety evacuation system, according to my source. Find the ejected container after the labs have been obliterated, and grab them. Bring them back to me immediately, and just ignore the Legionnaires who may attack you as you attempt to destroy the science labs. Sounds simple, doesn't it!?

You'll be well rewarded for your efforts.

Magnificent! I just can't wait to test my theory...!

Now, don't you look at me like that. I never said my plan was foolproof. I've only done, er, preliminary calculations on the effects these viral agents will have on the planet, true ... but it's worth a try! And if this works, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will make a fortune, and maybe I'll be able to redeem myself within the scientific community!

Oh, and don't you leave just yet ― I have another assignment waiting for you.

localizedName.text: A Mad Scientist's Dream - Transportation (3 of 5)

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get the shuttle here in a jiffy.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What else do you need to complete your project, {[character]agentID.name}?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Wonderful! However, now that I have the viral agents, I need a way to transport them down to the planet's surface. I'd like a small ship, one that´s easy to fly and can maneuver handily in the harsh atmosphere of the planet. A shuttle will do nicely. I only know how to fly the Caldari one, so you'll have to bring me that specific type.

Don't tarry, my life's work depends on this!

localizedName.text: A Mad Scientist's Dream - The Drill (4 of 5)

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Use the acceleration gate to get to Lephny's mining outpost and obtain the drill parts. After you've found them, bring them to {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Alright, now that I have the shuttle, there's just one more thing I need before I can get started. To infest the hot springs with these microorganisms, I will need to get to them through an enormous ice sheet. The only way to do that is to have an extremely powerful drill. And I know just the place to acquire one. Well, actually, four.

Jorek Lephny is an old mining tycoon who has been operating in the asteroid belts and moon orbiting Otomainen V for quite some time. The old coot has a mining outpost equipped with a hoard of high-tech drilling equipment, among other things. These drills should do the trick for me, but I need at least four of them in case of breakage or malfunction, which is quite likely due to the scope of the task at hand. The only problem is this: Lephny is extremely paranoid, and we had a falling out of sorts a few years back when I, er, borrowed some of his minerals to construct my lab equipment. He has also had to deal with many pirate attacks through the years and, as a consequence, recently hired a seasoned mercenary veteran from the Mordu's Legion to protect his assets. This mercenary operates a battleship, and he might pose some problems for you if Lephny refuses to hand over the drilling parts willingly.

You will find Lephny's mining outpost in a small asteroid belt near here. There is an acceleration gate close by, inside Rush Town, which will send you to it. Once there, use any means necessary to get those drilling parts! They are located inside the mining outpost itself. Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Now that I have the drill parts, it's just a matter of assembling them and getting to work! I can't wait! And don't you leave just yet: I have another assignment waiting for you!

localizedName.text: A Mad Scientist's Dream - Last Hindrance (5 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I am now on the verge of starting my project, but there is one last hindrance to be eliminated. There is a suspicious-looking craft hovering by a lone rock formation near here. I've tried hailing it, but I get no response. The ship is registered to Ratei Jezzor, whom I have never seen before in these parts. I'm convinced he is an agent working for Caldari Customs, here to spy on us.

I'd like you to take care of him for me, {[character]player.name}. This task will be the last one I give you, I am sure, before I'm on my way into the great annals of history. Just make certain he doesn't bother me when I make my descent to the planet. My life's work depends upon it!

When you finish this final job, you will have done me a great service that I can probably never repay in full. But I hope you'll like my gift ― it's an ultra-rare mineral that I scavenged from one of the ruins here in Rush Town. I have no use for it, but you might.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Ratei will bother you no more, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Destroy Ratei Jezzor's ship and bring his insignia to {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I hope you know what I meant when I said, "Take care of him"...

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Excellent! Now everything is in place for this historic moment. I can just smell the sweet scent of success! Once the icy blue planet has turned green, my pesky colleagues will be forced to admit they were wrong about me.

Nyahahahaaaaa!

localizedName.text: Lost Love - Manchura The Pirate (1 of 3)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
So ... tired. Michi has been holed up here for longer than he can remember ... and he won't leave until his broken heart has been mended ... his lost love must be returned! Old Michi won't rest until he has found the truth! Been digging up these old ruins for years, but her body is nowhere in sight. Dead she is, Old Michi thought. Dead after those blasted Guristas scoundrels attacked the remnants of this once prosperous community. Dead after the metal walls of these beastly stations caved in from the assault.

But then Old Michi stumbles upon an old pirate, in the Guristas stronghold of Otomainen, that he remembers from his younger years. A devilish man, who had a fancy for Old Michi's lost love he did. This troublesome pirate scoffed at Old Michi he did, and claimed his lost love was still alive! But reveal her location he did not. Old Michi will pay handsomely for that information. Bring it to Old Michi and you'll make him a happy man!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Ok, I found and destroyed this Guristas goon called Manchura.  He dropped a data chip with some logs stored inside, I hope this will help you in your search.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: All right all right, I'll help you out you crazy old coot.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Reports indicate that Manchura was last sighted in the Otomainen system.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Old Michi thanks you from the bottom of his heart!  This information should lead straight to lost love!  Please stay and help Old Michi finish his search ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Quickly now ... Old Michi can't wait much longer.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I found Wei.  Now where's my money, you old coot?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Now that Old Michi has the location of his lost love, {[character]player.name} needs to find her! ... Wei was the light of Michi's life, back when he had a reason to live ... she was the cornerstone of his existance ... lost so long ago.  But now he has a chance of regaining that precious lost love, and reclaiming what was lost to him so long ago ... the logs you retrieved indicate that she is being held prisoner at a Guristas base in an asteroid belt in this very system ... you must find her, and bring her back to Old Michi.  Do this quickly, the end draws near for poor Michi ...

Do this quickly, the end draws near for poor Michi ...

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Michi is eternally grateful to {[character]player.name} for completing such a difficult task!  Wei seems shocked at meeting Michi after so long, but he is sure that she will come to appreciate him before long.  Michi is a happy man indeed!  Take your reward, you've earned it!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Michi very thankful for your willingness to help ... very thankful indeed.
Michi will visit Wei from time to time, don't worry!  She will be well taken care of, and hopefully someday regain her happiness.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've delivered the woman to the health clinic like you asked.  She seemed pretty worked up over this whole ordeal, as if she was being held against her will, but that's none of my business.  Now hand over the reward, before I get too trigger happy.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Now that Michi and Wei have been reunited at long last, Michi has some worries ... Wei seems to have been brain washed by the Guristas scoundrels, she even thinks Michi is crazy!  Wei needs to come to her senses, and Michi has lost all hope of convincing her himself.  Therefore Old Michi has one final task for {[character]player.name} ... bring Wei to an old acquaintance of Michi ... this acquaintance runs a health clinic on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Bring Wei there and she will be taken care of, until her health problems have been dealt with ... do this for Michi and you shall be generously rewarded.
