messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Chief Executive Panel may have charged only a couple of the mega-corporations with the task of settling Okkelen, but that doesn't mean the others have to sit idle by on the sidelines and watch Lai Dai and NOH hog all the glory. And all the riches, more importantly.

Ishukone wants to keep a watchful eye on the goings on here. I'm one of several covert and not-so covert operators roaming the constellation gathering intelligence. Personally, I'm particularly interested in the spy station operated by the Guristas pirates over in Airmia. Why spend a lot of time and resources to do something that others are already doing? If you are proficient hacker and have all the right equipment, you could do much worse than snoop around there and collect some choice tidbits to sell to information peddlers such as myself.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Something tells me that we're on the verge on discovering something really marvelous here in Okkelen that might change the way we look at the world forever. There are artifacts here that are thousands of years old and if we can discover who left them behind and what kind of society they lived in, it might put our own meager existence into a more enlightened perspective.

Yes, interesting times indeed, and I for one want to do what I can to advance humankind to the next rug in the evolution ladder. I'm collecting interesting relics and am on the lookout for independent pilots that have some rudimentary knowledge of archaeology to help me out in this great endeavor. Are you interested?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
From what I've heard, the Guristas pirates have amassed an impressive amount of treasure and valuable information in the contested complex here in Friggi, but that stuff is pretty well defended, so you need some heavy armaments to have any chance of tackling that. A better bet is heading out to the Airmia system and enter the spy station the Guristas are operating in the contested complex there. If you have some basic hacking knowledge, I'm certain you can dig up something of value to me.

Just be very careful ― a big gun is a man's best friend around here, so be prepared to face a few.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Some bright light back at headquarters got the idea that SuVee was missing out on something good here in Okkelen. So they sent poor old me out here to map the riches. Yeah, right. If I ever find out who's responsible, I'll make him dance to the tune of my AK-107. This place is a real hellhole. All I've encountered is dust and danger. I've heard plenty of stories of fabulous riches, but that's it ― just stories. My superiors are getting restless, wanting more than just hints and rumors from me, so I'm looking for prospective pilots to lend me a bit of a hand.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The mega-corporations are trying to hog all the action here in Okkelen, but if you're careful to stay under their radar it's easy to get your hands on something good from time to time. I'm monitoring the excavation site here, looking for opportunities that might arise.

In the meantime, I hear the Kazka bandits over in Sakkikainen have hoarded a sizeable amount of artifacts in their headquarters. I'm well connected to shift these artifacts, so if you know anything about archaeology I'm interested in striking a bit of a business deal. I'll pay you good money for any {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} you manage to scavenge from the Kazka bandits.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Thanks in no small part to the documents you brought, we now have the location of the temporary facilities in this system where Vandano and his cohorts intend to keep the slaves while their forged documents are being submitted to the Republic. According to our reports, they will then be brought to the Joint Harvesting Plantation in Barkrik.

If you head out there now and destroy this outpost, our other team should be in a prime position to intercept the slave convoy when it comes in.

localizedName.text: Supplies For The Colony - Transporting The Goods (1 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The colony on Inder VIII is in desperate need of some outside help, {[character]player.name}. Since no station has yet been built orbiting the planet space travel is much more infrequent than other more prominent colonies within the Republic.

The first item that I would like you to fetch for me is soil. There's an amazing lack of fresh, quality soil in the settlements that have sprung up on the planet's surface. The farmer's union has been threatening an all-out withdrawal from Inder if this issue isn't resolved. I'll pay you well if you can get the soil which I've ordered from the Vherokior Tribe to me on time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Just make sure you head out there prepared, {[character]player.name}.  The shipment you're supposed to fetch is located in a pretty dangerous area, I cannot guarantee that you won't be ambushed by pirates on the way.  Good luck.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have three fighters on hand right now, but I need more to be able to run my show. I just received word that one of my best, Grace Tarsis, is being held by a group of Cartel thugs in a deadspace location here in Nakugard, on account of some unsettled debts. If you can find her and bring her back to me in one piece, I'll be a step closer to re-opening my arena and evading the Leisure Group's wrath.

They're keeping her in a brothel in their lair, one that's not really that heavily guarded. If you kill the guards and blow up the brothel, you should be able to get her out and bring her back. If you can do that, you will have my most heartfelt thanks.

I own and operate a portable arena of cyboerians, cybernetically augmented gladiators who fight each other for show, demonstrating a wide range of Matari martial arts. I was having problems generating revenue in my old home, so I relocated to Nakugard.

Shortly after I got here, though, a problem reared its head. Obviously I'd underestimated the extent of influence wielded by the criminal element in this area. Within weeks, most of my fighters were strung out on various illicit drugs, and I've since had to close up shop. Can't have a show if you don't have performers. And to make matters worse, my contract with the Leisure Group is still in full effect; if I'm not generating my revenue they're not going to be happy, and we most definitely do not want the Leisure Group unhappy.

There are a few things I need to be able to get my arena up and running again. Among these is oxygen; I can't very well run the place if no one can breathe, you understand. If you can go out and find me 150 units of oxygen, I'd be much obliged.

localizedName.text: Furthering the Cause - Keeping Tabs (1 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A few words of introduction are probably in order. I'm Mattheu Rochet, an investment banker and sometime independent trader. I made my fortune a while back, trading robotics after the great capsuleer influx two years ago. Since then, I've been constantly seeking ways to further the cause of the Matari, a proud people with a tragic history for which proper reparations have not been made.

I recently decided to make the Ani constellation my stomping grounds. The situation here is an intriguing one; the simmering conflict between the Ammatar and the old Republic is more evident here than in most other places I've been to, and there is much good work that can be done. In fact, I have a job for you if you feel like lending a hand.

Some associates of mine have set up shop in the Barkrik system's Joint Harvesting Food Packaging stations. They are going to install some equipment so they can keep tabs on some of the shadier elements in there. I need you to bring them a shipment of electronic parts, which they can then use to assemble their covert surveillance gear. Do this quickly and efficiently, and I'll have another job for you.

localizedName.text: Furthering the Cause - State of Readiness (2 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
According to my sources, there are some interesting times ahead in the Nakugard system. A group of unscrupulous individuals is planning to illegally move in Matari slaves under the guise of contract workers. Some of my contacts in Nakugard are working towards fixing this problem their own way, but I want to have my people standing by in case worst comes to worst.

I have a shipment of small arms coming into the Sisters of EVE Bureau in Lanngisi. The Sisters themselves have nothing to do with it, of course, but they trust me enough to look the other way in this case. I need the weapons delivered to the Krusual Tribe bureau at Nakugard V, where my people will pick them up and put them to good use, if need be. Will you do this for me?

I've just received word from one of my Nakugard associates that the group I mentioned earlier, the ones who are bringing in the slaves, have stashed away a sizable portion of Vitoc in one of the Joint Harvesting stations in Barkrik, presumably to keep better control of their "contracted labor." Fortunately some of the station personnel in there are on my payroll, so I've managed to have the whole load of it "confiscated."

If you head over there and bring the Vitoc back to the Sisters of EVE Bureau in Lanngisi, we will be one step closer to resoundingly sending out the message. You don't try to bring Minmatar slaves into this constellation, right under everybody's nose.

localizedName.text: The Time of Science - Tools of the Trade (1 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I work for the Sanctuary, one of the universe's foremost research institutions. We've recently managed to unearth what we believe could be facts paving the way towards greater understanding of the EVE Gate and how it operates; why it is the way it is. For us to put this information to practical use, however, we require more research data. You seem like the competent type. If you can do a bit of leg work for me, I'll make sure you're rewarded - and you'll be able to rest knowing you did your part in moving the scientific knowledge of today that little bit further forward.

First off, we're getting in a new batch of recently discovered material from a moon in the New Eden system, but our maintenance budget has been running low and many of our tools are in a sad state of disrepair. I have a batch of repair equipment here; if you could see fit to running this over to the SOE Bureau in Lanngisi, I would be much obliged - and so would my staff.

localizedName.text: The Time of Science - A Spot of Relief (2 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I've just received word that our station in Lanngisi is about to receive an influx of escaped Matari slaves who have made their way from the depths of Amarr space after their colony was attacked and destroyed. I'm already pulling all the strings I can, but there's one fairly basic thing I seem to have forgotten. There's quite a number of them, and the station will need an extra supply of water.

If you can head down to our Bureau in Traun and pick up water for the newly freed, I will reward you handsomely. I am also likely to have more work for you.

localizedName.text: The Time of Science - Shelter (3 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Matari refugees are safe and sound now, thanks in no small part to your efforts. The next step for us is to build them some decent living facilities in Lanngisi. To this end we will require building materials.

We've placed a large order for construction blocks at the Joint Harvesting plant in Barkrik. We quite like the idea of their materials helping to build housing for the free people their nation so callously and brutally mistreated. Do this for me, and I will see to it that you are handsomely rewarded.

localizedName.text: Supplies For The Colony - Tricky Terrain (2 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The settlers on Inder VIII are becoming increasingly restless due to travel delays on the planet. Simply put, most of them can't afford vehicles which are neccessary to travel through the inhospitable terrain which covers most of the planet. So I came up with a brilliant idea, why not start a rental service where they can rent cheap but effective planetary vehicles to use when neccessary? This will not only please the inhabitants but also make me some money.

I ordered a batch of planetary vehicles from Core Complexion. They are currently waiting to be shipped from {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}, and I'd like you to do the dirty work for me, for a nice reward of course. I hope you're up to it, I don't want to have to turn to Freedom Extension for a courier job, they're convoys are so damn expensive these days.

I ordered a batch of planetary vehicles from Core Complexion. They are currently waiting to be shipped from {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name}, and I'd like you to do the dirty work for me, for a nice reward of course. I hope you're up to it, I don't want to have to turn to Freedom Extension for a courier job, they're convoys are so damn expensive these days.

localizedName.text: Supplies For The Colony - For The Police (3 of 3)

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well, that was the last job I have for you this time, {[character]player.name}.  I can't thank you enough, you saved me a ton of hassle dealing with those damn bureaucrats back in Abudban, it takes forever and a day to get anything done through them.  Farewell.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Crime has run rampant on Inder VIII since it was first settled, mainly due to the extreme lack of law enforcement officers on the planet's surface. Therefore I made a formal suggestion to the Republic Security Forces to relocate some of their personnel here. They agreed to send some of their recruits, but only under the agreement that Urban Management supply them with the necessary equipment.

Most of their equipment has already arrived, but there is one last batch of small arms that hasn't made it here yet. I'd like you to fetch it for me in a jiffy, it will save me the expenses and hassle of ordering another convoy through our bureau.

localizedName.text: The Test Of Competence - Utrainen's Reports (1 of 2)

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well, you surprise me {[character]player.name}, I didn't think I'd ever find someone as capable as you in this crap-hole of a system.  But before I hand over the voucher, there's just one more thing you need to do for me.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The trial consists of 2 tests. The first test is rather simple. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} has set up some practice grounds in Otomainen where our combat pilots train every day. Inside one of these practice grounds you'll find a group of drones, similar to the rogue drones that keep harassing Caldari convoys in the outer constellations. If you manage to destroy all of these drones, you'll find some reports that you must bring back to me. These reports contain nothing of importance, they are just part of the test. Once I have the reports, you will have passed the test.

Just a word of warning though, I've already sent a few pilots on this test and none of them have returned. You might find the wreckage of their ships at the practice grounds, that is unless they fled before the drones managed to destroy them heh heh.

localizedName.text: The Test Of Competence - The Roaving Brigands (2 of 2)

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've completed the trial and are now free to take a few of the vouchers next to my desk.  Some of the agents working for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} require you to hand in one of these vouchers before they'll give you a mission, so I suggest you keep them safe.  Good luck.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The final test that I need you to complete is a bit more complicated. One of the major pirate organizations in Okkelen are the Kazka Bandits. They are a constant thorn in our side, and the inadequate security forces here don't seem to have the capacity to exterminate them.

To get straight to the point, I would like you to destroy 5 of their lower-grade cruisers. Bring me the spurs from their pilot's boots, that will be proof enough of your deed. Unlike your previous mission, I don't know exactly where you'll find them. I heard that one of their hideouts is located near one of Otomainen XI's moons, but that's all I know. Return to me once you have all 5 marauder spurs.

I know this might seem like a pain in the rear-end, but I can't give you that voucher unless I know that you've got the skills to track down the prey, sometimes that's required in case we don't have a bookmark to the exact location of your targets. If you can get this done then I'm sure you have what it takes to do any of our missions.

We have a policy here within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} that our more prominent members use certain implants to boost their mental ability, since it's important that our people in key positions perform at a level above what's considered normal for a human being. It's a competitive world we live in, and sometimes one has to take risks to achieve one's goals, even if it means meddling with the brain.

You may not be a full-fledged member of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, but you've created such a name for yourself that we feel obliged to treat you as one of our own. And considering your record, we feel that our policy pertains to you as well. So I've been authorized to give you this implant in exchange for one simple task. Bring me a few insignias and the reward is yours.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Enjoy your reward, {[character]player.name}.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, Hand In The Voucher (1 of 8)

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I would like to help out with the war against the Minmatar alliance.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's your voucher, General.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Bring me a voucher from one of the recruiters nearby and you're in.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I see.  Bring me a voucher from one of the recruiters nearby and you're in.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good.  Now let's get started on your assignments.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, The Gallente Spy Drones (2 of 8)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Your first assignment is to intercept a group of spy drones that the Gallente have deployed in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  They are guarded by a few Federation Navy cruisers and an interceptor.  They probably haven't figured out that we have them on our radar, so they won't be expecting you.  With the element of surprise on your side, this should be an easy job.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The spy drones are no more, as you requested General.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work.  Now on to you're next assignment.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I expect you back here with your ship in pristine condition.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So what's my first mission, boss?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your first assignment is to intercept a group of spy drones that the Gallente have deployed in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. With the element of surprise on your side, this should be an easy job.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, The Ammatar Traitor (3 of 8)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Our intelligence agency has informed us of an Ammatar traitor in our midst.  Apparently he's been collaborating with the Minmatar Republic, supplying them with information and even hiring mercenaries to sabotage our operation here.  I want you to locate him and take him out.  Our last reports indicate that he is most likely hiding near one of the moons within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.You will need a probe launcher to pinpoint his location. Once the job is done, return to me with something from his ship and I'll give you your reward.  Dismissed.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The traitor has been taken care of.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Find and eliminate Oggiin Kalda near one of Kenobanala's moons.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Nice job, with him off our backs we can rest more easily here in Fort Kumar.  Now get ready for another assignment.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: And the next assignment is?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Our intelligence agency has informed us of an Ammatar traitor in our midst. Once the job is done, return to me with something from his ship and I'll give you your reward.  Dismissed.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, Planting The Spy (4 of 8)

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's next?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have completed the mission, General.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It's time to send you into the front lines, {[character]player.name}. Yes that means flying into Audesder. It will be dangerous, there's no doubt about that. But I'm sure you're prepared for those kind of risks, considering you signed up for this job in the first place.

Your first task in Audesder is in fact to fly through Audesder, to Aedald. Our intelligence agency wants to place a spy inside their base, to gather intel on their defensive positions, plans and such. It's too risky sending him straight into the Alliance Barracks, so we're going to start with dropping him off at one of their stations in Aedald, where he'll hitch a ride on one of their ships heading to the barracks in Audesder. That's all you need to know for now, {[character]player.name}.

Drop him off at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, then hurry back here. Try not to be seen by the enemy, or you might compromise our agent's mission. Good luck.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent!  You're really something, {[character]player.name}.  You should consider joining the Imperial Navy sometime, as a full fledged member.  Kezti Sundara would be pleased.  But don't leave yet, I have more work for you.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, Damaging Their Surveillance Capabilities (5 of 8)

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So now what?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The surveillance tower has been destroyed, as you requested, General.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
This time I'd like you to do something a little more daring. The Gallente have set up a high-tech surveillance tower inside Audesder, which has allowed them to find every single one of our spy drones in the system, greatly hindering our intelligence gathering of their forces. It will take them a while to rebuild the tower after you demolish it, giving us time to gather some intel and possibly launch a sneak attack.

I'll give you the coordinates of the surveillance tower. All you have to do is fly over there and take it out. Good luck.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
This time I'd like you to do something a little more daring. I'll give you the coordinates of the surveillance tower. All you have to do is fly over there and take it out. Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I'm impressed.  Again you've come through.  Our war effort will benefit greatly from your assistance, I'm sure.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, Recovering the Spy (6 of 8)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It's time to retrieve the secret agent you delivered into Minmatar space earlier. He's currently located inside their main base in Audesder, called ‘Alliance Barracks'. It's filled with Gallente and Minmatar ships, and perhaps mercenaries like you as well. It will be extremely dangerous, {[character]player.name}. But if we don't get this done quickly, not only will the intelligence operation we put weeks of effort in be for nothing, our agent will also most assuredly be executed.

He will most likely be located inside one of the Minmatar bunkers. Get him out of there in one piece. Good luck.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the secret agent, General, safe and unharmed.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Retrieve the secret agent from one of the bunkers in the Alliance Barracks within Audesder.  Destroying it should not be neccessary.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Very well done, {[character]player.name}.  But there's more to be done!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm ready for another mission.

messages.mission.briefing.text:

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, Striking At The Blockade (7 of 8)

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's next?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The command post has been destroyed, as you requested General.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
This next mission will most likely be the hardest you've done so far. As you probably know by now, the Minmatar forces have set up a blockade at the main jump gate into Audesder, which they call the 'Minmatar Alliance Defense Brigade'. It's located not far from the stargate itself, and they are equipped with a short-range surveillance tower enabling them to detect any movement of our forces through the gate at all times. Mercenaries like you can generally get past them unhindered, but any official Amarrian strike force sent through there would have to face them or be destroyed.

To get to the point, I want to weaken the Minmatar position near the gate. The best way to do that is to take out their command post, it's destruction will hopefully send them into a disarray, giving us a hefty advantage when we launch our sneak attack. Bring me the Command Post's Bluechip as proof of your deed. Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great work, soldier!  Now only one assignment remains, which happens to be critical to our military operation in Audesder.  Get ready for the fight of your life!

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, The Dreadnought Manufacturing Facility (8 of 8)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I hope you are, {[character]player.name}, I hope you are … As I mentioned before, this last mission is critical to our campaign. It will definitely test your mettle in battle, and I am certain that you will need backup to complete the assignment. Unfortunately I won't be sending any of my own guys with you, that would most likely compromise the mission anyway, so I do hope you have some merc friends along for the ride.

Your task is to commandeer a full scale assault on the Minmatar Dreadnought Manufacturing Facility in Audesder. It's a massive installation, funded by ORE, the Gallente Federation, the Minmatar Republic and various other allies of theirs. It allows them to quickly build their dreadnought ships and deploy them immediately, with devastating effect on the battle field. If we take it out, it will seriously cripple their war effort, for some at least until they manage to build another one. This should give us the edge we need to attain victory.

You have your orders, {[character]player.name}, now make us proud. May God be with you.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The dreadnought manufacturing installation has been destroyed.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: This mission is much harder than any of the previous ones. Do not attempt it without serious backup!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm ready.

messages.mission.briefing.text:

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Amazing!  I'm at a loss for words ... You accomplished something even the old Amarrian war heroes would be proud of!  I hope you enjoy your reward, you've most definitely earned it.  God be with you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ahem, I'm really sorry if I insulted you, {[character]player.name}, but there's nothing I can do about this. I was given the order to test EVERYONE before we send them out into the fray, and if I would ignore that order I risk being demoted. I hope you understand, Minas is very strict about us following his orders.

Now you'll find the details of your test assignment in the briefing which I'm about to load into your NeoCom. Complete the assignment, which I'm sure you'll do in no time, and I'll send you off to the general. And don't forget to read the advice I've added to the mission details in your Opportunities interface. Good luck.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Do not speak with General Minas unless you have powerful friends at your disposal. Although Minas will begin by sending you into fairly easy encounters, once he's satisfied with your performance you will be sent straight into fleet battles, which I doubt you will be able to face alone and survive. And as my final word of advice, take care not to enter Minmatar space when criminally flagged by their security forces. It will mean certain death.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: This is outrageous!  I've stuck my neck out for you guys time and time again, yet I still have to prove myself!?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
This assignment has been created as a mandatory test to ensure all personnel are adequately equipped and ready for the tasks ahead. Failure is unacceptable.

The assignment is simple, and should be completed within 1 hour's time. A group of rogue drones have been activated in the Imperial Navy's testing area within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. Each carries a certification result sheet which will be ejected from its interior as soon as it is destroyed. Recover 5 of these sheets and bring them back to your contact. That is all.

- Minas Iksan

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: As I suspected, you're up for the job, {[character]player.name}.  Here's the voucher, bring it to General Minas Iksan, and he'll give you your next assignment.  He's located within the Central Control Tower in Fort Kumar.  Good luck out there, soldier.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, The Voucher (1 of 8)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I see.  Bring me a voucher from one of the recruiters nearby and you're in.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's the voucher, Warlord.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good.  Now let's get started on your assignments.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't forget to let me know when you have the voucher.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I would like to help out with the war against the Amarrian alliance.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Bring me a voucher from one of the recruiters nearby and you're in.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, End The Propaganda (2 of 8)

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do as you ask, Ison.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what's my first assignment?

messages.mission.briefing.text: You're going to start with something easy, {[character]player.name}.  The Caldari Navy's propaganda machine has been spreading lies and misinformation amongst our army for some time now.  For weeks we've been trying to located the source of their broadcasting but it wasn't until today that we narrowed down the signal to a small area of deadspace in the outer regions of {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  I would like you to investigate the area and report your findings to me.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: You're going to start with something easy, {[character]player.name}.  The Caldari Navy's propaganda machine has been spreading lies and misinformation amongst our army for some time now.  For weeks we've been trying to located the source of their broadcasting but it wasn't until today that we narrowed down the signal to a small area of deadspace in the outer regions of {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  I would like you to investigate the area and report your findings to me.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Interesting.  So their broadcasting unit is protected by multiple Amarr and Caldari cruisers … I expected worse.  Well, we can't give them any more time to prepare themselves, it's time for us to strike.  I have a replica of the keycard required to get past the acceleration gate to the next stage of the complex, which you can have.  Get ready for some action!

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, Strike At The Caldari (3 of 8)

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm ready to take on the Caldari.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The broadcasting unit has been destroyed, Warlord.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Ok.  I want you to fly straight to the broadcasting unit that you discovered in your last mission.  Destroy it, and return to me.  You will probably have to face a number of guards from the Amarrian alliance, but I'm sure you can handle it.  They've probably brought in some reinforcements since you're last attack, so be prepared.  Good luck.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Ok.  I want you to fly straight to the broadcasting unit that you discovered in your last mission.  Destroy it, and return to me.  You will probably have to face a number of guards from the Amarrian alliance, but I'm sure you can handle it.  They've probably brought in some reinforcements since you're last attack, so be prepared.  Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good good.  Now with that out of the way, I'm hoping morale here will become more positive.  Now on to your next assignment …

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, Smuggling The Marines (4 of 8)

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: A suicide mission?  Sounds like they must be really loyal to the Republic.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what's next?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Nice work.  I've already heard reports of an explosion within the factory of the station you went to, and the Ammatar governer is furious.  Great tidings indeed!  But don't leave yet, I have more work for you.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: It's time to send you into more dangerous territory, {[character]player.name}.  I really hope you are up to it.  This time I want you to smuggle a platoon of our marines into {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, which the Ammatar have overtaken to use as a military base close to Kenobanala.  The marines we are sending are on a suicide mission to sabotage the production facilities there, which are being used by the Ammatar and Imperial Navies to assemble their ships of war.  Return to me immediately once this has been done.  I'm counting on you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Of course they are.  Minmatar soldiers have no qualms with sacrificing their lives for our cause.  You should know that by now.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, The Khanid Outpost (5 of 8)

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You said you had more work for me.  I'm listening …

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Yes, and now is when it starts to get really dangerous. Again I want you to travel to Kenobanala, this time to a Khanid outpost near Fort Kumar. It was erected to accommodate a large force of Kameira soldiers, because they were not considered ‘good enough' to share living quarters with those of true Amarrian ancestry, nor even the traitorous Ammatar! As you well know, the Kameiras are Minmatar slaves of the Amarr and Khanid who are forced to serve in their military, and who's purpose is usually to be cannon fodder on the front lines in times of war.

I want these Kameiras rescued. But doing that will be tricky. The Khanid complex consists of 3 areas, not including the forward point at the entrance of the deadspace pocket. We have managed to acquire the access codes of the first two acceleration gates, but the 3rd one is unknown to us. Unfortunately the last room of the complex is where the Kameiras living quarters are.

I want you to fly to the Khanid outpost and search the rooms we have access to. Try to find something that will help us unlock the 3rd room, and bring it back here. Perhaps someone among the Khanid guards knows the code.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Ah, this Khanid commander should be able to reveal the access code to us.  We'll start interrogating him immediately.  By the way, I have another assignment ready for you.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, Espionage (6 of 8)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: While we wait for the interrogation of the Khanid commander to finish, I'd like you to conduct an extremely dangerous mission for me, {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente managed to smuggle a data recorder into Fort Kumar, the base of operations of our enemies in Kenobanala.  It's currently located in one of the army quarters inside their base.  All you have to do is infiltrate Fort Kumar and retrieve this data recorder.  Return to me once you have it.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the data recorder as you requested, Warlord.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Retrieve the Gallente Intelligence Data Recorder from one of the army quarters in Fort Kumar.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent!  Hopefully we'll be able to scrounge some useful information out of this thing.  Now on to your next assignment.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm all ears …

messages.mission.briefing.text: While we wait for the interrogation of the Khanid commander to finish, I'd like you to conduct an extremely dangerous mission for me, {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente managed to smuggle a data recorder into Fort Kumar, the base of operations of our enemies in Kenobanala.  It's currently located in one of the army quarters inside their base. localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, Freeing The Kameiras (7 of 8)

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, whats my next job?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have all the Kameira soldiers that I could find, here you go.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We managed to locate a key that should work on the 3rd acceleration gate inside the Khanid outpost where the Kameiras are being held. The Khanid commander you captured revealed its location to us. It's more reliable than an access code, since they probably already changed those after your last attack. You'll find the key in a small container not far from the stargate. It is cloaked and locked but since we know it's exact location now, your ship scanner should be able to detect it. You'll have to destroy the container to acquire the key.

Assuming that the key still works, you should be able to get into the 3rd area of the complex and save the Kameiras from captivity. I'm sure the Khanid and their allies have sent in reinforcements after your last attack, so be prepared for a difficult fight. You'll have to bring some friends along if you wish to have any chance of success.

Just a word of warning though, the Kameiras are normally extremely loyal to the Empire, being more efficiently brainwashed than normal slaves. They are raised with no education of their origins, and it usually takes some time to convince them that we speak the truth. So you'll probably have to take them by force. I'll supply you with some Eforte gas which will paralyze them instantly, allowing your crew to safely transfer them into your cargo hold. Good luck, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great work!  I'll have them transferred to our slave rehabilitation center immediately.  Now for your next assignment.

localizedName.text: The Audesder War Effort, The Dreadnought Manufacturing Facility (8 of 8)

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's next?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The assembly array has been destroyed as you requested, Warlord.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It's time to send you on your last assignment, {[character]player.name}. I'm sure this will be one of the most difficult encounter you have ever faced. I'm reluctant to send you on such a suicide mission, but you're the only one qualified for the job that we have. If we sent in our fleet they would be instantly attacked by everyone in Fort Kumar. You on the other hand should be able to get by them unnoticed, if you are cautious enough.

What you need to do is destroy the assembly array of the primary Amarr dreadnought manufacturing facility in Kenobanala. It's pumping out dreadnoughts faster than we imagined, greatly boosting their military strength. If we don't take it out soon, they will be ready for a full scale assault into Audesder, and that will spell disaster for our campaign. I just don't think we're ready yet to face such a large fleet.

And I can't stress this enough, get help! You won't be able to do this alone. Good luck!

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Incredible!  Not even in my wildest dreams did I expect you to return alive, and successful!  You've proven to be a huge asset to the Minmatar Republic, and I thank you from the bottom of my heart.  My the light of the Minmatar Republic be with you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ahem, I'm really sorry if I insulted you, {[character]player.name}, but there's nothing I can do about this. I was given the order to test EVERYONE before we send them out into the fray, and if I would ignore that order I risk being demoted. I hope you understand, Ison is very strict about us following her orders.

Now you'll find the details of your test assignment in the briefing which I'm about to load into your NeoCom. Complete the assignment, which I'm sure you'll do in no time, and I'll send you off to Tiadala. And don't forget to read the advice I've added to the mission details in your Opportunities interface. Good luck.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Do not speak with Warlord Ison unless you have powerful friends at your disposal. Although Ison will begin by sending you into fairly easy encounters, once she's satisfied with your performance you will be sent straight into fleet battles, which I doubt you will be able to face alone and survive. And as my final word of advice, take care not to enter Ammatar space when criminally flagged by their security forces. It will mean certain death.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: This is outrageous!  I've stuck my neck out for you guys time and time again, yet I still have to prove myself!?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
This assignment has been created as a mandatory test to ensure all personnel are adequately equipped and ready for the tasks ahead. This is done for your safety, we have no intention of sending you needlessly to your death.

The assignment is simple, and should be completed within 1 hour's time. A few floating containers have been placed in our training grounds in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, surrounded by sentry guns and spider drones. All you have to do is retrieve the certificates from the containers. Recover 5 of these sheets to your contact. That is all.

- Ison Tiadala

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: As I suspected, you're up for the job, {[character]player.name}.  Here's the voucher, bring it to Warlord Ison Tiadala, and she'll give you your next assignment.  Good luck out there, soldier.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm interested.  Give me more details.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Congratulations, you've just proven yourself as a competent mercenary fighter pilot.  Now that you've completed this task, I suggest you look for more {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} agents in {[location]agentRegionID.name} and surrounding regions.  I have no more work for you, but I'm sure you'll find some others from my corporation who do.  If all else fails, you could always work for the other {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} corporations, they have their own agents which hand out jobs as well.  Good luck in your travels, friend.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Right now I'm looking for {[item]objectiveTypeID.quantityName, quantity=objectiveQuantity}. These tags have been implanted into certain pirates which infest {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space, which they use to identify each other with. To acquire them you will most likely have to kill them, or buy them off someone who did exactly that. I don't really care either way, as long as they have been taken care of I'm satisfied.

This might not be the very best way to confirm deaths, but we've been quite successful in the past using this method. Forgeries are almost non-existent, as each tag costs more to manufacture than it's worth on the bounty market. Not only that but we can usually tell a fake apart from a genuine pirate tag. And they have remarkable survivability, usually found in the charred wreckage of the pirate ships despite everything else, including the pirate's corpse, having been completely vaporized.

You can find the pirates carrying the {[item]objectiveTypeID.name} in many places, but I'd first check the asteroid belts in the surrounding systems as attacking defenseless miners is their favorite past-time. Good luck, and have fun.

localizedName.text: The Missing Reporters - Minmatar Smugglers (1 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
This incident comes at a very bad time. Political relations between our governments are extremely volatile at the moment, and there are rumors of war floating around everywhere. So I have explicit orders to tell you to keep this quiet. With your record I know I can trust you, don't speak of this to anyone. Just find the missing reporters, destroy their captors, return them to me and keep your mouth shut.

The first Amarrian civilian went missing in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} reporting on a story involving a group of Minmatar terrorists, who were said to have been smuggling arms and other illegal goods to some of the more notorious criminal organizations in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, to what purpose we can only guess. I'll give you the coordinates to his last known position. Find him and bring him back, whether dead or alive. His family must know what happened to him. If you find any Minmatar ships at the scene, offer them no dialogue, just destroy them.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: How unfortunate, his family will be distraught.  Those damned terrorists will pay for this!  Get ready for your next assignment.

localizedName.text: The Missing Reporters - Political Foes (2 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Two of the remaining reporters went missing in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They were investigating reports that the political movement opposed to {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} government's policy on the Audesder incident is collaborating with the Gallente Federation, and have been planning a coup. We have reason to believe that they are being kept in a prison cell located inside a settlement belonging to these misguided {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} citizens.

I want you to pay a visit to this settlement and free the reporters who are being kept there against their will. Eliminate anyone who gets in your way.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I'm glad they are alive, {[character]player.name}.  Now on to your next assignment.

localizedName.text: The Missing Reporters - Miners Beware (3 of 3)

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: You notice on a local news bulletin reports of an unidentified craft destroying a peaceful Minmatar convoy carrying medical and food supplies.  The government refuses to comment, other than stating that they will do everything in their power to apprehend those responsible.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The last reporter who's missing was apparently abducted by Gallente terrorists in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  These Gallente have been masquerading as peaceful miners, having bought a lease on a small asteroid belt in this system.  But we know differently.  You'll find the abducted in one of their mining barges.  Find him and bring him back here.  Dismissed.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The last reporter who's missing was apparently abducted by Gallente terrorists in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. You'll find the abducted in one of their mining barges.  Find him and bring him back here.  Dismissed.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You didn't find the missing reporter?  How unfortunate.  But at least the terrorists have been taken care of.  I'll report our success here directly to the my contact in Amarr Certified News.  Thank you for your assistance.

Find him and bring him back here.  Dismissed.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
News of your heroic deeds have spread throughout the region after the interplanetary media organization The Scope aired a detailed report on your exploits. The family of the reporter you rescued offer their utmost gratitude, and the families of those that had been killed are thankful that you at least discovered their fate.

The last reporter who's missing was apparently abducted by Amarr slave traders in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. Find him and bring him back here. Dismissed.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You found him!  I'll notify his family immediately.  I'll also report our success here directly to my contact in The Scope. Thank you for your assistance.

I'll give you the coordinates to their last known position. Find them and bring them back, dead or alive. Their families must be informed of their fate, or they will never be at peace. If you find any hostiles at the scene, feel free to use deadly force.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
One of the remaining reporters went missing in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. He was investigating reports that one of the political movements opposed to {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} government's policy on the Audesder incident has been collaborating with the Amarr Empire. We have reason to believe that this information was flawed, and in fact the politicians in question have ties to the Angel Cartel which they've been adamantly denying. They own a small settlement in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, which coincidentally is where the reporter went missing.

I would like you to pay a visit to this settlement and look for the missing reporter. If you find him you are authorized to use force, if necessary, to bring him back. Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I'm glad you found him alive, {[character]player.name}.  Now on to your next assignment.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm in.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
There are millions of minmatars living in the Joas constellation which are not ethnically Nefantar, and many of them are still loyal to the Republic. Even some of the Nefantar living in the area are sympathetic to our cause. Hence there is a strong resistance movement there, which in fact started long before the Rebellion. The strength of the resistance has varied greatly through the years, but the Audesder incident has refueled unrest in the region. And this may be a key factor in our campaign to hold Audesder.

What I'd like you to do is transfer a large arms cache to my contact in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. This contact of mine is an agent of the Joas resistance, he will see to it that the arms cache gets to the right hands. Try to avoid any contact with the Ammatar or their allies, if they find out what you're up to then you'll have one hell of a fight on your hands. Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great job!  The resistance will benefit greatly from the arms cache you delivered.  It's been extremely difficult to get supplies to them with the military buildup in Kanebanala, so your success comes as a welcome surprise.  If you'd like, I have more arms that are ready to be shipped out.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The arms cache has been delivered as promised, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Bring the arms cache to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} in the Joas constellation.  My contact there will take care of the rest.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Bring the arms cache to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} in the Joas constellation. My contact there will take care of the rest.

localizedName.text: Civilian Pullout - More Civilians to Evacuate

messages.mission.briefing.text: As I've told you already, there are more Nefantar civilians in Aedald that need to be moved to Fort Kumar.  You'll find them in the hangar of {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Good luck.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As I've told you already, there are more Nefantar civilians in Aedald that need to be moved to Fort Kumar.  You'll find them in the hangar of {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Good luck.

If I have a job available! Of course I do! Do you know how hard it is to find help around here?! With FON organizing boycotts for any organization supporting us and picketing individuals we are affiliated with, I don't really blame them.

Anyway as I've already told you we have some problems with our transportation service. We're using some of our own freighters now to transport goods from Caldari space, but we're short on manpower. If you could stop by {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and bring the 50 construction blocks I had ordered to me, then I'll give you a reward. We need them for the next habitation module we're building for the workers stationed here.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: <font color=FF0000>You will lose Gallente Federation standing for completing missions for a Caldari corporation.</font>

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Back with the goods, just as promised.  Here's your reward, make good use of it!  But don't go far, I've got more jobs for you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm here to help actually.  If you have a job available, that is ...

We need them for the next habitation module we're building for the workers stationed here.

I have something slightly more dangerous for you this time, {[character]player.name}. We have 18 surveyors stranded on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} after Prompt Delivery backed out on our deal to get them moved here a few days ago. Apparently they decided the risks of transporting them through Gallente space were too great. The Federation Navy has threatened to attack any corporations under the Caldari State other than Wiyrkomi, and even with our surveyors on board we fear they might hold true to their word.

If you can get the surveyors here today, I'll give you a hefty reward. Just watch out for those FON fanatics, they're everywhere these days.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I have something slightly more dangerous for you this time, {[character]player.name}. We have 18 surveyors stranded on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} after Prompt Delivery backed out on our deal to get them moved here a few days ago. Apparently they decided the risks of transporting them through Gallente space were too great. The Federation Navy has threatened to attack any corporations under the Caldari State other than Wiyrkomi, and even with our surveyors on board we fear they might hold true to their word.

If you can get the surveyors here today, I'll give you a hefty reward. Just watch out for those FON fanatics, they're everywhere these days.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job.  But enough of these petty courier jobs, it's time to find out your true potential.  Let me know when you're ready, I have a combat mission waiting just for you!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have a matter of urgency for you this time, {[character]player.name}. Temko, the Gallentean mercenary organization that we hired, reported to us that one of its surveillance posts in Colelie has been attacked. All of their personnel are currently unavailable, so they pleaded with us to find someone else to investigate the attack. And I think you are the man for the job.

It's been a while since the attack was reported, so we have absolutely no idea what the situation is out there. Hopefully you will be able to track down whoever is responsible and punish them. Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: As I guessed, it was FON which were behind the attack.  They are becoming more bold with each passing day.  I must report this to Central Command immediately.  But before you leave, there's one last task I have for you.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've completed all the tasks I have for you, {[character]player.name}, so I'm sending you off to Veko Tallaja.  You'll find him in the Central Command site in Fluekele, he's in charge of all Wiyrkomi operations in Algintal.  Take this voucher, you won't get an appointment without it.  Good luck.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
This time I'd like you to obtain a pass into the Azure Canyon in Colelie. The Azure Canyon is located in a pocket of deadspace which has unusually dense ion clouds, which makes it ideal for creating a massive power plant. The reason we are in Colelie is to start constructing the power station, but so far we've been stuck at square 1 due to our inability to clear the area of Serpentis pirates and FON terrorists.

To get to the point, we're sending in a few squadrons of Temko mercenaries to conduct a quick reconnaissance operation in the Azure Canyon area. But we haven't been able to get past the first acceleration gate since Serpentis agents reconfigured the lock, and it would take far too long to manually navigate through the deadspace pocket. Hence we need the keycard.

You'll find a group of FON ships blockading the gate against anyone affiliated with Wiyrkomi. We believe their leader has the keycard we need in her possession. Her name is Apte Donie, and she should be located at the forward point into the complex. Use whatever means necessary to acquire that keycard, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm ready for my assignment, Veko ...

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Veko?? You will address me as sir, peon! I will not have some rug-rat insult me like that in public ...

Now where were we? Ah yes, your mission. Well I have a number of nuisances for you to 'take care of', and the first in line is a Gallentean called Alarus Ekire. He's the commander of the military arm of FON, the cowardly tree-huggers who've been sabotaging our operations in Federation space ever since we made that deal with the Gallente government. With him out of the picture, FON's terrorist groups will become more disorganized and less deadly, until they find a suitable replacement anyway.

You'll probably find Alarus in the Tourist area of Azure Canyon in Colelie. They've apparently made a pact with Serpentis to defend that area of deadspace against our attempts to move our own people in there. So you might have a bit of a fight on your hands, but I'm sure you'll manage.

Bring back something to prove that Alarus is no more, and I'll give you your reward.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Hmmph.  You got the job done, a tad later than I expected but I guess you've earned your reward.  But don't leave, I have more work in store for you.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As a matter of fact I do have something suited for you, {[character]player.name}. But first you're going to have to supply me with a voucher from one of the other agents around here. I recommend stopping by the Survey Station, they need some help there as well.

Do not accept this mission if you have not completed the pre-required mission sequence in the Survey Station or have acquired the neccessary voucher some other way.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here, I have the voucher.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What?  You just wasted my time for nothing?  Get out of here punk, before I send Temko mercs on your ass.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do as you ask.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Now that you've established your worth, let's get started.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't let me down.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I would like to sign up for some work, if you have any.

messages.mission.briefing.text: As a matter of fact I do have something suited for you, {[character]player.name}.  But first you're going to have to supply me with a voucher from one of the other agents around here.  I recommend stopping by the Survey Station, they need some help there as well.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Erm, on second thought I don't think I want to work for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Your second mission is to investigate the theft of a batch of drills we ordered recently. They were being shipped to our survey station in Colelie when their convoy was ambushed by unknown assailants. We have so far not retrieved any witnesses, and have not found any evidence at the crime scene linking FON or Serpentis to the attack. However gut feeling tells me it must have been FON. Serpentis would have taken the crew and held them for ransom, but we have found no evidence that they are still alive.

I'd like you to get to the bottom of this, {[character]player.name}. Fly to the FON recruitment center in Fluekele and see what you can find there. Return to me with anything that might implicate their involvement in the attack.

Dismissed.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: This data recorder may prove invaluable in our criminal investigation.  We'll see what we can find in there, but meanwhile there are some more tasks I'd like you to complete.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You better not let me down.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The next job is going to be a bit more difficult than your last two assignments. This time I want you to infiltrate the Azure Canyon complex and find a place called 'The Black Market'. We have reliable information that a regiment of Temko mercenaries are being held in a prison facility there. They were sent on a reconnaissance mission into the complex a few days ago, but never returned.

I advise you to avoid a direct confrontation with the Serpentis forces at the Black Market. Just grab the mercenaries and flee, they are your number one priority in this mission. We are running out of mercenaries already, we can't afford to lose these Temko personnel.

I also recommend that you finish this assignment in a timely manner. My time is precious.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Infiltrate the Azure Canyon complex in Colelie, find the area called "The Black Market" and rescue the Temko Mercenaries from their prison.  Then return to {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well ... you did get the job done.  Fine, here's your reward.  Now stick around, I've got some more things I'd like you to take care of.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't let me down.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Cafe lounge?  I never ...

messages.mission.briefing.text: Something urgent just came up. The Survey Station in Colelie was attacked by FON, probably in retaliation for our recent actions against them. Many of our people have been killed, and more importantly we lost billions of ISK worth of equipment. This heinous act must not go unpunished. Our surveillance teams are currently on their tail, and I would like you to take care of them. I'll supply you with a bookmark to their approximate location, you do the rest. And do hurry this time, you can hang around the cafe lounge some other time.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I see you're back in one piece.  Maybe you're not as useless as I first thought.  In that case, I have something more you could do for me ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Failure is unacceptible.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Now I want you to get us some Zemnar. The Survey Station in Colelie suffered heavy casualties, and their antibiotic supplies are stretched to the limit. On top of that there has been a viral outbreak which could cause many deaths if we don't get them the Zemnar they need fast. Now a few surveyors and engineers are expendable, but this threatens the entire outpost and could compromise our operation in Colelie!

You'll find a stock of Zemnar not far from the Pend Insurance station in Fluekele, in their storage bin. They refuse to share it with us, probably as a result of pressure from the various nature lover groups which have been protesting our presence here. So we are going to have to take it by force. Do whatever it takes to get a hold of that Zemnar, and drop it off at our factory in this system. One of my lackeys will transport it to Colelie. Just don't reveal who you're working for, to anyone! Now get moving!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well you managed to get that done, at least.  But there's more I have in store for you, so don't go running off yet ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't let me down.
Don't let me down.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Eule Vitrauze is no more.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
You've proven to be fairly reliable so far, {[character]player.name}, so I believe I can trust you for a rather sensitive assignment. We have a traitor in our ranks, or to be more precise in the ranks of the Temko mercenaries we hired. His name is Eule Vitrauze and he's apparently working for Friends of Nature on the side. We believe he's the reason the last Temko operation in the Azure Canyon complex failed.

I would ask the Temko to deal with him themselves, but Gara believes that if we make an outsider do the job and make it seem like we weren't involved in his death then our agent within FON will not be compromised. You'll probably find Eule orbiting a security outpost inside the Central Administration complex. But don't worry, the other Temko ships will not come to his aid, all you have to do is face him one-on-one, and then return to me once his ship has been turned to dust.

Dismissed.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Although it pains me to say it, you've managed to complete all the tasks I assigned to you on time and we owe you one.  Just don't expect any medals of honor, you're a secret agent working for us and the less our enemies know of you the better.  Now before I get all mooshy with you I suggest you turn your flabby tush around and head off to the Grand Future Information Center in Jolia, General Gara Kort has a few missions for you there.  Now be off with you.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: <font color=FF0000>You will lose standing with the Gallente Federation for attacking Friends of Nature.  Despite Wiyrkomi's insistence that FON are a terrorist organization, the Federation thinks of them only as a minor nuissance.  And in fact only a part of FON partake in fighting Wiyrkomi, the larger part of it is non-violent.</font>

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Since you've been approved by Veko Tallaja, I guess you're suited for a few missions vital to our plans here in Algintal. To get straight to the point, we are currently on a campaign to rid the deadspace areas we purchased from Federate sources of pirates and violent protesters, namely the Friends of Nature organization which has been causing us much grief since we came to Algintal. To complete our objectives we have been forced to hire mercenaries which are permitted entrance into Federation space, considering that the government steadfastly refuses to allow any Caldari State military presence in their sovereign space. Which is understandable considering the current political climate.

Wiyrkomi sacrificed much to get this deal, and we definitely are not backing out with our tails behind our legs. Our CEO has publicly announced that we are firmly against any Caldari State incursions into Federation space, incurring the wrath of the State Chief Executive Panel which has fined us for rediculous reasons simply out of spite. And on top of that our lease on the deadspace pockets within Federation space could be annulled at any time if the Senate gives in to the protesters.

So now that you're briefed of the situation, it's time to get started. Your first target is an old abandoned Federation Navy ammunitions storage in Jolia. We have confirmed reports that the military arm of FON uses the facilities located there to store their weapons of mass destruction. Take it out and their terrorist operation in Jolia will be crippled. Over and out.

But if I know them correctly, they'll use this as an excuse to launch a counter-attack.  Meanwhile though I'd like to start concentrating on the Serpentis.  Stick around and I'll give you more details on that.

Do not accept this mission if you have not completed the pre-required mission sequence in Central Command or have acquired the neccessary voucher some other way.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here is the voucher.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I have the voucher.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Alright, let me have it.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'd like to work for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Before I let you work for me you're going to have to supply me with a voucher from Veko Tallaja, located in Central Command in Fluekele.

Here's the deal. I'm a senior journalist for the Scope, and I'm working on an in-depth piece about the Wiyrkomi project in this constellation and the FON's (Friends of Nature's) struggle to counteract their plans. It's a big piece, and I have several reporters working on different strands in different places, so assistance from a fast-moving capsule pilot such as yourself is always needed.

As a matter of fact, I have a job for you right now if you want it. One of my reporters just completed a few interviews with Colelie project workers who are on break from the project at the Wiyrkomi Factory in Fluekele. He says he managed to get some juicy tidbits from them about the way Wiyrkomi handles its workers; grist for the cause, to mangle a metaphor.

Bring me back the interview transcripts from Fluekele, and I'll pay you as much as the agency allows me to dole out. How about it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Serpentis convoy has been destroyed, as you requested General.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
As I said earlier, it's time for us turn our attention to the Serpentis. The Serpentis problem should in fact be easier to deal with than our war with the Gallente environmentalists, but at the same time they are the deadlier foe. The Serpentis are not at war with us due to some fanatical idealogy, instead they are simply here to protect their financial interests. I'm quite certain that as soon as they see this 'war' becoming unprofitable in the long run, they will retreat from their positions in our territory.

So to start off we need to make them know we mean business. And to do that I want you to take out one of their drug convoys. I had the Temko mercenaries under my command conduct a massive surveillance operation, which eventually revealed one of the Serpentis's drug convoy routes. I'll supply you with a bookmark that should lead you to one such convoy. Destroy it and report back to me. And remember, the cargo should not be brought back here, I want nothing to do with their contraband.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job.  I've sent a message to the Serpentis outpost in Azure Canyon, claiming responsibility for the attack on their convoy.  With enough pressure on them, I'm sure they will cave in.  But there's more to be done, one convoy won't affect the Serpentis much at all.  So stay tuned.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It seems the Wiyrkomi Corporation isn't being entirely forthcoming when it comes to their labor practices. That was some very interesting material you brought back from Fluekele. So good, in fact, that I feel a sudden, almost physical urge to follow up on it.

One of my top reporters just came in from Oursulaert. I want you to take him to the Wiyrkomi factory in Jolia, where some highly classified contacts are waiting for him. Since Wiyrkomi won't give us the straight dope, we're going to have to turn to alternative sources. I'll find out the truth yet.

Take my guy to Jolia and I'll see to it that you're rewarded handsomely.

Something fishy's going on here. Word just came in over the feednet: apparently, a FON strike squad staged an attack on a surveillance outpost in Colelie belonging to Temko, a mercenary organization contracted by Wiyrkomi to protect their holdings and help them gain a foothold in this constellation.

This doesn't feel right at all. First, FON doesn't engage in out-and-out terrorism; their battles take place on politico-ideological fronts. Second, had it been FON, why would they advertise that fact? Their tactic is the swaying of public opinion, not the destruction of their opponents' assets. This has all the hallmarks of a frame-up.

An old friend of mine who's well-connected in this area says he's managed to obtain the data core from one of the attacking ships' computers as it was brought in by salvager vessels. If we can get it into the hands of our specialists here, they might be able to extract some clues regarding the attackers' real identities and intentions. Head out to Parchanier and get me that data core. A lot may be riding on this.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Fly to Fluekele IV's sixth moon and find Elere Febre's habitation module.  Destroy it and retrieve her data log from the wreckage.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Your next assignment is a pretty important one. Elere Febre is a Serpentis agent working in Fluekele, which we believe is their contact with Friends of Nature, as we've detected FON agents visiting her habitation module multiple times in the past week alone. FON are desperate to not let news of this alliance between them and Serpentis leak to the public. I'm not even sure if the majority of FON's members know of their dealings with pirates. Public opinion in favor of FON will undoubtedly plummet once people believe there is a connection between them and violent criminals.

Now killing her should be simple. The difficult part is retrieving evidence of her involvement with FON. I'm counting on her leaving some sort of evidence in her habitation module, which is located at Fluekele IV's sixth moon. Find the habitation module and destroy it, search the wreckage for anything that survived which may implicate FON's relationship with Serpentis. Return to me with your findings. Hopefully we'll be able to kill two flies in one swing with the completion of this mission.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Okay, it's about to hit the fan. We've stumbled on to something very very bad indeed. It's so bad, in fact, that I'm not even going to come close to covering it in my article. The people behind this cannot know, under any circumstances, that we know about their plans.

I can't tell you any more at this moment, but I'll tell you what I can do. I'm going to ask you for one more favor, and then I'm going to give you a contact within the FON. They have some work they need done, and since they're generally not the travelling types they could use a big strapping capsuleer to help them. But first I need to ask you one more favor.

I've collected the data I've accrued in the making of my article into one dossier, which I need brought to a safe place. Word's just reached us that Wiyrkomi have this place under wraps, so I've become compromised. I'll have to jack in and do the rest of this remotely.

Bring my dossier to my contact in Parchanier, and I'll hand over our analysis of the evidence you got for us. It's bad, friend. It's real bad.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Good work. I'm glad I found you.

Take this data chip. On it, you will find evidence that the Wiyrkomi corporation have been engaging in terrorism against themselves in order to shift the public's opinion regarding both them and FON. It's not absolutely 100 percent reliable, but what there is seems solid enough. Bring this chip to Preaux Gallot in the Natura Seminary in Audaerne. There is more to be done yet, and I have a feeling this is all just beginning.

Thank you for all your help. You've done us a great service.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Serpentis have so far refused to meet any of our demands. I expected as much, a few convoys and agents are expendable in their eyes. But it's time to turn up the heat. This time I would like you to gather the best pilots you can muster and launch an offensive directly into the Azure Canyon of Colelie. Head straight towards the Black Market pocket and destroy the Serpentis Stronghold. If you can, try to recover something that will allow us to blackmail them, such as computer logs, prisoners, anything.

I suspect that Salvador Sarpati will think twice about going up against Wiyrkomi after suffering the loss of such a costly installation. If all goes as planned, the Serpentis will retreat from the Azure Canyon, giving us full access to the ion clouds.

Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. I see that you brought back a data chip containing transaction logs from within the Black Market of Azure Canyon, that will most definitely help us in our dealings with the Serpentis. I'm sure some of their customers would be less than happy to find out their involvement with a pirate organization was leaked to Federation authorities, and I'm sure the Serpentis will be desperate to keep us from uploading this data to our contacts within The Scope ...

But our work doesn't end here. We still need to deal with those fanatics in Friends of Nature ...

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Looking forward to it, general.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The FON headquarters has been destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
As your final assignment for me, {[character]player.name}, I want you obliterate the FON headquarters, located in Deltole. As you probably know, Friends of Nature mainly consists of civilians which are protected by Federation law. They claim to be a peaceful organization fighting for 'the environment', but in fact a large portion of its members are nothing but terrorist scum who are willing to sacrifice human life to protect a heap of rocks and gas clouds. I've come to realize that no matter how hard we hit them, they will always come back for more. So the only course of action I see is to exterminate the lot of them.

Unfortunately, the Federation will not look kindly upon us killing its civilians, despite them being affiliated with Friends of Nature. They don't have the same view of FON as we do. So it is vital that you do not reveal who you are working for to anyone. If you do, I'll make certain you won't live to see another day.
