messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
My name is Jannegiers Estacan, and I'm the Chief Indoctrination Officer for the Friends of Nature in this area. I bring new recruits in and teach them all about the wonders of nature and how awful the corporate behemoth is ... as the 12th Prophet put it, "trying to put an ISK sign" on everything that grows naturally in this splendid universe of ours.

I also oversee most of the supplies that come to and from our fair little seminary. As a matter of fact, I have something on my desk right now that requires the attention of someone fast and competent. Couldn't help but notice that fine-looking vessel you're flying there. One of our fertilizer shipments was ambushed yesterday, and we need someone to replace what's missing. If you can find us 100 units of fertilizer, we'd be much obliged.

Great job with the fertilizer. My thanks. Next up, we have a shortage of wheat on one of our outposts on Parchanier IV. There's been a bit of a mix-up, it seems: A shipment of Quafe Ultra went to the planet instead of the wheat, and now those poor people have nothing to make their bread with.

If you could pop over to the Egonics Inc. Development Studio at Parchanier V and deliver this wheat to them, you'd be greatly aiding the FON's cause in this area.

Good news! One of our teams has just pulled off a major coup against the Wiyrkomi corporation in the Augnais system. They've managed to intercept the third shipment in a row of batteries for the workers' personal electronic entertainment systems. Things are at boiling point over there already, and I wouldn't be surprised if we saw a mutiny there sometime in the near future.

We need someone to go grab the batteries, though, so we can put them to good use and absolve our people in the area of any suspicions, should the powers that be decide to conduct a hangar search. Head over to the Pend Insurance Investment Bank in Augnais and grab the batteries for me, and we'll reward you well.

This is kind of strange. I've just been handed a shipment of small arms that is supposedly bound for an outpost of ours in the Deltole system. I'm not sure what this means, but the shipping slip seems correct. I'll have to get in touch with my superiors about this - we shouldn't be ferrying weapons around. Something fishy might be going on here.

Should you decide you want to take this job, the small arms will be placed in your cargo hold and since I know you'll remain quiet about this, I'm going to throw in a little something special as a reward this time.

My name's Astroo Opeau, and I'm FON's propaganda honcho. I could have some hoity-toity title, sure, but I like to keep things down-to-earth and formalities just get in the way.

I have a few things I could use a big strapping capsuleer like you for, if you're interested. Tidbits of information are in constant swirl around this constellation, like electrons in an atom, and we need to cast as many nets as far and wide as possible if we want to stand a chance against the corporate behemoth of Wiyrkomi.

One of my eyes in the Audaerne system just got a recording of one of Wiyrkomi's brass indulging in some, shall we say, languorous activities in a pleasure resort not far from here. Head over to the Modern Finances Investment Bank in Audaerne and pick up the tape for me, and we'll see what we can do with it.

The tape you brought back of the Wiyrkomi scumbag proved ideal for our purposes. We've made a holoreel of the "incident," and we need it copied and distributed to key points in the constellation so we can mount a full-scale broadcast offensive against the bastard.

Take this holoreel over to my distributor in the Fluekele system. We'll see how big a shot the bigshot is after this.

Well, our little gambit worked. The bigwig's been driven out of Wiyrkomi and a blow's been struck for the little guy. Thanks so much for your help.

One last favor, if you will. Some of our guys are founding an environmentalist education facility on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and they need some construction materials brought over. You think you could do this for me? I'll pay you well.

Hi there, stranger. I'm Croir Arghe, and I'm in charge of what we like to affectionately call FON's guerilla wing. Not for anyone, what I have. No sirree.

We've received some information recently that gives us reason to believe Wiyrkomi are up to some very clandestine things in this sector. In light of that, we're planning to mount a large offensive against a Wiyrkomi mercenary outpost in the Colelie system. Now, this is not something that's technically sanctioned by the top tiers of FON's command structure, but a certain portion of us feel that this must be done anyway. If you have a hauler handy and are willing to help with the logistics of this endeavor, I can pay you very well. Just keep quiet about it, OK?

First off, I need some recon speeders brought to Deltole. There's quite a large amount of them, so you'll need a good deal of cargo space. Are you up to it?

Preparations for the attack are going well, but a slight problem has presented itself. The squadron we have stationed in Fluekele has run out of rocket fuel for their ground-based missile systems. This doesn't bode well for the offensive, so if you could head over to Audaerne, grab the supplies we have there and bring them over to Fluekele, we would much appreciate it.

We are almost ready for the offensive. Only one thing is missing.

The squadron spearheading the attack is going to be mounting custom-built guidance systems, ones which will give them an unsurpassed ability to track ground-based targets on a flyby. We've had top engineers working on these systems for a while now, and they were finally completed yesterday.

Go get the finished batch from Barmalie and bring it to Deltole, and we will be ready for our strike.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great work, friend.  We are now ready to strike the enemy where it will hurt him the most.  You've been a valuable asset to the FON - know that you have helped preserve one of the most beautiful and sacred spots in the entire Gallente Federation.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I seem to have one more mission for you, {[character]player.name}. Lord Manel informed me a few weeks ago that he had more important business to take care of *hint of sarcasm* than occupy the Governor's seat in the Audience Chamber. But he told me he'd be back by now, actually he was expected back a few days ago. This is not unusual behavior of Manel, but it's surprising that no one at the mansion is returning our calls. So I'd like you to investigate the matter and see what's wrong. Pay a visit to Manel and tell him to contact us ASAP. Probably just a malfunction of the communications system, but it's better to be safe than sorry.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I seem to have one more mission for you, {[character]player.name}. Lord Manel informed me a few weeks ago that he had more important business to take care of *hint of sarcasm* than occupy the Governor's seat in the Audience Chamber. But he told me he'd be back by now, actually he was expected back a few days ago. This is not unusual behavior of Manel, but it's surprising that no one at the mansion is returning our calls. So I'd like you to investigate the matter and see what's wrong. Pay a visit to Manel and tell him to contact us ASAP. Probably just a malfunction of the communications system, but it's better to be safe than sorry.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: So the acceleration gate was locked and Manel's servants left stranded outside?  Shocking.  We need to get to the bottom of this immediately.  Please speak with Odan Poun here in the Governor's Audience Chamber.  He's the chief of security in Chanoun.  He might need some help in solving this mystery, and I told him you were the right man for the job.  Be safe.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Who are you?  I've got important business to attend to, so unless you're somebody important get lost.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Nossa Farad sent me.  Here's her voucher.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I think I have something that would interest you.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: To obtain the voucher, talk to Nossa Farad in the Governor's Audience Chamber agent site in Chanoun and complete her missions.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Ah, so you're the guy Nossa told me about.  I'm sorry about my rudeness earlier, I'm just so used to whiney Chanoun civilians harassing me day in and day out with their petty problems ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Well then, let's see what you got.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm just here for some work.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Who are you?  I've got important business to attend to, so unless you're somebody important get lost.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Shhh!! Quiet, fool. You might compromise my mission! I can't be seen talking to someone like you...

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have a message from Odan Poun...

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Calm down, Finn. I'm here on a classified assignment as well, and I need to talk to you.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: What?! If Odan has decided to risk my entire operation, then it must be because of something important. I'll take a look at his message. Give me a moment...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Alright, in that case maybe I do have a minute or two. But hold on a second while I do a trace for bugs on you. Stand still...

Okay, you're clean. What is it? And keep your voice down.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hey, you're Ader Finn right?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Shhh!! Quiet, fool. You might compromise my mission! I can't be seen talking to someone like you...

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Yes, like I said, while I evaluate this message, I'd like you to transport my report to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. It has details on my latest findings about the Blood Raider operation in the Araz constellation. This stuff is way too sensitive to send over a normal transmission. It must not fall into Blood Raider hands, or my life will be forfeit! Go now, and return at once when you're done.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have completed the delivery as you requested.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll be back before you can say "Get going!"

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: A courier mission...?

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'd like you to transport my report to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. It has details on my latest findings about the Blood Raider operation in the Araz constellation. This stuff is way too sensitive to send over a normal transmission. It must not fall into Blood Raider hands, or my life will be forfeit! Go now, and return at once when you're done.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Ok. Good job. Take this message and deliver it to Odan Poun; it should explain everything. Be careful out there.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
To start off our investigation into the disappearance of Lord Manel we need to get into his mansion. I took a look at the first acceleration gate at his mansion complex with some of my men and we noticed that it was not only locked but also booby trapped. But what was more concerning is the fact that the trap had the hallmark of a Blood Raider contraption. This, quite frankly, terrifies me. If the Blood Raiders are involved I truly fear for Manel's life.

While I do some more investigating near the mansion, I would like you to contact an agent of mine which has been working under cover as a Blood Raider operative in Munory. His name is Ader Finn, and you will find his roadhouse near the 3rd moon of Munory V. Bring him my message, it's contents are top-secret and may not fall into enemy hands. Hopefully he will be able to find some clues as to why the Blood Raiders became involved, and how to acquire a key into the complex.

Dismissed.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have Ader's answer to your message right here, Odan.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Speak with Ader Finn, who is located near his roadhouse at Munory V Moon 3.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Kardour has been taken care of, as you requested.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Ader Finn tells me in his message that the operation against Manel was not authorized by the highest ranking order of the Blood Raiders, even though members of the organization were involved. This was simply a side-job taken by one of the Blood Raider commanders in Araz, Kardour Maxten. Not only that but Ader reports that rumor in the organization has it that Kardour and the other commanders have had heated exchanges about his involvement in the Manel incident.

This is good news for us, because it means Ader can possibly acquire the help of one of the other Blood Raider commanders in our investigation, indirectly of course. He claims to be rather close to one of these commanders, who has access to a key which should temporarily disable the trap at the acceleration gate leading into Manel's Mansion. But there is a price of course, Ader was asked to assassinate Kardour in exchange for this key. The Blood Raider commander who he has been in touch with is apparently a rival of Kardour's, and is terrified that Blood Raider involvement in the killing or kidnapping of Manel will compromise their entire operation in Araz.

Obviously you are the best canditate to take out Kardour. I will supply you with a bookmark which was included in Ader's message, it should lead you to him. But I warn you, he operates a battleship and might be too tough for you to handle alone. Good luck.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ader Finn tells me in his message that the operation against Manel was not authorized by the highest ranking order of the Blood Raiders, even though members of the organization were involved. This was simply a side-job taken by one of the Blood Raider commanders in Araz, Kardour Maxten. Not only that but Ader reports that rumor in the organization has it that Kardour and the other commanders have had heated exchanges about his involvement in the Manel incident.

This is good news for us, because it means Ader can possibly acquire the help of one of the other Blood Raider commanders in our investigation, indirectly of course. He claims to be rather close to one of these commanders, who has access to a key which should temporarily disable the trap at the acceleration gate leading into Manel's Mansion. But there is a price of course, Ader was asked to assassinate Kardour in exchange for this key. The Blood Raider commander who he has been in touch with is apparently a rival of Kardour's, and is terrified that Blood Raider involvement in the killing or kidnapping of Manel will compromise their entire operation in Araz.

Obviously you are the best canditate to take out Kardour. I will supply you with a bookmark which was included in Ader's message, it should lead you to him. But I warn you, he operates a battleship and might be too tough for you to handle alone. Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Ader should have the key available now at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Go fetch the keycard please, it's the only way we will safely get past the acceleration gate leading into Lord Manel's Mansion.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the keycard in my possession.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll fetch the keycard in no time.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great.  Finally this investigation is getting somewhere ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what next?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Ader should have the key available now at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Go fetch the keycard please, it's the only way we will safely get past the acceleration gate leading into Lord Manel's Mansion.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do my best.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What now?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Now that we have the keycard to get into Lord Manel's Mansion, it's time for you to take over.  Infiltrate the complex and try to find any trace of Manel.  Once you do, report your findings to me.  If you find him alive, then bring him back in once piece, will you?  Uriam Kador will have my head if something happens to him.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Now that we have the keycard to get into Lord Manel's Mansion, it's time for you to take over.  Infiltrate the complex and try to find any trace of Manel.  Once you do, report your findings to me.  If you find him alive, then bring him back in once piece, will you?  Uriam Kador will have my head if something happens to him.

I'll explain the situation. Some time ago, I was taking one of my weekly vacations in my resort here when we were attacked by Blood Raiders. It was during the early morning, before most of my staff arrives for work. I was quite incredulous at the time, after all I have the entire Kador fleet at my disposal. But when I ordered my security personnel to send a distress call, they noticed that all of our communications systems had been tampered with, even the backup! Someone had been going through an extreme effort to cripple us. Even the warp drives of our ships had been disabled, preventing us from leaving that way as well. This sort of operation would require extensive knowledge of our security system, which is quite disturbing.

To cut the story short, our security forces have been fighting for their lives for the past few days. Only due to the exemplary bravery of my security personnel am I still alive. The Blood Raiders have cornered us here in the last pocket of my complex, and we're slowly running out of supplies. Our ships may be bigger, but the Blood Raiders just keep on coming, and for some reason not a single squadron of Kador ships has arrived to aid us.

If you could lend us a hand, I would be eternally grateful. I realize that I could leave this area with you on your ship, but I would only do such a thing as a last resort. I want control over my Mansion back, and the scoundrels who dared attack it destroyed! Every last one of them! I'll be the laughing stock of the Kador family if I flee from such low-life criminals with my tail behind my legs. Please do this for me, {[character]player.name}, I dare not risk any more of my own men.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll start clearing the Blood Raider lines.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: <font color =FFCC11>Start with destroying the weaker Blood Raider ships, and bring 10 of their tags to Lord Manel.</font>

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The targets have been destroyed, as you requested, Lord Manel.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Now it's time to take care of their cruisers and higher-echelon frigates.  That should severely cripple them and pave the way for you to take out their leaders.  Get me 5 of their tags and I'll consider the job done.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Now it's time to take care of their cruisers and higher-echelon frigates.  That should severely cripple them and pave the way for you to take out their leaders.  Get me 5 of their tags and I'll consider the job done.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.  Now there's just the leaders left to take care of.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what's my next assignment?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: You can take these severed disgusting heads now, Governor.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Now the only assignment left for you to complete is taking out their leaders.  Instead of just getting their insignias, I want their heads on a platter.  This will serve as a reminder to all pirates that I am not a man to be trifled with.  Once I have two of their heads, I will relieve you of your duties.  I will also give you a message which you might want to bring to Odan Poun, if he has become concerned with my well being.  In it I will recommend that he give you a reward for a job well done.  But you won't get anything until I have those heads!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You've done a good job, {[character]player.name}.  These heads will make an excellent addition to my collection.  And when you deliver my message to Odan Poun, the rest of the Blood Raiders polluting my complex will be taken care of by the Imperial Navy.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Yes, I have some work.  But it's pretty risky, and involves fighting some pretty nasty mercenaries.  If you think it's over your head, then back out now.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry, I'm up for it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Not bad, not bad.  I didn't expect you to make it out of there alive, {[character]player.name}, much less complete the assignment.  But you proved me wrong.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Well then, to your first assignment. One of the major guilds of Maphante, Giraka, has been a thorn in my side for quite some time. I made a deal with them a few years back which entailed that I had full rights on importing a certain commodity into Garisas. But because of my political feud with Lord Methros and Arachnan, who by the way think they have some kind of authority here when in fact Lord Manel occupies the Governor's seat, I've lost a great deal of power over the local guilds. So Giraka have decided to abandon their business relationship with me and have turned to Lord Methros instead. This of course is unacceptable, Garisas is mine and I won't have that sniveling fool Methros poking his nose where it doesn't belong.

I want to teach Giraka a lesson. That will also send a message to the rest of the guilds that I'm not to be trifled with. But I'm afraid that my own forces are simply not adequate to take on Giraka, and I'd rather not get Lord Manel involved in this dispute. He has enough on his mind already, what with Methros and Arachnan fighting over Araz as if it were their own.

Your first task is to assault a supply station that Giraka owns, in Garisas. They are expecting a shipment of this commodity I told you about, and I want their transport vessels destroyed. The only problem is that the convoy carrying the goods has an escort, and the supply station has a sizable security force as well. So I would suggest that you take care of the guards at the supply station before the convoy arrives. I estimate that the convoy will arrive soon, so I suggest you hurry and take care of those guards right now. Then wait for the convoy to show up and finish your business there. Report to me when your task has been accomplish.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm looking for some work.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the crash as you requested, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
After your last mission, you should have realized by now what I meant by 'the commodity' which me and Giraka have been disputing over. With the convoy destroyed, this gives me an excellent opportunity to get an edge over Giraka on the black market.

The client that was expecting the shipment of drugs by Giraka has in fact come to me to get his fix. He now wants 5 units of crash, which I have managed to acquire in Chanoun. The problem is delivering the crash here, those customs officials at the gate can be quite nasty when it comes to drug transports. I would suggest that you use a fairly cheap ship to get the job done, just incase the gate officials get trigger happy.

Make it here on time and you'll even get a bonus.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Nice work.  This will make my client very happy indeed, if it doesn't kill him heh heh.  But there's more to be done ...

messages.mission.briefing.text: Apparently Giraka's council have become furious at the destruction of the Blood Raider convoy that they were expecting.  They know I was behind it, which leads me to believe we have a traitor in our midst.  But two can play that game, heh heh.  I have my own insiders in Giraka's compounds in Port Maphante, and they inform me that Giraka are planning a strike against my astrofarm plantation in retaliation for the drug convoy incident.  I expect their strike force to be split into waves, which is their general tactic.  But this gives you an excellent opportunity to prevent them from ganging up on you.  Destroy the first waves fast enough and you should have no problems.  But be wary of the mercenary overlord, he's no small fish to fry.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great work, {[character]player.name}, workers at the astro farm inform me that there were no casualties and the structures are still intact.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the elite laser pistols that you requested.  Here you go.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
With the increasing hostilities between Garika and myself I've had to increase the number of personnel in my security forces considerably. It's costing me a fortune by the way. The problem is we are running kind of low on arms for the ground forces, because it so happens that the merchant guilds control most of the small arms trade here in Garisas and Garika has made it very hard for me to find a willing supplier.

But that got me thinking, why settle for standard small arms when I can have something much more effective? Something that will give my ground troops an edge if my enemies here decide to strike at my quarters within Maphante. It so happens that I know exactly where to find such high-tech weaponry. An agent of the Blood Raiders, which I have had extensive dealings with, informed me of a stash of elite laser-pistols which is hidden somewhere in the Mire Keep complex in Garisas, probably within the Grey Barracks. It's being guarded by powerful Blood Raider ships, and will be quite difficult to approach. Bring a few units of those pistols to me and I will reward you generously.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Since you've been so helpful to me I'll let you have something that will earn you plenty of favor points with the Governor of Araz. Well, as long as he's still alive anyway. One of my agents working inside the Governor's Audience Chamber in Chanoun overheard a conversation between Nossa Farad and some other individual. He took the liberty of recording this conversation. It should offer evidence enough that Nossa Farad is planning an assassination attempt against Lord Manel.

I haven't been able to locate Manel, but if you can then give him this message. It will explain everything.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I hear you may be offering a message from Bartezo Maphante...

[Do not accept this mission if you have not already spoken with Bartezo Maphante, in Port Maphante in Garisas.]

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here you go.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, then, quit wasting my time.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: One minute, let me find it in my cargo hold... [Do not accept this mission if you have not spoken with Bartezo Maphante in Garisas already.]

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Message? I don't know what you're talking about.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I don't have all day ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I have this message from Bartezo Maphante ...

messages.mission.briefing.text: Bring Bartezo's message to Lord Manel.  Bartezo is located in Port Maphante in Garisas.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Incredible! I knew Nossa disliked me, but I never thought she'd go this far. The only reason I haven't sacked her is due to the political ramifications, since she is closely related to Moranour Kom. With this evidence, I will be able to take care of Nossa Farad for good. She will lose her position in the Kador family, get thrown in jail, and possibly even be made a slave. Delightful, no?!!

I'm very grateful for your help, {[character]player.name}, and I hope you can make good use of your reward. Take care.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Lai Dai Corporation has requested a batch of data sheets for their researchers on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  Deliver them on time and you'll be rewarded with a bonus.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent that has a more variety of tasks available, simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking. You can also search for agents which will speak to you by checking the database information for the corporation of your choice. To do that simply open the People and Places menu through your NeoCom and search for the corporation name. Right click on it and choose 'show info'. There you should find a list of all of its agents that are available. Their division should give you a hint as to what type of mission they are associated with.

Take care!

messages.mission.briefing.text: The security forces in New Caldari are in constant need of extra planetary vehicles, and we are the main distributer of these vehicles. They have a commander coming in who demands a brand new vehicle whenever he arrives, though, so if you're free then I'd like you to take this unit and transport it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent who has a more of a variety of tasks available; simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking.

There, you should find a list of all of that corporation's agents who are available to you. An agent's division should give you a hint as to what type of mission he or she is likely to give you.

Take care!

They have a commander coming in who demands a brand new vehicle whenever he arrives, though, so if you're free then I'd like you to take this unit and transport it to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thanks for the help, {[character]player.name}.  I suggest you speak with Jeka Vantoh on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}: She needs someone for a job you might be interested in.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We have a trade agreement with the Caldari Navy, where they request a large amount of robotics each day from our factory here in Airkio to supply their assembly plant in Maurasi.  If you would be so kind, you could make a delivery of robotics for us in exchange for {[numeric]rewardQuantity} ISK as well as a bonus if you're fast.  You'll find all the info you need in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thanks for the help, {[character]player.name}.  Before you run off though, I suggest you speak with Jeka Vantoh at the Chief Executive Panel Bureau in New Caldari.  Apparently she's looking for a hand with something.  Until next time!

messages.mission.briefing.text: We just finished producing a batch of antibiotics that I want you to deliver to the Caldari Navy station in Maurasi.  Do this quickly enough and I'll even reward you with a bonus.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: We just finished producing a batch of antibiotics that I want you to deliver to the Caldari Navy station in Maurasi.  Do this quickly enough and I'll even reward you with a bonus.  Sound good?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Kaalakiota Corporation has promised us some construction blocks for the extension we're building to the CEP station here in New Caldari. I've been on the lookout for people willing to make the deliveries for us, and you seem to fit the profile. If you're faster than the last guy who made the run, I'll even give you a bonus. Deal?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Kaalakiota Corporation has promised us some construction blocks for the extension we're building to the CEP station here in New Caldari. I've been on the lookout for people willing to make the deliveries for us, and you seem to fit the profile. If you're faster than the last guy who made the run, I'll even give you a bonus. Deal?

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Now that that's taken care of, there's something else I'd like you to do for me. Just give me a minute here, would you?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Kaalakiota requires a progress report on our work here every now and then. I think you're the right man for this job as well. And remember, if you're fast, then you get a bonus.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work. By the way, could you pay Onmi Mara a visit? I believe she's looking for a freelancer like yourself to do a quick courier job. Right, good day.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A couple of our personnel here in Nonni require a lift.  They need to be at {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} for a meeting at the Mercantile Club.  Please, don't be late!

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Talk to Yrmek Penola at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} if you haven't already.  I think he's in need of a hand.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
So? Are you perhaps offended by the fact that I'm not Caldari? We are allies you know, no need to be rude. I'm just working here as a contractor for Mercantile Club.

Anyway, I need some tobacco transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}. Some State And Region Bank executives requested them, and they made a point in requesting them delivered ASAP. So hurry up with your answer, will you. Yes or no?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: What!?  How dare you ...  I'll ... I'll ... I'll demand your CEO send me an apology!  Yes that's what I'll do.  You better get ready for a demotion, because he won't like what I've got to say about you ...

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, but I don't like Amarrians.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hey, you're an Amarr aren't you?  What brings you to these parts.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Bring some tobacco to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, the State And Region Bank employees will pick up the shipment from your hangar there once it has been delivered.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good job, {[character]player.name}.  Now I suggest you speak with my colleague, Irsen Alaja, at the Mercantile Club Bureau in Kaimon.  He has more work for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'd like you to move a few tourists to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  They are stopping by the entertainment facility at the Nugoeihuvi Development Studio.  It's quite popular with the locals, and we're always open to cheaper labor than the horribly expensive standard transportation services here.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thanks for the help, {[character]player.name}.  I suggest you speak with Enanato Imeri at {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, she's been looking for someone with your enthusiasm to work for the State.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'd like you to move a stack of holoreels to our publisher in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  Take care not to lose the cargo, the holoreels contain thousands of hours' worth of video data!

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I know that a colleague of mine, Hann Najus, is looking for work, so I suggest you pay him a visit in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.

localizedName.text: To Create Silicate Glass You Need ....

messages.mission.briefing.text: I have a job for you, {[character]player.name}.  Demand for silicon is getting out of hand, and our convoys can't keep up.  Could you help them out by transporting this batch of silicon to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}?  It would be much appreciated.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thanks, {[character]player.name}.  I know Samora Miven, at the station you transported the silicon to, has some work to offer, you might want to pay her office a visit.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Caldari Navy has requested more ammo, and we're looking for someone to make the run for us.  Take this batch of hybrid-charges to the Navy assembly station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and I'll give you a reward.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent that has a more variety of tasks available, simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking. You can also search for agents which will speak to you by checking the database information for the corporation of your choice. To do that simply open the People and Places menu through your NeoCom and search for the corporation name. Right click on it and choose 'show info'. There you should find a list of all of its agents that are available. Their division should give you a hint as to what type of mission they are associated with.

Take care!

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.head.text: I cannot wait anymore on you. I have lost faith in you, you are no longer as reliable as i once believed.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text:
I am ashamed to know you. You may very well have damaged the constant supply line of Yorak Eggs to the royal family. For that I can never forgive you.

P.S Those Eggs will have already started to go bad. If you still have them on you I suggest you don't open them as you may not recover from the exposure to the toxins they produce (although that might not be a bad thing).

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I have a mission of great importance to the Empire, can you assist me?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have delivered the vital shipment of Eggs to ensure a constant supply for the Emperor and his family.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I am ashamed to know you. You may very well have damaged the constant supply line of Yorak Eggs to the royal family. For that i can never forgive you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I am ashamed to know you. You may very well have damaged the constant supply line of Yorak Eggs to the royal family. For that i can never forgive you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I would be honoured to carry out such a vital task for the Empire.

messages.mission.timeout.emailheader.text: You took to long to deliver the Eggs, the supply line to the royal family has been disturbed. My head may very well be on the line.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I am far to busy to haul junk food to those lazy royals.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't be bothered anymore, these eggs are really starting to smell out my ship.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Your assistance is greatly appreciated in serving the Emperor and his family.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Although you managed to prevent more Eggs from falling into the hands of the Blood Raiders, we currently do not have enough supplies to cope with the royal household's demands. Therefore i need you to collect me some more. 

I have already located a sufficiant supply from a neighbouring constellation. 

Be quick we do not have much time before the Emperor's Household runs out of their most valued delight.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Your services are duly noted and appreciated. Take pride in knowing that you have carried out an important duty to the Empire.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Your services are duly noted and appreciated. Take pride in knowing that you have carried out an important duty to the Empire. 

Don't go anywhere i have another important mission that i need you to assist me with.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Gah! those blasted pirates are still running rampant throughout the complex. There is no way we can re-establish supplies before the royal family runs out of Yorak Eggs.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
What an outrage!

The Emperor's House requires the finest delicacies from around the region to be delivered to its local office for the royal lineage to feast upon. As their humble servents we are tasked with the timely delivery of Nidupadian Yorak Eggs from this system.

Those blasted Blood Raiders have attacked our main processing plant in this system, we believe that there are still some Blood Raider pirates in the vacinity of the plant lead by a skilled mercenary called 'Keron Vandafelt' who is looking for left over Eggs and killing incomming vessels unaware of the recent attack.

These pirates must be eliminated once and for all. I am sending you the co-ordinates to the attack site now. I want Keron's head on my desk before the end of the day!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I can't be bothered anymore, these eggs are really starting to smell out my ship.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I am ashamed to know you. You may very well have damaged the constant supply line of Yorak Eggs to the royal family. For that i can never forgive you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I would be honoured to carry out such a vital task for the Empire.

messages.mission.timeout.emailheader.text: You Failed Me. For that i cannot forgive.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I am far to busy to haul junk food to those lazy royals.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Those royals can go without those pesky eggs, i've had enough.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Our generals in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} have requested an enormous amount of ground troops in preparation for a possible encounter with the Caldari Navy.  They're basically bolstering the front lines in case of an attack, and Unel seems to be one of the weak points in our defensive perimeter.  Would you be so kind as to transport some of these troops to their destination?  You'll be rewarded of course.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  I suggest you speak with Ansa Vanonari, she's an agent of Chemal Tech which might have some work for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text: {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} has requested another batch of silicon, to be used in the manufacturing process at their factory.  If you would deliver this shipment to them, I would be very grateful.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've certainly earned your reward, {[character]player.name}.  Now I suggest you speak with Ihanani Oksen, she might have something to offer you that's worth your time.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm interested.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
With political relations between the Ammatar and the Minmatar Republic quickly deteriorating, things look dire for our citizens across the border. There are thousands of Nefantar inhabitants stuck in the Tartatven constellation, some who are working there on official business, others who simply settled there years ago. The Republic government refuses to let the majority of them leave their sovereign space and, in fact, has many under constant surveillance.

We fear that their lives may be at risk should the Ammatar declare war on the Republic and invade Audesder. There's already a huge buildup of military forces here in Kenobanala, and many fear that war is inevitable. So it's my task to ensure the safe return of as many Nefantar to Ammatar space as possible.

What I need you to do is deliver a group of Nefantar refugees from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} to Fort Kumar. I will then relocate them to one of our settlements in Joas.

May God light your path.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You have done well, {[character]player.name}. But our task is not finished. There are still thousands of Nefantars that need to be moved. If you have more time on your hands, I'd like you to make a few more runs to Aedald for me.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Duvolle Laboratories is building an extension to its research laboratory in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, and purchased a crap-load of construction blocks from our warehouse. If you would be so kind, can you transport some of these blocks to the station? You'll find all the details you need in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work.  I suggest you speak with Ossa Blaus at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; she wants your help with something, I think.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Quafe Corporation Factory in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} is in constant need of more hydrogen batteries, which they use for some of their reactors.  If you're up for it, then I'd like you to transfer some of the batteries to them before our deadline runs out.  Be on time!

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well done.  I heard Lorchaert Brounave in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} has something to offer you, so stop by his office will you?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Federal Administration has requested another shipment of Quafe Ultra to their Information Center in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  We're always on the lookout for cheap labor to get these transportation jobs done, so if you have time could you take care of this {[character]player.name}?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I believe Ley Serene was looking for you at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} ...

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Killing cultists is my second-favorite pastime. I like it so much that I'd be willing to do it for free, if my all-time favorite pastime wasn't spending money. And lots of it.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I assume the smell of battle drew you here to Araz. This constellation may be a backwater of the Empire, yet interesting things are taking place here. I will not try to deceive you, so let me come clean right from the start. I'm here as a supporter of Lord Methros. Not as an official of Imperial Armaments, but as more of a personal friend; though Lord Methros has been a cherished customer of Imperial Armaments for years.

I do not know how much you know about the situation here in Araz, or what you think you know. Things are a bit complicated here at the moment, and the rumor mill is spinning like crazy. I'd advise you to take any information you get with a grain of salt. The hottest topic is the presence of the Blood Raiders in the constellation, or more precisely, why are they here and what are they up to? Idle tongues have spewed forth the rumor that Lord Methros invited the Raiders here, but heed not the black lies of these mouths. Lord Methros is just as anxious to rid Araz of the Blood Raider plague as everyone else. He even asked me personally to aid him in the matter.

Which finally allows me to answer your question regarding whether I have a job for you. Indeed I do. The Blood Raiders have taken over the ancient imperial fortresses that litter the night sky here in Araz. One of these fortresses lies close by, in the system of Koona. Travel there and enter the forsaken ruins. A group of Blood Raider cultists resides somewhere in there, taking blood from innocent travelers. We must put a stop to this vile practice. Locate the cultists in the fortress and retrieve the blood fund they've accumulated. Return with it to me, and we'll be one step closer to purging Araz of the Raiders' foul presence.

Be warned, though: The fortress can not be entered in anything larger than a cruiser-class ship.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well done. I will return the blood fund to the rightful authorities. Meanwhile, I have another assignment lined up for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I'm still trying to find out what the Blood Raiders are up to here in Araz. All I can say with certainty is that they're putting in a lot of effort into causing havoc here, presumably to further their own gains. Their agenda may be as simple as taking over the constellation. Simple, if megalomaniacal. But it may be that they're searching for something. We can't be sure. Whatever it is they're after, the Blood Raiders are out in force.

Moreover, I just recently discovered that they've sent some of their top scholars here, hiding them in a long-forgotten mining station in the middle of nowhere. These scientists are up to no good, and God knows what they're brewing in that alchemist's tower of theirs. We must put a stop to this operation before their plan unfolds. You took good care of those cultists, so there's no doubt in my mind that a few alchemists shouldn't pose too much of a problem for you. Blow up their tower and bring me back whatever concoctions they were making there.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Excellent job, {[character]player.name}. You are obviously in God's favor. Those plague spores seem destined for some evil purpose; good thing we got them before the Blood Raiders could unleash them on some unsuspecting planet. I can't wait to dispose of them.

I do have another small mission for you, if you're interested.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I know I can rely on you to deliver it quickly and efficiently.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We have to divert our attention away from the Blood Raiders for a moment, {[character]player.name}. I've been perhaps overly eager to help out my friend Lord Methros and as a result have been neglecting my duties here in Araz. The constellation is seeing a lot of black market activity, mainly in the guise of the so-called Giraka merchant guild. The Girakas have been attempting to undermine my business deals here, and my superiors are getting restless.

One of my most important clients is Lady Eroza Arachnan, sister of the despicable Lord Arachnan. Lady Eroza is an important political figure, and we must ensure that she remains a loyal client of Imperial Armaments. She's requested a rather curious item from our catalogue to be brought to her, called the Truthteller. While I won't go into details on how it works ― trade secrets and all that ― I will say that it's a torture device of the most ingenious sort, guaranteed to make anyone spill his beans, and probably his guts too. I've no idea what exactly the good lady intends to do with it, but let's just assume it's for a good cause. I need someone fast and reliable to deliver the device to the ACN station over in Aphi, where a representative of Lady Eroza is waiting for it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great job as always, {[character]player.name}. Now we can get back to business dealing with those pesky Blood Raiders.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What are you trying to do?! These Girakas will be the end of me!

localizedName.text: Clean Hands - Rust in Peace (4 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Now we can get back to taking care of those damned Blood Raiders. You've already visited one of their outposts here in Araz, the old imperial fortress over in Koona, the Bastion of Blood. The Blood Raiders are refurbishing the old keep and intend to make it into an impregnable stronghold. Needless to say, that won't do. We must foil their efforts now before the fortress's defenses come online. Mind you, the Blood Raiders are as hard to get rid of as cockroaches, so I don't intend for you to wipe them out for good. But if we strike them enough times, they might give up eventually.

There's a foreman overseeing the reconstruction of the old keep. If we can take him out, we'll at least delay them until a new foreman has been appointed. Bring me back that foreman's head.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done House Methros a great service, {[character]player.name}. Lord Methros wants you involved in his plans for Araz. There's an ACN reporter over in Koona who is a close confidant of Lord Methros. I'm giving you a holoreel depicting some of the worst atrocities committed by the Blood Raiders in Araz; as a reporter, this fellow will be thrilled to get his hands one something so juicy. Go talk to him, and he will let you in on the ingenious schemes Lord Methros is hatching. I believe the fellow's holed up in what is called "The Ravelin" in the contested Bastion of Blood in Koona.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I've been in contact with Lord Methros, keeping him up to date on what I've been doing to aid his cause. He's happy with your efforts and would have you take care of an important matter for him. This a personal request from Lord Methros himself: I don't have to tell you what an honor that is.

As you know ― better than most by now, I'm sure ― the Blood Raiders are a plague here in Araz. With so many of them nearby, it's only to be expected to find some of their more gruesome forms of entertainment here. They like blood sports, and they've set up an arena to indulge themselves. It's called "The Cauldron," and many good Amarrian souls have lost their lives there. One such soul is a cousin of Lord Methros, who was kidnapped a few weeks ago. Nothing was heard from him, or his kidnappers, for a long time, but now Lord Methros has finally learned the fate of his cousin: He died as an "entertainment" for a crowd of raucous Raiders. While Lord Methros mourns his fallen family member, he must mind the honor of his family. As do other members of House Methros, the young cousin bore the coat of arms of his noble family. Lord Methros wants that back, as the thought of some hideous Blood Raider wearing his sacred coat of arms is unbearable.

Make your way over to the Cauldron and locate the Blood Raider chapel there. The coat of arms is inside the chapel. Bring it back and you will have the eternal love of House Methros.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: The grace of God be with you.

localizedName.text: Clear Head - Throwing Down the Gauntlet (1 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Dakumon tells me you're a resourceful pilot. Let's see if he's right. As you perhaps know, the Arachnan family is the biggest rival of Lord Methros in the constellation. You might say the two families are duking it out to see what family is the most powerful in Araz. Lord Arachnan has a younger brother, Thyram Arachnan, who was a gifted fighter pilot. Sadly, Thyram was also what is commonly known as the black sheep of the family.

A few years back, shortly after he succeeded his father as head of the family, Lord Arachnan had had enough of Thyram's uncouth ways and disowned him, exiling the young scoundrel from the family estates. But Thyram didn't go far; he and his shady friends joined the local pirates and have been roaming the asteroid belts around Araz since then.

Lord Methros wants to send a clear message to the Arachnan family that none of them is safe, while at the same time ridding the habitants of Araz of a pesky pirate threat. And you're the person to deliver that message ― by killing Thyram Arachnan. The only problem is, Thyram discarded his identity long time ago. The only information I have on him is that he has the rank of a warrior with the local pirates. You need to track him down, move between the constellation's asteroid belts, and kill all the warriors you can find until you find the right one. How will you know you got the right one? Thyram still holds some sentiments for his old family, it seems, for it's said that he always wears his dynasty ring. Find the ring, and you know you've got the right guy. Return with the ring to me once you have it.

Oh, and in case you were wondering what a journalist is doing working under cover, let's just say that Amarrian journalism has never been plagued by impartiality and that the stories you instigate yourself are always the most interesting.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: It might take a while to find him, but have a bit of patience {[character]player.name}. I'm sure I can turn this into a good story for ACN, and you'll be at the center of it!

localizedName.text: Clear Head - Code of Chivalry (2 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We Amarrians are nothing if not civilized. We were eating off of gilded plates while the other races were still using their hands to wipe their arses. We have traditions older than sin and customs more ingrained (and sometimes more disgusting) than overgrown toenails.

The feud between House Arachnan and House Methros is getting serious, and in accordance with traditions, there's protocol to be followed. But there's a bit of a twist, you see. Lord Arachnan succeeded his father not many years ago. But while he is the eldest son of his line, he does have an older sibling, a sister. I believe you've already heard her name from me: Lady Eroza Arachnan. She is disputing her brother's claim as the head of the Arachnan family.

Lord Methros, in his infinite wisdom, has decided to throw his lot in with Lady Arachnan. Lord Methros' best and brightest archivists and scholars have been poring over old documents looking for precedents, and it seems they've found one. Some thousand years ago, apparently, when the head of the Arachnan family passed away, he was succeeded not by his eldest son, who by all accounts was frail of mind and body, but by his eldest daughter. She was a most capable administrator and disciplinarian, I understand, as is her descendant, the admirable Lady Eroza Arachnan. Lord Methros passed these records into my hands, and I will make sure they're well broadcast over the ACN netword in the next few days. But protocol calls for this information also to be delivered, by hand, to the lord of the region.

That's where you come in, {[character]player.name}. I want you to deliver the ancestral records to Kador Prime, where an associate of mine will accept them from you and deliver the package to the Kador household. The package is waiting for you in the ACN station over in Aphi, so you have to pick it up there first. This is hot news: Hurry so I can send out my report of the goings on through the ACN network.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We Amarrians are nothing if not civilized. We were eating off of gilded plates while the other races were still using their hands to wipe their arses. We have traditions older than sin and customs more ingrained (and sometimes more disgusting) than overgrown toenails.

The feud between House Arachnan and House Methros is getting serious, and in accordance with traditions, there's protocol to be followed. But there's a bit of a twist, you see. Lord Arachnan succeeded his father not many years ago. But while he is the eldest son of his line, he does have an older sibling, a sister. I believe you've already heard her name from me: Lady Eroza Arachnan. She is disputing her brother's claim as the head of the Arachnan family.

Lord Methros, in his infinite wisdom, has decided to throw his lot in with Lady Arachnan. Lord Methros' best and brightest archivists and scholars have been poring over old documents looking for precedents, and it seems they've found one. Some thousand years ago, apparently, when the head of the Arachnan family passed away, he was succeeded not by his eldest son, who by all accounts was frail of mind and body, but by his eldest daughter. She was a most capable administrator and disciplinarian, I understand, as is her descendant, the admirable Lady Eroza Arachnan. Lord Methros passed these records into my hands, and I will make sure they're well broadcast over the ACN netword in the next few days. But protocol calls for this information also to be delivered, by hand, to the lord of the region.

That's where you come in, {[character]player.name}. I want you to deliver the ancestral records to Kador Prime, where an associate of mine will accept them from you and deliver the package to the Kador household. The package is waiting for you in the ACN station over in Aphi, so you have to pick it up there first. This is hot news: Hurry so I can send out my report of the goings on through the ACN network.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job. Now I can broadcast this sensational news to the rest of the Empire. Talk to me again soon; Lord Methros is nowhere near through with Lord Arachnan.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Predictably, Lord Arachnan is not amused by his sister's actions. I believe "treacherous" and "bitch" were the words he used when describing his feelings. And of course the fact that his arch-rival Lord Methros has intervened on Lady Arachnan's behalf aggravates him even further. But Lord Methros stands by his allies, and he has allied himself with Lady Arachnan. He has know made it his mission in life to depose Lord Arachnan and instate Eroza as the rightful head of the Arachnan family. If he succeeds, the Arachnans will undoubtedly be very grateful and, more importantly, less belligerent toward our lord and master.

With Lord Arachnan declining to step down voluntarily, more drastic measures are called for. (Incidentally, we already started down this path when we killed Lord Arachnan's younger brother. And by "we," I mean "you," of course.) Don't you sometimes just marvel at Lord Methros foresight?

Now all that stands between Lord Arachnan and his sister in the hereditary ladder is Lord Arachnan's son. With him out of the way, the path is clear for Lady Arachnan. The son goes by the name Aradim Arachnan, and he is a real hot-head. The boy fancies himself a knight of the olden days, and his foolish father indulges his fanciful dreams. Aradim and his friends like to duel in their shiny cruisers. Or joust, as they call it. They think so highly of themselves that they've declined protection from Lord Arachnan's household guards, against the better wishes of the lord's chief of security. So taking them out shouldn't be too much of a problem. Just don't fall into the same trap as they likely will and get overly confident. Overconfidence is ugly at best and lethal at worst, so keep your head screwed on straight.

Bring me the head of Aradim Arachnan, as intact as possible. Lord Methros wants it to be quite recognizable by Lord Arachnan when it's presented to him.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Brilliant work, as always. Lord Arachnan must know what is coming by now. Talk to me again when you're ready to thicken the plot a bit more, ok?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Things are heating up now, {[character]player.name}. We've put things into motion that we cannot have perfect control over; I have little idea where it will all lead. Isn't it exciting?

Lord Methros is very pleased with your efforts so far; we have seized the initiative in the struggle against Lord Arachnan, and it will be interesting to see how he'll react to us slaying his son. Lord Methros himself is putting the final touches on the coup de grace for Lord Arachnan, and my editor and I are already quivering in anticipation of what he will do. But in the meantime, I have an interesting assignment for you.

I do not know how familiar you are with Amarr high society, but I can tell you that appearance and prestige are critical. For the Amarrians, you must appear powerful and strong to be prestigious, regardless of your birth. Bloodline alone is not enough. And I have the perfect mission for you to humiliate Lord Arachnan and take him down a peck or two.

The ancestral armor of House Arachnan is back in Araz, after being on display on Kador Prime for the last six months. Needless to say, the armor represents the dignity and ancestry of House Arachnan, so losing it would be a huge blow for Lord Arachnan, as the head of the house. The armor is usually stored in the Black Barbican, an ancient and impregnable fortress over in Chanoun owned by the Arachnan family. They keep many of their most valuable and prestigious items there. But the armor is not yet in the Barbican itself, it's still lying in the Outer Keep. Experts are inspecting it to see if it received any damage on the journey, and the armor won't be transferred into the Barbican for a little while. So if we hurry, we can catch the armor before it's locked away for good in the Barbican.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: And so the world crumbles around the great Lord Arachnan. Oh, the irony! Lord Methros is ready to close the matter now for good by killing Lord Arachnan himself! Talk to me when you're ready.

localizedName.text: Clear Head - Dragon in a Dungeon (5 of 5)

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Fantastic results. No doubt we'll soon see Eroza Arachnan assume the leadership of House Arachnan. Oh, happy days!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Arachnan family owns a manor out in deep space. The grandfather of the current lord of the house built it as a reclusive summer vacation spot for the family. While its location is no secret, its tight security means it receives few visitors. Thus it's an ideal location for secret negotiations. Lord Methros has set Lord Arachnan up beautifully. Using one of his own lieutenants as a decoy, Lord Methros has manipulated Lord Arachnan into thinking he has a spy placed highly in the Methros household. And now a meeting has been arranged between Lord Arachnan and the double-agent in the aforementioned manor.

All we need do is invade the place and blast everything to pieces, including Lord Arachnan himself, allowing Lady Eroza to assume her rightful place as the head of the Arachnan family. You, a dedicated and superbly talented supporter of Lord Methros, are to be given the honor of killing Lord Methros' greatest foe.

Go and blow up the manor house. Lord Arachnan is in it and will surely die with the destruction of the manor. Now here's the only tricky part: Lord Methros wants the surveillance tapes from the internal security systems in the manor. They will serve not only as a proof of Arachnan's death, but will also allow Lord Methros to see with his own eyes the final moments of his arch-nemesis. The internal security system is called Perpetual Chamber Warden. Bring it back to me and your job is done.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Go blow that bastard up, {[character]player.name}! Did I mention I have an exclusive on the surveillance tapes you're bringing back? This will make my career!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I'm a very busy person, so unless you possess something of interest for me, then don't bother talking to me.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's the holo reel, full of Blood Raider atrocities.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: It's your loss.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Don't bother me again until you have a scoop of some sort. With all the goings on in the constellation us journalists are quite busy.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I have a special holo reel I received from an agent in Munory. I'm sure it's of interest to you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I have nothing of interest for you. Let me get back to you when I have.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Ok, lets see this holo reel then.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'm a very busy person, so unless you possess something of interest for me, then don't bother talking to me.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Oh, this is interesting. And there's a encrypted note in here too.

Ah, you have proven yourself as a worthy champion of the cause of House Methros. I have some interesting jobs lined up for someone of your calibre.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'd like you to transport a few State officials to the Federation Navy station in Luminaire.  They've got important business to attend to, so don't be late.  Just drop them off at your hangar in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent that has a more variety of tasks available, simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking. You can also search for agents which will speak to you by checking the database information for the corporation of your choice. To do that simply open the People and Places menu through your NeoCom and search for the corporation name. Right click on it and choose 'show info'. There you should find a list of all of its agents that are available. Their division should give you a hint as to what type of mission they are associated with.

Take care!

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Core Complexion Inc. Factory in {[location]objectiveLocationSystemID.name} informed us that they have another shipment of ammo ready to be transported here.  Our transportation services cannot handle the load of these constant courier jobs so I'd be very grateful if you could take it on yourself to bring one batch of Carbonized Lead ammo here.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thanks.  Don't go anywhere though, I have one more assignment I'd like you to complete.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A friend of mine, Hakar Ogok, apparently is in need of some work.  He resides on the Core Complexion station in Arlek which I sent you to earlier.  Since you're probably heading there anyway to speak with Hakar, you might as well bring a batch of Enriched Uranium with you.  They need it for their factory there.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work.  And don't forget to speak with Hakar before you leave.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Urban Management station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} is getting low on medical supplies.  It's located very close to the border with the Ammatar territories, and due to the current hostilities between our nations, the sick and wounded keep the medical staff there busy.  If you could make a quick run to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} with a batch of antibiotics, I would be very grateful.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  Keep helping the Republic like this and you'll definitely make a name for yourself.  By the way, Eslin Stein was looking for someone like you.  He's located at the Urban Management station in Odatrik.  Good luck.
Good stuff.  Speak with Vilhara Vit at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} if you need more work.  Cheers.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Vherokior Tribe Treasury station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} is in constant demand of coolants.  They're a pretty wealthy bunch out there, and they keep needin' more cooling devices to keep the engines of the shuttles and planetary vehicles, which they use on their expeditions, from overheating.  If you're up for it, you could take a batch of coolants over there and earn a reward.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The Vherokior Tribe Treasury station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} is in constant demand of coolants.  They're a pretty wealthy bunch out there, and they keep needin' more cooling devices to keep the engines of the shuttles and planetary vehicles, which they use on their expeditions, from overheating.  If you're up for it, you could take a batch of coolants over there and earn a reward.

localizedName.text: Ingredients For The Native Freshfood Special (1 of 2)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have a batch of Dairy Products that need to be shipped to the Native Freshfood Warehouse in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} today, {[character]player.name}. They are used in creating the traditional Native Freshfood Special, which is a highly sought after meal. Our executives love it, and so we have this extremely lucrative deal with Native Freshfood corporation where we supply them with the ingredients almost for free and they make the product. To cut our losses we try to hire cheap labor to transfer the goods over to their factory.

So you up for it, {[character]player.name}? You could stop by my friends office, Benur Errus, for a treat if you want. He's located at the very station I'm sending you to.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  Don't forget to pay Benur Errus a visit.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice job, {[character]player.name}.  I couldn't have done it better myself.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Hello, {[character]player.name}. I'm on the lookout for someone who can handle a combat ship, if you know what I mean. You see, there is currently a trade agreement between Native Freshfood and Vherokior Tribe: They supply us with dairy products, and in return we sell them our meals for a very low price. Usually we get many convoys each day from their station in Teonusude, but there has been a problem recently. There is apparently a rogue drone hive somewhere in that system, and the security forces haven't been able to locate it. Our convoys have been attacked occasionally when they are passing through.

Fortunately, our last convoy that was attacked managed to escape, giving us the exact coordinates of where it was ambushed. These drones don't have any common sense, so they're probably still there. Apparently they have taken control over a warp disruptor device near a research outpost and are using it to "capture" passing ships. We've already managed to disable the device remotely, but we need someone to take care of the drones. And that's where you come in. You up for it?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

messages.mission.briefing.text: A friend of mine, Vilhara Vit, is expecting a shipment of our famous Native Freshfood Special.  I'd like you to make the delivery for me.  I'll pay well, of course ...

Your next job is a little more risky, it will send you into 0.5 security space. I doubt you'll encounter any pirates on the way, but you never know.

What I need you to do is transport a few tourists to the Krusual Tribe station in Hek. Hek is a popular tourist area these days and we always have people on the lookout for cheap flights there. If you're up for it, I'll let them know.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thank goodness you arrived there safely.  And by the way, Evika Deng was looking for you.  You'll find her at the Krusual Tribe station in Hek.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Republic Fleet keeps demanding more troops due to the current hostilities with the Amarr-Caldari alliance, and we're forced to comply. I don't know where this will end; so many youths lost in battle... I just hope this won't be like the Great Wars, when an entire generation was almost lost. Ah, tragedy.

Anyway, we cannot avoid our duty. Could you transport a few of these troops to the Republic Fleet station in Lustrevik? I would be very grateful; good, reliable independent transport is hard to find these days.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. You can continue working for various corporations in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} as long as you like. I suggest finding an agent who has a more of a variety of tasks available; simply search the stations that are owned by a corporation within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} and you are bound to find an agent to your liking.

You can also search for available agents by checking the database information for the corporation of your choice. To do that, simply open the "People and Places" menu through your NeoCom and search for the corporation name. Right-click on it and choose "show info." There, you should find a list of all of that corporation's agents who are available to you. An agent's division should give you a hint as to what type of mission he or she is likely to give you.

Take care!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take it, but does this mean we're invading the Federation?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work, {[character]player.name}.  I suggest you speak with Ilia Abazen at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, she has a job or two for you.  Good luck.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I need a hand with a courier job.  The Emperor Family has ordered the movement of millions of foot soldiers to Saidusairds, which is on the Federation - Empire border.  Since {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} is one of the chief suppliers of these troops, our local transportation service is currently flooded.  What I'd like you to do is take one small group of light marines to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, and drop them off at the Carthum Conglomerate station there.  I'm not authorized to send someone like you into low secure space, so unfortunately I can't pay you for making the entire run.  But it will at least save us half the journey.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I need a hand with a courier job.  The Emperor Family has ordered the movement of millions of foot soldiers to Saidusairds, which is on the Federation - Empire border.
