messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: No, we're just strengthening our position there in case of an attack.  With the political climate as bad as it is today, we need to be prepared.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good job.  I suggest that you pay a visit to Korini Nakan, at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  He has some work that you might be interested in.

messages.mission.briefing.text: One of our executives needs to be delivered to the Sarum station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} for a meeting.  He's running pretty late and we haven't managed to find suitable transportation for him in time.  Could you make a quick run to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and deliver him to this destination?  I would be very grateful.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: One of our executives needs to be delivered to the Sarum station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} for a meeting.  He's running pretty late and we haven't managed to find suitable transportation for him in time.  Could you make a quick run to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and deliver him to this destination?  I would be very grateful.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I suggest you speak with the Sarum agent Korini Nakan, he's always on the lookout for someone like yourself.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I need you to make a standard shipment of robotics to the Sarum Family station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, {[character]player.name}.  Just drop off the shipment there and Sarum personnel will pick it up.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I need you to make a standard shipment of robotics to the Sarum Family station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, {[character]player.name}.  Just drop off the shipment there and Sarum personnel will pick it up.  You up for it?

messages.mission.briefing.text: I have a shipment of goods to deliver to the Ministry of War in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, and I was wondering if you could make the run for me, {[character]player.name}.  You'll be paid in full, of course.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I suggest you visit Kanori Agored's office while you're at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. He just might have a job for you. Good luck.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I need to get another shipment of small arms to our troops in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}, {[character]player.name}.  Could you make a trip to the Imperial Navy station there and drop them off at the docking bay?  You'll be rewarded ...

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thanks, {[character]player.name}.  If you're still looking for work, I know Utaka Orasa at the Navy station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} has been looking for someone like you.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We just received a shipment of arms cache, which means another group of our slave troops has been equipped and is ready to move out.  If you have spare time on your hands, {[character]player.name}, I would like you to help us move them to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  Drop them off at the Imperial Navy station there, and my colleagues will take care of the rest.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: We just received a shipment of arms cache, which means another group of our slave troops has been equipped and is ready to move out.  If you have spare time on your hands, {[character]player.name}, I would like you to help us move them to {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name}.  Drop them off at the Imperial Navy station there, and my colleagues will take care of the rest.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} surveillance spotted a small team of Thukker mercenaries in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, probably up to no good. They're wanted men, and need to be taken care of. I would ask you to bring them in for trial but that really isn't necessary, the exception being their captain. I want him taken alive and brought to me. We'd like to figure out exactly what they've been up to.

Your objectives in this mission are not as simple as they sound, however. We haven't been able to locate their captain's hideout yet. but we expect him to show up if you warp to some of his minions who are holed up in a small asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. So I suggest you destroy the first group of mercenaries you encounter as fast as you can, before more reinforcements arrive, or you'll have a heck of a battle on your hands.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} surveillance spotted a small team of Thukker mercenaries in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, probably up to no good. They're wanted men, and need to be taken care of. I would ask you to bring them in for trial but that really isn't necessary, the exception being their captain. I want him taken alive and brought to me. We'd like to figure out exactly what they've been up to.

So I suggest you destroy the first group of mercenaries you encounter as fast as you can, before more reinforcements arrive, or you'll have a heck of a battle on your hands.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work.  But it seems that your captive is no longer of use to us.  My guess is that he injected himself with a deadly viral agent before you arrived.  But don't worry, we expected as much, and we have an antidote ready for you in the infirmary.  However, this will complicate matters a bit.  Now we have to wait for them to make the next move ...

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'd like to do some more investigating on the Thukker mercenary incident.  It would help a great deal if we knew the true identity of the pilot you captured, but to do that I need professional help, since our database here has very limited records of Thukker citizens.  I know of a private investigator residing in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} who might be able to identify the scoundrel.  Bring a DNA sample taken from his body to this acquaintance of mine and we'll see what he comes up with.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Nice work, {[character]player.name}, but I need you ASAP for another mission.  Something dire has come up.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've done us a great service, {[character]player.name}, I can't thank you enough.  I hope you enjoy your reward, you've certainly earned it!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
As I said earlier, something dire has come up. One of our biggest research outposts in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has been attacked. Its location is a secret, so someone must have been snooping around; I'm gonna take a shot and guess that it was those Thukker mercs you took care of.

We've identified the attackers as agents of the Minmatar-Gallente alliance. They've certainly got balls if they've come this far into our territory, I'll give them that. But they must be eliminated before they board the outpost. We'll destroy it before we allow them to get their filthy hands on the stuff our scientists have been researching there.

From the data I've received, there is a large force of Minmatar fighters at the doorstep of our research outpost already, fighting their way in. We are expecting reinforcements to arrive soon, as we spotted two separate groups of Republic ships heading their way already. So you must hurry before the reinforcements arrive, or you'll never be able to take them out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Great, now make haste!  Destroy the Republic forces before their reinforcements arrive, then take care of the extra ships.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've had increasing reports of hostile activity within our borders in the past months, and I've been ordered to take a look into the matter. One of these reports came from a group of miners scouring the Veldspar belts in the outer regions of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They claimed to have seen a large ore convoy heading away from one of the belts, consisting of ships which appeared to be of Gallentean origin. Their escort attacked them immediately, but they escaped unharmed. My best guess would be that these hostiles are in fact pirates, but what intrigued me is that their ships did not appear to match the description of any pirate organization known to infest {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

I want you to take a look into this, {[character]player.name}. Fly to the asteroid belt where the miners were attacked. Wait there for a while, and see if any hostiles show up. If they do, destroy them but try to take back someone from their ranks alive for questioning.

Dismissed.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Interesting.  The pilot you managed to capture is a Federation marine.  This will undoubtedly raise a few eyebrows in central command.  Please wait a bit while I get our next orders.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Take care out there.  I've no idea what to expect, so be prepared for the worst.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've been to the anomaly and this is what I discovered ...

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Something came up while you were off on your reconnaissance mission. A group of slave traders traveling through {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} stumbled upon a strange anomaly that caught their attention. It's a cloud of gas that somehow acts as a shield against long-range scanners, which is probably why our surveillance forces haven't detected it yet. These slave traders couldn't scan what was inside and weren't going to take any chances by approaching the anomaly, so they left and informed the authorities.

I would like you to investigate this strange cloud, and see what's inside. I'll upload a bookmark to the mission details in your Opportunities interface that should send you close enough to the anomaly for your scanner to detect what's inside. If you encounter any hostiles, destroy them. Then report back to me with your findings.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: More Federation vessels?  This smells very fishy indeed.  We'll have to investigate this acceleration gate more thoroughly ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Now be careful out there, who knows what you'll find in that gas cloud.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Incredible. You've done extremely well, {[character]player.name}, but from here on in this investigation is in someone else's hands.  The case has been taken over by someone higher up the chain of command, so from my point of view this investigation is closed.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Since you found the acceleration gate in your last mission, I believe you're the most suited to take a look at what's at the other side. I've received reports of Gallente convoys traveling to and from the area you discovered, but never realized there was a connection until your discovery. So this might be a hidden base of some sort, who knows. But it's for you to find out.

When you arrive at the warp-in point after using the acceleration gate hidden inside the anomaly, I want you to neutralize any hostiles you find. I'm especially keen on finding out what these convoys have been transporting, so if you see one then destroy it. I'll send someone else to pick up the pieces after you're done, so don't leave any survivors.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good luck out there.

localizedName.text: Secrets Of The Mire Keep (1 of 4)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
There is a rumor afloat that the ruins of the Mire Keep in Garisas is currently being used as a Blood Raider stronghold. We've known this for many years, but this is the first time rumors such as this have spread so far within the civilian populace. It's causing quite a stir, and the people demand action. With the limited funding we have, a direct assault will hit our wallet quite hard. Not to mention the Blood Raider forces will simply come back in a few months and reclaim the area, or build another base of operations elsewhere in Araz. We also do not want to start a full fledged war with those pirates, not when our military is busy with the Republic and Federation scum.

But even so we need to prove that we're doing something about them. And for that we have you, {[character]player.name}. Your first task is to infiltrate the Keep and retrieve some of their bio-engineers within the infamous Blood Factories. I want to know more of what is actually transpiring in there. With knowledge comes power.

We're under a huge amount of pressure, even from the Emperor Family, to rid all of our territories of the Blood Raider religion and the gruesome ritualistic murders committed by it's followers. So don't screw this up, we might not get another chance at this if they know what we're after.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Find Blood Factories in the Contested Amarr Mire Keep complex in Garisas, and capture Blood Raider scientists from their laboratories inside those structures.  Return to your agent once you have captured 5 scientists.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You did good out there, {[character]player.name}.  My men have already started interrogating the prisoners.  I'll let you know when we have some results.  In the meantime, I have some other work for you so listen up ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good to know you're ready for this assignment, {[character]player.name}.  I suggest you thoroughly search the Mire Keep complex for any Blood Factories, you'll probably find the scientists inside.  Good luck.

I want you to enter the Slope and kill a few Corpse Dealers for me. Bring me back some of these inactive bug-ridden corpses; I want to investigate further what these bug devices can do.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Welcome, capsuleer. Your presence here in the Ravelin indicates to me that you are interested in stemming the tide of Blood Raiders into Koona. The Blood Raider cult is out in force in this constellation, and here in Koona they've made this old Imperial fortress their own. Thankfully, they've not been here all that long, so there's still time to do something about it.

The local authorities seem either unable or unwilling to deal with the Blood Raiders once and for all. I've even heard rumors that Lord Methros, ruler of Koona and the nearby Munory, is secretly dealing with the Blood Raiders, or with some part of the cult at least. Be that as it may, all of my attempts to get help from the lord have fallen on deaf ears, and even my pleas to the Imperial Navy went unanswered. I guess it's all up to me.

Amarr Constructions has poured a lot of ISK into building up its infrastructure here in Araz, and we're not about to let some murderous scumbag fanatics ruin it all for us. My superiors have given me full rein to deal with the problem, including a vast warchest to reward those willing to aid me in this endeavor. If you're interested, I might have several assignments for you.

The Blood Raiders are strengthening their defenses all the time. We will deal with that later, but for now we must put an end to a particularly devilish little scheme of theirs. For all their fanaticism, the Blood Raiders are no fools, and they know they will be resisted. So they're expecting a lot of visitors in the Bastion of Blood. They'll fight with every means at their disposal, and not just firepower alone. One of their more cunning plans, our spies have discovered, is to fill bodies they've already drained of blood with bug devices and Trojan horses. They disperse the bodies around the complex in the hope that someone compassionate (or foolish) enough will pick it up. Once the bug-ridden corpse is inside the ship, it can wreak all kinds of havoc.

Fortunately, the plan is still only in its infancy. The Blood Raiders have started littering the first room in the complex with corpses, but the bug devices in them remain inactive. That gives us a chance to clean some of them up before they come online, plus kill some Blood Raiders in the process. I want you to enter the Slope and kill a few Corpse Dealers for me. Bring me back some of these inactive bug-ridden corpses; I want to investigate further what these bug devices can do.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent job. Now we can start doing some serious damage to the Blood Raiders here in the Bastion.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Welcome aboard, {[character]player.name}. The Corpse Dealers shouldn't be too much of a problem as they're not expecting anyone to engage them just yet, but be careful nevertheless.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Go into the fortress and hunt them down. Once you've collected a sizeable amount of antiseptic biomass, return to me with it. Perhaps some bereaved families will at least be able to bury their loved ones, instead of having to anxiously wait for years for any news of them.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I doubt your actions against the Corpse Dealers were enough to scare the Blood Raiders off from carrying out their macabre plan. But at least it tells them that we're on to them. Once I've analyzed the bug-ridden corpses you brought me, we'll have a better idea how we can foil their plan further. In the meantime, we're ready to strike the Blood Raiders at the heart of their operation. The cultists have been busy ambushing innocents around the constellation, and every day dozens of corpses are taken to the Bastion of Blood to be drained in their horrid rituals. Most have been processed with antiseptic agents to hinder rot. The bodies, or what remains of them, are brought in by special couriers called simply Corpse Collectors.

Enter you: Go into the fortress and hunt them down. Once you've collected a sizeable amount of antiseptic biomass, return to me with it. Not only are we putting spikes in the Blood Raiders' operation, but we're also saving the remains of those they've killed from a fate worse than death. Perhaps some bereaved families will at least be able to bury their loved ones, instead of having to anxiously wait for years for any news of them.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well done. I'm all ready to run a DNA test on the biomass you brought me. I hope we get some positive results. Talk to me again soon; you've been of great help to me so far, and I have several jobs earmarked just for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Bring the remains of Daryd Kador to his family for proper burial.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Most of the biomass you brought me is too mixed for DNA analysis, but fortunately some pieces were more or less intact. In fact, my analysis shows that one of the bodies you brought back is that of a member of a minor branch of the Kador family, one Daryd Kador. Now, Daryd was not part of the ruling branch of the Kador family and thus stood a long way from the Kador throne. Nevertheless, I feel it is my duty to have his remains brought to the Kadors for proper burial.

Of course, since it was you who found him, I feel it's only right that you finish the job and bring Daryd Kador's remains home. It's not much of a job, but I can use the time while you're gone to put the final touches on the next step in my personal crusade against the Blood Raider heretics. Just so you know, I have acquired a passkey to the innermost sanctum of the Bastion of Blood, and once you've returned, I aim to put it to good use ... in your hands. Just don't take too long getting back, or I'll be forced to give the passkey to someone else to do the job.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job as always, {[character]player.name}. Now we can strike the Blood Raiders were it really matters. I have to step out for just a moment; talk to me again when you're ready.

localizedName.text: Blood Hunt - Cut to the Heart (4 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The passkey I gave you, the Bastion Master Key, was built by Amarr Constructions centuries ago, which explains how I got my hands on it. It will give you access to the Treasure Chamber and allow you to bring some friends along. But be very careful because the gate reconfigures its access algorithms each time it's used, so you can use the passkey only once ― which means you get only one shot at completing this assignment. Fail and we're through.

Before you panic, I've done some research to help you prepare. Most likely you'll be confronted by a squadron of Blood Raider destroyers the moment you enter the chamber. The generator building is guarded by a few battleships, supported by several battlecruisers and a few elite frigates. Be careful of the frigates, as they can warp scramble you. I want you to destroy the generator building, but otherwise I leave the planning of this operation in your capable hands.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Blood Raiders have centered their operation on what they call the "Treasure Chamber," the innermost sanctum of the Bastion of Blood. There they are constructing a massive power generator; once operational, it will generate enough power for the Blood Raiders to operate an insane number of defensive structures around their station. Destroying the unfinished generator now would be a huge blow to the Blood Raiders, plus it would allow us to continue harassing them in the Treasure Chamber because their mega-defense systems would remain inoperable.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Outstanding job, {[character]player.name}! Your success fills me with confidence. Talk to me again soon. With you at my disposal, I'm raring to have a go at the top-echelon Blood Raiders in Araz. With you on our side, I'm sure we'll have no problem dealing with them.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Tough luck, {[character]player.name}. I thought you were made of sterner stuff. Clearly I overestimated your talents. I guess I'll have to scramble our ships to deal with the Blood Raiders en masse. God knows what we'll do about the generator and their uber-defenses now, though... Maybe I should look into evacuation parameters.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great job. Of course, I expected nothing less of you. Your talents are unquestioned, and I´m honored to call you friend, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Blood Raiders have a massive command outpost in Garisas. It is very well defended, so don't even think of entering it unless you have backup and are packing a lot of firepower. The Blood Raiders have a battle station there that acts as their command outpost, but that is not our concern. Instead, head for the innermost room in the outpost, the Commander Keep. There you should find the leader of the Blood Raider operation here in Araz, Archpriest Hakram.

Bring me the Archpriest's head to complete this assignment and you will have done not only Amarr Constructions, but the whole Amarr Empire a great service.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Thanks to you, the Blood Raiders have been dealt severe blows here in Koona. Maybe that will set their timetable back some weeks and even make them abandon the Bastion all together. I feel there's little to be gained by harassing them further here in Koona, though. If we really want to hurt the Blood Raiders, we must attack higher up the chain of command.

The local lord over the Garisas system here in Araz, Baron Bartezo Maphante, has long since lost his autonomy in the system. It is now run by criminal elements and merchant guilds. Thus, it was easy for the Blood Raiders to establish themselves in force there. Now, pretty much the whole Blood Raider operation in the constellation is run from Garisas. That is were we must hit them.

The Blood Raiders have a massive command outpost in Garisas. It is very well defended, so don't even think of entering it unless you have backup and are packing a lot of firepower. The Blood Raiders have a battle station there that acts as their command outpost, but that is not our concern. Instead, head for the innermost room in the outpost, the Commander Keep. There you should find the leader of the Blood Raider operation here in Araz, Archpriest Hakram. He is a close friend of Omar Sarikusa, the supreme leader of the Blood Raiders, and is acting on Sarikusa's behalf here in Araz. If we take Hakram out, their whole operation will be thrown into disarray, which might allow us, and those local authorities actually willing to do something, the chance to drive the Blood Raiders out for good.

Bring me the Archpriest's head to complete this assignment and you will have done not only Amarr Constructions, but the whole Amarr Empire a great service.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm a happy man, {[character]player.name}, for I know this tough assignment is in the hands of the very best.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Welcome, weary traveler. Are you here to visit the holy spa? Araz holds a special place in the hearts of true believers, for it was here that the great prophet Angitus Omira had his divine visions. Every year thousands of pilgrims make their way here to visit and pray at the spa.

Alas, lately is had become very dangerous for pilgrims to enter Araz. Blood Raiders are everywhere and the ongoing feud between the most prominent noble families in the constellation destabilizes things even further. And Kador does nothing but watch, but that is to be expected as he likes his underlings to fight each other. That way, they're too busy trying to choke each other to harbor any thoughts of uniting against their liege lord. What is more, it allows Kador an easy way to determine the strengths and weaknesses of his feudal lords. He's a clever man, but as is so often the case it is us lesser persons that suffer.

But enough of that. Let's get back to the business at hand. For many years I have aided pilgrims on their voyage to the Prophet's Spa. With the volatile situation I've had to take extra precautions to make sure nothing untoward happens on their way over here. One such precaution is to have experienced pilots ferry the pilgrims the last stages of their journey. Your presence here tells me you're interested in work, so that is what I'm offering you. It's not much fun, but for the pilgrims it's quite vital. And if you do well I have another job for you that might more to your taste. I take it you have nothing against killing Blood Raiders? Never mind, we worry about that later. For now, I want you to fetch a few pilgrims and bring them to Munory. I will then guide them on the last part of their sacred journey.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry, I'll get those pilgrims here safely.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well done, I had a feeling you wouldn't mind doing something that was so trivial for you, yet so vital for others. Talk to me again if you're interested in putting that Bastion Master Key I gave you to some good use. Be careful with it, it can be used only once.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't take any unnecessary risks, the pilgrims are here seeking solace, not excitement.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Are you here just for the view, or do you have a job that needs taken care of?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So what is this job you promised me?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I hope you still have the passkey I gave you, because you'll need it for this work I'm offering you. I don't know how much you know about the Blood Raiders and their customs. Unfortunately, it is my job to know these things and let's just say that many of their rituals are quite gruesome in their cruelty and barbarity. It pains me that our glorious Scriptures could be so fanatically misinterpreted.

The Blood Raiders base many of their believes on parts of the Scriptures which authority has been put into doubt. These texts are nothing short of heretical in nature and the Emperor has long since decreed that possessing them, let alone preach or practice the vile teachings, leads to immediate excommunication. Now I have reliable sources telling me that the Blood Raiders have carried these despicable texts into the Empire, hiding them away in a fortress they control over in Koona. The fortress is appropriately named Bastion of Blood and in its inner most chamber, called the Treasure Chamber, they have erected an altar where they can practice their inhuman rituals. A copy of these heretical texts, called the Apocryphon, is stored there and I want you to get it for me so I can burn it.

Enter the Bastion of Blood in Koona, make your way to the Treasure Chamber using the Bastion Master Key I gave you and destroy the Altar of the Blessed. Come back with the Apocryphon to complete this job. Be careful though, the Blood Raiders are rebuilding the fortress and are out in force there. In particular, they are building a power generator in the Treasure Chamber that is heavily defended, so stay well clear of it.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So what's the hurry?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I'm glad you're here, {[character]player.name}. Something terrible has happened. The pilgrims you brought me were ambushed by Blood Raiders at the Prophet's Spa itself. The Blood Raiders have never before been so bold as to attack us directly there. It only yet another sign that everything is falling apart here in Araz.

I feel obligated to the families of the fallen pilgrims to try and get their bodies from the clutches of Blood Raiders. I shudder to think what those barbarians will do to them. I want you to hurry over to the Spa and assault the Blood Raiders there. I fear most of them have left, but some may still be waiting for more pilgrims to appear. Show them no mercy, they don't deserve it. Bring me back the bodies you find. I will make sure they will be treated with dignity and respect.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Outstanding work! With you at side I'm getting more and more confidant that Araz may still be saved. I even have a plan on how we can bolster the constellation's image as a site of holiness and spirituality. Talk to me if you want to hear more.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew you would come through for me. Please hurry before all the Blood Raiders leave the Spa.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Prophet's Spa has been the constellation's main attraction for pilgrims, but the recent unfortunate events at the spa have diminished it's value. I have been looking into ways to revive the pilgrim trade and I think I have found the perfect way. There's a musty old museum over on Koona II that's been in steady decline for decades. The curator there is as anxious as I am to bring back the glory days and I have just the thing for the museum.

The death shrouds of holy people are always items of reverence for strong believers and none more so than shrouds of saints. I have acquired several shrouds of St. Ageroth himself, they're lying in my hangar not far from here. I want you to bring them to me, I will get them to the curator. You may be quizzical about why there are so many shrouds, but I assure you that they're all authentic. We Amarrians have been in the holy business for a long, long time and know what needs to be done. Every time a notable holy person dies we make sure to wrap it in as many death shrouds as possible. It makes sense, why use only one that can get damaged? This way, we can even sell a few for a healthy profit. Fetch the shrouds for me and I think Araz will be back on the map as a place to visit for pilgrims.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Fantastic job as always, {[character]player.name}. I'll get the shrouds to the curator, but in the meantime I have an important job for you, if you're interested. It's combat oriented this time, so bring along your big guns.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: The grace of God looks upon you, {[character]player.name}. You walk the path of the righteous and I feel it will lead you to untold glory before your journey comes to an end.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have one more boon to ask of you before I allow you to go your merry way. You have put a huge effort into fighting the Blood Raiders for me, so why stop now? I think it's time we go on the offensive and try to shake things up a bit for our friends the Blood Raiders. My hope is that it will give me the breathing space to get the pilgrim run back into order.

The Blood Raiders are nothing if not devoted to their twisted believes. So it's not surprising that they are putting as much effort into erecting religious sites as into fortifications and military outposts. As we know only too well they're not about to let go of their filthy habits just because the control of this constellation hangs in the balance. I want you to strike at their most sacred site they've built so far. Sacred in their eyes of course, not mine. Not far from here they've built a temple they call the Temple of Revelation and in it they store the Arc of Revelation. It contains many relics of immense spiritual value to the Blood Raiders. If we can steal it from them it would be a huge blow to their morale and esteem here in Araz. Once again I hope it will give them second thoughts about staying here. We'll see how it pans out, just get me that Arc of Revelation. It goes without saying that the temple is no doubt heavily defended so some reinforcements might be in order for you before you head out there.

localizedName.text: Secrets Of The Mire Keep (2 of 4)

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Blood Raiders guarding and coming through the rogue stargate have been taken care of, as you requested.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It seems that you brought more than just those scientists back with you, {[character]player.name}. A squadron of Blood Raider ships apparently followed you through the stargate and have been wrecking havoc in the outlying settlements in Jakri searching for you. While chasing down a few of these rascals our security forces stumbled upon a gold mine, an old smuggler stargate used by the Blood Raiders to enter Jakri unnoticed!

We haven't attempted to attack the stargate yet, and I believe they are unaware that we have discovered it. But that will change soon. So before I send you off to face the vagabonds you brought with you to Jakri, I want you to plug this 'hole' in our security network. As long as their stargate is operational, they will keep sending more ships to look for you and the missing scientists. And we can't have that, now can we ...

Your objectives are probably a little more complicated than you're used to. I want you to fly to their stargate, destroy the guards there, and then wait for more to come through. Take out the next wave of Blood Raiders that appear through the stargate, which should be from 4 to 6 minutes according to our experts, rinse and repeat until they stop sending more forces. This will cause a maximum amount of casualties on their side. I will send in our technicians to disable the stargate once you've accomplished your task.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great, our technicians will take care of the stargate immediately.  Now get ready for your next assignment, we need to take care of the stragglers that are still in Jakri before Odan Poun has my head for lunch for 'inviting' them here ...

localizedName.text: Secrets Of The Mire Keep (3 of 4)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Now it's time to take care of those troublemakers in Jakri that followed you here from Garisas. They're causing immense destruction and terror while they scour the settlements in search of any trace of your whereabouts. I'm starting to think they've abandoned hope of finding you and have resorted to simply fulfilling their satanic desire to torture and maim those who do not belong to their religious sect.

We've had reports of 4 settlements being attacked recently. They are located in a single pocket of deadspace, connected by acceleration gates. I want you to fly over there and drive them off. If possible destroy all of their ships. And whatever you do, don't visit any of the structures inside the settlements, we'll have trained personnel take care of that later. I do not believe you're prepared to witness the gruesome scene they usually leave behind in their wake.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great job.  Even though these settlements suffered heavy casualties, it could have been worse.

localizedName.text: Secrets Of The Mire Keep (4 of 4)

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done humanity a great service, {[character]player.name}, by delivering such a devastating blow to the Blood Raider cult.  Accept my reward, and know that you are not only wealthier for your actions but have also gone one step closer to securing a place within our God's heavenly domain.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Now for your final mission, {[character]player.name}. Our interrogation of the Blood Raider scientists you captured has revealed some terrifying facts. Apparently they have started to use bio-engineering to create human clones by the millions, to accommodate their increasing population. They use these clones in their bloody rituals, even though clones would essentially be considered an 'impure' sacrifice according to their religion. To fool the members of their cult, they slightly alter their facial and body appearance. It seems their old way of mass breeding humans through captive female slaves was not living up to demand, and had to be supplement else causing unrest within the organization.

Our morale obligation is of course to put a stop to this, even though we risk starting an undesirable war. This is my personal command, {[character]player.name}, and does not come from higher up the chain of command. It is your choice to act on my words, but should you do so then I will reward you.

What I request of you is to destroy the headquarters of the Blood Raiders in Mire Keep within Garisas. It is located inside an asteroid, in an area called 'The Blood Keep'. Bring me evidence of your deed and I will consider the mission accomplished.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} surveillance spotted a small team of Thukker mercenaries in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, probably up to no good. They're wanted men, and need to be taken care of. I would ask you to bring them in for trial but that really isn't necessary, the exception being their captain. I want him taken alive and brought to me. We'd like to figure out exactly what they've been up to.

Your objectives in this mission are not as simple as they sound, however. We haven't been able to locate their captain's hideout yet. but we expect him to show up if you warp to some of his minions who are holed up in a small asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. So I suggest you destroy the first group of mercenaries you encounter as fast as you can, before more reinforcements arrive, or you'll have a heck of a battle on your hands.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work.  But it seems that your captive is no longer of use to us.  My guess is that he injected himself with a deadly viral agent before you arrived.  But don't worry, we expected as much, and we have an antidote ready for you in the infirmary.  However, this will complicate matters a bit.  Now we have to wait for them to make the next move ...

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've done us a great service, {[character]player.name}, I can't thank you enough.  I hope you enjoy your reward, you've certainly earned it!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
As I said earlier, something dire has come up. One of our biggest research outposts in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has been attacked. Its location is a secret, so someone must have been snooping around; I'm gonna take a shot and guess that it was those Thukker mercs you took care of.

We've identified the attackers as agents of the Minmatar-Gallente alliance. They've certainly got balls if they've come this far into our territory, I'll give them that. But they must be eliminated before they board the outpost. We'll destroy it before we allow them to get their filthy hands on the stuff our scientists have been researching there.

From the data I've received, there is a large force of Minmatar fighters at the doorstep of our research outpost already, fighting their way in. We are expecting reinforcements to arrive soon, as we spotted two separate groups of Republic ships heading their way already. So you must hurry before the reinforcements arrive, or you'll never be able to take them out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Great, now make haste!  Destroy the Republic forces before their reinforcements arrive, then take care of the extra ships.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'd like to do some more investigating on the Thukker mercenary incident.  It would help a great deal if we knew the true identity of the pilot you captured, but to do that I need professional help, since our database here has very limited records of Thukker citizens.  I know of a private investigator residing in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} who might be able to identify the scoundrel.  Bring a DNA sample taken from his body to this acquaintance of mine and we'll see what he comes up with.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Nice work, {[character]player.name}, but I need you ASAP for another mission.  Something dire has come up.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've had increasing reports of hostile activity within our borders in the past months, and I've been ordered to take a look into the matter. One of these reports came from a group of miners scouring the Veldspar belts in the outer regions of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They claimed to have seen a large ore convoy heading away from one of the belts, consisting of ships which appeared to be of Gallentean origin. Their escort attacked them immediately, but they escaped unharmed. My best guess would be that these hostiles are in fact pirates, but what intrigued me is that their ships did not appear to match the description of any pirate organization known to infest {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

I want you to take a look into this, {[character]player.name}. Fly to the asteroid belt where the miners were attacked. Wait there for a while, and see if any hostiles show up. If they do, destroy them but try to take back someone from their ranks alive for questioning.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Interesting.  The pilot you managed to capture is a Federation marine.  This will undoubtedly raise a few eyebrows in central command.  Please wait a bit while I get our next orders.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Take care out there.  I've no idea what to expect, so be prepared for the worst.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've been to the anomaly and this is what I discovered ...

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Something caught my attention while you were off on your reconnaissance mission. A group of slave traders traveling through {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} stumbled upon a strange anomaly that caught their attention. It's a cloud of gas that somehow acts as a shield against long-range scanners, which is probably why our surveillance forces haven't detected it yet. These slave traders couldn't scan what was inside and weren't going to take any chances by approaching the anomaly, so they left and informed the authorities.

I would like you to investigate this strange cloud, and see what's inside. I'll upload a bookmark to your mission details that should send you close enough to the anomaly for your scanner to detect what's inside. If you encounter any hostiles, destroy them. Then report back to me with your findings.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Now be careful out there, who knows what you'll find in that gas cloud.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Incredible. You've done extremely well, {[character]player.name}, but from here on in this investigation is in someone else's hands.  The case has been taken over by someone higher up the chain of command, so from my point of view this investigation is closed.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Since you found the acceleration gate in your last mission, I believe you're the most suited to take a look at what's at the other side. I've received reports of Gallente convoys traveling to and from the area you discovered, but never realized there was a connection until your discovery. So this might be a hidden base of some sort, who knows. But it's for you to find out.

When you arrive at the warp-in point after using the acceleration gate hidden inside the anomaly, I want you to neutralize any hostiles you find. I'm especially keen on finding out what these convoys have been transporting, so if you see one then destroy it. I'll send someone else to pick up the pieces after you're done, so don't leave any survivors.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Something urgent has come up. An agent working for {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} managed to discover a Federation built stargate within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}! Apparently it was being used by Roden Shipyard, for what purpose we do not yet know. But our sources within the Federation Navy have reported that a large fleet of Federation ships are headed our way, through the gate. They must not reach the stargate in time.

Your objectives are simple, but extremely critical. You must destroy the stargate immediately, before the Federation forces manage to get through. If they do, I seriously doubt you will be able to handle them.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thank goodness you made it, {[character]player.name}.  I was really worried there for a minute.  With the stargate destroyed, they won't be able to send any more reinforcements for a while.  But we still have to deal with those that did make it through before the stargate was discovered.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Make haste!  Every minute you waste, the enemy draws closer.  Our estimates are that they will arrive through the stargate in a matter of 4 or 5 minutes.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
While the royal family does not officially condone the fighting between Methros and Arachnan, they do not see it as any major threat to their claim to power in this region. To that end they are willing to let it continue as the infighting is bringing a much needed economic boost to the region.

With this in mind, it is our duty to monitor the conflict and inform the Emperor and his council should either of the parties engage in business detrimental to the empire.

We have a mission suited to your talents my friend. Lord Methros and Arachnan have secret outposts inside their sphere of influence in Araz, from where they conduct various operations. We are of course aware of these outposts, as the Emperor Family has ears and eyes in all corners of the Empire, figuratively speaking of course. I want you to make an unannounced visit to these outposts and retrieve an encrypted data burst located inside them.

I want you to start with Lord Methros' outpost. I'll give you a bookmark to it's exact location, of course. I will inform his guards of your visit as soon as you arrive, since doing it any earlier would compromise your mission.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the Encrypted Data Burst, but I have some disturbing news as well ...

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that data chip back here in no time.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: The presence of the Blood Raiders is disturbing news, I have another assignment for you already if you feel up to the job?

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Do this for me and you will go far within the Amarr Empire.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Do you have any work for a servant of the Empire?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Piece of cake ...

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I hope the Blood Raiders want to pick another fight with me!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Thank you, {[character]player.name}. It doesn't surprise me that Lord Arachnan's henchmen claimed that the Guardian Drone was malfunctioning, most likely a lie to buy them more time to edit or replace the data burst. Let's just hope you were quick enough to prevent that from happening.

I have still heard no news of the Blood Raiders presence at Lord Methros' Outpost. But I have another mission of high importance for you to take on.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Be quick, we don't want to give them enough time to replace the data inside the chip to hide anything which may damage their reputation.  As mentioned already, they won't be expecting you, but as soon as you arrive I will inform them of your surprise visit.  So don't waste any time once you get there!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You said you had some more work for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: I am incredibly puzzled by the large presence of Blood Raiders around the outpost. In fact I am surprised any Blood Raiders were at that rendezvous point.  But before we pursue an investigation of that any further I would like you to conduct a similar mission to Lord Arachnan's 'secret' outpost.  Retrieve the data burst from there as well, and bring it to me.  As before you should encounter no resistance from Arachnan's guards, as you are there on my behalf.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
While you were retrieving that data file for me, one of our agents, Amolah Kesti, was dispatched to retrieve more intelligence on Lord Methros and his troops and possible reasons to explain the Blood Raider presence along side his convoy. Unfortunately our agent was discovered as he was making his escape. Before his ship was destroyed he managed to launch several high security containers. Inside are fragments of information on Lord Methros. According to him, this information was too sensitive to send over a standard transmission.

Apparently he didn't have time to send the containers on a direct route to our station here in Zimse. Instead they are floating in space at a random location within the system. Hopefully they will have gotten caught in a moon or planet's gravitational pull, which would narrow down the search a bit. But the easiest way to find them would be to search for their cosmic signature, as they are programmed to release one after a certain amount of time has passed.

Your objectives are to find these containers and bring their contents to me.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will get those fragments back to you before you have chance to setup the decoder.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Find the first data fragment inside a floating container in space.  You know that there probably is a cosmic signature located near it, and that the container might be located near a celestial object in Zimse.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: This fragment is insufficient.  I need more to piece together the information Amolah Kesti was trying to send to us.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I have faith in you, my friend.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You said you have another mission for me?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will do as you ask.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I need you to retrieve another data fragment from one of Amolah Kesti's ejected containers.  Scour Zimse for any traces of it, or use scanner probes to find it's cosmic signature.  Return to me once you have completed your objective.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I need you to retrieve another data fragment from one of Amolah Kesti's ejected containers.  Scour Zimse for any traces of it, or use scanner probes to find it's cosmic signature.  Return to me once you have completed your objective.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Again, I don't have enough to piece together the information ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good luck ...

messages.mission.briefing.text: As before, I need another data fragment from Amolah Kesti's message.  Scour Zimse for any traces of it, or use scanner probes to find its cosmic signature.  Return to me once you have completed your objective.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As before, I need another data fragment from Amolah Kesti's message.  Scour Zimse for any traces of it, or use scanner probes to find its cosmic signature.  Return to me once you have completed your objective.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Interesting.  Give me a few hours to piece together the information.  But in the meantime there's another mission I want you to complete.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Lord Methros' Encrypted Data Burst is to complex for me to decode, I want you to take your copy to a rendezvous site in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. There will be a courier waiting for you to deliver it to a top secret laboratory. Hopefully they will have better luck than me. Report back when you have delivered it or if you run into any difficulties.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I'm back but I have some bad news.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll be back before you know it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Go quickly; the courier will not wait long for you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm hungry for more work ...

messages.mission.briefing.text: Hmm how could The Blood Raiders have known about our rendezvous point? This is most disturbing, get back to me quickly once you're ready as I have more work for you.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
That Data Burst must have incredibly valuable data on it; it must be why we keep encountering resistance whenever it is being transported. To that end I have decided to bring the scientists and equipment to me. But there is one issue I would like you to take care of before we move on. Our agent that was killed managed to write down the coordinates of a Blood Raider stronghold which he uncovered during his time undercover. It's located in Garisas, inside the Mire Keep. You should have no problems finding it, the Mire Keep is still bookmarked on most conventional starmaps.

He mentioned something about Corelum Commanders stationed there who are running the place. I want you to kill at least one of the commanders and return to me with a token of his worth. We'll see what effect that has on their operations in Araz.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Just as I promised, 1 Warm Corelum Commander Medallion

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll bring it to you with warm blood still on it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Find the Contested Amarr Mire Keep in Garisas, destroy one of the Blood Dukes, and return to your agent with his medallion.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You have done well my friend. Come back to me when you need another job, I've got one just in mind.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Work, work, I can't seem to get enough of it, can you help quench my thirst?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You told me to come back when I wanted another job, so here I am.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The note has been delivered. Nice receptionist at the station I might add.

messages.mission.briefing.text: It looks like your skills have been noticed by higher echelons of my section. There is somebody expecting you, he goes by the name of Ammargal Detrone. You can find him in Nidupad. However he's very formal, and requires an official ID card before he'll deal with you. Take this note to the Emperor Family station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and you'll get your ID card. Good luck my friend.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: It looks like your skills have been noticed by higher echelons of my section. There is somebody expecting you, he goes by the name of Ammargal Detrone. You can find him in Nidupad. However he's very formal, and requires an official ID card before he'll deal with you. Take this note to the Emperor Family station in {[location]objectiveDestinationSystemID.name} and you'll get your ID card. Good luck my friend.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I wish you good luck, here is your ID card may your experience with me serve you well with Ammargal.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Hmm is this you? You look taller than I imagined ... do you have it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here it is, I knew I had it around here somewhere.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I've got that ID card around here somewhere just let me get it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Very good, I believe you are the person I was waiting for. If not well he's just to damn slow. Anyway I've got a job lined up for you to get started with.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Please be quick, I don't have all the time in the world you know.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I was told to come and contact you, do you have work for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Hmm is this you? You look taller than I imagined ... do you have it?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I have a mission of very high importance to the empire. That data fragment you retrieved from Lord Methros' Transport Cruiser is using a very special form of encryption that our scientists cannot break without the correct machinery.

I need you to go and collect a decoding device from the Emperor Family Bureau in Gensela. From there we can start to modify it to suit our needs.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the decoder, what do you want me to do with it?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that device to you before you've finished your breakfast.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Keep hold of the Decoder, I need you to use it to help us decode some of our intelligence from the front.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Please be quick, time is of the essence.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm here for my first assignment. What do you have?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have a mission of very high importance to the empire. That data fragment you retrieved from Lord Methros' Transport Cruiser is using a very special form of encryption that our scientists cannot break without the correct machinery.

I need you to go and collect a decoding device from the Emperor Family Bureau in Gensela. From there we can start to modify it to suit our needs.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That decoder isn't getting any younger, what do you want me to do with it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here is that Enigma book you wanted.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
That decoder you have does not work properly on the algorithms that Lord Methros is using, we need to get components from his machines which are fitted on almost every ship he has command over. But I have a more pressing task first for you, in order for us to program the machine correctly we need an Enigma Cipher Book, it is a set of codes that will allow us to help better decode his transmissions. Find this and collect as many Encoding Matrix components as you can find while you search for it.

Once you have proven your worth I will need you to assemble the modified encoding machine for me.

Oh and you should be able to acquire the Enigma Cipher Book from some of the pirates that infest our asteroid belts. They apparently use a very similar coding system as we found in Methros' Data Burst ...

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work, our scientists have just completed work on the blueprint. Get to work and build it for us and get back to me with it as soon as you can.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, if you were paying attention to me last time we spoke you should have the parts we need to assemble the machine. If you didn't manage to find them all go back to Lord Methros' compound and see what you can dig up ... Don't give away you're working for us; otherwise you will undermine our entire operation.

Take that blueprint I gave you and create a working decoder. Then bring it to me.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here is the decoder, I hope you can make use of its abilities.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: No worries, I'll have that decoder ready for you in no time.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I'm sure I will. It will not be long now before we can find out what this transmission means.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You best have it soon, my superiors are waiting on the information it can decode.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hmm yes that decoder…

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Well, if you were paying attention to me last time we spoke you should have the parts we need to assemble the machine. If you didn't manage to find them all go back to Lord Methros' compound and see what you can dig up ... Don't give away you're working for us; otherwise you will undermine our entire operation.

Take that blueprint I gave you and create a working decoder. Then bring it to me.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I don't believe it! That treacherous swine. We finally managed to decode the transmission. From what we can tell it's an attack plan for Lord Arachnan and he's in league with The Blood Raider Covenant. We need to confirm this before we take it to the Emperor's House and the Imperial Navy. Go to these co-ordinates and see what you find.

Kill anything you find there and report back with any information you can find from them.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I killed everything in sight and I managed to find this. Does it help?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: You've got it, I'll blow the a whole right through them.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Yes it does, it seems to be able to be decoded by that device you built. I'll have one of my engineers look at it right now. Get back to me in a minute and I'll see if I've got a job for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Make sure you make a video; it'd be nice to watch over when you've finished.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I've got guns… Depends on the target… what do you want me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:

Go to these co-ordinates and see what you find.

Kill anything you find there and report back with any information you can find from them.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've been deceived; an undercover operative of The Blood Raider Covenant, Yamia Mida, was found working within our ranks. Once he knew his position was compromised he fled into a fleet of waiting Blood Raider troops.

That Encoded Data Chip showed attack plans against Arachnan and the Imperial Navy stationed in his area of influence, it would seem that Arachnan wasn't in league with the Blood Raiders after all.

Find the traitorous bastard and bring him to justice. We received a tip that he's located in Zimse, but that's all we know. I suggest you use a system scanner to search for him, if he's located in the middle of nowhere I assume he either has a beacon or cosmic signature nearby for navigational purposes.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the spy, although his condition could be better ...

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Spies are my favourite kind of target. He'll be dead in no time.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Search Zimse with a system scanner for any traces of the Blood Raider agent.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
It seems he committed suicide rather than face justice. Probably when he saw that you were overpowering his guards.

I thank you once again for your assistance, but I've got one more task for you, if you feel up to the challenge.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: And they are my favourite kind of assignment to give out..

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I've got a gun and it's still warm from helping you last time. What do you need dead?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
This internal quarrel is turning into a massive political mess, we've been receiving rumors of Lord Methros' involvement with the Blood Raiders, we aren't sure but if it is true then recent activities you and I have encountered would make a lot more sense. However this is to be resolved at another time. For now I have one final task for you to complete for me.

There is a large Blood Raider fleet assembling in Nidupad, which we believe is going to launch a full scale assault against Arachnan's forces. It must be quashed before it can grow any larger. If you fail I will have to deploy the Imperial Navy, but with the current situation that would cost us greatly.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Their armada is no more.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Time to offload some more firepower into these guys. I cant believe they haven't gotten the message yet.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Preventing their attack should send a pretty strong message to Omir Sarikusa, or whoever is responsible for their presence in Araz.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Blood Raiders? Annihilation? Give me more info!

If you fail I will have to deploy the Imperial Navy, but with the current situation that would cost us greatly.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Amazing job.  You've certainly earned your reward, {[character]player.name}.  I will also make sure my superiors hear of your deeds, they're bound to notice.  Good luck on your future endeavours!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have another assignment for you, {[character]player.name}. The military commanders on the Amarr/Gallente border have been demanding more troops, and of course systems which are quite a safe distance away from the front lines have to suffer. So I've received an order from the highest chain of command to transport hundreds of thousands of troops from our outposts here to where they are more needed.
I'd like you to take care of one of these transport missions. Fly to Khodesa, the Kador space-military training camp in Chanoun, and pick up 50 Amarrian light marines. Transport them to my location. Take care to avoid pirates around the gates which you travel through. And when you're in the military complex, don't get too close to the security outposts! It's strictly prohibited! Good luck.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I have another assignment for you, {[character]player.name}. The military commanders on the Amarr/Gallente border have been demanding more troops, and of course systems which are quite a safe distance away from the front lines have to suffer.
