messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm interested ...

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Ok, you're now all set to speak with Aviekko. You'll probably find her at her desk in the Echelon Entertainment Development Studio in Autama. And don't forget to bring your graduation certificate when you pay her a visit!

If you forget the location of this agent, you can always look it up by opening the 'show info' window for the graduation certificate.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The colleague that I mentioned, Aviekko Ta, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Aviekko.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The colleague that I mentioned, Aviekko Ta, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Aviekko.
Unless you've been sent here by one of my subordinates, I have nothing for you.  If you're interested, you can find them in Data Centers in Kamokor, Ahtulaima and Saikanen.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here it is.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I was sent to speak with you, Aviekko, and I have this certificate to prove it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Ah, so you're a qualified pilot eh.  I have some work for you after all.  Just give me a minute to go over my files, I'll have something for you to do in a jiffy ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Ok, show me the certificate.  You better not be pulling my leg ...

messages.mission.briefing.text: Bring Aviekko Ta a Graduation Certificate which you can acquire by speaking to one of her agents. The agents can be found in Data Centers  located in Kamokor, Ahtulaima and Saikanen.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Before you begin I should get you acquainted with my current assignment. I am Aviekko Ta, agent of Atoa Issa. I am one of many agents which were dispatched by Atoa to search for leads of the missing relics, which were stolen from the 13 Achur temples. So far I've had little luck, but I believe my venture in hiring graduates from the prominent aerospace aviation schools, like yourself, will pay off in the long run.

Your first task is to retrieve a few starmaps of mine from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}. I just ordered them from our archives on our home-planet Achura in Saisio. They should lead us Kikko Roisen, who I've suspected for quite some time to have been involved with the infamous heist.

Anyway, get going. I need those starmaps asap.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here are the starmaps, Aviekko.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The sacred pieces believed to be from the Rod of the Creator were stolen from under the watchful gaze of the Achur religious order. This any true Achur would know. The State has pledged enormous resources to tracking down the thieves. But even so the Elder Visionaries of Achura are not satisfied. They do not trust the State government, and they cannot sit idly by as their religion is ridiculed for its failure to protect the icons of its faith.

And so the Celestial Imperative was devised. Atoa Issa, a proud Achur himself, took leave of his prominent position within the Caldari Navy to oversee the search for the scoundrels who dared insult the Achur religion and people of Achura. By his side stands Seer Chakai Potan, representative of the temples of Achura. Together they control the enormous wealth the Achur government and the temples have supplied to fund this investigation. And to quote Atoa, 'no stone shall remain unturned, no world shall elude our probing gaze. I vow to you, people of Achura, that I will spend every fiber of my existance from here after to track down these vile, wretched thieves and restore the honor of our people!'

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent.  I'll have a look at these starmaps immediately and compare them to the data I already have about Kikko.  I'll let you know when I've found something ...

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
These starmaps are indeed interesting. They point to virtually hundreds of locations in Autama where Kikko has been sighted. Visionary Atahari has had him tracked ever since his bungled burglary attempt at the temple a few years ago, so that should come as no surprise. But I've managed to narrow down these locations to 3 settlements, where he has been spotted very frequently. These are the most likely locations where we will find him.

I truly hope he hasn't left the system, but at this stage we can only cross our fingers. The mercenary tracking Kikko on Atahari's command disappeared when he tried to confront Kikko on my behalf, and that may have triggered him to think about relocating himself. Fortunately rumor still has it that he hasn't left Autama, but you never can be too sure.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will help you look for Kikko.  What's my first objective?

Your first task is to investigate a small settlement next to the ruins of an old Caldari station. It's been rumored to be inhabited by pirates in league with the Guristas organization. You might encounter some resistance when you start poking your nose around there, but I'm sure you can take care of it.

Your goal is to find any trace of Kikko. If you find nothing, then return back to me and we'll continue the search. You will recieve a bookmark to the location in the mission details in your Opportunities interface, of course.

Your second objective is to storm a habitation module in Autama where Kikko Roisen has been seen multiple times. If you find him inside, then bring him to me. Either way, report back to me immediately after the operation has finished.

Again you will receive a bookmark into your NeoCom, so this should be simple enough. There may be guards there, so be prepared for a fight.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: So you found nothing, except a worthless data chip recovered from the security monitor?  How depressing ...

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Luck has not been on our side so far, {[character]player.name}. And I'm becoming less convinced we will ever find Kikko *sigh*. The third hotspot which I want you to investigate is a bit different from the last two. It's a small mining colony situated at Autama VII's moon. I won't give you a bookmark this time, as you should find it very easily on any standard map of Autama.

Search the place thoroughly. If you can't find Kikko there, then I don't know what to do.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Warp to Autama VII – Moon 1 and find the mining colony there.  See if it leads you to Kikko.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Incredible!  You did it!  You found Kikko!  I'll get to analyzing the data you brought back immediately, if it's what I think it is then we finally have a lead on the missing Achur relics!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Cross your fingers, {[character]player.name}, if this lead doesn't give us any results then I'm afraid I'll have to report to Ichoro Hinalairos empty handed.  I've been trying to earn Atoa's favor for years and blowing this chance will be devastating.  So don't let me down!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: If you're not here to kill me, then do you mind sparing my life?  Kill the Guristas guards here if you want, take the loot, just don't kill me.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I found this data sheet in your stash, Kikko.  It has some pretty incriminating evidence about your dealings with the Guristas organization.  Either cough up whatever you're hiding, or I'll take this straight to the authorities.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: So, what brings you to such a dangerous place?  The Guristas are not to be trifled with ...

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Ok ok, you can have the damn data chip.  I was going to sell it to her anyway, but since it's my life I'm bargaining for then just take it!  I've had it with trying to escape that wretch, even the Guristas can't save me.  Now please leave me alone.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Well, erm, they told me I'd be safe if I gave them access codes to some corporation hangars at the Echelon Entertainment station here in Autama.  Hey wait, you aren't recording this are you? ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Uh ... yeah, Aviekko sent me.

messages.mission.briefing.text: If you're not here to kill me, then do you mind sparing my life?  Kill the Guristas guards here if you want, take the loot, just don't kill me.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You sure you don't have any work for me?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have Havatiah's internal database records.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Hmmm, actually there might be something you can help me with. My corporation, Echelon Entertainment, has a long standing rivalry with Nugoeihuvi Corporation. We're competitors in the entertainment industry, and it always gives you an edge if you know what your adversaries are planning.

It so happens that I know of the location of a hidden Nugoeihuvi station in Autama. It's called Station Yxtara, and I'll supply you with a bookmark to it. What I want you to do is retreive the access codes I need to break into their central computer mainframe inside Yxtara. And I believe that I know of a person who has those access codes and should in fact be orbiting around a lookout post next to the station.

His name is Havatiah Kiin and he's the captain of Yxtara's security. He normally flies a condor right outside of the station, and should be an easy target. Now considering the station is supposed to be hidden, I'm quite confident that the station manager will want to keep it that way, hence I doubt they will call in CONCORD. However Nugoeihuvi will have their own guards defending the station. So don't say I didn't warn you!

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent.  You've done me a favor and certainly deserve the implant you'll receive for your efforts.  Have a nice day, and give Aviekko my regards, heh heh.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what's next?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice working with ya, mate.  Ta-da.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I've quickly run over the data you recovered and I'm certain that it's genuine.  Now I need my report delivered to Atoa.  He's currently stationed in Uemisaisen, I've arranged one of his couriers to pick up my report in the Wiyrkomi Peace Corps Assembly Plant in that system.  Please deliver them there, and my associate will take care of the rest.

Please deliver them there, and my associate will take care of the rest.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm interested ...

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Ok, you're now all set to speak with Avrue Auz. You'll probably find her at her desk in the Creodon Factory in Lirsautton. And don't forget to bring your graduation certificate when you pay her a visit!

If you forget the location of this agent, you can always look it up by opening the 'show info' window for the graduation certificate.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The colleague that I mentioned, Avrue Auz, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Avrue.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The colleague that I mentioned, Avrue Auz, requires your graduation certificate before she'll offer you work.  I suppose you've left it behind at your hangar somewhere?  If not I can easily have a copy of it made on {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}.  Just pick it up there and bring it to me.  Once I've signed it then you're all set to speak with Avrue.
Unless you've been sent here by one of my subordinates, I have nothing for you.  If you're interested, you can find them in Data Centers in Muer, Abenync and Ekuenbiron.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I was sent to speak with you, Avrue, and I have this certificate to prove it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Ah, so you're a qualified pilot eh.  I have some work for you after all.  Just give me a minute to go over my files, I'll have something for you to do in a jiffy ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Well, let's see it.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Bring Avrue a Graduation Certificate which you can acquire by speaking to one of her agents. The agents are in Data Centers located in Muer, Abenync and Ekuenbiron.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Here it is.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Since you are so eager to work for me, {[character]player.name}, I would like to start off our relationship by explaining a few critical details.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: So what is it I need to know?

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
I am Avrue Auz, agent of Beizan Picholen. I came to Chandeille (Lirsautton V) eight years ago, during the height of the Picholen-Auboure family feud. Deni Picholen hired me as Beizan's secretary and financial manager. The Picholen family is quite wealthy, having long owned a number of franchises connected with Kaalakiota and their wares.

Anyway, the feud was quite draining on the Picholens, especially their wallet. But the biggest disaster the family had ever faced came only a few years ago. It was a dreadfully cold afternoon during the height of the Chabash winter on Chandeille when I received the news that a Picholen industrial had been caught by planetary security forces, trying to smuggle a troop of slaves and illegal combat boosters into Namin City. Speculation had it that the slaves were to be used as cheap manpower in a secret military operation directed against Auboure, named after its ancient ruling family.

To me, this siezure of assets was bad enough, but to make matters far worse, my employer, Beizan, was directly implicated in the deal, for the industrial smuggling the contraband had been rented in his name. It was a debacle. Kaalakiota canceled their multi-million ISK deal with Picholen, and the Governor of Chandeille placed a huge fine on the family that has basically crippled its financial status. In other words, the Picholens lost everything other than their name and sovereignty over Namin City. Most of their lands were confiscated, as well as their overseas bank accounts. I'm a bit surprised you haven't heard this story, in fact; it was all over the Federation media at the time.

But anyway, to cut the story short, Beizan was imprisoned in Pinmouth, an infamous Federation prison facility in Lirsautton, and resides there still. It is my firm belief, however, that Beizan is really innocent, and that is why I sent for someone like you.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: These documents will have to do.  Let's see if we can find anything in here that connects Kelmiler to the crime.  One minute ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Your first task is to raid a merchant operating a small trading hub in Meves. He is known to have dealings with the Auboure family; he was in fact their first contact when they started expanding their trade relations outside of Lirsautton to compete with the Picholens. It is my firm belief that the Auboures have something to do with the smuggling incident that resulted in Beizan's arrest ― yes, I believe he was framed.

The merchant's name is Kelmiler Delbone. Interrogate him for me, find a way to make him reveal what he knows about the incident. Once you have something, report back to me.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your first task is to raid a merchant operating a small trading hub in Meves. The merchant, Kelmiler Delbone, is known to have dealings with the Auboure family. Interrogate him for me; find a way to make him reveal what he knows about the incident that resulted in Beizan's arrest. Once you have something, report back to me.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Found anything?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Fly to the FedMart station in Jel and return with records of FedMart transactions at that station. Perhaps they will lead us to whoever bought those illegal boosters from Kelmiler Delbone.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The documents you retrieved reveal nothing about the industrial. However, what interests me is that Kelmiler appears to have sold a large number of illegal boosters to a member of FedMart, located in Jel. Interestingly, these boosters are identical to the ones found inside the industrial that was caught by the planetary security forces on Chandeille. Yes, a very interesting find indeed.

I want you to fly to the FedMart station in Jel. I have an acquaintance there who will supply me with records of transactions at that station. Perhaps they will lead us to whoever bought those boosters from Kelmiler Delbone.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Thank you. Alright, let's see... Hm. Interesting. Hmmm. Oh, my goodness! These records explicitly mention a man by the name of ... Mamo! No, surely it can't be. Mamo Guerre!? The Mamo Guerre? Amazing, even if this clue turns out to be a dead end. At the very least, we have uncovered evidence of criminal activity on one of the most powerful men in {[location]agentRegionID.name}.

Good work, {[character]player.name}. Very good work!

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'd like you to pay Mamo Guerre a visit near the moon of Lirsautton VI. See if you can scrounge up evidence linking him with the incident Beizan's rotting in jail for.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I'd like you to pay Mamo Guerre a visit. You might find him near the moon of Lirsautton VI; my sources claim that he frequents that place. See if you can scrounge up evidence linking him with the incident Beizan's rotting in jail for. If Mamo's playing any part of this ... why, I'll drag his name so far through the dirt he'll move to Fountain and live as a hermit. But let's give him something Beizan certainly could have used during his trial ― the luxury of being innocent until proven guilty.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Aha! According to this message, Eilard Ansti purchased the boosters from Mamo Guerre. Eilard is a long-time associate of the Auboure family. Now I think we're finally getting somewhere...

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I don't have time for simpletons.  Either leave me be or show me a good reason why I should waste my time on you ...

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I believe this might interest you ...

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I want information ...

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Ok, you have my attention. But don't think for a moment that your little plan has any chance of success. In these parts, I am practically above the law. You can go right ahead and report your findings to the authorities, little good it will do you ...

But before you leave, you might want to consider a proposition I have. If you do a certain job for me, then I will give you what you seek. The choice is yours.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: And why should I care?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I was sent to speak with you, Mamo.  Do you have a minute?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Find something of interest to Mamo Guerre ... Avrue Auz might have something in mind.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the 'commodity' you are after, now cough up the info.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
So let me get this straight. You want me to tell you what I did with the boosters that I supposedly bought through my connections in FedMart? No problem, as long as you do something for me. You rub my back, I rub yours.

There is a certain commodity I am after, which is extremely hard to acquire. It's virtually undetectable with the current sensors used by the customs officials, and is highly illegal if you get my drift. It so happens that I know where a few units of this commodity are stashed. In fact I've configured the gateway located behind my ship to send you there. It's being guarded of course, but that's why I need you.

Bring me what I need, and I'll give you the information you've been looking for.

Just a word of advice before you leave, the spot you're about to warp to is located in a phenomenon we call deadspace. Since we are also currently located inside deadspace, you won't be able to warp directly back here without the use of an acceleration gate. Instead you'll have to warp outside of the deadspace bubble and then back to me.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:

It's being guarded of course, but that's why I need you.

Bring me what I need, and I'll give you the information you've been looking for. Deal?

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job.  Now for the information Avrue Auz was after, one moment.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Just a word of advice before you leave, the spot you're about to warp to is located in a phenomenon we call deadspace. Instead you'll have to warp outside of the deadspace bubble and then back to me.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Don't be so hasty, {[character]player.name}. There's always a catch you know. All you have to do is transport the commodity to the FedMart storage facility in Jel. I need it analyzed there in our lab, plus you'll make a good test dummy to see if it actually works against the customs officials at the stargates.

Once the item is in your hangar there, then I will reward you with the information you seek. And I do hope you'll never show your face in my territory again after this is over, comprende?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do what you ask, but if you try and play me like that again I'll ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Yes, don't worry.  I've no more tricks up my sleeve, you'll definitely get what you want when you're done with this simple courier job.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what's the deal?  You said you'd cough up the info after I got you the crash ...

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Alright, here you go.  Bring this data chip to Avrue, it will explain everything I know about her situation.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'd like you to bring Eilard Ansti here; he must know something about the crime, and it's essential that we acquire this information. You may use any means necessary. I will supply you with a bookmark to Ansti's whereabouts within a deadspace pocket in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. You'll have to navigate through a few checkpoints due to the warp disruption, but I'm sure you can "convince" the guards to let you through...

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ok, it's time to pay Eilard Ansti a visit. I'd like you to bring him here; I really need to have a ... chat with him. He must know something about the crime, and it's essential that we acquire this information. You may use any means necessary ― you'll receive a sizable reward for your efforts, of course, and I'll see to it that the authorities don't get involved.

I will supply you with a bookmark to Ansti's whereabouts. Fortunately for us, he owns a small piece of space here in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, set within a deadspace pocket. You'll have to navigate through a few checkpoints due to the warp disruption, but I'm sure you can "convince" the guards to let you through...

I won't pull any punches here, {[character]player.name}. This may be quite dangerous. Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
You found Serpentis there along with Eilard's corpse?! Oh, my. It's getting very hot in here, suddenly, don't you find...? Ahem.

Give me a few minutes while I'll have the computer in our medlab perform a quick scan of Eilard's remains.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what did you find out?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Magnificent, you have him! I'll make sure he spends the rest of his days behind bars unless he can reveal anything of importance concerning the crime Beizan was imprisoned for.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I think we can assume Govarde is alive until we receive evidence to prove otherwise: The Navy database has no record of his death. I have a bookmark that should lead you to a luxury resort in Lirsautton where Govarde is known to hang out. I want you to snoop around and search for any clues that might lead us to him.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The data you retrieved revealed that this Govarde is indeed a member of the Serpentis organization and is wanted by CONCORD for a number of offenses. He was last seen in Lirsautton, which would explain his meeting here with Eilard. Now we can only hope that he wasn't one of the Serpentis you killed during your retrieval of Eilard's corpse, but I think we can assume Govarde is alive until we receive evidence to prove otherwise: The Navy database has no record of his death.

I have a bookmark that should lead you to a luxury resort in Lirsautton that has been under investigation for quite some time as a secret drug-manufacturing op. Not yet proven, of course, but the interesting part is that Govarde has been sighted there frequently by civilians staying at the resort. I want you to snoop around and search for any clues that might lead us to him.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's the word from the medical lab?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Pay a visit to {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and pick up a package for me from an acquaintance of mine who's Navy data technician there.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The results of the autopsy scan show that Eilard was killed by a blaster at close range, most likely by the Serpentis goons who were waiting for you when you arrived. However, I did find an interesting bit of data in his ComPlant. The Serpentis probably hadn't gotten to extracting it when you showed up, so I was able to recover his datajournal entries.

Most of the information was useless (if mildly entertaining...), but one very recent bit of mem-script reads, "Meet Govarde at 1800h." Now, I might be reaching a little here, but perhaps this "Govarde" was one of the Serpentis you killed earlier? Maybe he was the person Eilard was due to meet? Certainly a difficult theory to prove, but I have an idea.

I want you to pay a visit to {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and pick up a package from a Navy data technician there. The records are off limits to non-Navy personnel, for they contain extensive data on the Serpentis, but I have a contact working there who should be able to do the research for me. He owes me one, and this is as good a time as any to pay up.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent.  One minute while I take a look at this data ...

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Khanid Insurgency are rebels who want to topple the Khanid government and install one that'd be more inclined to start a war with the Amarr. They are led by an old, crazed hag going by the name of Deza Yobili. She claims to have been 'wronged' by the Khanid Monarchy, because as part of an exchange deal we handed her husband to the Amarr authorities in return for a group of Khanid citizens that had been illegally held in Amarr prisons. Her husband was nothing more than a murderer, and yet some misguided souls within the Kingdom view him as a martyr. It's a rather sad ordeal, all in all.

We are doing everything we can to stop Deza and her cronies, but she keeps eluding our grasp. And their numbers refuse to drop, which is why we have started taking extra measures to quell this uprising attempt before it gets out of hand.

Now here is where you come in. One of my servants, Ziona Koon, went missing while she was posing as a student for the Royal Amarr Institute in Emrayur. The last I heard of her she was on to something. She left a report in her quarters in Emrayur, and I would like to retrieve that report to figure out what happened to her. Please retrieve this report for me.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: You can count on me!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The Khanid zealot, Deza Yobili, nicknamed ‘the black widow', runs a guerilla army whose aim is to enact a coup against the current regime. She has captured the hearts of many hardline Khanids due to her heart-wrenching story. Her husband, Jabil Yobili and 3 of her sons were executed by Amarr Imperial forces after they had been handed over by the Khanid Navy as a part of an exchange deal for Khanid POWs. Jabil and his sons had been accused by the Empire of slaughtering many Amarrian citizens during an insurgency in Gousoviba.

Deza's youngest son, Abarak Yobili, was imprisoned by the Khanid government for ‘causing civil unrest', when he led a demonstration against the newly rejuvenated Khanid – Amarr alliance.

Deza is the figurehead in a persistent movement to oust the current monarch of the Khanid Kingdom, and to sever their ties with the Empire once more. They are still greatly outnumbered and opposed by the majority of the Khanid nobility, but even so they are considered a threat and the Khanid monarch is eager to eradicate this thorn from his side.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent.  Please wait a minute while I run over the report ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I do hope so ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What is the 'Khanid Insurgency'?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, have you finished reading the report?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I've briefly skimmed over it. The report mentions that Ziona had found a suspicious fellow who claimed to offer her a job inside the Khanid Kingdom. He told her to meet her at a rendezvous point in Emrayur, where he would go over the details. She was to bring all of her credentials along with her. This certainly sounds like an undercover operation of some sort. Maybe we've hit the jackpot!

I want you to fly to Emrayur and investigate the rendezvous point. I am afraid something may have happened to Ziona, since she hasn't been in contact with me for many days. Perhaps she left some clues as to where they took her.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You brought back a Khanid marine I see.  The rookie fighters that attacked you must have been some of the new recruits this rogue agent has been gathering.  Well, at least we don't need to worry about them in the future.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Turn out that the marine has certain weaknesses, and has received very little anti-interrogation training. The clock is ticking, but there may be a way for us to extract data from him in a rather more humane way than I had originally intended.

I'd like you to look for some ... helpful products on the market, as I haven't the time to see to those matters. Think of it as some time off from the more dangerous tasks that I have in store for you.

I'd like you to look for some ... helpful products on the market, as I haven't the time to see to those matters. Think of it as some time off from the more dangerous tasks that I have in store for you.

I think I've found our lead. According to the prisoner, the man we're after is Mamin Choonka. He runs a diner in Ashab, at the moon of Ashab II to be exact. It offers a hefty discount to students of the academy, hence it's quite popular among their ranks.

I want you to pay him a visit. But don't go in with guns flaring, I want you to get to know him. Tell him you just graduated from the academy, and let's hope he tries to convert you to his cause. If all goes well, he will offer you a place within the Khanid insurgency. Perhaps that will lead us to one of their bases, or even better Deza Yobili.

It's hard to pin Choonka down, so I won't give you a bookmark. Instead, I want you to fly to his base at the moon of Ashab II and find him on your own. I'm sure you won't have any trouble.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Find Mamin Choonka at his diner in Ashab, near the warp-in point of Ashab II's moon.  See if you can acquire the coordinates to the Khanid insurgency from him.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Amazing!  This operation has gone more smoothly than I had expected, even in my wildest dreams.  I will report back to the Royal Family immediately, but before I leave I have one more task to give you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, how's the interrogation going?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Now that depends entirely upon the source, {[character]player.name}. But yes, I might have something available. It depends on whether you're willing to risk your neck or not. My assignments involve fighting ... lots of it. If you're looking for something more on the lines of dung-hauling, I suggest you look elsewhere.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Then I am definitely what you're looking for. I am well prepared for combat.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Ah, I was hoping you had something safe and easy. I'll have to decline.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: A job well done, {[character]player.name}.  Take your reward, but don't leave yet.  I have more tasks in store for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Your first job involves taking on a group of rogue drones that have for some god-forsaken reason decided to infest my storage facility in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. Destroy all of them, and then report back to me.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I heard you had work available.  Was my source correct?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your first job involves taking on a group of rogue drones that have for some god-forsaken reason decided to infest my storage facility in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. Destroy all of them, and then report back to me.

You did well against artificial intelligence, I'll give you that. But can you cut it against living opponents? Your next assignment is to destroy a pirate convoy carrying illegal goods into {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. You might ask, "how did you find out about this convoy?" The answer is that I ordered the goods myself. Through a contact, of course ― I would never reveal my true identity to those bastards.

Destroy the convoy, and bring the database from one of the ships to me if you manage to find one intact. I need to present it to the authorities so that we might trace their travel route to its origin and eliminate their drug factory for good.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Khanid pilots are no more, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Magnificent!! You passed the test, {[character]player.name}. Nice work. Not only have you shown that you can handle yourself in combat, but you've also proven yourself to be reliable under ... "difficult" circumstances. I now truly believe I can trust you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what's my next assignment?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Anything else you need me to do, {[character]agentID.name}?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. I think you'll fit into our ranks very nicely. But I'm afraid I've nothing more to offer you, so I must bid you fare well. Good luck in the future.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Yes, in fact. One last errand for you, {[character]player.name}. I'd like you to pick up some potential new recruits from the academy in Chaven. Once that has been completed, I'd like you to meet a very special person in the Khanid Kingdom. You'll find her at the coordinates listed in this data disc. Once she has gotten to know you better, you might have a very promising career ahead of you within the ranks of the Khanid Traditionalist Movement.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What task is that?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent.  You've done well, {[character]player.name}.  I'll definitely recommend you to his Highness.  Take care!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I've had a sinking suspicion for quite some time now that I'm being followed. I kept seeing the same mysterious man behind the corner whenever I turned my head. It was getting quite antagonizing. I work for the Khanid secret-service, so I notice these things quite well ...

Anyway I had the man's ship bugged, and we tracked him down to guess where ... Mamin Choonka's diner. Obviously Choonka has somehow gotten a hold of my identity, and probably wants me killed. I suspect they will strike after I leave the station. Which leaves me in a sort of a dilemma, as I have to meet with my superiors soon for a meeting in Khanid space.

To make things easier for me, I would like you to take care of these pests. That should clear the way for me to leave the station for a while. I will give you the exact coordinates for their ships, as we still have one of them bugged.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I have an important job for you, {[character]player.name}.  Because of your good standing and the fact you have successfully completed a number of missions for {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} we have decided you are worth the trust of a very important courier job. It entails bringing a large cargo of transaction and salary logs to this station from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} where they have been stored for the last few weeks for a routine inspection by the authorities.  This data holds information of sensitive nature on our recent business dealings, earnings and expenses and wages that we pay our staff members.  Under no circumstances may any of these reports be lost, or worse yet fall into the wrong hands.  Pirates have a tendency to want this information so they can sell it to our rivals.  They used to have easy access to this information by hacking our transmission calls, but now that we send these reports via freight this is no longer as serious of a problem.  I trust you on this, {[character]player.name}, don't let me down.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Thank you. Be careful out there, those logs must not fall into the wrong hands.

It entails bringing a large cargo of transaction and salary logs to this station from {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} where they have been stored for the last few weeks for a routine inspection by the authorities.  This data holds information of sensitive nature on our recent business dealings, earnings and expenses and wages that we pay our staff members.  Under no circumstances may any of these reports be lost, or worse yet fall into the wrong hands.  Pirates have a tendency to want this information so they can sell it to our rivals.  They used to have easy access to this information by hacking our transmission calls, but now that we send these reports via freight this is no longer as serious of a problem.  I trust you on this, {[character]player.name}, don't let me down.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I am very disappointed in you.  This failure might result in catastrophic consequences, should the logs you were supposed to transfer fall into the wrong hands.  If this happens I will hold you fully responsible.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Thank you. Be careful out there, those logs must not fall into the wrong hands.

localizedName.text: A Force to Be Reckoned With

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've spotted a few Angel Cartel ships roaming near here. We believe that they are part of a reconnaissance force sent to scout for a weakness in security. We sent men out to intercept them, but none have returned. Another surveillance team caught sight of the pirates again recently, though.

The Angels are led by an infamous captain, Jenmai Hirokan. Do not underestimate him! Many have done so in the past and have paid the ultimate price.

I won't keep you here any longer. I'm sure you'll want to get going before we lose sight of Hirokan and his allies again.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
{[character]player.name}, we've spotted a few Angel Cartel ships roaming about near here. We believe that they are part of a reconnaissance force sent to scout for a weakness in security, probably in preparation for a drug-smuggling operation. We sent a few of our best men out to intercept them, but none have returned. Another surveillance team caught sight of them again recently, though, and decided to wait for someone a bit more competent before we engage them again. I'm hoping you will be up to the task of taking out these scoundrels.

The Angels are led by an infamous captain, of whom you may have heard already: Jenmai Hirokan. Do not underestimate him! Many have done so in the past and have paid the ultimate price.

I won't keep you here any longer. I'm sure you'll want to get going before we lose sight of Hirokan and his allies again.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Republic bastards just launched a daring but foolhardy attack on our outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They killed every man, woman and child residing there, taking no prisoners. This was probably a retaliatory attack after we killed one of their commanders, but it matters not. We must intercept them before it's too late. I have reliable information that the leader of this attack was none other than Warlord Ixon Kruz, so you will undoubtedly have a very tough fight on your hands. Prepare yourself well, but don't tarry too long or you won't get there in time!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We need you for a very important assassination mission, {[character]player.name}. The Caldari State military has set up a base in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, intent on flushing out pirate activity here. We cannot afford to launch a full scale attack on it at the moment, so we have been forced to resort to scare tactics to drive them away. We planned to assassinate their commander, who is their highest-ranking official at the military outpost, but so fair all of our attempts have been foiled. You are our last hope, {[character]player.name}.

Now is the perfect time to undertake this mission. We know that the Commander is traveling through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} at this very moment, and we can supply you a bookmark to his approximate location. Should you strike immediately, then you may catch them by surprise. He is traveling with a small troop from his armada occupying the military base, so the fight may be difficult for you if you go in alone.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
That blasted priest, Karmone Tizmer, is at it again. He has set up base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and is busily trying to convert and kill our brethen there in the name of his false religion. With him are a troop of Amarr ships, being piloted by Cult of Catechization activists. We need someone competent to take them out of business before they cause too much damage. You are the perfect man for the job, {[character]player.name}.

But do not take this mission too lightly. They are quite dangerous, and their ships are of the highest quality. You will probably need backup for this one.

Alright, here's a job you might be ready to tackle. A few unfortunate members of our corporation were kidnapped yesterday while on duty near the edge of this very system. I have reliable information that their kidnappers are nearby. I'll upload the coordinates into your NeoCom: You should use them to find a series of gateways which should lead you to these enemies of the state.

Sound like something you'd be interested in? If you succeed I will reward you handsomely.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The kidnappers are dealt with, and I've returned with the victims.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Fair enough, if inconvenient. Always refreshing to meet someone who knows his or her place in the scheme of things.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Absolutely, I'm interested. This one's right up my alley.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Uh, I'm not really much of a combat pilot, actually. Maybe someone else would be a better choice.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good, good. I'll trust that you know what you're doing, then. See you soon.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A few unfortunate members of our corporation were kidnapped yesterday. I have reliable information that their kidnappers are close by. If you find the kidnappers, then deal with them appropriately and return their captives to me, dead or alive.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent.  The victims' families will be pleased that their loved ones are still alive.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Correct. A few of our senior officials were kidnapped yesterday while inspecting one of our sites in this very system. I have reliable information that their kidnappers are nearby.

Can you help?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The kidnappers are dealt with, and I've returned with the officials.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Fair enough, if inconvenient — it's always refreshing to hear someone who acknowledges his or her place in the great scheme of things.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Absolutely, I'm on it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Uh, I'm not really much of a combat pilot, actually. Maybe someone else would be a better choice.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good — I'm certain you know what you're doing. See you soon.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You don't say… something I can help you with, I'm guessing?

messages.mission.briefing.text: A few of our senior officials were kidnapped yesterday. I have reliable information that their kidnappers are close by: I've uploaded the coordinates into your NeoCom. If you find the kidnappers, then deal with them appropriately and return our people to me, dead or alive.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent. We are forever grateful, and their poor families will be pleased to hear the news.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Now that I know you have the skills to pull through, it's time to test your loyalty.  So I'll get straight to the point.  I work for a Matar citizen, who wishes to remain anonymous, who was wronged by a certain Vherokior shaman.  My client wants revenge, and this requires the capture of this Vherokior individual.  If you don't have the guts to take part in this endeavor, then I suggest you leave now.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here is the prisoner you asked for.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm up for the job, as long as it doesn't involve breaking the law.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The Brutor, Hnarlir Afer, has been an outcast from his home-world, Matar, ever since his Voluval ritual. The mark it left behind was so shameful even his loving father disowned him. He moved to the Gallente Federation, where hardly anyone recognized the mark or paid it any attention. There he began a life of a mercenary, having been bred as a space pilot by his military veteran father.

He quickly made a name for himself, before becoming a freelancer. Using the wealth he garnered from that profession, he started up his own corporation, The Markoni Dragons. It has been quite successful, earning Hnarlir a small fortune.

But even with his change of fortune, Hnarlir greatly misses his homeworld. He desperately wants to return and reclaim a position within his nation of birth. But he dares not return with the mark on his cheek as visible as ever. His family has suffered enough shame on his behalf already.

Yet Hnarlir still has hope. Hope that his ‘condition' can finally be modified. Even though it goes against everything the Minmatar consider holy, Hnarlir is just desperate, and wealthy, enough to pull it off. He wants to learn the method which the Vheriokor shamans use to perform the Voluval ritual and modify the mark so that it no longer resembles the symbol of the Ammatar Mandate.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent!  He will do nicely.  But there's more to be done, so stick around.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Oh don't worry about that, you won't be breaking any laws. Or in other words, no one will know that you are breaking any laws. We dug up some dirt on the shaman in question, and soon he will be a wanted man in the Republic. We won't reveal it to the authorities until we have him though, just to make sure we get there before the police do. We need him alive, he's of no use to us dead.

Once our allegations of him are proven, he will be executed. It will matter little to the authorities if we do the honors for them. Therefore you have nothing to fear.

Now for your task, I want you to apprehend a member of the Angel Cartel. The Cartel is the biggest criminal organization in the known universe, so finding a few of their members shouldn't be very difficult. I'll even upload a bookmark to one of their hideouts for you, you can view it in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what do you need me for?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Warp to the coordinates that Pinala gave you, recorded inside the mission details in your Opportunities interface.  Destroy the Angel Cartel ships at their hideout and capture one of their pilots from the ejected container (if one survives).  Bring this person back to your agent, as long as the captive is still alive.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Now I would like you to drop off these reports I have to the Vherokior Bureau in Gelfiven.  An associate of mine will retrieve it from the hangar there.  These reports and the Angel Cartel prisoner you brought me will be enough to convince any jury of the Vherokior shaman's guilt.  That should set us up nicely for capturing him.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Bah, I knew you didn't have it in you.  Get lost then, bud.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Makes sense.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This sounds a bit too suspicious to me.  I'm out.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good job.  We're almost there ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good, now get going.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So, what's next?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Now I would like you to drop off these reports I have to the Vherokior Bureau in Gelfiven.  An associate of mine will retrieve it from the hangar there.  These reports and the Angel Cartel prisoner you brought me will be enough to convince any jury of the Vherokior shaman's guilt.  That should set us up nicely for capturing him.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Before we make our attempt at capturing Logut Akell, the Vherokior shaman I was referring to earlier, we need to find him. He is currently meditating somewhere in Eram, but I haven't been able to track him down. If you didn't know, this meditation process of the Vherokior shamans can take months or even years, and frankly I'd rather not wait that long.

There is one link to Logut that I haven't pursued ... yet. His name is Matique Karani, and he's an associate of Loguts. I want you to pay Matique a visit and force him to reveal the whereabouts of Logut. Use any means necessary.

Oh and you'll probably have to deal with a few guards Matique hired. If it weren't for them, I'd have done the dirty work myself a long time ago.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: So he's at one of Eram IV's moons eh?  I hope you 'took care of Matique' in your last mission, otherwise I'm afraid he may have notified Logut about our plans already.  But either way we can't waste any more time, it's time to finish what we started.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Well, what are you waiting for then?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's my next assignment.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Before we make our attempt at capturing Logut Akell, the Vherokior shaman I was referring to earlier, we need to find him. He is currently meditating somewhere in Eram, but I haven't been able to track him down. If you didn't know, this meditation process of the Vherokior shamans can take months or even years, and frankly I'd rather not wait that long.

There is one link to Logut that I haven't pursued ... yet. His name is Matique Karani, and he's an associate of Loguts. I want you to pay Matique a visit and force him to reveal the whereabouts of Logut. Use any means necessary.

Oh and you'll probably have to deal with a few guards Matique hired. If it weren't for them, I'd have done the dirty work myself a long time ago.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I already told you, go get Logut!  Matique said he was located near one of the moons of Eram IV, so go get him!  Now!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Alright, alright, I'll do it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm tired of your insults, Pinala, go find someone else to do your dirty work.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great work!  My men are taking care of his 'accommodations' as we speak.  You'll be rewarded well for your efforts, of course.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'll see you soon, with Logut.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: My next assignment please.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Find Logut and bring him to your agent, alive. Your agent told you to find the objective near a moon orbiting Eram IV.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I'm sorry but he explicitly told me to prevent anyone from disturbing him today.  Maybe some other time?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have someone here with me that might 'interest' Logut ...

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Uh, ok.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: No, you either hand him over now or I blow this place up.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The key to the gateway is hidden inside the blasted neon sign near Logut's Abode, so bring along a Data Analyzer.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Right-e-o, I'm sorry to disturb you.  Silly me.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: How dare you!?  I will not 'hand him over', and I am perfectly fine with laying down my life for Logut.  We also have a very nice security system in place, so I'd think twice about attacking our home or trying to sneak in ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I need to have a chat with Logut Akell.  It's personal.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Obtain something of importance to Logut, to force him to come with you.  A wise choice would be to use the gateway beneath Logut's abode, perhaps it leads to somewhere interesting.  The key to the gateway must be around here somewhere ... I suspect a Data Analyzer may come in useful.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
No, this cannot be! Touch a strand of hair on Dari's head and we'll have the Republic Fleet so far up your ass they'll hear your screams on Amarr Prime. But I will speak to Logut, as long as Dari is unharmed.

*long pause*

Logut has agreed to your terms, he will cooperate as long as Dari remains safe with me. He would do anything for his daughter, even surrender to treasonous scoundrels like yourself. But be warned, if he is not returned safe and sound within the month, we will contact the Minmatar secret service and they will hunt you down like the dog you are. Be-gone!¨

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ah, is that so? I will relay this information to Logut immediately, one minute ...

*long pause*

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have done what you asked, Hlebnar.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll wait.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry but I don't have time to wait for you, I have business elsewhere.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I have spoken with Logut. He says that he will come with you under the pretense that you have 'kidnapped' him for Pinala. He will be wearing a bug attached to his garments, which will send his exact coordinates to me. I will then inform the government of his kidnapper's location, and hopefully they'll be taken care of by the Republic Fleet.

However before he can commit himself to such a dangerous task, he wants you to do him a favor. His daughter, Dari Akell, lost her husband to the Angel Cartel. He was a miner, working as a contractor in Elgoi for Core Complexion inc, when a gang of Cartel thugs struck. They had threatened to 'cause grievous harm' to the mining operation if the foreman would neglect to pay them tribute, but he had refused. So they made an example of some of his subordinates, including Dari's husband. The Cartel got what they wanted, and Logut's son-in-law is now dead.

Needless to say, Logut wants revenge. I will supply you with a bookmark to the mining operation where Dari's husband was stationed, a few Angel goons should be located nearby. Destroy them. Do not return until this task has been accomplished.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Actually, I was sent here by a person named Pinala Adala.  I was supposed to kidnap Logut, but I've had a change of heart.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I have spoken with Logut. He says that he will come with you under the pretense that you have 'kidnapped' him for Pinala. He will be wearing a bug attached to his garments, which will send his exact coordinates to me. I will then inform the government of his kidnapper's location, and hopefully they'll be taken care of by the Republic Fleet.

Needless to say, Logut wants revenge. I will supply you with a bookmark to the mining operation where Dari's husband was stationed, a few Angel goons should be located nearby. Destroy them. Do not return until this task has been accomplished.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Alright, Logut will see you now.  Take him to Pinala, we will take care of the rest.  Fare well.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As your final task for me, I would like you to help with delivering the reports of our success to Hnarlir Afer.  His agent in Eystur will pick them up and deliver them the rest of the way.  Hnarlir is a very secretive man, and would not want his whereabouts known to just anyone, even a trusted accomplice such as yourself.  Good luck.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have delivered the reports, as you requested.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent.  Be on your way then.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Is there anything else you wish of me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: As your final task for me, I would like you to help with delivering the reports of our success to Hnarlir Afer.  His agent in Eystur will pick them up and deliver them the rest of the way.  Hnarlir is a very secretive man, and would not want his whereabouts known to just anyone, even a trusted accomplice such as yourself.  Good luck.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've done well, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll rescue them in no time.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Give me something meaningful to do, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm looking for a challenge.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Hmm... Yes, I do have some work for you.

Although the Cartel usually has a firm grip over the criminal strata in our system, Sansha's Nation has been poking its ugly nose in here of late-- which is perfectly fine with us. In fact, watching the two outlawed organizations duke it out is one of my favorite pastimes. If we're lucky, it will give both sides a good bruising, which will only work in our favor.

Of course, there's also bad news. An InterBus ship traveling to {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} got caught in the middle of one of the pirate warzones. The ship was damaged beyond repair and can neither warp out nor navigate away from the crossfire. Your task is to rescue the ship's crew. Please retrieve them before any more harm is done; they're already scared out of their minds. The faster you get this done, the better.

Oh, and before you leave I'd like to give you a word of advice. When you venture into this particular deadspace area, the warpgates are not locked, which gives you the chance to avoid most of the conflict, if you're not up to the fight. However, I'm told only frigate and destroyer-class ships can activate the first gate.

Good luck.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Hmm... Yes, I do have some work for you. Although the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} have traditionally had a firm grip over this system, Sansha's Nation has been poking its ugly nose in here of late. We were about to assemble a strike force to take care of their latest infiltration when we noticed something interesting. The Sansha fleet that we had stumbled upon is fighting for their lives against a sizable Gallente armada!

We aren't sure where the Gallente came from or what they're doing here, but I suspect it's one of those blasted entrepreneurs, scouring space outside of Federation borders for possible business opportunities. Either way, we're always happy when our enemies fight each other. When they're done, it's that much easier for us to clean up the pieces.

Now, what I need you to do is fairly simple: retrieve some of our valuable drug stash that's lying in the middle of their little warzone. You'll have to navigate through the contested deadspace area to get to it, but I'm sure someone of your caliber can handle that. Just stay clear of their main fleet and you'll make it.

Good luck.

messages.mission.briefing.text: It appears that the Federation Navy has been gathering en masse inside {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  Obviously they have been trying to keep a low profile, as they have split their armada into multiple groups.  But nonetheless my superiors are extremely nervous at these tidings.  We'd like you to remove their presence from {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} for good, before they manage to gather enough ships here to launch a massive offensive against one of our strongholds.  I'll supply you with the bookmarks that you need to find them.  Just remember, do not let them know under any circumstances who you are working for, we do not want to receive a retribution attack should you fail.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ah then I have something for you. I'm in charge of security for the Minedrill expedition forces stationed here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. As you probably know this is risky space, but even so we've been harassed by the same pirate far too many times for it to be coincidence. Also upon investigating the matter further, I discovered that this pirate is in fact called 'Black Jack', a notorious felon who terrorized Molden Heath not too long ago. There was a documentary about him released by The Scope ...

Anyway, if you find him then kill him for me, please. He's been the bane of too many of my colleagues and has been making quite a fool out of my security division in fact. There are many stories floating around which tell of his greatly exaggerated 'victories' over my men and those of the Navy guarding the civilian excavators, which are often completely false and unjustified. Now if you could bring me something to prove he's dead, his DNA would probably do, then I'll be able to vindicate the reputation of the security division here in Kois City.

Now as for finding Black Jack, I have absolutely no clue. You could try searching for him with your scanners, but that's about all I can tell you. I've tried looking for him near the habitation module they call 'Black Jack's Shack', but he's never there.

Finding Black Jack is about as hard as finding a needle in a haystack. I suggest you refrain from accepting this mission unless you have some idea of his whereabouts.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll try my best.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great news!  With Black Jack out of the way, our expeditions should be a lot less risky.  This will most definitely boost morale, and all thanks to you.  Enjoy your reward.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Somehow I doubt you'll find him, but good luck regardless ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm looking for some work, as long as it's for the greater good of the State ...

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Now on to the big fish. As you undoubtedly know, our biggest threat in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} has been the Guristas organization. Although they seem to be quite disorganized, as you would expect for a pirate organization, their top man here is rumored to be Airkio Yanjulen, a commander residing in O-LR1H. Killing him should weaken them considerably ... at least I hope so.

Bring me proof of his death and I'll reward you generously. The last I heard he was stationed in the Guristas War Installation in one of their outposts within O-LR1H. You will have to use your system scanner in that system and search for the 'Iacta Space Plain' to find him.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Take care.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Is it that obvious? Well, since you had the guts to fly out here into no-mans land you might be of some use to me.

We've been holed up here for days, unable to complete our objective. I was sent here along with the rest of my division to set up a blockade around the O-LR1H gate, to prevent the Guristas from continuing to flood this system with their fighters. Unfortunately we're simply outnumbered and outgunned, there's no way for us to hold that position and the admiral was very clear when I left that he could not spare any reinforcements for quite some time.

So we've been forced to do nothing more than monitor the gate, alerting our forces of any possible threat. It's rather embarrassing to say the least, but here's where you come in ...

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the war plans, as you requested {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Go on ...

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Search for the Iacta Space Plain in O-LR1H.  A system scanner will probably be necessary.  From there infiltrate the prison facilities and rescue the prisoner Tomi requested or find some way of acquiring the Guristas War Plans.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You have the plans?  Most excellent!!  I'll have this delivered to the Admiral immediately.  But if you have some spare time on your hands, I could use a hand with a couple other tasks ...

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
During my research of the Guristas movements through {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, I discovered that most of the Guristas squadrons flying through {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} originate from a certain outpost within O-LR1H. I believe that's where their command post in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} is located. Not only that but local rumor has it that many of the Guristas ships currently stationed in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} have only recently arrived to the constellation.

So my conclusion naturally is that a large portion of the Guristas forces that have been harassing us here lately are part of an assembly of fighters recently allocated here by the Guristas central command in 6NJ8-V. With this in mind I would also assume they are acting on specific orders and not randomly attacking us when the opportunity arrives, like is often the case with pirates in these parts.

Now if I could only get a hold of their plans, I would have some good news finally to present to Admiral Aurobe Kois. Knowledge of their next move would give us a huge advantage. Acquiring this knowledge is of course easier said than done.

This is where you come in. Your job, obviously, is to acquire this data. And I know of two ways to do it. Your first option is to befriend one of their leaders within the Iacta Space Plain in O-LR1H and somehow acquire the information through him. This is of course highly difficult and only possible if you are in good standing with the Guristas organization. Your second option is to rescue the last agent I sent on the very same task, Otsalen Mano. He found something, but before he could return to me his identity was discovered. He's currently being held in one of their prison facilities near the Iacta Space Plain in O-LR1H. And there's nothing I can do about it until I get more firepower ...

Anyway, don't return until you have the Guristas war plans!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Looks like you could use a hand out here ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What other tasks?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The armory has been destroyed, as you requested.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The most important task is behind us, but there are a couple more assignments that I'd like you to accomplish before you leave. The first of these assignments is to destroy a small armory near G5ED-Y II. It's being used to re-supply Guristas fighters in the system, and therefore must be destroyed. You may keep any of the supplies found inside, but do bring back some evidence of its demise.

The armory is in a deadspace pocket hidden from passive sensors. You will need to use probes to scan it down.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I saw the armory disintegrate from a distance.  What a sight indeed.  Nice work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The last thing I want you to do for me is to intercept a squadron of Guristas fighters who recently came through the stargate from O-LR1H.  They've been following a certain expedition of ours, no doubt waiting for the right time to attack.  Little beknownst to them we've been tracking their every move.  Now I expect them to show up at a certain point in G5ED-Y any moment now, and I want you to be waiting there for that to happen.  Once they appear, shoot them down immediately.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have completed the mission.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Just remember to be patient.  I don't know exactly when they will show up, so keep your guard up.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Is there anything else I can do for you?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Not bad, not bad.  I could really use someone like you on my team ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I heard you might have some work available ...

messages.mission.briefing.text:
You heard right, {[character]player.name}. We've been plagued by Caldari agents trying to infiltrate our operations here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. One such agent, Tantima Areki, managed to fool us for weeks, pretending to be a Guristas loyalist. When we finally discovered his true identity, he fled to somewhere within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}. We haven't found him yet, but I'm hoping you will succeed where my lackeys failed. Bring me Tantima Areki, preferably alive, and I will reward you well.

Use a system scanner and look for deadspace signatures. He will most likely be orbiting a Caldari Tactical Outpost.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Ah, you brought him back alive.  Excellent.  I will have him interrogated immediately, and then executed.  You have done well.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Remember to equip a system scanner, you'll need it to find Tantima.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The Caldari have erected a base of operations close to the stargate we use in G5ED-Y.  Not only that but they are closely monitoring our movements from a static long range scanner.  They use this information to send in reinforcements to the Caldari Navy positions before we attack, among other things.  I'm tempted to launch a major assault against their outpost, but perhaps you can spare me the manpower by doing the job yourself.  You will be adequately rewarded of course.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will destroy the scanner.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Destroy the long range scanner near the stargate to O-LR1H in G5ED-Y, and bring back its contents to your agent.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good, I'm counting on you.

His name is Knaaninn Aranuri and he currently resides in a habitation module near the fifth planet in G5ED-Y.  You'll have to use a system scanner to find him.  Make haste.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Give it to me then so I can take a look at it ...

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here you go.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Yes, just one moment.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Ah.  My orders, finally they have arrived.  My men have been getting quite restless, ever since Airkio sent us here to spy on the State scum.  It seems that we get to launch a major offensive against the Caldari Navy positions here in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}.  But don't leave just yet, I have a job for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I don't have all day ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I was supposed to bring this data to you, {[character]agentID.name} ...

messages.mission.briefing.text: Bring {[character]agentID.name} the Guristas War Plans.  You should have received these plans from agent Airkio Yanjulen in O-LR1H.  {[character]agentID.name} resides near the fifth planet of G5ED-Y.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've started readying the troops for battle, but there is one critical threat looming on the horizon. My sources tell me that a massive weapons convoy is en route to {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, all the way from Caldari Navy compounds in their sovereign space. It is scheduled to arrive here any minute now.

If it arrives at Kois City in one piece, it will give our enemies a huge boost. They've been low on ammunition and equipment for the past few weeks due to our relentless guerilla attacks, but that will be a thing of the past if that convoy arrives at its destination.

You probably guessed it by now, but I want you to stop it from getting to Kois City. I have a bookmark to the stargate they are using to get here. Warp to the location and eliminate every Caldari ship you see. Once they have all been reduced to floating debris, report to me.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The convoy has been destroyed.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I hope you have what it takes, {[character]player.name}.

I'm actually becoming quite worried, he and his men are a vital part of our expedition, and if something happened to them I'm afraid we might have to go empty handed back to base.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have this message from Gue.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I might be of some assistance, if you need help.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: This is terrible news.  Black Jack possibly dead?  This changes everything.  But before we pack our bags and head back to Syndicate space, I want to make sure our information is correct.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: As a matter of fact, I could use a hand in finding out what has actually become of Black Jack.  A colleague of mine in UL-4ZW, Gue Mouey, might know something.  He's one of the overseers of the Syndicate Trade Hub in that system, you'll find it near UL-4ZW IX.  He has had extensive dealings with agents of the Guristas and Caldari Navy, if anyone is qualified to scrounge up information on what happened to Black Jack, it's him.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Aha!  I knew that broad liked me.  Whatever kind words she has for me, tell her it's mutual.  Or better yet, I have some flowers I'd like you to give her ...

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have these tags if you'd like, I heard they fetch a good price in these parts.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Err, actually she needs some information on Black Jack.  You heard anything from the ranks of the Guristas lately, relating to him?

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: What?!  That's all she wants?  Some information?!   Well, if that's the case then it'll cost ya.  Getting my hopes up like that wasn't very nice ...

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hello, {[character]agentID.name}.  Isana Dagin sent me to you, she ...

messages.mission.briefing.text: Get something for {[character]agentID.name} that will convince him to give you the information Isana wants.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well ... ok, that will have to do.  Now as for the information, I have something on Black Jack, yes.  This guy, Tikui Makan, a prominent member of the Guristas I might add, has been boasting lately of killing Black Jack in a duel which supposedly took place in Y5J-EU.  I don't have any more information on the matter, but I can give you Tikui's location.  I'll upload it into this data chip, take it back to Isana.  And when you do that, put in a good word for me, will ya?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As you heard from Gue, Tikui Makan recently boasted of killing Black Jack.  We need to confirm this statement before we abandon our assignment.  Gue lists the coordinates to Tikui's hideout in his message, and I want you to take a closer look.  See if you can find Tikui there, and if you do tell him to give you the exact coordinates of the encounter he had with Black Jack so that we may identify his corpse, if there is one.  Just make sure he's telling the truth.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Oh and another thing, I think Gue has the hots for you.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
This information changes everything. I cannot believe we almost fell for Black Jack's ploy. This matter will be dealt with when I arrive back to Syndicate space.

The Syndicate forces under my command are not well equipped enough to take on the assignment without Black Jack and his men. So I must rely on you, {[character]player.name}, to finish the job.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You can tell that rascal that he has a bigger chance of winning the Legends Trials than he has with me.
