messages.mission.briefing.text: I've been hearing about a rogue drone hive nearby. The Theology Council has been searching for more information on the issue of these… "awakened" drones. Such a matter has a certain interest to those who are given to the study of doctrinal matters. Will you do me the courtesy of investigating the situation and, if possible, bringing one of these strange creatures' AI cores back for study?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I've been hearing about a rogue drone hive nearby. The Theology Council has been searching for more information on the issue of these… "awakened" drones. Such a matter has a certain interest to those who are given to the study of doctrinal matters. Will you do me the courtesy of investigating the situation and, if possible, bringing one of these strange creatures' AI cores back for study?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I found an AI core, but I'm not sure if it will do you any good.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I will pray for you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I will keep you in my prayers.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will do all I can.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't think I'm up to that right now.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Rogue drones are too weird for me. I'm done.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: That is the most any of us can do, no? It's always good to find someone else with a well-developed moral sense. Do be careful.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Got any work for a capsuleer, Your Eminence?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Next time you are called upon, assuming you are called upon, perhaps you will act with appropriate haste.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: That is for the Council to decide, of course. Go with God, child, and know that your assistance is appreciated.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Next time you are called upon, assuming you are called upon, perhaps you will act with appropriate haste.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I've been hearing about an abandoned drone hive nearby. We have yet to find any viable explanation for its presence. I need someone to go investigate and make sure there aren't any rogue drones still hanging around: We need to be certain this is not a threat.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I've been hearing about an abandoned drone hive nearby. We have yet to find any viable explanation for its presence. I need someone to go investigate and make sure there aren't any rogue drones still hanging around: We need to be certain this is not a threat.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I destroyed all the drones in the area. Should be no further threats from that quarter, at least.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That's a damn shame. I'll have to send out someone who can handle it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I can do that.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You'd better send someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Sorry, I'm just not up for this.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Glad to hear it.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Got any work?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Or maybe something. That structure's been dismantled, picked clean. Try to act a little faster next time, huh?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: That's the Caldari spirit, all right. Well done.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Or maybe something. That structure's been dismantled, picked clean. Try to act a little faster next time, huh?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I've been hearing about an abandoned drone hive nearby. These creatures are undeniably strange, and at this point, any information we can get about them is a boon. Trust me, the university will be happy to have the chance to examine anything you can find, once they know there's no threat of active drones out there.

I need someone to go peruse the area, if you take my meaning? Confirm that it is the "real deal," as it were, and make sure there are no rogue drones still in the vicinity. Does this task seem agreeable to you?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, perhaps… Yes. Yes, I've been hearing about an abandoned drone hive nearby. These creatures are undeniably strange, and at this point, any information we can get about them is a boon. Trust me, the university will be happy to have the chance to examine anything you can find, once they know there's no threat of active drones out there.

I need someone to go peruse the area, if you take my meaning? Confirm that it is the "real deal," as it were, and make sure there are no rogue drones still in the vicinity. Does this task seem agreeable to you?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I found drones out there, but it's all clear now. Send those egg-heads on in there!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That's truly a shame. I knew I needed a first-rate capsuleer for this one, not just some riff-raff pilot.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I see. Well, I cannot say I'm surprised. One look ought to have told me to send you packing.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Yeah, I'm up for it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Nah, I don't think I'm up to that right now.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This shit's too weird for me. I'm out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: "Up for it." How quaint. You do seem quite the pedestrian. Still, not all covers belie the contents. And it's always good to find someone else with a healthy sense of intellectual curiosity, whatever their manners.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Yeah, there is. You got any work?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Or perhaps something. That structure has been dismantled in its entirety. Do try to act a little more quickly next time, won't you?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well, that is good news. I'll put the grad students to work on it; maybe we'll be able to come up with a way to use this location for further study.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Or perhaps something. That structure has been dismantled in its entirety. Do try to act a little more quickly next time, won't you?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I' been hearin' 'bout this abandoned drone hive nearby. These things are weird, right, but they're also huge ― and really advanced, techonologicalically, you know ― and I'm always on the lookout fer spare parts. I need someone to go check it out, see, confirm it's abandoned; make sure there aren't any rogue drones still hangin' around. See if there's anything useful there ya can bring back fer me.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I found some stuff, but I don't know if it will do you any good.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That's a damn shame. I really coulda used those parts.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Oooh. Hoity-toity, eh? Well, fine, suit yerself then.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sure.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Not interested.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm not in the mood to go junk-hunting. See you later.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: It's always nice to find a like-minded indy-vidual. Careful out there, huh?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Got any work?

messages.mission.briefing.text: I' been hearin' 'bout this abandoned drone hive nearby. These things are weird, right, but they're also huge ― and really advanced, techonologicalically, you know ― and I'm always on the lookout fer spare parts. I need someone to go check it out, see, confirm it's abandoned; make sure there aren't any rogue drones still hangin' around. See if there's anything useful there ya can bring back fer me.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I'll get this sent down to the shop right away, see what my boys can put together.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've got some confidential mining survey reports here. There has been a lot of Angel Cartel activity in this area recently, though, and I'm not going to take the risk of sending this over an open channel or even via common courier. I need it hand-delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Deliver this and I'll see to it that you're suitably rewarded... and put in a good word for you with the station manager.

What do you say?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The report has been delivered, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I say… I'm on my way.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thanks for the assist. Come back soon and we'll have more work for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Ha. Good. Contact me as soon as you get there, alright?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Thanks, {[character]agentID.name}. What sort of work did you have in mind?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I've got some confidential mining survey reports here I need hand-delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. I suspect that there are some fairly valuable mineral deposits nearby and they may need help mining them. Deliver this and I'll see to it that you're suitably rewarded... and put in a good word for you with the station manager. I've entered the station location into your Neocom.

The reports have been placed in your station hangar. Remember to put them in your cargohold before you set out!

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Alas, Jalita has surely escaped by now and is lost to us forever. Your failure will not sit well with those in power, and certainly does not bode well for your future.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I'm not entirely sure you're ready for an important task like this, but time is of the essence. This may well be the most important mission you have ever undertaken.

A slave named Jaliti has escaped from the house of the one of the five Heirs to the Imperial Throne. We don't know why or how, but she has commandeered a luxury transport and is still on the run. The Heir in question, who will of course remain anonymous, demands her return, for he greatly enjoys her beauty and company. She is also privy to a great number of personal secrets that could cause great embarrassment to the Heir, and perhaps even to the Imperial Council.

We intercepted a transmission indicating that she intends to meet a contact in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We don't know whom she will meet, but you must stop her and bring her back, any way you can. Alive if possible, but dead if necessary. I'm sure if you're successful, the rewards will be substantial. We are dealing with an Heir, after all.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the slave in custody and her Minmatar lover is floating ash.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You were not paid to think, fool! Your rashness will not sit well with those in power, and certainly does not bode well for your future.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I didn't think you were up to this challenge. Perhaps you should go do something less meaningful.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Most of the difficult labor in the Empire is performed by legions of uneducated slaves, who serve at the beck and call of those who are both clearly and naturally above their station. From conquered races to hereditary servants, Amarrian slaves are diverse and numerous, and they spend their entire lives working toward enlightenment under the guidance of their rightful masters.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I think the slave is better off where she's going.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. You had better move. We cannot afford to lose her.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What would you have me do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A slave named Jaliti has escaped from the house of the one of the five Heirs to the Imperial Throne. We don't know why or how, but she has commandeered a luxury transport and is still on the run. The Heir in question, who will of course remain anonymous, demands her return, for he greatly enjoys her beauty and company. She is also privy to a great number of personal secrets that could cause great embarrassment to the Heir, and perhaps even to the Imperial Council.

We intercepted a transmission indicating that she intends to meet a contact in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We don't know whom she will meet, but you must stop her and bring her back, any way you can. Alive if possible, but dead if necessary. I'm sure if you're successful, the rewards will be substantial. We are dealing with an Heir, after all.

The ship Jaliti commandeered is known to be well-armed. You might need a battle-ready frigate to bring her back.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Splendid! In custody. Splendid! The Heir will be pleased.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Alas, the window of opportunity through which you might have proven yourself has passed. Fortunately for the Empire, someone else stepped up to challenge instead of you. Your failure will not sit well with those in power, and certainly does not bode well for your future.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Someone bought the Vitoc out from under us. When you're working with smugglers, you work fast, and you don't take anything for granted.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, some good, some… Heh. Just kidding. No, folks are saying good things about you.

Anyway, listen, I have a lead on a Vitoc shipment not far from here. I've arranged a buy, but I need someone to make the pick-up under the radar. We've arranged for special packaging that will keep the authorities from being able to scan the stuff in your hold, since the stuff is normally highly illegal around here, so you don't need to worry about that.

{[character]player.name}, this could provide the breakthrough our researchers need. Can I trust you to handle it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've got the Vitoc.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm sorry I entrusted you with something so sensitive.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I understand. Please excuse me; I've no time to waste.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I can handle it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Vitoc Method is fundamental to the Amarr slave market. The Method has two key components: a deadly, highly toxic drug with a seemingly viral ability to mutate, and its carefully-guarded antidote: Vitoc. The subject infected with the chemically engineered virus will suffer an agonizing death without regular doses of Vitoc; his daily dose, however, will react with the toxin to bring him several hours of euphoria in addition to keeping the virus inert for a short time.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm gonna have to pass.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: So my source was right about you. Nice. Listen, I should have more work for you soon. I've arranged for a Civilian Relic Analyzer to be placed in your hangar in station; come and see me once you have it fitted on your ship.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Work fast. We're counting on you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh, yeah? All good, I hope. So what's going on?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Go pick up the Vitoc shipment in its warded container and bring it back to {[location]agentStationID.name}.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I have to find someone who can get this done before our contact sells that Vitoc to someone else. Don't contact me again unless you have the time to do the job.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm not dealing with drug-runners. I quit.

localizedName.text: Vitoc Vector - Earning Their Trust (2 of 4)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Hack the wrecked Amarrian science vessel's computers and bring whatever you find back to your agent. Be sure to have some weaponry fitted as well: There's a good chance some pirates have already caught wind of this wrecked vessel as well.

Make sure you fit out the Civilian Relic Analyzer that your agent gave you before you leave the station. You may have to run it for a few cycles before you find anything on the wrecked ship.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, I've got a job you can do to prove it. We're always looking for information. After the last job you ran, I think I can trust you with something a little more sensitive.

I just got a tip that there's a wrecked Amarrian science vessel nearby that is likely to contain something useful; apparently it was here on some kind of "goodwill incentive program" devised by some clown in CONCORD, but the ship was jumped by Brutor Tribe radicals before it landed in station. Heh. Stupid CONCORD, and pathetic Amarrians ― no doubt they were using this program to scout for slave-ship raids anyway.

Point is, though, that I need you to get in there and hack it; take whatever data you can from it before the pirates rip the whole thing to pieces for salvage. This is more important to us than you can understand right now. Matari lives may well be at stake here.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the information you asked for.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: My source was wrong about you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I see. Don't come back until you're ready to prove yourself worthy of my trust.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm willing to help.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This is all a little too dull for me. I'm more of a straightforward, shoot-em-up kind of capsuleer. Good luck finding someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Guess I can't be trusted after all. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Your loyalty is in the right place.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I can. And I'm glad you feel that way.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The pirates beat you to it. There's nothing left of that science vessel.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The pirates beat you to it. There's nothing left of that science vessel.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: So my source was right about you. I'll pass your name along. Come back and talk to me again in a while, will you?

localizedName.text: Vitoc Vector - Mounting a Defense (3 of 4)

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The station has been destroyed by Nafantar raiders. The Matari lives lost are on your head.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
One of our research stations ― the very one where I sent the information from that science vessel you hacked for us ― has been compromised, and we believe that the Amarr and their allies, the traitorous, mongrel Nefantar, will attempt to destroy it. As you know, we Minmatar have many small research stations scattered throughout space to better avoid Amarr detection, but as a result, our resources are necessarily splintered.

The loss of this research station would be a tremendous setback to us. We need you to get in there and defend the station, for I can't be sure I can mobilize local military forces in time. The Amarrians will go to any lengths to prevent us from reverse-engineering a treatment that could invalidate the Vitoc Method. If we can make it costly enough for them, though, they may just be forced to give up on this station, with it being so deep in our sovereignty.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The station is safe, and the Ammatar have learned a painful lesson.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: We will not take this betrayal lightly.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope, for your sake, that you do not come to regret this choice.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm on my way.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The Nefantar go by many names, but Ammatar is the most common ― though their former Minmatar brethren sometimes refer to them as “the Lost Tribe” in pity, but more often “the Fawning” or “the Yoked” in scorn. The Nefantar have left behind their tribal heritage and taken up many (but not all) aspects of the Amarrian religion, a movement that has resulted in a unique blend of cultures.

The Ammatar Mandate and the Minmatar Republic have been locked in a state of cold war for years now; since the Vindication Wars, there hasn't been a large-scale battle between them, mainly due to former Prime Minister Karin Midular's diplomatic efforts. However, after Midular's passing, the animosity between the two peoples cannot be denied.

The old, traditionally aristocratic bloodlines of the Nefantar see themselves as the rightful rulers of all the Matar tribes; for their part, most Minmatar hold little more than bitter animosity toward the tribe that long ago betrayed its cousins, and a widespread hatred of the Ammatar is still common among all other Matari.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't think I can do that.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Though this battle was small, it is still a great victory. And already it bears unexpected fruit. Return to me when you are ready to take on a great labor.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You will do what you must.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What is it?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
One of our research stations has been compromised, and we believe that the Amarr and their allies, the traitorous, mongrel Nefantar, will attempt to destroy it. We need you to get in there and defend the station, for I can't be sure I can mobilize local military forces in time.

The Amarrians will go to any lengths to prevent us from reverse-engineering a treatment that could invalidate the Vitoc Method. If we can make it costly enough for them, though, they may just be forced to give up on this station, with it being so deep in our sovereignty.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: We are sending someone who understands the importance of speed. Stand down.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't fight a war by myself! I'm outta here.

localizedName.text: Vitoc Vector - A Terrible Thing (4 of 4)

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.head.text: You are released from your obligation

messages.mission.briefing.text: Destroy the Amarr Breeding Facility, kill any enemy ships there, and return any enslaved Matari you find to {[location]agentStationID.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We have tracked down an Amarr "breeding facility." {[character]player.name}, I was held in one of these places once, when I was young, and it is only thanks to the efforts of one such as yourself that I find myself a free person today. They're hellholes.

You will find only women and children there; the boys are shipped elsewhere before they turn nine. Most of these facilities don't even bother with Vitoc; they prefer cheaper, more primitive methods of control. After all, the work is hardly complicated: Where humane restraints don't work, brute force and fear often will.

Destroy this place. Rescue as many Matari as you can, but be certain that even those who die are better off.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've brought back as many as I could.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: Amarr Breeding Facilities – Even Death Is Better

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I hope that you are haunted for the rest of your days by the angry spirits of those you refuse to save.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, not everyone is capable of such a thing. But a capsuleer is supposed to be made of sterner stuff.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I understand. I'll do what you ask of me.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
This type of breeding facility produces Minmatar children ready to assume their place as servants to the Amarr; rumors abound that the slaves in these places hail from other races as well, including even fallen Amarr who are sent here rather than to penal colonies.

Brood slaves are held within breeder colonies for the sole purpose of increasing a slaver's stock. Discarded when they have outlived their usefulness, these poor souls have a terribly short life expectancy, although that fact might be a blessing when one considers the misery of their existence.

Slavers who use such methods tend to be secretive about it, often anchoring their breeding centers in low-sec or unclaimed space; however profitable, these facilities are generally looked down upon even in polite Amarrian society (especially since the Doriam reforms).

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I can't condemn innocent victims to death, even in the face of such an atrocity.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm not doing this. I'm done here.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Steel yourself, and do what must be done.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's happened?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The Amarr have swift counter-intelligence. They have moved their operations, and we don't know where.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done our people a great service. No reward can be enough, though our means are limited ― still, go with our gratitude.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I pray there is still time to rescue those unfortunates. Clearly, that rescue will fall to someone else.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Well, as we had projected in that report you delivered for me, scouts we hired from the Minmatar Mining Corp found that there are some significant amounts of Augumene nearby. That's not normally a very valuable substance, but we're using a fabrication process here that utilizes Augumene as a catalyst, so we'll take all we can get. We need 400 units. You good for it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's the Augumene you requested, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Doesn't sound too exciting, but I'll do it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
When mining for specific minerals, use the Overview to help. Click the small white arrow beside the word “Overview”; from there, select “Load default,” and then “Mining.” Then, you can right-click any type of asteroid in your overview and select “Remove from Overview”; keep doing this until only the type you want is left in your overview.

Now, if you plan to mine this type of ore regularly, you can click the Overview arrow again and select “Save current type selection as…” and put in whatever name seems appropriate. Now you can return to this setting anytime you want to simply by using the Overview arrow to select “Load [type].”

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: That's a great help to us, friend. Come back and see me, okay?

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Well, get to work then! We'll see you on your return.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You bet. What is it?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Scouts we hired from Minmatar Mining found that there are some significant amounts of Augumene nearby. That's not normally a very valuable substance, but we're using a fabrication process here that utilizes Augumene as a catalyst, so we'll take all we can get. We need 400 units.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Our production here is going into high gear and we're experiencing shortages of just about everything. We expect everyone to pitch in. I need you to obtain 750 units of Tritanium and deliver them here. You've been reliable so far: care to help out again? You'll get fair compensation for your efforts, plus our gratitude… which isn't worthless, I assure you.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Tritanium is here.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: First, you'll need to locate Veldspar, Scordite, or other ores that produce Tritanium. Next, mine the ore and transport your cargo back to the station. Open your cargo hold and right-click on the ore, then select "To Hangar and Reprocess." In the next window, you'll see how much Tritanium you'll receive. Once you've reprocessed enough, return with it to your agent to complete the mission.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thanks a million, {[character]player.name}. We'll be needing some help on another matter, so come back soon.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: See you when you get back!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Sounds good to me. What do you need?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Our production here is going into high gear and we're experiencing shortages of just about everything. We expect everyone to pitch in. I need you to obtain 750 units of Tritanium and deliver them here. You've been reliable so far: care to help out again? You'll get fair compensation for your efforts, plus our gratitude… which isn't worthless, I assure you.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It seems that our activity in this system has attracted unwanted attention. Mercenaries and pirates of a variety of allegiances have been preying on our unarmed miners and transports. This can't go on! The industrial production of this sector is vital to our military effort.

Are you willing to hunt these bastards down? We have lots of pilots who are good mining operators, but only the rare few are also capsuleers capable of taking on pirates and raiders like you can. There's a generous reward in it if you're in, not to mention the bounties and loot on the enemies themselves.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The raiders have been defeated.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I won't leave one pirate vessel intact.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: If you take too much damage in battle, be sure to warp out to a nearby station for repairs; also be sure to replenish your ammunition if you're running low. Pirates can be pretty tough, so you'll need to be on your toes to deal with them.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I knew we could count on you, {[character]player.name}. We're planning to finish those raiders off once and for all, so stick around, huh?

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good hunting, my friend.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It seems that our activity in this system has attracted unwanted attention. Mercenaries and pirates of a variety of allegiances have been preying on our unarmed miners and transports. This can't go on! The industrial production of this sector is vital to our military effort.

Hunt these bastards down. I've uploaded their current location to your NeoCom.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It looks as if there was some organization behind all the recent pirate activity. You hurt them in that last mission, but they're still out there. We've just learned that they maintain communications in adjacent systems via a communications tower network in this very system! If one of their scouts is forced to flee, the others maintain contact with him via FTL communications made possible by this com network.

We need someone to take out the pirates' tower array. There's been a lot of subspace chatter over the past few days, and we have a pretty good idea that they're planning something big. We need to hit them hard before that happens, throw a wrench in their plans.

So, would you like to be the one who goes in there and finishes them off? I'll enter the locations into your bookmarks. If you leave now, there's every chance you'll catch 'em napping. We'll offer a decent reward plus a bonus if you hit them fast.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those tower arrays are history. Now, about that reward?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll head out there right away. They don't stand a chance.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good bye and good luck, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hey, {[character]agentID.name}. Alright, tell me about this idea of yours.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It looks as if there was some organization behind all the recent pirate activity. We've just learned that they maintain communications in adjacent systems via a communications tower network in this very system! We need someone to take out the pirates' tower array. That someone is you.

I'll enter the locations into your bookmarks. If you leave now, there's every chance you'll catch 'em napping. We'll offer a decent reward plus a bonus if you hit them fast.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Happily, I I consider it well spent. You've proven yourself admirably. This system is a safer place because of you.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You allowed those filthy, disease-ridden slaves to escape. Now they will carry their pestilence to the rest of the galaxy!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Oh, they have their uses, I assure you. Just rule them with an iron hand, my friend.

Anyway, it seems a woman named Zira started an uprising among those new slaves almost the moment they arrived at the indoctrination facility. It was a bloody affair, and several guards and innocent citizens were killed or wounded. This insubordination cannot be tolerated. You are to hunt down Zira, terminate her with extreme prejudice as a lesson to them all, and recapture the other escaped slaves.

Don't waste any time. We've tracked them to a deadspace location, but they may be planning to jump out of the system even as we speak. I've uploaded their location to your NeoCom.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Slaves in custody. Zira is dead.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What, scared away by the thought of facing a few miserable sub-humans? This does not look good on you. Not good at all.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text:
Who's paid you to think?! Your job is to do!! Ach!

I hope I can find someone else to handle this on such short notice.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll bring them back.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: You can usually find the items your agent requires by sifting through the wreckage of destroyed ships or structures, or by looking inside floating cargo containers.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Let them go. They're not worth the trouble.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Nice work. These escapees will be severely punished. Now, don't go far; I'm sure I can find something else for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good hunting.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: More trouble than they're worth, slaves. Alright, what can I do?

messages.mission.briefing.text: A woman named Zira started an uprising among those new slaves almost the moment they arrived at the indoctrination facility. It was a bloody affair, and several guards and innocent citizens were killed or wounded. You are to hunt down Zira, terminate her with extreme prejudice as a lesson to them all, and recapture the other escaped slaves.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You allowed those filthy, disease-ridden slaves to escape. Now they will carry their pestilence to the rest of the galaxy!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: On second thought, I think we should just let these slaves go. They're just not worth the trouble.

localizedName.text: New Slaves - A New Rebellion (3 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Zira Cobalus, the slave leader you dispatched for us, might have been a Minmatar agent sent into our slave population to foment rebellion among the masses. This is intolerable. However, we must verify that she was indeed a spy, and our databanks here are inadequate to this task.

Take this data chip for examination at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Intelligence personnel there will compare our data with theirs, and hopefully we will get a match.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Zira, the slave leader you dispatched for us, might have been a Minmatar agent sent into our slave population to foment rebellion among the masses. This is intolerable. However, we must verify that she was indeed a spy, and our databanks here are inadequate to this task.

Take this data chip for examination at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Intelligence personnel there will compare our data with theirs, and hopefully we will get a match.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Package delivered.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You cannot complete a simple mission like this? Oh, dear. Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear. This does not bode well for your future in the Empire.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: That is unfortunate. I'm sure I can find someone else whose loyalty is not so plainly in question. Keep one eye over your shoulder, my friend.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get this over there right away.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
You can make multiple consecutive jumps through stargates much more quickly manually than you can relying on Autopilot (because the Autopilot brings your ship out of warp 15 km from the stargate each time you warp, forcing you to then fly at sub-warp speed to within 2,500 m of the gate before jumping).

First, set your destination by right-clicking on the location in the mission details or in your bookmarks. The correct stargate icon will now be highlighted in yellow, both in your overview and in space.

Now, right-click on the stargate (either in space or in the overview) and use the "Warp to within 0 km" option… and then turn on Autopilot; you will drop out of warp directly beside the stargate and, because Autopilot is on, jump immediately. As soon as you begin to jump, turn your Autopilot back off; once you've jumped, simply repeat the whole "Warp to 0 km" process with each stargate along the route until you arrive at your destination system.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Oh, I've had enough of this business, I think. Not interested. Sorry.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: It didn't take them long. We were right about this Zira Cobalus. Return immediately so we can discuss the next step.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh? What might that be?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You waited too long. Someone erased all the data we had on this "Zira." Now we will never know the truth.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I think I'm going to pack it in after all. I'm tired of being your errand-runner.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You waited too long. We have missed an opportunity to thwart the rendezvous and discover the identity of the Amarrian double agent. Your lack of initiative puts your loyalty in question, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I think you can, yes. Are you ready for another mission, a truly important one? Good.

We did intercept an encrypted transmission from Zira's contact. How could a naked slave with no possessions receive a transmission, you ask? We sent a recovery team to pick up Zira's remains, and we discovered that she had a cybernetic transceiver implanted in her brain. Not a simple cybernetic implant, but something bio-electrical, beyond our current technology, deep in her cerebral cortex.

Her contact identified himself only as "Helter." We don't know who he is, but we think, from examinations of his speech patterns, that he is Amarrian. The coordinates of the rendezvous were included in the transmission, and I've uploaded them into your data bank.

Go out there and see who we're dealing with. But be careful.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The contact is an Amarrian, and his name is Garmasi Jowai. He is definitely working with the Minmatar.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I was afraid this was too much for you. From now on, we'll have to keep you busy elsewhere... maybe hauling trash or something.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I was afraid this was too much for you. From now on, we'll have to keep you busy hauling garbage or something.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sounds more like my kind of work. Sure, I'm in.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: If your ship is badly damaged and in danger of destruction, you should consider warping away from an encounter. You can repair your ship at most stations, for a cost dependent upon the amount of damage, or you can use Hull Repairers and Armor Repairers to fix the damage yourself while you are in space. But before you try to fit those items to your ship, you should make sure you have the correct skills.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This sounds too dangerous to me. I don't want to be a spy; just give me some pirates to fight or something.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent! So, a double agent working with the Minmatar... No surprise, really. Those mindless sub-humans will do anything to stick a thorn in the side of the Empire, and true loyalty is at a premium these days. Now, we do have a chance to finish this before it goes any further: Come see me as soon as you can.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good luck, and good hunting.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's frustrating. Is there some way I can help?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We did intercept an encrypted transmission from Zira's contact. (We sent a recovery team to pick up Zira's remains, and we discovered that she had a cybernetic transceiver implanted in her brain.) Her contact identified himself only as "Helter."

We don't know who he is, but we think, from examinations of his speech patterns, that he is Amarrian. The coordinates of the rendezvous were included in the transmission, and I've uploaded them into your data bank. Go out there and see who we're dealing with. But be careful.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You waited too long. We have missed an opportunity to thwart the rendezvous and discover the identity of the Amarrian double agent. Your lack of initiative puts your loyalty in question, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is too dangerous. Bring in the Navy or something, okay?

localizedName.text: New Slaves - To Catch a Spy (5 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Now is our chance to apprehend Garmasi Jowai. Intel has determined that he is meeting his Minmatar handlers in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Get out there and catch him, and bring him in to face the Emperor's justice.

The strength of the Minmatar force is unknown, but you can bet they'll be heavily armed. You should not attempt this mission without a well-armed ship, and you should be prepared to warp out for repairs if necessary.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Excellent. This is our chance to apprehend Jowai and make him pay — as well as getting some useful intelligence from him. Intel has determined that he is meeting his Minmatar handlers in a remote pocket of deadspace in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Our ships are too far away, and you've shown great courage and resourcefulness up till now.

Get out there and catch him, {[character]player.name}, and bring him in to face Imperial Justice. Our interrogators are quite... skilled. And you will be well rewarded, of course.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Garmasi Jowai is in custody, and his Minmatar flunkies are destroyed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: It seems the Minmatar frightened you off after all. From now on, we'll have to keep you busy hauling garbage or something.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: It seems the Minmatar frightened you off after all. From now on, we'll have to keep you busy hauling garbage or something.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: You bet. And I'll enjoy every nano-second.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Some deadspace acceleration gates are locked so that you cannot use them until all the enemy ships in the area have been destroyed. If you warp into a deadspace area and you become surrounded by enemies, consider warping out again to repair or to try a different tactic rather than running for the next acceleration gate.

When you warp to an encounter area that you expect might be swarming with enemies, do not use the "Warp to 0 km" option if you can avoid it. Instead, warp to 50 km or so, and force your enemies to come to you. This is a useful option particularly if you are outgunned or seriously outnumbered, especially if you use long-range weapons. (Unfortunately, this tactic isn't available in many deadspace locations, but it should be used whenever possible.)

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This is too dangerous for me. I think I'll go find something else to do.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is too dangerous. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Glad to have you working on this one.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Yes, I can. And I will.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You waited too long. Garmasi Jowai escaped from the rendezvous point with his Minmatar handlers. Your lack of initiative puts your loyalty in question, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done the Empire a great service, {[character]player.name}. You will be handsomely rewarded.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You waited too long. Garmasi Jowai escaped from the rendezvous point with his Minmatar handlers. Your lack of initiative puts your loyalty in question, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A group of Thukker raiders has taken residence in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. So far they've only hit soft targets, passing industrials and the like. They haven't gotten brave enough to try for a station. And, thanks to you, we won't let them live that long.

Head out to their hiding spot. Wipe the savages out. All of Creation will be a safer place for their deaths. And remain wary. I smell the Minmatar "government" behind all this.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yes. Minmatar heathens, and pirates as well. As if we don't have enough to worry about with Blood Raider pirates, Gallente political maneuvering, and our own houses trying to screw each other over. We don't need a bunch of bloodthirsty savages coming in here and causing more trouble.

The Thukker raiders have taken residence in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. So far they've only hit soft targets, passing industrials and the like. They haven't gotten brave enough to try for a station. And, thanks to you, we won't let them live that long.

Head out to their hiding spot. Wipe the savages out. All of Creation will be a safer place for their deaths. And remain wary. I smell the Minmatar "government" behind all this.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those Thukkers will no longer bother the living.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Disappointing. But not entirely unexpected.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: The Empire was not forged by the timid, my friend, nor can the timid preserve it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will make these Thukkers regret ever coming to this system.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The Empire has been studying the ships flown by the Minmatar for some time. Though they mostly fly variants of standard Minmatar ships, the Thukkers usually have specific load outs: They favor Explosive and Thermal weapons, and their ships have a low heat tolerance, making Thermal weapons the best to use against them. If you are using laser weapons, X-Ray or Gamma lenses could be good to equip. If you feel like bringing the fight in closer, Multifrequency lenses do even more Thermal damage, but at the cost of range.

Remember, whatever weapon you use to destroy their ships, Thukkers decompress explosively, just like any other Minmatar...

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I have no desire to engage these violent beasts. Do you have any idea what it costs to replace a ship like mine these days?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I cannot wipe out the Thukkers.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Spoken like a true crusader. Godspeed.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's the problem? Specifically, I mean.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The Thukkers attacked a local outpost. Though the savages themselves died in the ensuing battle, the civilian losses were great. Had you acted more quickly, perhaps fewer souls would be awaiting their judgment now.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Take joy in the knowledge that you have preserved the Empire's peace, and that more damned have been sent to the eternal purgatorial furnace.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The Thukkers attacked a local outpost. Though the savages themselves died in the ensuing battle, the civilian losses were great. Had you acted more quickly, perhaps fewer souls would be awaiting their judgment now.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A small group of Serpentis pirates has taken up residence in a deadspace pocket here in our system. I want you to fly out there and take these clowns out. Use whatever means you need to. And be careful: I have a feeling that they wouldn't be here this deep into our space unless Gallente agents were behind it.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Great, 'cause we have a slight problem: A small group of Serpentis pirates has taken up residence in a deadspace pocket here in our system. They've been mostly harmless until recently, when the dumbasses actually tried to hold up a Rorqual. As you can imagine, they didn't hurt anybody, but they raised enough ire from high up in the corporation that now we have to do something about them.

I want you to fly out there and take these Serpentis clowns out. Use whatever means you need to. And be careful: I have a feeling that they wouldn't be here this deep into our space unless Gallente agents were behind it.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those Serpentis are not coming back… ever.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text:
You know that and I know that, but my boss will not get off my back about it.

Alright, alright, fine. I'll get someone else.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You are going to tangle with the Serpentis at some point. Better to tangle with them when they're small and stupid.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Dead Serpentis, coming up.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
We have data sheets miles long on the Gallenteans. While a lot of it is complete crap, it does give us good information on their typical ship load outs, including the ships flown by pirate groups working in Gallente space, such as the Serpentis.

Serpentis ships favor Kinetic and Thermal weapons, so be prepared for that. Their armor is tough, but cannot turn a point: Using an ammo type that does Kinetic damage should do the trick. Scourge light missiles or rockets work well.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not about to tangle with the Serpentis just because some haulers got spooked.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: These Serpentis aren't worth the effort.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good to hear.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's me, always willing to help.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The Serpentis pulled off a heist on a freighter full of rare ores. That pissed the Navy off something awful. Subsequently the Serpentis thieves had a little run-in with a Navy Raven. The idiots are dead, but we have no idea what they've done with the minerals. If you had acted faster, the State would not have lost these resources.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great. Maybe my boss will ease up on me for a while now.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The Serpentis pulled off a heist on a freighter full of rare ores. That pissed the Navy off something awful. Subsequently the Serpentis thieves had a little run-in with a Navy Raven. The idiots are dead, but we have no idea what they've done with the minerals. If you had acted faster, the State would not have lost these resources.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
What's the matter is the Guristas, of all things; there's a group of them in this system harassing industrials and civilian vessels alike. They don't seem particularly effective as pirates go, but they're brazen enough.

The big concern is that filming for the holo Tears of the Sky is taking place in the same area. Smart money would bet that the Caldari mega-corps are funding these guys; the State is desperate to keep this holo from coming out.

Anyway, the best solution is to just take these Guristas out.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
What's the matter is the Guristas, of all things. Yeah, I know, when have Guristas ever caused trouble in these parts, right? It's weird. But nonetheless, there's a group of them in this very system harassing industrials and civilian vessels alike.

Now, they don't seem particularly effective as pirates go, but they're brazen enough. The big concern is that filming for the holo Tears of the Sky is taking place in the same area. It's set to be the best selling version of the Caldari Uprising yet, with a quarter of the Federation's biggest companies all sponsoring it. If the Guristas mess it up, there is going to be a storm of bad press.

Smart money would bet that the Caldari mega-corps are funding these guys; the State is desperate to keep this holo from coming out. They claim it "misrepresents history." Heh, well, whatever else you want to say about 'em, it's a fact that they have no respect for artistic license...

Anyway, the best solution is to just take these Guristas out. You interested?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Guristas are… dealt with. Tears of the Sky is still on track to be the best holoreel of the year.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I can understand if you don't want to mess with the Guristas, but I never want to hear you besmirch the holoreel industry again.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I know you're young, so you may not fully understand it yet, but believe me when I tell you that nothing is more important than holoreels.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Dead Guristas, coming up.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Federation Navy and FIO have been investigating the Guristas for years, seeing as they're primarily a Caldari organization. Most of the information is classified, but what is public knowledge is their usual load out: Guristas prefer weapons that do Explosive and Kinetic damage, so watch out for that. Luckily, their ships tend to have poor Kinetic resistance; using pretty much any hybrid charges should work fine, or use Hornets if you're into drones.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I think I have more important things to do than safeguard the filming of a holoreel.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: To hell with the Guristas, and to hell with this holo.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Get to it.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's the matter?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The Guristas made a move on the set of Tears of the Sky. Security ships took them out, but this is going to push back the shooting for at least another quarter. Not only is this going to hurt the Gallente economy, but you've disappointed holoreel fans everywhere.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: No, not of the year. Of the century.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The Guristas made a move on the set of Tears of the Sky. Security ships took them out, but this is going to push back the shooting for at least another quarter. Not only is this going to hurt the Gallente economy, but you've disappointed holoreel fans everywhere.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A group of Blood Raiders has been seen in this system. This deep in Minmatar space, you can bet the Amarr government is behind it. I need you to go out there and wipe them out, and make it as violent as you can. We want to make sure this hit is noticed. But be careful on this one.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yeah, Blood Raiders. Never heard of them? The Raiders are a corrupted sect of an ancient cult — I forget the proper name — that historically used human blood in its rituals. Today, they believe that cloned bodies have "purer" blood than others… which is why they operate mainly in space, attacking unwary capsuleers and other rich folks who can afford clones and draining their bodies of blood.

Anyway, a group of Blood Raiders has been seen in this system. Yeah, weird, huh? This deep in Minmatar space?! You can bet the Amarr government is behind this. I need you to go out there and wipe them out. Make it as violent as you can. We want to make sure this hit is noticed. But be careful on this one.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The explosions of the Blood Raider ships could be seen from Athra, I imagine. Boy, did I make a mess of them!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: It may seem like just a few whacked out pirates, but if we let them escape without punishment, what message are we sending our enemies?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Fine. I'll find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will exterminate these Blood Raiders in as bloody a manner as I can.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Between our records and CONCORD's, we have a ton of data on the Blood Raiders. They're about what you'd expect from one of the only religious pirate organizations in existence. But what we're most interested in, of course, is how to destroy them, should we need to: They seem to favor Electromagnetic and Thermal weapons; their ships are tough, but vulnerable to EM-based attacks… so EMP ammo would be a good choice for guns, Mjolnir if you are using missiles.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm busy enough as it is, thanks. But no thanks.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm not too keen on facing down these Blood Raiders. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: That's the spirit.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Blood Raiders?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The Blood Raiders took out one of our patrols. The Raiders themselves were destroyed, but at considerable loss of life. Had you exterminated them when you were asked to, our dead pilots would still be around.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: That's exactly what I wanted to hear. Good work.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The Blood Raiders took out one of our patrols. The Raiders themselves were destroyed, but at considerable loss of life. Had you exterminated them when you were asked to, our dead pilots would still be around.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text:
Those fools went and let ships dock with no medics to give the okay. Turns out one of 'em was carrying some kind of plague, and the whole station ended up sick before they figured out what was going on.

Anyway, you don't need to take the AID parts over anymore. They'll take care of that when they refurbish the place after the hazmat team finishes sterilizing it and incinerating the bodies.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Good. Listen, some idiot just hacked into the AID system and fried all the doctors. Then a bigger idiot burned out all the replacement hardware by trying to replace single units instead of rebooting the whole damn system. So the whole station is fracked, completely without medical staff.

I need you to go pick up the nearest batch of replacement parts from the Sisters of EVE Medical Center in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and bring them back here before everyone manages to die of the Debylian flu or something.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Got the AIDs here. Turned out to be a bit trickier than expected, I might add.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I can hardly blame you. I'll have to find someone else to fix those morons' mistake.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I can hardly blame you. I'll have to find someone else to fix those morons' mistake.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Yeah, I'll give it a shot.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Medical doctors being in such short supply, and thus in high demand, few of them are willing to risk their lives for a less lucrative practice than the one they can run comfortably planet-side. On stations, robotic AI Medical Doctors (AIMEDs, more commonly known as "AI Docs" or just "AIDs") are much more common than human medical practitioners, and much more affordable.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I think I'll pass.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good for you. The morons barely deserve the help, but it's my ass if someone goes and dies.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Well, that's fortunate! I came to see if you had any work for me.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Pick up the shipment of AIMEDs and deliver them to {[location]agentStationID.name}. Keep in mind that pirates and other unsavory elements are always looking for AIMEDs since medical staff among them are virtually non-existent, so you should be prepared for interference of some kind.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well done. Not a single unnecessary death. And the reward's pretty generous, so it should cover any additional hassle, I think. Sorry for the trouble, though.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text:
Those fools went and let ships dock with no medics to give the okay. Turns out one of 'em was carrying some kind of plague, and the whole station ended up sick before they figured out what was going on.

Anyway, you don't need to take the AID parts over anymore. They'll take care of that when they refurbish the place after the hazmat team finishes sterilizing it and incinerating the bodies.

localizedName.text: Pot and Kettle - Wounded Hunter (1 of 5)

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The Amarrian battlecruiser has escaped, possibly with valuable information regarding our force dispositions and capabilities. Your failure to complete this mission is a stain upon both your honor and mine, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It looks as if the Amarr are getting a little too ballsy. We encountered a small Amarrian skirmish fleet a couple of jumps away and chewed 'em up pretty bad. Their leader was in a Prophecy, which was damaged in the fight, but he managed to warp her away when we demolished his squad. She was nearly hulled, and we want someone to make sure she doesn't make it back to Amarr territory.

One of our covert ops pilots managed to scan the ship down in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system, but of course he couldn't take her on, even if she was badly damaged; he figured her captain was hiding out until we eased off on stargate security so he could sneak through and get back to Amarr space. I want you to get out there and take out that damaged battlecruiser, blow her to hell.

Now, I know you'd be willing to do this just to take down some of those arrogant Amarr bastards, but I've arranged for a decent reward anyway. You in?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The battlecruiser's destroyed. It wasn't alone, and it must've had both hull and armor repairers fitted, 'cause there wasn't a scratch on it when I got there.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, I'll just have to find someone else with the guts to finish the job!

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I guess I misjudged you, {[character]player.name}. I'll have to seek help elsewhere.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That battlecruiser's dead, mark my words!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Prophecy is built on an ancient Amarrian warship design dating back to the earliest days of starship combat. It was originally intended as a full-fledged battleship, but Imperial Navy engineers determined after mixed fleet engagements with early prototypes that the Prophecy would be more effective as a slightly smaller, more mobile cruiser-class ship.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Hm. No. Not worth my time, one lone battlecruiser. Thanks, but no thanks.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Those Amarrians will rue the day they messed with us! We're analyzing the enemy fleet's communications — come back if you're interested in more action.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Good hunting, {[character]player.name}!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's up?

messages.mission.briefing.text: One of our covert ops pilots managed to scan a badly damaged Amarrian Prophecy down in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system, but of course he couldn't take her on, even if she was badly damaged; he figured her captain was hiding out until we eased off on stargate security so he could sneak through and get back to Amarr space. Go out there and blow that damaged battlecruiser to hell.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text:
{[character]player.name},

Your delay in responding to my request for assistance with the enemy battlecruiser in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has forced me to revoke my offer of employment. I will be seeking assistance from more reliable pilots in future.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: That battlecruiser isn't as badly hurt as you claimed, and it sure as hell isn't alone out there. Take your mission and shove it!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Amarrians were busy out here. It seems they were up to a lot more than just scouting. One of their missions was apparently to place mines along some of our major shipping routes. {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, in particular, is full of the blasted things, and we've got a convoy coming through within four standard hours. We need to get someone to both systems and clear out those mines!

These "mines" are quite something, though. They are highly explosive proximity charges built into structures, but when they blow, they also launch a bunch of drones into space to finish off anything not torn entirely apart by the explosion. It's a tough job, but if they're not cleared by the time the convoy gets there, our people are in serious trouble.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Amarrians were busy out here, I guess — they were up to a lot more than just scouting, it seems. One of their missions was apparently to place mines along some of our major shipping routes. {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, in particular, is full of the blasted things, and we've got a convoy coming through within four standard hours. We need to get someone to both systems and clear out those mines!

These "mines" are quite something, though. They are highly explosive proximity charges built into structures, but when they blow, they also launch a bunch of drones into space to finish off anything not torn entirely apart by the explosion. It's a tough job, but if they're not cleared by the time the convoy gets there, our people are in serious trouble.

You up for it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The convoys are safe. I've dealt with the mines — cunning idea, those. Too bad we didn't think of it first!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You think this is a joke, don't you? Good men and women may die because you don't have what it takes to finish a simple job!

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Don't ask if you're not serious about wanting work. You've wasted my valuable time.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it, sure — sounds a little more interesting than your typical shoot-em-up.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Surely you must have some cheap ships you can throw away on these mines, right? I mean, why risk my ship?!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Sorry, I decided I don't want to risk my ship to clear those mines.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Well, what are you waiting for? Get out there and get those mines!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm back. What do you need? Those Amarr ships were up to no good, I'm sure.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You've delayed too long; our convoy struck a mine and had to turn back. Lives have been lost and our forces in the region have been dealt a serious setback. Well done.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I don't like being kept waiting. We've had to abort two convoy missions now and I've had to hire a team of minesweepers to go in there and clear it out. If you're going to treat all my offers this way, don't bother coming back.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work, kid! Those convoys will get through now. Come on back soon and I'll have some more work for you.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Those techies over in research are still waiting to create the new smart bomb, {[character]player.name}. I've given the job to someone else.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
That convoy you helped get through was more important than you know. In addition to their normal cargo, they were transporting a sealed diplomatic container containing research blueprints for a new EMP Smartbomb II. The next time those Amarr decide to swing through this sector and leave drones for us to find, our boys'll be waiting for them with a few racks of these babies. Those fanatical SOBs won't know what hit 'em.

Anyway, we need a fast, competent courier to get these documents for a modified EMP Smart Bomb over to the research wing at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; they need them as a model for the new prototype. I imagine I'll have more work for you as soon as you get back, since they're going to want to start producing these right away. You up for the job?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I delivered those smart bomb design documents as requested.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, it's not the most glamorous job around, fine, but it was vital. Guess I'll find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll leave right away!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not your errand boy. I'm a capsuleer. Find someone else!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work. See me again as soon as you get a chance.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Fly safe, {[character]player.name}!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's up? Any more minefields need clearing?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We need a fast, competent courier to get these documents for a modified EMP Smart Bomb over to the research wing at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}; they need them as a model for the new prototype. I imagine I'll have more work for you as soon as you get back, since they're going to want to start producing these right away. You up for the job?

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Research needed the docs for that smart bomb yesterday, {[character]player.name}! While you were busy screwing around, I hired someone else for the job.

localizedName.text: Pot and Kettle - Seek and Destroy (4 of 5)

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Since you dawdled for too long, the enemy has observed our smart bomb test. They'll be coming here in force any time now, I'm sure. If you want to make up for this failure, come see me.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yes, of course. We waste your talents in such banalities, I realize. Still, thanks to your help, we've managed to build a number of the advanced EMP smart bombs. We've scheduled a live test in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, but it looks as if Amarrian intel has realized that something is up: Our spies tell us Amarr is dispatching recon ships to all our surrounding systems.

We can't let them observe this weapons test! We need someone to keep the gate closed. We need to hit any Amarrian recon ships in the system and destroy them before they can get word back to the enemy. And I have a plan.

We've tracked down a small gang of Amarrian ships nearby. If you were to go in there and attack them, they would call for backup, luring their recon ships in to assist; then you can pick them off once they arrive.

What do you say? This a little more up your alley? If not, well, I might have something else you can do to help.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Not a single enemy ship escaped. The secret testing operation is secure.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Alright, that's fine — not every capsuleer develops recon skills, I know. Let me peruse these files and I'll see what else I can offer.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Definitely! This sounds like something I can sink my teeth into!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Quitting a mission invariably results in a loss of faction standing; it is almost always in a character's best interest to complete all missions he or she accepts.

However, a character may freely decline a mission when it is first offered, as long as it isn't one of those rare "storyline" missions; after that, declining another mission within four hours of the first does result in a loss of standing. Still, in general, a capsuleer's career is usually long and eventful enough that a few such minor hits to standing may not be too large a price.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, no can do. Sounds like maybe you have something else for me, though?

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
The test went without a hitch, thanks to you and our other recon pilots! Now we're ready to take the fight to the enemy.

Come back and see me as soon as you can.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good! Now for all that's holy, be careful out there!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Absolutely. Uh, something a little more challenging, though? I mean, any rookie can mine Kernite…

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Thanks to your help, we've built a number of the advanced EMP smart bombs. We've scheduled testing in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, but it looks as if Amarrian intel has realized that something is up: Amarr is dispatching recon ships to all our surrounding systems.

{[character]player.name}, we can't let them observe this weapons test! We need to hit any Amarrian recon ships in the system and destroy them before they can get word back to the enemy. And I have a plan.

We've tracked down a small gang of Amarrian ships nearby. Go in there and attack them so they call for backup, luring their recon ships in to assist; then you can pick them off once they arrive.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: We needed help sooner than this, {[character]player.name}. I've gotten help elsewhere.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Sorry, this was more than I could handle.

localizedName.text: Pot and Kettle - To Battle (5 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
You've been with this assignment since the beginning, so it's only fitting that you be the one to take the fight to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, where our scouts have detected part of an Amarrian fleet. The Navy will engage the main Amarrian force elsewhere, but we are confident that a capsuleer such as yourself, having proven your skills time and time again, can be trusted to deal with this smaller force.

Be careful out there, {[character]player.name}. I mean it: This one is not going to be easy.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Enemies destroyed. Smart bombs or otherwise, they didn't stand a chance.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You've come this far only to quit? I expected better of you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You've come this far and now you're backing out?!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll blow those bastards back to hell!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That sounds suicidal. No offense, but I'm not the pilot for this one.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Sorry. There's no way I'm going to be able to complete this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Prepare for launch then, captain. Good luck!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Reporting back for more work — you said you might have something big this time?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
You've been with this assignment since the beginning, so you know we're involved in producing new high-tech EMP smart bombs. Our intel tells us that the enemy fleet is fielding a good number of electronic warfare frigates that like to orbit at close range. Fitting a smartbomb or two would counter this tactic of theirs quite effectively.

{[character]player.name}, it's up to you now.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've done us an invaluable service! Let us hope this reward for a job well done, along with our eternal gratitude, will suffice.

localizedName.text: Pot and Kettle - Making Amends (5 of 5)

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Amarrians now know that we're manufacturing high-tech EMP smart bombs in this vicinity. They can't attack this station -- it's too well defended -- but they also know we need Mexallon to produce the bombs, and they are trying to cut off our supply. We need you to deliver some Mexallon to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As a result of your failure, the Amarrians now know that we're manufacturing high-tech EMP smart bombs in this vicinity. They can't attack this station — it's too well defended — but they also know we need Mexallon to produce the bombs, and they are trying to cut off our supply. We need someone to deliver some more Mexallon to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. You good for this job, at least?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Okay, your precious minerals are safe. Are we even now?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I knew you couldn't hack it, {[character]player.name}. You've just proven it… again.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Coward! I knew you weren't up to it!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Spare me the sarcasm, {[character]agentID.name}. Let's see you go out there and face down an Amarrian fleet! Just give me the stuff and I'll get it there, okay?

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Er, no thanks. I may not have been able to defeat the Amarrian fleet single-handedly, but I'm not some stupid courier.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: On second thought, I don't think I will deliver the Mexallon. Your insolence is just a bit too… insolent.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Ha! Some spirit after all. Good! We might make a decent pilot out of you yet!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Uh, "failure" is such a strong word…. Anyway, what can I do?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The enemy has successfully shut down our advanced EMP smart bomb production. Your repeated failure to act has caused considerable damage to this sector.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes, you've erased that black mark on your record, {[character]player.name}, at least as far as I'm concerned. But do keep the insolence to a minimum from now on, hmm?

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The enemy has successfully shut down our advanced EMP smart bomb production. Your repeated failure to act has caused considerable damage to this sector.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We recently found a number of new mining fields in adjacent systems, and the usual assortment of pirate trash has come out of the woodwork to exploit it. We'll need them mined soon because even those thieving bastards have friends in places high enough to put the legal status of these sites in doubt. For some reason they've taken an interest even in Banidine, too, and we'll need to find out why; all my workers are busy with the more profitable fields, but I'm not taking any chances.
