localizedName.text: Regional Stability - Moving the Consul (1 of 4)

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The protests are heating up. The Minmatar are now using their Gallentean allies to pressure the State into recognizing the Sagacious Path as a political movement: For all intents and purposes, the dissenters have won legitimacy. The State will not soon forget this embarrassment.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Last week a branch of the Achur monks calling itself the "Sagacious Path" began protesting some Caldari legislation. They claim the State has been abusing the Achura, steering them into supporting war with the Gallente Federation and its Minmatar allies. Now, groups like this crop up from time to time, and usually everything works itself out and goes back to the status quo.

Unfortunately, this group seems smarter and more determined than usual, staging rallies outside of foreign embassies, that sort of thing. They're getting some real attention now. The Minmatar especially are giving us a hard time. We aren't in a position to end these protests yet, so the next best thing is to end the Minmatar involvement.

The State wants you to go pick up the Minmatar emissary at the station he's residing in. Bring him back here, where he is to remain until this whole situation blows over.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Minmatar emissary has been safely relocated.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You do not understand what you have done. Through your failure to act, these dissenters have gained legitimacy. The State will not soon forget this embarrassment.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Some day, you will learn just how important politics are; this job is vital. If you will not do it, I will find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will ensure the emissary arrives safely.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Politics are an integral part of life in the EVE universe. The empires engage in a complex ballet of posturing, promises, and deception. Although empire politics rarely reach the all-out hostility common in lawless space or even along the empires' border zones, they are no less deadly.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You have my sympathies, but I'm not about to ferry some Minmatar about just because a few Achura are upset.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}. The consul is clearly unhappy with the whole affair, but he remains silent. Don't go far – I expect to have more work for you very soon.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: And remember, that Minmatar consul must come to no harm.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You can trust me. What do you need done?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Last week a branch of the Achur monks calling itself the "Sagacious Path" began protesting some Caldari legislation. Their Minmatar allies, especially, are giving us a hard time. We aren't in a position to end these protests yet, so the next best thing is to end the Minmatar involvement.

The State wants you to go pick up the Minmatar emissary at the station he's residing in. Bring him back here, where he is to remain until this whole situation blows over.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The protests are heating up. The Minmatar are now using their Gallentean allies to pressure the State into recognizing the Sagacious Path as a political movement: For all intents and purposes, the dissenters have won legitimacy. The State will not soon forget this embarrassment.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: To hell with politics. I will waste no more time on this.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Scope just broadcast a special feature called Caldari: State of Fear. It is every bit the sort of drivel it sounds like, but the universe is buying it. Most of the footage came from the reporters you didn't scare off. We won't ask for your help again soon.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The media can be as dangerous as an army. The masses are swayed by it, and the masses sway the politicians. There's a group of Scope reporters sitting out at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They're feeding the Gallentean and Minmatar viewers exactly what they want to see: dissent in the State. We need you to... persuade these gentlemen to leave.

Of particular interest is their broadcast array: It's an expensive piece of hardware that allows them to broadcast to the rest of the universe in real time. As soon as you warp in, target and destroy that array. Do not concern yourself with the Scope reporters. They aren't fighters, and are likely to flee as soon as you start firing. Under no circumstances are you to kill any of the reporters. That will only make the entire situation even more explosive.

Got it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The array has been taken care of.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: The only thing worse than intimidating the press is failing at it. The Scope are now pressing even harder. The State is not going to come out of this looking good at all.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You are fooling yourself if you think the press is innocent in all this.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I got it. Consider the Scope silenced.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Not all entities in deadspace pockets will immediately attack on sight. Some operate under orders to have limited engagement zones, while others are simply cowardly. Note, however, that nearly all starships or space station defenses will return fire if attacked first.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I will not threaten innocent civilians, no matter what your rationale.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work. And now it seems the Achur government has requested your help in another matter.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Just remember: Destroy Scope array, good; kill reporters, BAD!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: The media? What are you getting at?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
There's a group of Scope reporters sitting out at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They're feeding the Gallentean and Minmatar viewers exactly what they want to see: dissent in the State. We need you to... persuade these gentlemen to leave.

Of particular interest is their broadcast array: As soon as you warp in, target and destroy that array.

Do not concern yourself with the Scope reporters. They aren't fighters, and are likely to flee as soon as you start firing: Under no circumstances are you to kill any of them. That will only make the entire situation even more explosive.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Scope just broadcast a special feature called Caldari: State of Fear. It is every bit the sort of drivel it sounds like, but the universe is buying it. Most of the footage came from the reporters you didn't scare off. We won't ask for your help again soon.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I thought I had it in me to scare some journalists, but I guess I don't.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Reports are flooding out from the protests. The amateur nature of the reports is actually making them more damaging than the Scope story was. The other empires are viewing the protesters as oppressed underdogs, which plays directly into the protesters' hands.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
You did well in kicking out Scope; aside from some minor whining, we have not heard anything from the Minmatar consulate. The Achura are viewing you as something of a good luck charm, it seems. In fact, they have asked for you to handle another task that some may view as dubious.

Despite your good work, reports are still coming from the protests. Individual citizens are spreading the news over the open channels, doing nearly as much damage as Scope. If stability is to return, we must prevent these amateur reports from getting out.

There is a fluid router nearby that is the primary hub for the areas where the Sagacious Path is protesting. One of our best contractors at a nearby station has managed to break the encryption key on the router. If you retrieve this key and bring it back to me here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, the State will be able to control what information enters and leaves the area.

And don't worry, I know what I'm asking you to do would be illegal under most any circumstances, we've been given dispensation by the State in this affair. Still, if you feel uneasy, I can come up with something less.... distasteful for you. Your choice.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've returned with the encryption key. Hope it works out for you.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I didn't expect you to give up so soon. Yeah, okay. I have something else, I think.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Playing the good guy, eh? That's alright. I think we have something else for you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: No worries. CONCORD won't even know I was there.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Fluid Routers are the backbone of interstellar communication. These devices make faster-than-light (FTL) communication possible. Though many are owned by private companies, they all fall under the purview of CONCORD, and tampering with them is considered a serious crime. Thanks to some complex legal loopholes, in this case you will not be doing anything illegal by transporting the encryption key.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I will not do something this blatantly immoral. I'll do something else, but not this.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Fantastic. With this we can control what information enters — and leaves — the area. Now, come back as soon as possible: I have one more job for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You were born for this kind of work, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I think I have proven myself after the last mission. What is it?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Despite your good work, reports are still coming from the protests. Individual citizens are spreading the news over the open channels, doing nearly as much damage as Scope. If stability is to return, we must prevent these amateur reports from getting out.

There is a fluid router nearby that is the primary hub for the areas where the Sagacious Path is protesting. One of our best contractors at a nearby station has managed to break the encryption key on the router. If you retrieve this key and bring it back to me here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, the State will be able to control what information enters and leaves the area.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Reports are flooding out from the protests. The amateur nature of the reports is actually making them more damaging than the Scope story was. The other empires are viewing the protesters as oppressed underdogs, which plays directly into the protesters' hands.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't continue in this immoral mission any longer. You mentioned that you could give me something else to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Sagacious Path has been immune from action for too long. They've hidden behind the media. They've hidden behind civilians. Now they have nothing to hide behind. Our security forces have forced the Sagacious Path out of all State stations. Now they are concentrated in a few ships, rallying in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to plan their next disruption.

Warp in and compel the Sagacious Path to leave Caldari space. Use any means necessary. If any Sagacious Path remain in this area, or if anyone sees you and escapes, harmony will not return. Ensure that order prevails.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
How else do you restore order? You remove the chaotic elements.

The Sagacious Path has been immune from action for too long. They've hidden behind the media. They've hidden behind civilians. Now they have nothing to hide behind. Our security forces have forced the Sagacious Path out of all State stations. Now they are concentrated in a few ships, rallying in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to plan their next disruption.

We will take advantage of this opportunity. You will warp in and compel the Sagacious Path to leave Caldari space. You are cleared to use any means necessary. If any Sagacious Path remain in this area, or if anyone sees you and escapes, harmony will not return. Ensure that it does.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The protests are officially over. None escaped the consequences of their dissention.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: {[character]player.name}, there is no other way. I had thought you and I were of a mind in this. Clearly I was wrong.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: {[character]player.name}, there is no other way. I had thought you and I were of a mind in this. Clearly I was wrong.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: For the good of the State, it will be done.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Capsuleer ships contain impressive amounts of monitoring equipment. This equipment is what allows CONCORD to respond so quickly when capsuleers attack each other in empire space. Regular ships usually lack such sophisticated equipment, making them particularly vulnerable. If these ships are destroyed in deadspace, it is likely no one would learn of it for some time.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I cannot do this. There has to be a better way to resolve this.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I cannot do this. There has to be a better way to resolve this.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Go, citizen. Restore peace to our people.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: How do you suggest we do that?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The Sagacious Path have resumed protests, and we have failed to reach our goals in this matter. I believed you to be a person of action. Clearly I was mistaken.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Stability is returning to the area. Those who would change our ways have been silenced. And it is all thanks to you.

You have done the State and Achura a great service. But you must remain vigilant. In the war to come, the State will have need of elite agents like you.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The Sagacious Path have resumed protests, and we have failed to reach our goals in this matter. I believed you to be a person of action. Clearly I was mistaken.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
There is a terrorist cell comprised of Matari and Gallentean extremists out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They plan to use the recent unrest to bomb several key Achur sites. For security reasons I cannot reveal their targets, but it is truth when I tell you that countless civilians will die unless we act.

Fly to their hideout. Destroy their cell before they succeed in their terrible goals.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I know. The truth is we've been waiting for someone of your moral caliber. Now listen closely: This is an urgent matter.

There is a terrorist cell comprised of Matari and Gallentean extremists out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They plan to use the recent unrest to bomb several key Achur sites. For security reasons I cannot reveal their targets, but it is truth when I tell you that countless civilians will die unless we act.

Fly to their hideout. Destroy their cell before they succeed in their terrible goals.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I stopped the terrorists. The Caldari State is safe from foreign aggression once again.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: The State forgives you, {[character]player.name}. But will you forgive yourself?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You don't trust us? I shall shed a single tear.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: If I accomplish nothing else, I will have done some good in this.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't trust you. Not anymore.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I am not up to this task. May the State forgive me.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You're our best hope, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I've already told you, I will not do anything immoral.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You have wasted enough of my time. I consider our business through.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You're alive!? Ah... excellent! Well done, {[character]player.name}. The State is indeed in your debt.

While you were defending our people from foreign extremists, our peacekeeping forces have dealt with the Sigacious Path. They will not be seen here again. Now peace and stability can return to the area.

Did I mention how glad I am to see you've returned safely?

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You have wasted enough of my time. I consider our business through.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Pick up the supplies and bring them back to your agent at {[location]agentStationID.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I — and a number of other members of the Federation — believe that the official position we have taken regarding the Amarrian enslavement of the Matari people is far too lenient. We feel that something must be done to eliminate this dehumanizing practice within our lifetimes, and if we are to see action, we must take it ourselves.

Amarr slavers commit atrocities on a regular basis, and while they do not hide this fact, they can hardly be expected to advertise it. We must bring the attention of the masses to focus upon the sheer cruelty of the slavers… even if it is necessary for us to manipulate the facts of the situation to do so.

Are you willing to stand with us, to do what is necessary?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've got the supplies you asked for.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Some people just aren't ready to serve the greater good.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Some people just aren't ready to serve the greater good.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I am. Just tell me where to go.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: While the Gallente Federation officially condemns Amarr for practicing slavery, they fear to take any action that might lead to outright war. Some individuals feel that it is well past the time for mere words, and that action is long overdue.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't like the sound of this. I'll pass.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I can see that you have principles, {[character]player.name}. Come back when you're ready to act on them again.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Um, it's bad? Is this a trick?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The shipment is already on its way. We'll have to wait for another chance, and while we do, more will die in durance vile.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The shipment is already on its way. We'll have to wait for another chance, and while we do, more will die in durance vile.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I figured out what you're doing here, and I don't want to be part of it.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The convoy reached its destination, and people have the nerve to praise the Amarr for allowing the aid through! Work this important has to be done fast.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
You did well with the last task I gave you. A careful leak to my contact at the Scope got us into the news: a minor story about slaves being allowed to starve under Amarrian "care." A minor story! We're going to need a lot more than that to achieve our goals.

So, this time, we're getting a little more high-profile.

We have the location of a small, unmanned Minmatar convoy that's carrying relief supplies to an Amarr slave camp. It's the kind of effort that's likely to do more harm than good in the long run. Slavery doesn't look as bad if the slaves are well-cared for.

I need you to destroy that convoy; once you're done, I'll have my people arrange something at the scene that points back to the Amarr. After all, they're the ones responsible for this whole mess.

I can see you blanching at this: Trust me, it's for the best. But if you really can't bring yourself to do it, well, then let me know and I'll give you something less... distasteful.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've done what you asked. None the wiser.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I understand. Some people don't have the breadth of view necessary to serve the greater good.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Crazy or no, this work needs doing. But I'll find someone else, fine. Talk to me in a bit and I'll have something else for you instead, something that won't ruffle your moral feathers.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: You're making sense to me. I'm in.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Though Scope (the corporation taking its name from its famed primetime holocast, The Scope) was originally based inside the Gallente Federation, it has expanded to the point where it is now considered the leading news agency throughout the empires.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That's entirely too heavy for me. I'm not going to go destroy relief ships. You're crazy!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent. Come back to me when you're ready to do some more work for the cause.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't worry, we will make sure that the blame for this action falls where it truly belongs — on the Amarr.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I think so. Depends, I guess.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We have the location of a small, unmanned Minmatar convoy that's carrying relief supplies to an Amarr slave camp. It's the kind of effort that's likely to do more harm than good in the long run. Slavery doesn't look as bad if the slaves are well-cared for.

I need you to destroy that convoy; once you're done, I'll have my people arrange something at the scene that points back to the Amarr. After all, they're the ones responsible for this whole mess.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The convoy reached its destination, and people have the nerve to praise the Amarr for allowing the aid through! Work this important has to be done fast.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't do this. The people we're hurting are the Minmatar who need these supplies!

localizedName.text: Greater Good – Poisoning the Well (3 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Scope picked up on the destruction of a certain Minmatar relief convoy, alright, but the story suggested that the whole thing was a military accident. An accident! How dangerous did that convoy look to you?!

Well, anyway, now the public has the idea that the Amarr are just a bit incompetent, that their destruction of a relief convoy was merely overzealous rather than malicious. So now we need to show people how dangerous Amarrian incompetence can be.

I need you to take this… er, well, the item I'm about to give you... to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Leave it in your hangar there, and my contact will see that it makes its way into... well, where it needs to go. The less you know, maybe, the better?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I left the item where you told me to.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm not sure why you're quitting now.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I'm not sure why you're quitting now.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Okay, I can do that.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not sure what you're planning, but I'm through with it.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is messed up. I'm out of here.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: This may not seem difficult, but it is very important. Act quickly.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Maybe. What do you want me to do this time?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Take the Food-Borne Toxin to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and report back to your agent.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: So I heard. You're doing a difficult job, and doing it well, {[character]player.name}. Come see me when you're ready to take the next step.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The ship was still destroyed, but the Empire managed to dodge the blame again. I've been hearing stories ranging from pirates to equipment failure. If you had done as I asked, at least some good would have come of this destruction.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Finally, we're getting noticed. Egonics picked up the last story — how Amarr standards are so lax that they fed contaminated rations to their slaves. Egonics isn't keen on the Amarr anyway, so they really let them have it.

Here's the thing, though: The food poisoning outbreak affected so many people that it showed up on CONCORD's radar. They've sanctioned a small independent committee to inspect the conditions in one of the slave colonies. Ridiculous as it sounds, they're checking the conditions in which people are being kept as livestock.

The ship is due to arrive in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} soon. Our cause will be better served if it never gets there. Obviously, that will look bad for the Amarr; it might even make people reconsider what happened to the last non-Amarr ship that tried to reach one of their slave colonies.

Do you understand what I need you to do?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I did what you asked of me.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm sorry you've lost the nerve to do what must be done.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I'm sorry you don't have the nerve to do what must be done.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll blow up the ship, just like before. 'Nuff said.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Gallentean super-corporation Egonics Inc. uses a special intracranial technology for broadcasting sound that has been outlawed in the Amarr Empire.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not interested in messing with CONCORD. You nuts?!

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Come see me again soon. This isn't over yet.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I realize this is difficult, but believe me, it must be done.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's happened?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Destroy the CONCORD Committee Vessel so that the Amarr Empire can be blamed for the act.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: The ship was still destroyed, but the Empire managed to dodge the blame again. I've been hearing stories ranging from pirates to equipment failure. If you had done as I asked, at least some good would have come of this destruction.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: No way am I going up against CONCORD. You nuts?!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Since we've drawn so much attention to the plight of the Matari, there's been a news leak: one of the slave colonies has staged a rebellion. Now, the Amarr always respond to rebellion with brute force, so those people are pretty much doomed. But we can save them, and still make it look like they all perished once again at the hands of the Amarrians.

Destroy the mining colony before the Amarrians do, and bring the survivors back here for safekeeping.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Impetus is considering putting out a new holoreel about the enslaved Matari. Now that people think the Amarr would rather blow up CONCORD ships than allow the public to see how slaves are treated, there's talk of a major project, not just a documentary. This is exactly what we need!

News and documentaries are useful, but this would really reach the public. The average person needs things black and white, and that's what holos are for.

This is the last thing I'm going to ask of you, and it won't be easy. Since we've drawn so much attention to the plight of the Matari, there's been a news leak: one of the slave colonies has staged a rebellion. Now, the Amarr always respond to rebellion with brute force, so those people are pretty much doomed.

But we can save them--at least a good number of them--and still make it look like they all perished, once again at the hands of the Amarrians. And it's unlikely Amarr will even bother to deny responsibility since everyone knows they'd destroy the whole colony anyway. Remember, if you leave it to the Amarr to destroy the colony themselves, those Matari will only suffer further torture and degradation, and then be killed anyway.

Can you do this final task for the cause?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've done what you asked. I'm not sure how to feel about it, though.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm sorry you're not willing to make the necessary sacrifice.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I'm sorry you're not willing to make the necessary sacrifice.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: You're right, a quick death is better. I'll destroy the colony and bring back what survivors I can.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Impetus is the main producer of holoreels in the universe today. In recent years, they have led the development of instant news arrays. Impetus predicts that when these arrays are completed, they will revolutionize the news business.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This is going too far. No, I'm done.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is just too creepy. I'm done with you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You are sparing those people from Amarr aggression. Surely death is better than servitude.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's going on now? You've got more work, you said, right?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text:
Amarr retook the colony. They captured the leaders for transportation and torture, followed by public execution. Well, the men, at least. The women were lobotomized and transferred to breeding colonies. Everyone else involved was merely spaced.

So as you can see, you did them no favors.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You display exemplary moral fiber. Not many have the sheer grit to do so many unpleasant things in the service of their fellow man.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text:
Amarr retook the colony. They captured the leaders for transportation and torture, followed by public execution. Well, the men, at least. The women were lobotomized and transferred to breeding colonies. Everyone else involved was merely spaced.

So as you can see, you did them no favors.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
People act like infants sometimes: Some locals have complained of not receiving any new entertainment holoreels for several weeks. Apparently there is a large contingent of fans in that system clamoring to experience the new Marek Garulous comedy, and the distribution company that normally supplies them has gone out of business. No one has stepped up to bring in more holoreels. The people are so frustrated that they're threatening violence unless the governor takes action. Some people and their entertainment, huh?

Anyway, I need you to procure 20 holoreels from a supplier and transport them for me; I'll upload the station's coordinates to your Opportunity interface. And don't worry, I'll pay you far more than it will cost you to buy the 'reels — I just don't have time to buy and deliver them myself.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Holoreels delivered. Hope they got there in time.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You cannot deliver 20 measly holos for me!? I have slaves with more initiative than you!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm on my way. Don't worry.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
To find a particular item for trade, open the market window and select the Search tab on the left-hand side. Type in the name of the item you are searching for. If there are any available in your region, they will appear under Sellers, in the top half of the window. You can then right-click on the seller you want for more options.

Note that you might have to fly some distance to pick up the 'reels, especially if you want to pay bottom ISK for them.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Splendid. Don't waste a second.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Procure 20 holoreels from any source and transport them to the station whose coordinates I've uploaded to your Oppertunities interface.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: They did; well done. You're a shrewd customer.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Excellent. As you know, it is the duty of every citizen to demonstrate his or her loyalty to the state from time to time. Though you are, at present, a small cog in the great machine of the Empire, you will find that even you have your place. We have a task for you that will help show your fitness to advance in our society and become a more significant part of that great machine.

It seems that the construction works at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} are experiencing an unfortunate labor shortage, possibly brought on by their overly harsh personnel management methods. It is important to the Empire that we get them a shipment of elite slaves so that they do not fall any further behind schedule. Are you a loyal enough citizen to do this task and do it quickly?

I will upload a bookmark to your People & Places databank; use it to locate and reach your destination.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The slaves have been successfully delivered, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: The Empire is disappointed in you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I am a loyal citizen. I will deliver the cargo.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The easiest way to travel to a destination station quickly is to use the Overview. Stargates are marked in the Overview settings panel under the "Celestial" group. Once you have selected "stargate" in the Overview settings, right-click on the hyperlinked destination system in your mission details and choose "set destination." You will notice that the applicable stargate in your Overview is now yellow, as well as the one in space that leads to the next system along your route.

Next, simply right-click on the yellow stargate in the Overview (or in space) and hit "warp to within 0m"; turn on your Autopilot and simply sit back and relax until you are in the destination system.

Once you have arrived in the correct star system, simply right-click anywhere in space. In the drop-down window that appears, your current mission information appears at the bottom. From there, select the "dock" option and your Autopilot will bring you into the station momentarily.

Once the slaves are delivered, return to your agent's home station (also available via the drop-down simply by right-clicking anywhere in space) to collect your reward.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Well said, citizen. Good luck.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Good day, {[character]agentID.name}. I am seeking employment.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It is important to the Empire that we get a shipment of elite slaves to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} so that the workers there do not fall any further behind schedule.

Remember to move the slaves to your cargo hold before departure.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done well, citizen.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Hey, I'm glad you asked!

Here at Nugoeihuvi Corporation, we're all about pleasure. I'm sure you've seen our adverts — "If it's fun, it must be from Nugoeihuvi." And it just so happens that we're opening some new clubs over in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The problem is that the talent has gotten stranded here, and has to be over to the station for the grand opening. What talent you ask? Well, I mean the dancers, {[character]player.name}... Exotic dancing is an art form, you know, appreciated on the highest intellectual level. And we've got a bunch of dancers just standing around waiting for a ship to take 'em to their new home.

You probably know the rest. We need a fast, reliable pilot and a ship without any major mechanical problems. That brave and resourceful pilot needs to take these dancers to their destination so that they can get bringing in the high-rollers and thus earning their wages. It's important that this be taken care of soon, so we're offering a substantial reward to anyone who wants to take the job. You up to it, kid?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The dancers are dancing in your club as we speak, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Okay, I guess I'll do it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good going. Now deliver those dancers, tiger! And try not to make too many stops along the way to… enjoy the merchandise, m'okay? Heh.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hello, {[character]agentID.name}. Any work for a poor but honest young capsuleer?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It just so happens that we're opening some new clubs over in {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. The problem is that the talent has gotten stranded here, and has to be over to the station for the grand opening. You probably know the rest. It's important that this be taken care of soon, so we're offering a substantial reward to anyone who wants to take the job.

Remember to move the dancers to your cargo hold before departure.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thanks! We're counting the money already.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Well, yes. Now, I can't say too much, but something's come up, and there's a great need for ground troops in a nearby system. You may have noticed all those marines hanging out in the loading bay. We've grabbed every available transport we can find, but there's still a few left behind who need to be transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Suffice to say, their presence is of vital importance to Federation efforts, and if you're a loyal citizen, you'll take them to their destination. And of course there's some extra pay in it for you. Will you help?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've successfully transported the marines to their destination.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You've let down our glorious Federation, pilot.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll help you any way I can.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Thanks — the Federation won't soon forget this.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hello. I hear you might have some work for a capsuleer like me?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
You may have noticed all those marines hanging out in the loading bay. We've grabbed every available transport we can find, but there's still a few left behind who need to be transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Suffice to say, their presence is of vital importance to Federation efforts; if you're a loyal citizen, you'll take them to their destination.

Remember to move the marines to your cargo hold before departure.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
These are dark days for our Republic, as you know. Our enemies threaten us on all sides, and our ancient traditions are in danger of dying out. We are a race of warriors, {[character]player.name}, and only through strength do we survive in a hostile universe. Our strength is in our warriors and in their weapons.

We believe that the cursed Amarrians are planning a major invasion, and we need to equip our warriors to repel their attacks on planetary environs. On the loading dock is a shipment of weapons for our 412th Regiment, currently garrisoned at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Can you get it there for them?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The delivery is complete, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will serve the Republic, as always.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You are a true warrior, captain.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I see a great deal of activity on the docks, {[character]agentID.name}. Is there anything I can help with?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
On the loading dock is a shipment of weapons for our 412th Regiment, currently garrisoned at {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Can you get it there for them?

Remember to move the High-Tech Small Arms to your cargo hold before departure.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: With the help of those weapons, our fighters will triumph. You have the Republic's gratitude, as well as my own, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We're going to have a little test for the delivery staff. Acquire for me a mere 15 units of Tritanium. Keep them in your cargo hold and then talk to me again. I will send the new staff to pick up the mineral.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
A number of weeks ago I ordered a case of long-limb roe from a respectable supplier who was docked at this very station. The delivery staff was atrocious. Many of the packages were damaged, and most of the roes were half rancid. I made sure everyone on that staff was fired, but I am not so quickly inclined to trust these new hires. We're going to have a little test. And I need someone of your caliber, a graduate and a capsuleer, to help.

Acquire for me just 15 units of Tritanium. You can purchase them from the market or mine ore to reprocess it yourself — how you get it is up to you. Keep the Tritanium in your cargo hold and then talk to me again. I will send someone from among the new staff to pick up the mineral.

If you need further instructions on purchasing items, I shall provide them in the mission briefing I'll upload to your Opportunities interface.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here is your Tritanium, ready to go.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: How will I know if I can trust the delivery staff with my perishables again?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Harumph.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: You got it. Be back in a jiffy.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
To purchase Tritanium from the market, open the Market button from your NeoCom on the left. When the Market window is open, click on the Search tab and search for "Tritanium." Doing so will open a list containing the buyers and sellers in the region.

To purchase 15 units of Tritanium from a particular seller, right-click an item from the listing and select "Buy this"; in the "Quantity" field on the window that pops up, change the value to "15." Be sure to note the location of the order, as you will have to pick up the Tritanium from that station. (If you're not sure what station you've bought something from, you can always find all of your possessions, in any station, using the "Assets" window in your NeoCom.) Click "Buy."

Do NOT click "Place a Buy Order" unless there is a seller at your station that can fill the order immediately or you are willing to depend upon someone filling your order before this mission times out.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Yeah, I'm not even going to bother with this.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm quitting this whole thing. It's completely laughable, with your "markets" and your "orders." Jeesh.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Oh, a jiffy! Hooray! I'm aquiver with anticipation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Uh, maybe. What sort of test?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You move even more slowly than that incompetent delivery staff. Were you delivering my long-limb roe, I'm sure it would have grown a mold of such maturity that it would be well on its way to developing a written language.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Very good. It seems my Tritanium is already on the way.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You move even more slowly than that incompetent delivery staff. Were you delivering my long-limb roe, I'm sure it would have grown a mold of such maturity that it would be well on its way to developing a written language.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Deliver the secure coded package for your agent.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, it's my sister. I mean, I remembered her birthday this time, I swear. I planned out the gift, got it ordered in advance — and it was not cheap, let me tell you. I found a specialty perfume maker, and it turns out my sister likes the smells of really damn expensive things. And of course the fancy-pants perfumer has a ridiculous waiting list. But I got everything done in time!

I just need you to deliver it. I'll pay you, okay?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've got your… well, whatever's in this box.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, now she's never gonna talk to me again. Although maybe that's for the best…

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: She's never gonna talk to me again.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Well, since you asked so nicely… yeah, sure. I'll help.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Trade is a booming industry. Humanity is spread out over such a vast area of space that everything is rare somewhere, and there's always someone willing to make that journey for a profit, however small.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't want to contribute to spoiling your sister. Take a stance, will you?!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've been thinking about it, and your sister sounds kinda mean. I don't wanna get her present. Let her fume.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'll let them know you're coming. The perfume should be in a secure coded package in your hangar — with what I paid for it, I'm not taking any chances. I may be forgetful, but I'm not stupid.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Maybe. What did you have in mind?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text:
She realized I didn't have her present yet, and she wouldn't believe me when I told her it was on the way! She said she should've known I'd forget again, and she's never gonna speak to me again!
This is gonna be a shitty week. Thanks a bunch, jerk.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Oh, thank you! Things were already getting tense. If she thought I'd forgotten again, I think she might've stopped speaking to me!

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text:
She realized I didn't have her present yet, and she wouldn't believe me when I told her it was on the way! She said she should've known I'd forget again, and she's never gonna speak to me again!
This is gonna be a shitty week. Thanks a bunch, jerk.

localizedName.text: Save the Trees - Seeding a Future (1 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Some of our scientists have discovered a strange species of tree previously unknown to us. We need to transport the seeds for further study. But the tree has the most peculiar means of procreation: The seeds must be germinated inside a living animal host. Our scientists on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} have prepared some suitable livestock to serve as host for the germination. Take the seeds to this station so the tests can begin.

Remember to move the seeds to your cargo hold before you undock.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Some of our scientists have discovered a strange species of tree previously unknown to us. We need to transport the seeds for further study. The nearby planet has vast, ancient forests, and this new species lies deep within one of its densest rain forests; no human has ever seen its like before. We have obtained a sample of one of its seeds and we will attempt to grow it in the laboratory.

The tree has the most peculiar means of procreation. The seeds must be germinated inside a living animal host. Our scientists on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} have prepared some suitable livestock to serve as host for the germination. Take the seeds to this station so the tests can begin.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Plant seeds delivered. They were certainly strange-looking things.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm on my way.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You have done well. Contact me again and I'll tell you how the research is progressing.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Splendid! But be careful: They're quite fragile.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I think so. Courier runs are always such easy money.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You disappoint me. I thought you could handle a simple courier mission, but apparently I was wrong. I suppose I'll have to limit your work to garbage runs. I've found someone else to take care of this.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You disappoint me. I thought you could handle a simple courier mission, but apparently I was wrong. I suppose I'll have to limit your work to garbage runs. I've found someone else to take care of this.

localizedName.text: Save the Trees – Forest's Revenge (2 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Unbeknownst to us, a botanist here named Horei Falcosis took one of the seeds for examination before you shipped the package; a short time ago, as he worked with it, it shot out a tendril and sank it into his flesh. It was several minutes before he was discovered, and by that time, the seed's tendrils had penetrated his body in several locations. Falcosis was unconscious by this time, and the seed had pulled itself close to his body and started to secrete a protective resin.

Sadly, this station does not have the proper facilities to care for him. And since this tree has now been designated noxious and dangerous--the other seeds were all incinerated safely, I understand--Falcosis has been placed in cryogenic stasis for transport.

Deliver him to the station I've included in the mission details, would you?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Interesting, yes. Also disgusting.

One of the seeds had thoughts of its own on whom or what might be its host. Unbeknownst to us, a botanist here named Horei Falcosis took one of the seeds for examination before you shipped the package; a short time ago, as he worked with it, it shot out a tendril and sank it into his flesh. It was several minutes before he was discovered, and by that time, the seed's tendrils had penetrated his body in several locations. Falcosis was unconscious by this time, and the seed had pulled itself close to his body and started to secrete a protective resin.

Brings new meaning to giving one's body to science, don't you think?

In any case, this station does not have the proper facilities to care for him. And since this tree has now been designated noxious and dangerous — the other seeds were all incinerated safely, I understand — Falcosis has been placed in cryogenic stasis for transport. Deliver his cryo-tank for me, would you?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've delivered the cryogenic stasis capsule, as you requested. How's the patient? Any word?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You cannot make a simple courier run on something this important? A man's life is at stake!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm on my way.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You have done well. No word, no. Time will tell if Falcosis survives this ordeal. Come and see me again when you have time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm sure Horei Falcosis would thank you to hurry, were he able.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Uh, not sure, but I'm guessing it might be interesting…

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You disappoint me, and Horei Falcosis has since died thanks to your lack of initiative. I suppose I'll have to limit your work to garbage runs from now on.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You disappoint me, and Horei Falcosis has since died thanks to your lack of initiative. I suppose I'll have to limit your work to garbage runs from now on.

localizedName.text: Save the Trees – Save the People (3 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
As soon as Horei Falcosis was taken out of cryo-stasis, the tree started using his body for food. Fortunately for him, he didn't survive long. But the tree exploded with immediate growth. And it is semi-mobile! It can move slowly on its roots as if they were tentacles! And it's predatory! Its vines killed several lab technicians. We need to stop it before it takes over the whole station.

Since we don't yet know much about its biology, we need more information. I'll upload a destination to your Bookmarks: Go there and pick up the copy of Dem's Galactical Botanical I've ordered, and bring it back to me here. Perhaps in that book there will be some clues about how to contain or destroy this thing.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Dozens have been killed so far. That tree is vicious! It almost took over the entire station. And it's still growing!

As soon as Horei Falcosis was taken out of cryo-stasis, the tree started using his body for food. Fortunately for him, he didn't survive long. But the tree exploded with immediate growth. It reached a height of 4 meters in less than hour. And it is semi-mobile! It can move slowly on its roots as if they were tentacles! And it's predatory! Its vines killed several lab technicians. Apparently human body fluids kick the tree's metabolism into high gear. Its growth became rampant, and it's now trying to propagate itself some enormous, striated greenish-red fruit. We need to stop it before it takes over the whole station.

Since we don't yet know much about its biology, we need more information. I've uploaded the destination station in the mission details in your Opportunity interface: Go there and pick up the copy of Dem's Galactical Botanical I've ordered, and bring it back to me here. Perhaps in that book there will be some clues about how to contain or destroy this thing.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've delivered the book. Crisis averted, I hope.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm on my way, don't worry!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: There's no time to waste.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You bet. What can I do?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: We couldn't wait for you any longer. We sent someone else after the book. Because of your delay, it will now be months before we can reclaim that part of the station, if not the whole thing. Who knows?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have proven your resourcefulness. Enjoy your reward.

No doubt you've see that little furrier that's been bouncing around the station for the last few days, {[character]player.name}? You haven't? Well, I certainly have. Nasty little creature. It bites, you know.

In any event, it was part of a shipment of exotic pets intended for delivery to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, but it got left behind because I spilled a drink all over the cargo manifest. We need someone to take this furrier, special delivery, over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} and get it the hell out of our hair. We need a special pilot, a pilot with skill and daring, a pilot who doesn't know the meaning of the word "fear"… and who isn't allergic to furriers. You interested?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The furrier's delivered. Man those things stink.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Okay, I'll take the damned furrier.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The easiest way to travel to a destination station quickly is to use the Overview. Stargates are marked in the Overview settings panel under the "Celestial" group. Once you have selected "stargate" in the Overview settings, right-click on the hyperlinked destination system in the mission details in your Opportunities and choose "set destination." You will notice that the applicable stargate in your Overview is now yellow, as well as the one in space that leads to the next system along your route.

Next, simply right-click on the yellow stargate in the Overview (or in space) and hit "warp to within 0m"; turn on your Autopilot and simply sit back and relax until you are in the destination system.

Once you have arrived in the correct star system, simply right-click anywhere in space. In the drop-down window that appears, your current mission information appears at the bottom. From there, select the "dock" option and your Autopilot will bring you into the station momentarily.

Once the courier item is delivered, return to your agent's home station (also available via the drop-down simply by right-clicking anywhere in space) to collect your reward.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: So the little monster didn't ruin your upholstery? Good job, my friend. You may have a future in the animal transport business! Check back to me in a while.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You'll do it? Hey guys — he says he'll do it!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hi. I'm looking for some gainful employment.

Remember to move the "special delivery" container into your cargo hold before you go.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ha. Good one…

Listen, about that furrier? Things have gotten a little complicated, {[character]player.name}. That thing was carrying some kind of disease, and it's running rampant since the thing bit a few folks here. We haven't got the right vaccine here, and god the place is in bad shape — people turning green and swelling up like balloons everywhere. Since you were the one who brought the damned furrier that started it all, I think it's only fitting that you get the vaccine and bring it back here for us.

Oh, yeah — we'll vaccinate you before you leave, too. What do you say, champ?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Vaccine delivered, boss.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll deliver the vaccine, but only if you stop calling me a furrier-hauler.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great job, {[character]player.name}. Come back later and I'll see if I can scrounge up another job for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew you'd want to help. Please make it snappy.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Who are you calling a furrier-hauler, drink-spiller?

messages.mission.briefing.text: That furrier you delivered was carrying some kind of disease, and it's running rampant since the thing bit a few folks here. We haven't got the right vaccine here. Since you were the one who brought the damned furrier that started it all, I think it's only fitting that you get the vaccine and bring it back here for us.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ha! Smartass! No, nothing like that {[character]player.name}. Er, well, sort of…

It seems that the folks at one of our other offices can't find the proper paperwork about this last pet shipment, and they need this manifest. Or at least what's left of it after I spilled my drink on it. They're begging us to send it over. So, can you run this manifest over there so we can put this entire sordid affair behind us?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Done, {[character]agentID.name}. Hope that helped.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Okay, but just this one more time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Here's the manifest. Now get going.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You are? Why? Spill another drink and you need me to get some wipes for you?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It seems that the folks at one of our other offices can't find the proper paperwork about this last pet shipment, and they need this manifest. Or at least what's left of it after I spilled my drink on it. They're begging us to send it over. So, can you run this manifest over there so we can put this entire sordid affair behind us?

Remember to put the manifest in your cargo hold or you'll have to come back and relive the whole, sad incident all over again.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thank goodness. That's the last furrier we'll be transporting out of thisstation, let me tell you.

localizedName.text: Hunting a Heretic  - Tracking a Crackpot (1 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
One of the functions of my job is to ensure things operate smoothly in this region. I have a number of informants that keep me in the loop of the less visible happenings. They tend to be skittish by nature, but recently one of my informants was noticeably shaken. He won't send the information, and he won't meet me in person. He's insisted that I send a third party to pick up the data.

Normally I'd just find another informant, but this one was on the trail of a particularly virulent heretic. The man can't be anything but mad--he calls himself The Crackpot, for one thing--but it's damned hard to track a madman. He's been attracting attention, even followers from among the weak-minded, and it's long past time to put a stop to his nonsense.

If you'll go and pick up that data, it could help us track this menace down.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not interested.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Go quickly. I can't afford to lose this lead.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Of course I am.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well done. Once I get this decrypted, I may have more work for you.

localizedName.text: Hunting a Heretic - Book Burning (2 of 3)

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I'll find someone who understands that, and can help us dispose of this garbage in a more timely fashion.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
That Crackpot has been hiding his heretical nonsense in copies of the Pax Amarria! This is absolutely intolerable! Needless to say, we've been seizing copies as they're found, and of course those in possession of such an insulting piece of work have been detained for questioning. Still, that leaves us with a pile of gilded filth on our hands.

I want you to go pick up the copies that are being held and bring them back here. We're having the Pax Amarria covers stripped off before we send them along for the ceremonial burning.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the heretical nonsense you requested.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I thought you were better than that.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I thought you were better than that.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll go and get the books immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: From the publisher's description: "This is the most remarkable book published in the last century. Here, the great Emperor Heideran VII records his dreams for peace throughout the galaxy; it is this vision that propelled him into becoming a champion of interstellar relations. His relentless struggle toward this goal has brought unparalleled harmony among the empires; his constant search for peaceful solutions to any problem having many times quelled the storms of hostilities on the horizon. His determination and his powers of persuasion have compelled his own people and others to sacrifice many things they thought sacred to ensure that tranquility will prevail, now and forever."

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not helping with any book-burning.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
We'll get these stripped down and shipped out as quickly as possible. They'll be burned at a more appropriate location.

By the way, some of our detainees have proved… most informative. I should have more work for you soon.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Remember, we can't get rid of this trash fast enough.

localizedName.text: Hunting a Heretic - Crackpot Captured! (3 of 3)

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've finally got The Crackpot. I need you to go pick him up and bring him here. We've made sure to keep him anonymous. Go and get him before some other loon tries to break him out.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've finally got The Crackpot. It turns out his real name was Russell. I need you to go pick him up and bring him here for transport. We want him there when his books burn—he'll need to recant publicly, throw the books on the fire, that sort of thing. After all, we wouldn't want him martyred.

He's in confinement a few jumps away. We've made sure to keep him anonymous. There are still some crazed sympathizers on the loose, and we don't want them endangering themselves any further. Go and get him before some other loon tries to break him out.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the Crackpot.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, I'm sure I can find someone who will properly appreciate the honor of this assignment.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I thought you'd be pleased at the chance to finally bring this menace in.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm honored to be of service the Empire.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't like the sound of this. I think I'll pass.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I thought you would be. Remember, this must be done quickly, before word gets out.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You do?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Someone broke that madman out. Now we'll have to start the hunt all over again.

localizedName.text: For the Troops - Food for Fun (1 of 3)

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You have taken too long.  Our chefs have quit in disgust.  This will delay SPLET for weeks.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Even with the best of equipment and space superiority, any long-term military engagement has to rely on ground and station personnel. And personnel are only as reliable as their morale. I won't lie to you, the morale of our soldiers could be better.

To fix this, a number of the mega-corporations have joined together to produce SPLET—the State Personnel Life Enrichment Tour. This program will tour to various parts of the State, providing entertainment and other morale services for our soldiers.

The first thing we need is food, and there are crates of frozen food waiting not too far from here. Bring the food here so our chefs can start to figure out how to stretch it into an appropriately festive-- but still economical-- dish.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Food has arrived.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: The State should support its soldiers not out of concern for the soldier, but for the services he renders.  Remember this in your future travels.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: The State should support its soldiers not out of concern for the soldier, but for the services he renders.  Remember this in your future travels.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Food?  You got it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The problem is information networks. Our soldiers are well cared for and would normally be content, but they find that pictures and holoreels all tend to be from Gallente producers. They see the decadence and excess of our enemies. Our men are revolted by the excess of the Gallente, yes, but there is jealousy among them as well. And this jealousy is eating away at the core of our efforts.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: To hell with food delivery.  The soldiers should be happy simply serving the State.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Not very appetizing, is it?  I have faith our chefs will be able to make ...something... out of it.  But come, there is still more to do.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: And do hurry.  Our chefs are grumpy and impatient.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: How can I aid the mighty State?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yes, I think you are. Listen, our miners have just reported a bunch of rogue drones in the system. Between them and the damned ore thieves, I'm almost ready to give up. They're worse than Gallentean greenroaches – if we don't show them that they're not welcome here, we'll be up to our eyeballs. And I can't send my guys out there if I know they might be in danger. No, we need a capsuleer on this job, someone capable of defending a ship and mining at the same time.

I've bookmarked a mining site for you. Go on out there and, if you see any drones, take 'em out. Be caref— well, I don't need to tell an experienced starship captain like you. You know the risks. Then mine whatever Banidine you find out there so I can find out what the damn things are so interested in.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's the ore you asked for. Seems like a waste of time, but hey — anything the drones want, it's a safe bet we shouldn't let them have it, right?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sure, no problem. I'm on it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Most people don't go looking for Banidine: It's virtually worthless, so you won't find it on the market.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good luck, my friend!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Yep. As usual, I'm the right one for the job, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Agreed, {[character]player.name}... can't be a good thing. Thanks for the assist!

localizedName.text: For the Troops - Error of Comedy (2 of 3)

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Our prop comedian is dead.  He was reportedly beaten and stabbed to death by citizens who were simply "annoyed into a murderous rage."  Had you acted faster, we might have acquired his services before he was brutally killed at the hands of a vengeful mob.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
No, the State cannot afford the lofty prices of professional entertainers of such caliber. We have booked far worse, I'm afraid.

There is a man awaiting pick-up at a nearby station-- I'll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom. The man is a comedian of a specialized sort. You‘ll know him when you see him. Bring him back here for me.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Though it may constitute some form of war-crime, here is your prop comedian.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Inane or not, this job posed no threat to your safety.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Indeed he could, but the State wants him here now, and if you will not get him, I will have someone else do it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: This is getting slightly weird, but okay.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: According to recent studies, the typical foot soldier's sense of humor tends towards the ironic, with a particular fondness for satire and gallows humor. Yet to hear Command tell it, these types of humor are the most dangerous to morale.  As a result, most government-sponsored entertainment is consciously light-hearted, even if nobody really enjoys it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I will not bother with this.  The comedian can take a transport like everyone else.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I share your misgivings, but if this is the worst thing we do to our men, then we will be well on our way to perfection.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Trust me, this isn't any less weird on my side.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What are we talking about?  Musical acts?  Stunts?

messages.mission.briefing.text: There is a man awaiting pick-up at a nearby station-- I'll upload the coordinates to your Neocom. The man is a comedian of a specialized sort.  You‘ll know him when you see him.  Bring him back here for me.

Had you acted faster, we might have acquired his services before he was brutally killed at the hands of a vengeful mob.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I have delivered many inane objects in my time, but I will never deliver a comedian.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A recent survey scan of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} reveals a big deposit of Banidine ore. We were content to leave it alone at first, but then we saw swarms of drones in the area. They seem to be making their way through the asteroid fields there in a hurry. They haven't stumbled on the Banidine yet, but it's only a matter of time.

We want you to get to the ore before they do. I won't lie to you; it's going to be close. You may even have to fight a few of them off, so be careful.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
A recent survey scan of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} reveals a big deposit of Banidine ore. We were content to leave it alone at first, but then we saw swarms of drones in the area. They seem to be making their way through the asteroid fields there in a hurry. They haven't stumbled on the Banidine yet, but it's only a matter of time.

We want you to get to the ore before they do. I won't lie to you; it's going to be close. You may even have to fight a few of them off, so be careful.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Got your Banidine here. No drones were going to stop me.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What? A few drones too much for you to handle?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If we don't get that Banidine, those drones will. I hope someone else can do it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: A race against the drones, huh? Sure, I'll do it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
It's not a well-kept secret that as rogue drones get more advanced, they're becoming more unpredictable. Talk to any seasoned pod pilot and they'll tell you about the dozens of rogue drones they've had to fight off just in the course of their regular business. Even more disturbing are reports of drone hives, massive constructs of debris that no one can quite figure out, but which are always full of haywire drones.

So what's their interest in Banidine? Who knows?! Most humans don't go looking for the stuff: It's virtually worthless, so you won't find it on the market. In fact, most sensor manufacturers don't even bother giving it its own entry in their mining packages when they produce ship scanners. (If you're having trouble finding the Banidine at the mission location, you can right-click the "Banidine" icon in the mission details in your Opportunity interface entry and select "Add to Overview.")

So, again, why the interest from the drones? Well, none but the drones can say, and they're not talking. Suffice to say that their interest can't mean anything good for the humans that share their space.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No. I'm not scared, I'm just sick of mining and popping drones.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I decided I'm not really into this job.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Get this done, {[character]player.name}. We don't really need that Banidine, but better we get it than those drones.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's this about drones?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: {[character]player.name}, because of your inaction, the drone swarm found the Banidine. This rare mineral is now even rarer because you let those automatons get to it first, and that can't be good for any of us.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work. Those drones are making life difficult for everyone hereabouts.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I'm giving the job to someone else. The universe isn't going to stop and wait for you to make up your mind.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} wants a massive shipment of Augumene right away, so we need you to get out there and bring some back. They seem to think they might be able to find some use for the stuff for chemical warfare, I guess? But that's just between you and me, right?

Anyway, I've been looking for a miner who's experienced enough, with the right kind of ship, and maybe you fit the bill. Time is critical on this one. There's a big bonus for you if you can bring it in fast enough.

Seriously, we need a mountain of this stuff, so get on it. I've uploaded the location to your People & Places databank.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have your mountain of Augumene right here.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Maybe next time, huh? In any case, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will manage. It's your loss.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope I can find someone else to handle this.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sure. I'll see what I can do.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Augumene is an extremely toxic ore; fortunately, it is also extremely rare. It can be mined safely from a starship, but proves very deadly when handled directly unless one takes extremely expensive safety precautions that more than negate any profit to be made from refining the stuff. For this reason, even black market operators generally won't deal in it, and it is never found for sale on the open market.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't waste any time. Our people are waiting.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm ready. What's up?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} wants a massive shipment of Augumene right away, so we need you to get out there and bring some back. I've been looking for a miner who's experienced enough, with the right kind of ship, and maybe you fit the bill. Time is critical on this one. There's a big bonus for you if you can bring it in fast enough.

Pirates and claimjumpers abound in these parts, so you should also be prepared to defend your ship from such scavengers.

Finally, this amount of raw Augumene ore may require multiple trips unless you have a Hulk or a similarly large hauler for the job.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work. I'll keep you in mind when something else comes up.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Chemical warfare may not be as flashy as space lasers or doomsday weapons, but it just might decide the outcome of this war we're in. After all, what's the value of taking over territory if all your planets are uninhabitable? Of course, our foes have found counters to most of the known chemical agents. So the key to victory will be new compounds.

That's why I want you to acquire a big bunch of Augumene for us. The stuff is insanely toxic, hence its absence on the market. But in this case, its very toxicity is what we want to harness.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here is the Augumene.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Morals don't win wars.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: "Conscientious objectors" like you are going to destroy this government.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: If it will help us defeat those bastards, I'll do it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Augumene is an extremely toxic ore; fortunately, it is also extremely rare. It can be mined safely from a starship, but proves very deadly when handled directly unless one takes extremely expensive safety precautions — which more than negates any profit to be made from reprocessing the stuff. For this reason, even black market operators generally won't deal in it, and it is never found for sale on the open market.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't want to be a part of this. It's just not right.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm starting to think this is a bad idea. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Make me proud.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Sure. Uh, how do I do that?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Acquire the 20,000 units of Augumene at the location I've given you. Now, there may be other folks looking to get this stuff too, so don't go out there unprepared to defend yourself, okay?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good. You've helped make the universe a safer place.

localizedName.text: For the Troops - Final Negotiations (3 of 3)
