Head on over there to the coordinates I've provided and take them out. Pick up whoever makes it into the escape pod from the shuttle and bring them back to {[location]agentStationID.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It turns out the Caldari were researching some kind of advanced planetary shields, basing much of their work on what little ancient Yan Jung technology they'd been able to acquire. We got the specs of the "macroshield" they were working on. It's powered by a huge generator located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Yeah, that close!

Now, the generator itself is protected by a smaller, but still very powerful shield system controlled by three smaller power links somewhere else in the same deadspace location. In order to take out the macroshield generator, you first need to destroy the three shield power links. Then you should be able to warp back to the first room and take out the main generator.

Got all that? It's a bit complex, but that's the only way it'll work. Oh, and of course, I expect the whole place will be fairly heavily guarded. So be wary.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Caldari shield system is offline… for good. Let's just hope they don't come up with a better version and slip it under our noses somehow, eh?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I can't believe you're quitting now, with victory so close. Ach, well, I guess I'll have to find someone else to go out there.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You have a pod, for Zane's sake! You can't die! What's your worry?!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sounds like my idea of a good time. Count me in.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This sounds like it's crazy dangerous. No, sorry, but I'm out.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This mission is just way too hard. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. But this may well be one of the hardest missions you've ever attempted, so don't be too hasty.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Really? Tell me all about it!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It turns out the Caldari were researching some kind of advanced planetary shields, basing much of their work on what little ancient Yan Jung technology they'd been able to acquire. We got the specs of the "macroshield" they were working on. It's powered by a huge generator located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Yeah, that close!

The generator itself is protected by a smaller, but still very powerful shield system controlled by three power links somewhere else in the same deadspace location. In order to take out the macroshield generator, you first need to destroy the three shield power links. Then you should be able to warp back to the first room and take out the main generator.

Oh, and of course, I expect the whole place will be fairly heavily guarded. So be wary.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes indeed. But at least for now we've managed to deal with them. And as long as we have competent capsuleers like yourself around, I believe our chances are good.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I can't give you her name-- though you probably know it. She's the heir to an obscene amount of money, and she has enough demands that I can certainly use all the extra help I can get.

Her new pet-- a miniature slaver-- has just arrived at a nearby station. Of course, she wants it here, and here now. The sooner you can get it back here, the sooner we can both get on with our lives.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I can't give you her name-- though you probably know it. She's the heir to an obscene amount of money, and she has enough demands that I can certainly use all the extra help I can get.

Her new pet-- a miniature slaver-- has just arrived at a nearby station. Of course, she wants it here, and here now. The sooner you can get it back here, the sooner we can both get on with our lives.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's your tiny dog.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I can't say that I blame you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I can't say that I blame you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Yeah, okay.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No thanks. I hate rats.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Let the princess know she'll have to wait on her new toy. I'm not running your errands anymore.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Please hurry back.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Okay...

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: She threw another tantrum. Not that it really matters.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Oh, thank you. I'm just receiving a new message-- I should have another job for you when you come back.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: She threw another tantrum. Not that it really matters.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
While you were gone, she managed to crash a vehicle she wasn't supposed to have been driving on some backwater planet in a nearby system. And then security found boosters on her. She's being held at the nearest space station.

I need you to post her bail, preferably before the media gets wind of this. Drop off the currency in your hangar at the station. She won't ride in your ship, so just check in with me when you're done. I'm sure I'll have something else for you by then.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I dropped off the cash.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I can't say that I blame you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I can't say that I blame you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll do it to help you out.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I think I'll pass. The detention might do her some good.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Nah. Let her rot.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Uh… why?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
While you were gone, she managed to crash a vehicle she wasn't supposed to have been driving on some backwater planet in a nearby system. And then security found boosters on her. She's being held at the nearest space station.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thanks. I'm trying to talk her out of her latest demand. Check in again in a sec; I'm sure it won't work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I need you to go mine some polygypsum, as the Heiress has decided she wants a complete bedroom set made out of it. Yes, I know it sometimes spontaneously combusts. She still wants it. Obviously, reason has nothing to do with it.

So, bring me 20 units of polygypsum, and we'll see what she wants next.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've got your hideously unstable rocks here.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I can't say I blame you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I can't say I blame you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: This is getting ridiculous, but I'll help you out again.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Some ores have no value on the open market, usually as a result of their unstable properties, but they can still be useful in completing missions.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, this is nuts. You'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is nuts. I'm out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Your willingness to help is astounding.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm not?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I need you to go mine some polygypsum, as the Heiress has decided she wants a complete bedroom set made out of it. Yes, I know it sometimes spontaneously combusts. She still wants it. Obviously, reason has nothing to do with it.

So, bring me 20 units of polygypsum, and we'll see what she wants next.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Oh, good. Maybe she'll blow herself up.

Ahem. I mean, I'll let her know the polygypsum is available. Check back in soon.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The bad news is that the Heiress's inheritance is nearly hers: her grandfather has just died. The good news… well, I can't tell you that until after you've delivered her to the funeral. We're not sure if she'd actually get there if we let her go alone.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Right, one heiress delivered.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Tsk, tsk. Just when things were starting to look brighter.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: It's a shame. Things were starting to look up.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I have to say, I'm curious. I'll do it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I've had enough of these games. I'll pass.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't care what she runs herself into; I'm done with this mess.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Hurry back, there's wonderful news waiting in the will.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: How's that again?

messages.mission.briefing.text: The bad news is that the Heiress's inheritance is nearly hers: her grandfather has just died. The good news... well, I can't tell you that until after you've delivered her to the funeral. We're not sure if she'd actually get there if we let her go alone.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thanks for getting her there intact. I have to speak with her grandfather's executor, but it shouldn't take long, and then I can let you in on the secret.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It turns out that the former Heiress's grandfather felt that she wasn't doing his family name any favors. The will he left behind disinherits her, but there's more.

In order to stop her unceasing exploitation of her unearned fame and fortune, he wants her dead.

That's right. The request that she be killed outright is in the old man's will. I'm relieved to discover that he died with his wits intact, after all.

She's off celebrating, of course-- went straight from the funeral. I'll give you the approximate coordinates; you shouldn't have any trouble finding her private transport. It may take you awhile to destroy it, though, so be patient. If we're lucky, she may have some explosive substances on board that could trigger a chain reaction and speed things up considerably.

So, do you think you can kill the Heiress?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I hope you heard about the explosion?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Weird. I thought you'd be thrilled.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Huh. I thought you'd be pleased about this one.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Are you kidding? Wait, don't answer that. I accept!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I can't say I like her, but I don't want to get involved in this. It seems kinda risky.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Now it's just creepy. I'm out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I thought you'd like it. Go get ‘er!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Okay, what's the big secret?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
In order to stop her unceasing exploitation of her unearned fame and fortune, the Heiress's grandfather requested that she be killed outright in his will. I'm relieved to discover that he died with his wits intact, after all.

She's off celebrating, of course-- went straight from the funeral. I'll give you the approximate coordinates; you shouldn't have any trouble finding her private transport. It may take you awhile to destroy it, though, so be patient. If we're lucky, she may have some explosive substances on board that could trigger a chain reaction and speed things up considerably.

So, do you think you can kill the Heiress?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thanks for all your help. I'm just glad this whole thing is over with.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The thing is, I don't know. Look... I lost a bet with this guy I know, and I was dumb enough to agree to do five forfeits-- “to be named later”-- when I thought I was going to win. Now I've got no idea what he's holding over me.

On top of that, part of the deal is that I've got to stay put, so I have to find someone who'll follow these freaking bizarre directions.

If you're willing to help me out, the station info is in the mission details I've uploaded to your Opportunities interface; all you have to do is go pick up the item that doesn't belong there and bring it back to me.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Yeah... it's a doll. Here.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I guess... it's not gonna blow up or anything, right?

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, but I'm not signing up to carry something unless I know what it is.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I think you should really do your own dirty work.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Oh, don't worry, the one thing I do know is that it's legal.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh? What's that?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The thing is, I don't know. Look... I lost a bet with this guy I know, and I was dumb enough to agree to do five forfeits-- “to be named later”-- when I thought I was going to win. Now I've got no idea what he's holding over me.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Oh, I should have known he'd pull something like this. That bastard knows--

Never mind. There're directions on the damn doll. Give me a minute to figure them out, and then I'll need your help again.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Well, you're not going to like it. He's set a location-- I'll upload it for you-- and you're supposed to fly out there and wait around for a drop. I don't know how long he's gonna make you wait, so be patient. <font="#FF0000"> And don't fire on anybody!</font>

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: It's another doll. I think there's something you're not telling me.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: You're right; I don't like it. But I'll do it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I think I'll pass. It sounds kinda suspicious.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm out. Find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Remember not to fire on anybody! I don't know what'll happen if I screw up any of these.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Yeah, what is it?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Well, you're not going to like it. He's set a location-- I'll upload it for you-- and you're supposed to fly out there and wait around for a drop. I don't know how long he's gonna make you wait, so be patient. <font="#FF0000"> And don't fire on anybody!</font>

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
It's about something that happened when I was a kid, all right? I don't want to talk about it.

There's another set of directions. I'll see you in a few.

localizedName.text: What's in a Name  - Change of Address (1 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
So get this: There's some big high society party going on. All the best and brightest are there. So this one Gallente dignitary is completely hammered and starts mouthing off to everyone. He even goes right up to an admiral and calls our side, "a bunch of humorless egg-jockeys." Right to his face!

So now it's this whole thing. The higher-ups are protesting by pulling out of the embassy. I think it's a stronger statement than they really should be making, but they're going ahead with it. They need you to provide security while they pull out. Rumor has it some jingoist factions of the Gallente will try to make a move on the ambassadors to spark more conflict. Patrol the area outside the embassy until the dignitaries have completed their withdraw.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: It's a good thing I was there. A Gallente and his drones began attacking during the withdraw. I don't know if he was Gallente Navy, though.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You better hope this doesn't get as big as it could.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You better hope this doesn't get as big as it could.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: No harm will come to the diplomats.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The empires are itching for a war. All they need is a good excuse. It's coming. It's more a question of when than if.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Screw the diplomats. Let them hash this out themselves.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Screw the diplomats. Let them hash this out themselves.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good to know.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What've they done now?

messages.mission.briefing.text: So get this: This one Gallente dignitary is completely hammered and calls our side, "a bunch of humorless egg-jockeys." The higher ups are protesting by pulling out of the embassy. They need you to provide security while they pull out. Rumor has it some jingoist factions of the Gallente will try to make a move on the ambassadors to spark more conflict. Patrol the area outside the embassy until the dignitaries have completed their withdraw.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: That is troubling. I'm glad you were there to handle it.

localizedName.text: What's in a Name  - Smile When You Call Me That (2 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The nature of the business, friend.

The Gallente media is painting both the Caldari and Amarr as overly sensitive ninnies because of the pullout. So there's going to be a little accident with one of the Gallente communication arrays.

Go make sure that accident happens.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The tower is down.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Liar.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: So you want them to think us weak? They're only more likely to attack.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: They should really put defenseless media towers somewhere safer.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Some structures are notoriously difficult to destroy with small weapons fire. If you're in a bit of a hurry, keep an eye out for more vulnerable targets attached to the structure. A good shot at a fuel or weapons depot might be what you need to bring a speedy end to the assault.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No. This is pushing things too far.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I decided I have better things to do than pop broadcast towers.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I know, right?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I like that I can almost hear the quotes in that sentence.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Gallente media is painting both the Caldari and Amarr as overly sensitive ninnies because of the pullout. So there's going to be a little accident with one of the Gallente communication arrays.

Go make sure that accident happens.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Hah! Let's see how whiney they get when their precious "free press" can't broadcast their filth.

localizedName.text: What's in a Name  - Poke (3 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
New plan. It's a bit riskier, but it should get the message across.

There's a Gallente battleship "practicing maneuvers" in the region. You're going to practice maneuvers too--right across their bow. Pass by their ship as close as you can. It will scare the hell out of them.

But please, whatever you do, do not fire on the battleship. It will win that fight.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That was excessively fun. I bet they're shaking.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You would have been fine if you just didn't fire first.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Chickening out? Come on, don't let the Gallente be right.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Time to give the Gallente a little scare.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Seriously, don't fire at the battleship.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Battleship? I'm thinking, "No."

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: It was a battleship. I thought better of it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Make the captain crap himself.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Stupid Gallente.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
There's a Gallente battleship "practicing maneuvers" in the region. You're going to practice maneuvers too--right across their bow. Pass by their ship as close as you can. It will scare the hell out of them.

But please, whatever you do, do not fire on the battleship. It will win that fight.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You should hear the reports. The Gallente are now paranoid that we're going to roll right over them! Of course our line is just that you were taking photographs for your family or something, but they're scared senseless.

localizedName.text: What's in a Name  - Thorny (4 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Starting to get mixed reports of Gallente buildup. Ships are moving out of stations. Reserves are being called up. We don't know what's going on, but it needs to be investigated. I'm giving you the most likely location for a convergence, if there is one. Report back when you know what is going on.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: There were ships. Lots of ships.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What? But--What?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: What? But--What?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll return shortly.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Not every mission you get requires you to kill every enemy in sight. It's often easier to warp out once your objective is done, enemy ships be damned.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not involving myself in this anymore.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm not involving myself in this anymore.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Be quick.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What is it?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Starting to get mixed reports of Gallente buildup. Ships are moving out of stations. Reserves are being called up. We don't know what's going on, but it needs to be investigated. I'm giving you the most likely location for a convergence, if there is one. Report back when you know what is going on.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I was afraid of that. Similar reports are popping up all over.

localizedName.text: What's in a Name  - Smelling Sweet (5 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
There's a difference between being taken seriously and letting the inmates run the asylum. Diplomacy must resume, even if to only keep things just below war being declared.

It's a strange game, friend. I don't think even the diplomats fully understand it. Still, this is one of those times diplomats are useful again.

Take our envoy over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. From there he will meet with the Gallente envoy to begin non-public negotiations. If all goes well, the situation will simply vanish from the public's consciousness and life will continue as normal.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The envoy's been delivered. I hope everything goes well.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I don't know that my mind is even capable of forming a response to that.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I think a few hurt feelings and wounded egos are worth it if it avoids war.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll make sure he gets there safely.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Lots of stuff.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Envoy? Like hell. They want peace, they'll apologize.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: You know, I decided I like war. Screw peace.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: For everyone's sake, he better.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I thought this is what you wanted? The Gallente are taking us seriously.

messages.mission.briefing.text: This situation snowballed. Diplomacy must resume, even if to only keep things just below war being declared. Take our envoy over to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. From there he will meet with the Gallente envoy to begin non-public negotiations. If all goes well, the situation will simply vanish from the public's consciousness and life will continue as normal.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: We'll know if everything is going well by if there is a tomorrow.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Perfect. You've just been invited to the Gallente-Minmatar Joint Air Show. I'm sure you're very excited.

As a representative of state-sponsored capsuleer programs, you'll be expected to perform a variety of piloting tricks. All very basic for you, I'm sure.

Oh, what am I thinking? You need your entrance badge! Pick up your badge, then I'll be able to provide you with your show shuttle.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's my entrance badge.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Fine, move on. Next!

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Fine, move on. Next!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Pick up the entrance badge, bring it back here. Got it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Even when on the brink of war, sometimes the people need a reminder just what all of their taxes are paying for. Air shows have long been a reliable PR program that gets the people excited about military tech in a slightly friendlier venue than a state-funded parade. There are accidents every so often, and the introduction of the vacuum of space has certainly not made them any safer, but damn if they are not still popular.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Whoa, hang on there. I have no interest in being in your air show.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: On second thought, I have no interest in being in your air show.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Meanwhile I'll make sure your name is added to the program.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Good? I'm gr--

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Perfect. You've just been invited to the Gallente-Minmatar Joint Air Show. I'm sure you're very excited.

Oh, what am I thinking? You need your entrance badge! Pick up your badge, then I'll be able to provide you with your show shuttle.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I'll take that. Here's your shuttle.

localizedName.text: Air Show!  - Kick the Fires...? (2 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Your first event is just to fly around the audience. Don't get too excited, everything is carefully choreographed. You have to fly out to a beacon. Once you reach the beacon, that one will go quiet and the next one will appear. Make the whole circuit, and your first act is done. Simple, yeah?

Oh, and make sure you're flying a shuttle. You received one for signing up, but really any shuttle will do.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Audience completely wowed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Air shows are not about fun.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Air shows are not about fun.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: No problem.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
These beacons were specifically designed for use in air shows. There are similar devices already used in construction, but that wouldn't have been nearly as fun as another inflated government contract.

Note: You will have to add Large Collidable Objects to your Overview to see these mission specific beacons. The first one will be called Beacon 1.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Gee, as fun as that sounds, I think I quit.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Gee, as fun as that sounds, I think I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: What are you still doing here? Get flying!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hey, that rhyme--

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Your first event is just to fly around the audience. You have to fly out to a beacon. Once you reach the beacon, that one will go quiet and the next one will appear. Make the whole circuit, and your first act is done. Simple, yeah?

Oh, and make sure you're flying a shuttle. You received one for signing up, but really any shuttle will do.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Never say "wow" again. I hate that word.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Hang on to that thought. I'm getting word that one of our stunt craft just burst into flames. I told them we were overloading the systems too much! Now we're…

Wait…yes, the pilot ejected successfully, but his pod is damaged. He can't make his way back under his own power.

{[character]player.name}, get out there and bring that pilot back. I'm not losing a pilot.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Pilot safely returned.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You are out of the show. Get out of here.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You are out of the show. Get out of here.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry. I'll get that pilot out.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Proper capsuleer pods are completely reliable and do not break on their own. They are, however, slow as all hell and liable to pop if looked at wrong. Traveling in one for any period of time is not recommended.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That pilot knew the risks. Let the audience see the reality we face.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: That pilot knew the risks. Let the audience see the reality we face.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Hurry, but not too much. The audience likes some excitement, after all.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Whatever it is, I'm re--

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I'm getting word that one of our stunt craft just burst into flames. The pilot ejected successfully, but his pod is damaged. He can't make his way back under his own power.

{[character]player.name}, get out there and bring that pilot back. I'm not losing a pilot.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Is he still alive? Yes? Good. Just dump him over here somewhere. I'm sure someone will get to him eventually.

localizedName.text: Air Show! - Target Rich Environment (4 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
This is the big combat section. We've got some drones flying around that you're going to pop. This is live fire, but it shouldn't be too dangerous. Just take out any drone you see. The people will love it.

Oh, and do note that you must fly something with weapons this time. Your shuttle will not cut it.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The drones have been dispatched in a series of satisfying explosions.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Come on. What's more entertaining than explosions?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Come on. What's more entertaining than explosions?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I can pop a few drones, no problem.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Contrary to Caldari propaganda, not all drones gain sentience and turn on their masters. The Gallente have made great strides in drone technology. Modern drones are highly reliable. The one you will fight today have been made to simulate rogue drones, but it is only simulation.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Combat? I think not.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Combat? I think not.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Then go out there and give everyone a good show.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Just tell me since you'll interrupt me any--

messages.mission.briefing.text:
This is the big combat section. We've got some drones flying around that you're going to pop. This is live fire, but it shouldn't be too dangerous. Just take out any drone you see. The people will love it.

Oh, and do note that you must fly something with weapons this time. Your shuttle will not cut it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Perfect!

localizedName.text: Air Show! - Requesting a Flyby (5 of 5)

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
So what you're going to be doing is an old fashioned tower-buzz. It's rather simple. I'll give you a series of nine start and end points. Fly between these points. This will take you past the onlookers, giving them a good buzz.

Of course there is no air in space, so the buzz will be simulated with massive subwoofers we've hidden around their seating, but they'll love it.

If you have the skills and equipment, you can use a Micro-Warp Drive (MWD) for this. It's not required, but you'll go crazy fast.

Note: You will have to add Large Collidable Objects to your Overview to see these mission specific beacons. The first one will be called Beacon 1.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: And I'm done.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Massive. Subwoofers.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: : Massive. Subwoofers.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Just one fly-by? Easy.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Because soundless space is not cool.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: How droll. I pass.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is droll. I pass.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Easy, but they do so love loud noises.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: ...Oh, can I talk this ti--

messages.mission.briefing.text:
So what you're going to be doing is an old fashioned tower-buzz. It's rather simple. I'll give you a series of nine start and end points. Fly between these points. This will take you past the onlookers, giving them a good buzz.

If you have the skills and equipment, you can use a Micro-Warp Drive (MWD) for this. It's not required, but you'll go crazy fast.

Note: You will have to add Large Collidable Objects to your Overview to see these mission specific beacons. The first one will be called Beacon 1.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great work! Everyone loved the whole show. Why, at this rate we may even have another air show before too long.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It's simple, really: I supplied this ungrateful Gallente leech with items he requested, and then he warps away before paying me. I'd like you teach him some manners — by blasting his ship to stardust, then returning my stolen cargo to me.

My sources tell me he can be found at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I wish everyone was as straightforward as you, {[character]player.name}. Then I wouldn't be in this situation.

I supplied this Gallente leech with certain items he requested, and then he warps away before paying me. Some people, I tell you. So, I need to teach him some manners. Well, okay… I need you to teach him some manners.

My sources tell me he can be found at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. {[character]player.name}, I'd like you to do that — teach him his manners — by flying out there, blasting his ship to so much dust, then returning my stolen cargo to me. If that doesn't teach him, nothing will.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text:
Your thief is dead, here's your cargo. I taught your friend a lesson, all right — don't mess with me. Too bad he's dead, because I'd like to teach him that one again.

Now pay up.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You disappoint me, {[character]player.name}. If I can't count on you, then who can I count on? This universe grows darker every day...

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Oh, that's all I needed to hear today. No one gives a toss for a poor, honest businessman these days, it seems.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sure, I don't mind teaching scum like that a lesson or two. Count me in.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Remember to keep an eye on your shields and armor during battle. But if you do forget and you happen to lose a ship, well… hey, that's the life of a capsuleer. Just get a new one, even if you've got to beg, borrow, or steal, and just get right back to work.

Get used to the idea: Ships — not to mention your current clone — won't last forever.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Boo-hoo, someone stole something from you. Deal with it yourself: I've got places to be.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I really don't have time for this. Find someone else to fight your battles for you. Or better yet, learn to fight them yourself.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: This pleases me more than you know, {[character]player.name}. We'll show this crooked wretch how we do things downstation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Is that so? Well, as long as it makes me rich, color me interested. What is it?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Because of your failure to deal with the small matter of bringing justice to the Gallente thief at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, my business is now facing bankruptcy. Sooner or later, {[character]player.name}, you're going to have realize we're all in this together, and start acting accordingly.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Superbly done, {[character]player.name} ! If only I could have been there, to see him mewl as his ship crumbled around him — oh, the hilarity! Enjoy your reward, friend. You've earned it.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: {[character]player.name}, I really could have used you on this job. It's unfortunate things didn't work out… but I'm sure the fault is all yours.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
As you may know, the Tash-Murkon family is one of the richest in the galaxy. The kind of wealth they can bring to bear is mind-boggling. One of their scions, an otherwise respectable man named Geeral — he is, in fact, one-hundred and seventy-eighth in line for the throne — has turned traitor. He has stolen the access codes for some of the family's secret bank accounts and fled toward Gallente space.

We have tracked Geeral Tash-Murkon to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We suspect he is going to meet his Gallentean allies, who will escort him back to Gallente space. Go out there and capture Geeral. Bring him back to me; destroy his allies.

You will need some firepower for this mission. A stoutly armed cruiser is recommended.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I have just the thing, never fear.

As you may know, members of the royal families can be... er, marginally eccentric. However, rarely do they prove disloyal to the Empire. The Tash-Murkon family is one of the richest in the galaxy. The kind of wealth they can bring to bear is mind-boggling. One of their scions, an otherwise respectable man named Geeral — he is, in fact, one-hundred and seventy-eighth in line for the throne — has turned traitor.

He has stolen the access codes for some of the family's secret bank accounts and fled toward Gallente space. If he reaches it, the Gallente would be only too willing to drain those funds dry in an effort to throw the entire Amarrian government into chaos. Naturally, we cannot allow this to happen.

We have tracked Geeral Tash-Murkon to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We suspect he is going to meet his Gallentean allies, who will escort him back to Gallente space. Go out there and capture Geeral. Bring him back to me; destroy his allies.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Tash-Murkon traitor is in the hold — a little the worse for wear, but he's alive.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I must question your loyalty to the Emperor, or else your bravery. You are not the ship captain I thought you were.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope I can find someone else to handle this.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: He won't know what hit him.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Tash-Murkon family is one of the royal families of Amarr, but their blood is not truly Amarrian blood. They were originally Udorian, but their immense wealth allowed them to buy their way to power.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't want any part of royal family machinations. I hate politics.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Sorry, but Geeral escaped. There was nothing I could do.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't waste any time! And don't worry: House Tash-Murkon has formally disowned Geeral already, so you'll face no repercussions from them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Sure, but... how about something with a little action?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done well; the Tash-Murkon family will certainly appreciate your efforts. I shudder to think of the horrors that await Geeral when he is returned to his family.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I don't want to talk about it. Whenever I close my eyes I can still hear the screams...

So, yes, more dolls. There are four dolls hidden in a series of deadspace pockets. How he found an unused chain of acceleration gates, I have no idea. But they're out there. Go to each canister, take a doll, and then use the acceleration gate to get to the next room. There should be four rooms and four dolls.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Four more dolls for you.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Be careful you never bet something you don't want to lose.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Four rooms, four dolls. Got it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Yes, dolls. All kids love dolls.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: To hell with this. I quit.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: To hell with this. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Do hurry. I'm not sure I can take these dolls much longer.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What is the story with the dolls, anyway?

messages.mission.briefing.text: There are four dolls hidden in a series of deadspace pockets. How he found an unused chain of acceleration gates, I have no idea. But they're out there. Go to each canister, take a doll, then use the acceleration gate to get to the next room. There should be four rooms and four dolls.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Just...just put them over there. With the others.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
He's hidden another one of those blasted dolls at another location. But it's not just anywhere, oh no, he's hidden it this time. It's in the middle of an asteroid field. You'll have to mine through those rocks until you find it.

Yes, I'm serious. So go! Fetch the dolls! The more the merrier!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That was thoroughly unpleasant, but I have retrieved the doll.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: Don't you hear them? The dolls?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You can't quit! There are still more dolls. Always more dolls.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Have you ever looked at their faces? They look back.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Easy, there. I'll get the doll.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: They're all laughing at me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You're starting to scare me a little. I think I better go.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This isn't even funny anymore. Quitting.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Another doll, and that'll be all. Another doll....

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What is it this time?

messages.mission.briefing.text: He's hidden another one of those blasted dolls at another location. But it's not just anywhere, oh no, he's hidden it this time. It's in the middle of an asteroid field. You'll have to mine through those rocks until you find it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Another doll! Almost done here! Yes....

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yes, the show. It's the real reason for all of this, you see. At first I thought he was being vindictive by constantly reminding me of that terrible night, but now I see. He is the only one that understood the significance of that night. He was trying to show me.

It's all been an act, you see? And it wasn't the dolls. They're just an audience. We! We are the performers. And this story, like all good comedies, ends with a death.

Find Enlil Bel. He is the one who began this tale.

End his role. Bring me his meat costume. I want to wear it.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Enlil Bel is dead. His part in this is done.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Maybe...rraarrgh...maybe you're right.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Maybe...rraarrgh...maybe you're right.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Enlil is as good as dead.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
It's five acts, don't you see? The purity of it! The establishment, the turn, all wonderful. But the end!

...At last there will be a resolution.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I will not kill for you. Get help.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I will not kill for you. Get help.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: As good as dead! I love it! I'll have the curtain ready for our guests.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: The show? Are you alright?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Find Enlil Bel. End his role in this story. Bring me his meat costume. I want to wear it.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Enlil Bel? What are you--

You didn't talk to me when I was... Oh god, what did you do?

Oh dear, oh dear. I have to think of what to do now. Uh, here. Here's your payment. You don't know anything about what happened here, right? Neither of us know anything.

It's happening all over again.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Command has been hearing strange things about a certain Major. Unsettling things. Given our situation with the other empires, it is felt that investigating the Major must be handled with more tact than a traditional inquiry would provide. The first step is implanting a spy into his staff. Deliver this man to the location provided; he will do the rest.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The spy has been delivered.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Sooner or later, you will have to involve yourself in the affairs of the world around you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Disappointing.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll make sure he arrives safely.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Holoreels would have you believe that spies occupy romantic positions, such as enticing femme fatales or ceiling-crawling ninjas. The reality is that often the most effective spies are the ones posing as simple functionaries. Nobody expects the dull guy.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No, this sounds like something I want to stay away from.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I decided that I don't want to get involved in this.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. After this, the real work begins.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's up?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Command has been hearing strange things about a certain Major. Unsettling things. It is felt that investigating the Major must be handled with more tact than a traditional inquiry would provide. The first step is implanting a spy into his staff. Deliver this man to the location provided; he will do the rest.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: That's great. In fact, our spy is already providing us with interesting data.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Apparently there was a theft in the Major's office just before our spy arrived. The thief made off with a number of the Major's personal effects. The timing of this could be coincidental, but it's unlikely. What's even stranger is that the Major has expressed no interest in chasing down the thieves. He claims it would, "be a waste of resources." We've been tracking the thieves, and we know just where they are.

I want you to go out there and take them out. Bring back whatever they stole. If my suspicions are right, what we find will greatly aid the investigation.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here are the Major's personal effects.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: If you want something done right...

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Do you have any idea how hard it will be to get another free agent to do this without attracting attention?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Do you have any idea how hard it will be to get another free agent to do this without attracting attention?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Stolen property, coming up.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: You have to hire someone better.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I can't bring that thief down. Sorry.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't bring that thief down. Sorry.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I hope this will be as big as I feel it is.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
There was a theft in the Major's office just before our spy arrived. The thief made off with a number of the Major's personal effects. The timing of this could be coincidental, but it's unlikely.

I want you to go out there and take out the thieves. Bring back whatever they stole.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Good work. Let's see what we have here....

I don't get it. There's nothing but actual personal items here. Some medals, family photos; nothing valuable nor incriminating. Weird.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We know nothing else has left the Major's office yet. Everything's just been business as usual. Our spy has not been able to check what the Major has thrown away. Rummaging around the garbage would be a bit suspicious. Luckily we do know that the recent garbage has not been properly disposed of yet. You know what I'm thinking, of course.

Get out there and bring me that garbage. There has to be something in there.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's the Major's garbage.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Too high and mighty for garbage duty? Blasted capsuleers.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It's not as glamorous as I'd hoped, but okay.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: As a capsuleer, you never have to take out your own trash.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Nope. I'm not wasting my time picking up garbage.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I just can't do it. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Real investigative work is never glamorous.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Any ideas?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Our spy has not been able to check what the Major has thrown away. Luckily we do know that the recent garbage has not been properly disposed of yet. Get out there and bring me that garbage.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Let's have another look.

This is interesting. It's some sort of letter from a Serpentis! Give me a minute to read this.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Not quite, but it's close. According to this the Major has some sort of clandestine meeting with a member of the Serpentis. The meeting is out in the middle of an asteroid field, no less. If something illegal isn't going on, I'll kiss a slaver hound.

Go out to the meeting place and bring this Serpentis contact in. Let's blow this thing wide open.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's the contact. He's still breathing, too.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: It's been my experience that the Serpentis are always angry.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: It's been my experience that the Serpentis are always angry.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: One Serpentis contact, coming up.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Serpentis Corporation was founded a few decades ago by V.Salvador Sarpati. At first it was engaged in hi-tech research, but with time its ties with the underworld grew and the Serpentis research stations, scattered around in remote areas, became infamous pirate havens. It is strongly believed that Serpentis is the main developer and manufacturer of illegal neural boosters, especially since Sarpati's father was a renown specialist in that field. The home of Serpentis is in the Phoenix constellation in the Fountain region.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No can do. I'm not angering the Serpentis

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I quit. I'm not angering the Serpentis.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: This better be the lead we need, or so help me....

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: The proverbial bloody knife?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Major has some sort of clandestine meeting with a member of the Serpentis. The meeting is out in the middle of an asteroid field, no less.

Go out to the meeting place and bring this Serpentis contact in.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent. Now if you'll excuse us, our new friend and I need to have a little chat.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
That Serpentis scum is the Major's son. I've just confirmed it with intelligence.

What happened is that the Major's son joined the Serpentis as part of some grey op about a year ago. A few months in the kid stopped reporting in. He was presumed dead. We now know that the Serpentis figured out who he was, and put the boy through extreme conditioning.

The Major has been trying to recover his son while keeping the operation that started this a secret. The Serpentis meanwhile have been trying to blackmail the Major. We're lucky they thought small by threatening the Major's career with exposing his son as a traitor. With the son now recovered, the Serpentis have nothing.

The boy needs to be sent for proper psychiatric care. It's going to take a while to scrub what the Serpentis did to him. The Major is waiting for him at the delivery point. I can't think of a better person than you to give closure to all this.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Major has been reunited with his son, if briefly.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: There's nothing to be gained by being bitter. It's over.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: There's nothing to be gained by being bitter. It's over.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I would be honored to bring this to do this.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: There are many forms of brainwashing. None of them are very pleasant, particularly in the time frame that the Major's son was brainwashed in. He can get better, but it will be a long and strenuous process.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: After all this I am not just going to hand the boy over and pretend nothing happened.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: After all this I am not just going to hand the boy over and pretend nothing happened.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good luck.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What happened? What'd that Serpentis scum say?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
That Serpentis is the Major's son. He joined the Serpentis as part of some grey op about a year ago. A few months in he stopped reporting in. The Serpentis figured out who he was and put the boy through extreme conditioning. The Major has been trying to recover his son while keeping the operation that started this a secret. With the son now recovered, the Serpentis have nothing.

The boy needs to be sent for proper psychiatric care. It's going to take a while to scrub what the Serpentis did to him. The Major is waiting for him at the delivery point.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You did good work, {[character]player.name}.

You know, it wasn't quite the big bust I was hoping, but I feel like we really did something good, you know? You don't get to feel like that every day in this universe. Savor it while you can.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've got a wolf by the ears — a number of enemy ships escorting the Amarrian carrier Lupus Nivius. We simply don't have the resources in this sector to stop them. We're looking for resourceful pilots to fly to the Lupus's last known location and hit it hard before the crew can effect repairs and start raiding. There's a squadron guarding her, so you'll have to take them down too. The enemy's location has been programmed into your Neocom, and time is of the essence.

I suggest you find some help for this mission — these Amarrians are going to be pretty tough to take down on your own.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our naval units managed to ambush an Amarrian strike force and forced them to jump into Republic space. Now, just between you and me, our action was a ploy to pin the incident on the Empire and gain support for our war efforts... but I never told you that, right?

Well, I was against the plan from the beginning, since those blasted religious fanatics always have some kind of trick up their sleeves. In this case, it turns out that their force was simply stronger than our intelligence led us to believe, and we took some serious damage. And now they're loose inside Republic territory.

Personally, I think they were expecting it all along and just used our attack as an excuse to get a raiding force inside our borders. Now we've got a wolf by the ears — a number of enemy ships escorting the carrier Lupus Nivius. They took some losses in the initial battle, but our ships are even worse off and we simply don't have the resources in this sector to stop them.

We're looking for resourceful pilots to fly to the Lupus's last known location and hit it hard before the crew can effect repairs and start raiding. There's a squadron guarding her, so you'll have to take them down too. I'll upload the enemy's location to your Neocom.

I suggest you find some help for this one — they're going to be pretty tough to take down on your own. Can you do it?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: The Amarrians will be loose in our systems in a matter of hours, then, thanks to you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: That's a fine way to defend our Republic. I'm disappointed.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
One of the most infamous of Amarrian vessels, the Lupus Nivius is nearly 80 years old, and has participated in many different engagements during its long and varied career. The Lupus has been extensively refitted with advanced technology and high-end weaponry. It has served as a raider par exellence, often leading flotillas of battleships and cruisers on missions deep inside Minmatar and Gallente territory.

The Lupus participated in the bombardment of several planets during the Empire's attempts to reconquer the Khanid Kingdom, and its name is spoken of with hatred and fear in Minmatar space — it is widely believed that the Lupus was responsible for the massacre of several refugee convoys as they attempted to escape from Ammatar space three decades ago.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: We're counting on you, {[character]player.name}. Good luck.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: We've received reports that the enemy has completed repairs on Lupus Nivius. They've moved out and begun raiding. Your mission is a failure, and now the Republic will suffer for it. Let us hope the Navy can send reinforcements here in a hurry — but it's not as if they don't have their hands full already.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: The sector is safe from the Amarrians for now, but I fear for the future, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Congratulations? Congratulations? Those short-sighted fools at the Center for Scientific Advancement have no idea what they've done! To dismiss my contributions to the furtherance of human knowledge with a mere honorable mention is an insult! An insult!

Well, we'll show them, won't we? Go blow up the old farts' convention! You'll find a large container of explosives right next to the facility. I'd intended to make a gift of them-- my own new design, very strong-- when I accepted my rightful prize. It seems fitting to use them as the agent of destruction for those too blind to see the brilliance right before their eyes.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I blew up the Center for Scientific Advancement. The prize committee is now in very small pieces.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I should have known better than to trust someone of such obviously sub-par intelligence with any aspect of my work.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Hmph. I should have known that someone like you couldn't comprehend the magnitude of this offense any more than you could grasp the true significance of my work.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Um, okay. I'm gonna back away slowly and go blow up the nasty old prize committee.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Sometimes, explosions cause chain reactions.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: What? No! I'm not blowing up a civic center just because they didn't give you first prize!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: On second thought, this is ridiculous. Do your own dirty work for a change.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Yes, they'll pay for their temerity. Off you go!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Well, that's great, right? Congratulations!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Those short-sighted fools at the Center for Scientific Advancement have no idea what they've done! To dismiss my contributions to the furtherance of human knowledge with a mere honorable mention is an insult! An insult!

Well, we'll show them, won't we? Go blow up the old farts' convention! You'll find a large container of explosives right next to the facility. I'd intended to make a gift of them-- my own new design, very strong-- when I accepted my rightful prize. It seems fitting to use them as the agent of destruction for those too blind to see the brilliance right before their eyes.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: That'll teach 'em.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Ah, yes, well. The data you brought me proved very interesting. Now I need you to go collect the physical samples. Again, they're in the same location. I've left them in a container with very little shielding to observe the effects of exposure to the peculiar conditions of the area over time. Pick them up and bring them back to me; the faster, the better.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's your... whatever these are.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I should have known better than to trust someone of such obviously sub-par intelligence with any aspect of my work.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Yeah, sure, fine.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Run your own errands.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm bored with all this science crap. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Speed is of the essence, so hurry up.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's not getting old at all. You told me to come back, you jerk.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The data you brought me proved very interesting. Now I need you to go collect the physical samples. Again, they're in the same location. I've left them in a container with very little shielding to observe the effects of exposure to the peculiar conditions of the area over time. Pick them up and bring them back to me; the faster, the better.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Give me a few minutes for analysis, then come back. Go away now.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ah, yes. Well, I've reset the password, but the fact remains: I don't trust whatshisname anymore. I'd like you to go collect my data from the area where you found my former assistant. You're on the system's allowed list, so you should be fine.

There are a series of cloaked beacons in the area, which contain devices for collecting and recording data. They are also capable of transmitting the data, but only over a very short range. You'll need to get in close to each beacon. Once you've gotten close enough, my device will collect the transmission and the next beacon will decloak.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Data retrieved.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I should have known better than to trust someone of such obviously sub-par intelligence with any aspect of my work.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I should have known better than to trust someone of such obviously sub-par intelligence with any aspect of my work.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Get close to the beacons, bring back the data. Got it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No thanks; sounds boring.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Get your own damn data. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Go on then, enough time's been wasted already.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You said I should come back, remember?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Well, I've reset the password, but the fact remains: I don't trust whatshisname anymore. I'd like you to go collect my data from the area where you found my former assistant. You're on the system's allowed list, so you should be fine.

There are a series of cloaked beacons in the area, which contain devices for collecting and recording data. They are also capable of transmitting the data, but only over a very short range. You'll need to get in close to each beacon. Once you've gotten close enough, my device will collect the transmission and the next beacon will decloak.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I need silence to assess these data. Come back when I'm done.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Done. Your guy ran away.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sure, I can help you out.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Nah, you can find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Find someone else; I'm done.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Hurry up.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Uh... you have another job for me, right?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
You still have that device I gave you, right? Make sure it's in your cargohold before you head out after my lab assistant. I've loaded a program that will initiate my security's stand-down sequence as soon as you get close enough. All you have to do is approach the trapped ship-- my device will take care of the rest.

Don't go shooting anything! I've got sensitive equipment in there.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Typical. Take this device and come back in a few minutes. I'll need you to do some work for me.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
My stupid lab assistant has managed to trigger the security protocols in one of my research areas, and now he's stuck in there. He's just lucky he managed to get off a brief call for help, because as it happens, the lockdown procedure includes jamming all long-distance communications.

I need you to go pick up one of my data chips. I'm storing them at another station; I'll let them know to leave one in your hangar. I can explain more after you bring it to me.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
My stupid lab assistant has managed to trigger the security protocols in one of my research areas, and now he's stuck in there. He's just lucky he managed to get off a brief call for help, because as it happens, the lockdown procedure includes jamming all long-distance communications.

I need you to go pick up one of my data chips. I'm storing them at another station; I'll let them know to leave one in your hangar. I can explain more after you bring it to me.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's your data chip. That was hardly a challenge.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I can do that.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Since you're such a charmer... get your own damn chip.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I quit. You can run your own errands.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: That remains to be seen. Get on with it!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I've been meaning to get a new lab assistant anyway.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I'll have this ready in a few moments if you stop bothering me.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yes. Well, not me personally — but Ducia Foundry needs your help. As you probably know, Ducia often sends mining ops into dangerous areas. Most of the time, they are able to handle whatever belt-rats come along, but it sounds like something terrible has happened this time. They lost contact with their mining colony in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

The only information we have is a garbled message. Listen...

...*SQUAWK crackle crackle* ... unknown intruders ... picking apart ... communications ... *hisssss* ... help us! ... escorts are ..."

We fear its already too late, but we have to do something. We‘ve made several attempts to contact them, but their com network appears to be down.

We want you to enter the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and look for survivors. If you find any, pick them up and bring them to me. And be careful. We don't know what might be out there.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Mission accomplished. The surviving miners are safe, and the Gallente privateers are space dust.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I guess those Gallente privateers were too much for you. Don't worry, I doubt I'll overestimate you again.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I can handle it. "Danger" is my middle name.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Ducia Foundry is one of the most ambitious mining corporations in the Amarr Empire. They routinely send heavily armed mining expeditions into low-sec space to mine the most profitable ore deposits.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Miners?! I don't have time to help a bunch of miserable rock-zappers.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't handle this. I give up.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good luck! Be careful!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: So you have need of my particular brand of, er, justice?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Go to the Ducia Foundry mining colony in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take out any hostiles you encounter. Then look for survivors; if you find any, pick them up and bring them back to {[location]agentStationID.name}.

We're not expecting you to have to go to war, but whoever took down that mining station was able to defeat a heavily armed escort. Just be prepared for a tough fight.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent. Ducia Foundry is most pleased that you were able to save their miners. And taking down those Gallente privateers was an added bonus.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
A secret Gallente outpost nearby just suffered a catastrophic overload in its main power core. The resulting explosion obliterated the outpost. The Gallente navy is on its way there to look for survivors.

We don't care about the Gallente civilians, but we do care about the massive amount of sensitive information that might be stored in the remnants of the outpost's central information core. That outpost was a communications hub routing vast amounts of data back into Gallente space. There's no telling what secrets we could uncover with that information core.

We want you to go to the remnants of the outpost and sift through the debris until you find that central data core. Just pick it up and bring it back.

This might sound easy, except that the Gallente Navy is already en route to the location. They likely won't be looking for the core themselves; they'll be picking up survivors. However, intelligence reports say that the rescue fleet is large, and they might not react favorably to Amarr vessels nosing around in the face of their tragedy.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the central data core on board.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You just helped us miss a golden opportunity. This doesn't bode well for your future.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope I can find someone else to handle this.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll see what I can do.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, but I don't like the political ramifications. You'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't waste any time.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh? What's happened? And does it mean work for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A secret Gallente outpost nearby just suffered a catastrophic overload in its main power core. The resulting explosion obliterated the outpost, which had been a communications hub routing vast amounts of data back into Gallente space. There's no telling what secrets we could uncover if we were to recover its central information core.

We want you to go the remnants of the outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and sift through the debris until you find that data core. Just pick it up and bring it back.

This might sound easy, except that the Gallente Navy is already en route to the location. They likely won't be looking for the core themselves; they'll be picking up survivors. However, intelligence reports say that the rescue fleet is large, and they might not react favorably to Amarr vessels nosing around in the face of their tragedy.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nicely done. This information core might just be priceless.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, we have a bit of a problem we need to deal with, {[character]player.name}. A low-level executive here has consistently failed to live up to our standards, but because of his position in a sensitive area of the corporation, simply terminating his contract would have an unfortunate effect on our stock prices. As a result, it has become necessary to— shall we say, "eliminate his salary line"? Yes, that works. Eliminate his salary line, through alternate means.

This executive and his entourage, consisting of a number of security vessels, will be stopping by a transfer station in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system shortly. We would like you to fly to the transfer station and eliminate his vessel; you can do as you like with the security detail, but their elimination is not strictly necessary.

Once you've completed the job, return to me and I'll make sure you are amply rewarded.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The problem has been eliminated.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That is unfortunate. We may not have another chance to dispose of this fool quietly for some time. Your failure here has cost us a considerable amount of money, pilot.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If you do not have the fortitude to do what must be done, I suppose I can find someone else with the courage to see it through. I cannot hide my disappointment in you, however.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will deal with him, kirjuun.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Because of the importance placed on "saving face" in Caldari culture, mid- and high-level executives often remain employed despite failures in leadership or performance, simply because firing them publicly would damage the corporation's reputation. In extreme cases, it is not altogether unknown for superiors within the corporation to arrange "accidents" for executives who fail to meet objectives and threaten their employer's bottom line. This eliminates the drain on corporate resources and allows them to save face.

While such methods of dealing with "problem employees" are simply not discussed openly (doing so would be in horribly poor taste, after all), it is something that lurks in the back of every corporate executive's mind.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not going to kill this man just to solve a few headaches.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I am afraid I will not be able to carry out your orders, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Here are the coordinates of the transfer station; you should proceed there post-haste. I'll be waiting to hear from you upon your return.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: How can I serve {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}? Eager to help, as always.

messages.mission.briefing.text: An incompetent executive will be passing through a transfer station in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. In order to eliminate this problem for the company and keep it from hurting our stock price, you will need to intercept the executive and his security detail at the transfer station and eliminate the executive's ship. You may engage the security detail if you wish, but it is not strictly necessary.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I'm glad to hear that, {[character]player.name}. Perhaps with him out of the way, that division will begin to show the profit we have been expecting for the last year.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I'm afraid I couldn't wait any longer for a response from you on this mission, pilot. Thankfully, I was able to contact another pilot to take care of the matter while the window of opportunity was still open, and she managed to deal with the problem. Next time, please be a bit more punctual in your response.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A number of important shareholders were aboard a transport vessel in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system when their ship was attacked and incapacitated by Gurista raiders. Fly out there, secure the area, recover the VIPs, and bring them safely back to your agent in {[location]agentStationID.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We have a bit of a problem, {[character]player.name}. A number of important shareholders were aboard a transport vessel in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system when their ship was attacked and incapacitated by Gurista raiders. We need you to fly out there, secure the area, recover the VIPs, and bring them safely back here.

Can you handle that, {[character]player.name}?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have recovered the VIPs, {[character]agentID.name}. Unfortunately, the ship was a total loss.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You've failed not only me, but the State itself. I have no doubt you will come to regret this.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Most unfortunate. Well, I'm sure someone else will accept the honor of such an important mission for the State.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry, {[character]agentID.name}. I'll handle this right away.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: While Caldari society is not what most people would call democratic, the shareholder meeting is one of the few places in the State where a certain type of democracy still exists. Anyone who is a corporate shareholder is welcome to attend a shareholder meeting either in person or virtually and voice their concerns to the corporation's board of directors, whether they own one share or millions.
