While most small shareholders do not bother to attend and simply proxy their shares to one of the large voting blocs within the corporation (the largest of which is usually the board of directors itself), this has been used on occasion to embarrass corporate officers; those who do so, however, do not generally have long to revel in their triumph.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't think I am really the person for this job.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: The Gurista force there is too strong for me; I can't even get close to the ship! Find someone else for this suicide run.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good luck, {[character]player.name}. We're all counting on you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: How can I serve the State and {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, kirjuun?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The shareholders have been captured by the Guristas, along with the valuable information they carried. This is a dark day for the State, {[character]player.name}; this failure rests upon your shoulders.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Well done. We could use more pilots like you.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Due to your indecisiveness, I was forced to contact another pilot about handling this mission. He was able to assist the stranded vessel in time. Perhaps next time you will be more prompt.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.head.text: Wildcat strike brought to bloody end

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The workers in a corporate mining facility are striking, taking control of the facility's defense grid and arming their mining vessels. They have shut the mining operation down completely and locked corporate personnel out of the area until their demands are met.

This situation is not acceptable. You are to enter the facility and neutralize any armed resistance: bring the strike to an end before there is any more damage to corporate property or loss of production. Do what you can to minimize collateral damage, but ending this as soon as possible is your top priority.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We have a bit of a problem, {[character]player.name}. A corporate executive seems to have used some rather unorthodox methods to try to speed up production in his mining fields, and the strain this placed on the labor force there has led to a wildcat strike which has shut down production in that field entirely, causing materials shortages all the way up our supply chain. Of course, this is entirely unacceptable; it is imperative that this strike be brought to a close immediately and production resume as soon as possible.

Corporate security is stretched rather thin in this sector, so we would like you to go to the mining facility in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and eliminate any threats to corporate assets. You should be aware that the striking miners have taken control of the facility's defense grid and armed many of their mining vessels with makeshift weapons, so you should expect heavy resistance.

Avoid any collateral damage to corporate assets if possible; we don't want this strike to cost us any more than it already has.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The strike has been brought to an end.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I certainly hope you're not a sympathizer, pilot.  You won't go far if you keep up this attitude.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I certainly hope you're not turning this down because you sympathize with them.  I suppose I'll have to find someone else with a more realistic idea of the situation to handle this.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll deal with the strike.  You can count on me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not sure this is really a job for me.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've decided I don't have time to clean up this particular mess.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good.  Here are the coordinates for the entrance to the mining facility.  Return to me as soon as the job is done.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What sort of trouble?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You've taken too long: the strike has gotten far too out of control and corporate assets are in serious danger.  We've called in the military to deal with the situation. Your services are no longer needed, pilot.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent.  Hopefully the new manager of that facility will be able to get production up and running in short order.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I couldn't wait any longer for you to decide if you could handle this for me. I was forced to call in another pilot to take care of the matter.  While I am not exactly a fan of her methods, she has been able to bring the strike to a quick end.  Perhaps next time you will make sure you get back to me in a timely manner.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.head.text: Insorum convoy rescued by loyalist pilot

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A convoy belonging to the Zainou Biotech corporation has broadcast a distress call to all nearby stations, saying they are under attack by unknown hostiles and going down fast. Because the convoy's cargo, chemical components of an insorum prototype, is such a valuable and dangerous one, the CEP itself has given orders for all nearby agents to find ships capable of rescuing the cargo, even if the ships in the convoy are otherwise unsalvageable.

You will need to fly to the last reported location of the convoy, eliminate the attacking vessels, and either escort the convoy to safety or recover the insorum components from the wreckage if it is already too late. It is imperative that this be taken care of as soon as possible; we cannot allow this cargo to fall into the wrong hands.

You will need a Salvager to complete this task.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've just received a distress call from a Zainou Biotech transport ship nearby, saying that she was under attack by unknown hostiles and her escort force was failing fast. Unfortunately, most of the nearby vessels are unable to assist and as a result the CEP has ordered everyone in the general vicinity to try and find pod pilots willing to assist the transport before it is too late.

It is critical that they receive that assistance, because that convoy is carrying a large quantity of chemical components for a new synthesis of insorum. No doubt you're aware of how valuable such a thing would be, and how dangerous it would be if it were to fall into the wrong hands. Zainou, and the State, cannot allow such a compound to fall into the hands of terrorists or foreign powers. We need you to fly to the last reported location of this convoy and destroy any attackers; if the convoy is still in serviceable shape, escort it to the nearest safe station, otherwise, recover whatever you can of the insorum synthesis components and bring them back to me immediately. Are you up to it?

You will need a Salvager to complete this task.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The convoy was destroyed by Minmatar terrorists, {[character]agentID.name}, but I was able to recover the insorum components.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Do you understand what you're doing? You're handing over a doomsday weapon to people who have no compunctions against its use! I sincerely hope that you never have cause to look back at this day and realize what a mistake you made, but I fear that time will come all too soon.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Perhaps it's for the best. After all, it would be better to place something of such import in the hands of someone more responsible.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I won't let something so dangerous fall into enemy hands, I swear.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Despite the death of Dr. Ullia Hnolku at the hands of Caldari paramilitary forces and the capture of all remaining insorum samples by enemies of the State, Zainou Biotech continues to research the process for creating the material at various locations in the Caldari State. Speculation continues as to what their intentions are if they ever manage to replicate the process; some within the Amarr Empire fear the Caldari will use it as a weapon should they have reason to fight the Empire, while the Federation's halls echo with concerns that the Caldari will use it as a counterweight to break the Republic from the grasp of the Gallente. The only sure bet is that the Republic would pay almost any price, in money or blood, to have the secret of insorum creation in its hands.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't have time to take on this sort of responsibility right now, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't take care of this right now; you'll have to find someone else. Or not; I don't really care.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good hunting, pilot. For the sake of the State and its citizens, I hope you do not fail.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll certainly try, kirjuun. What can I do to serve the State today?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You've failed both me and the Caldari State. Your failure to recover the insorum prototype components has as good as handed them over to Minmatar extremists, and who knows what those primitives will do? I hope you can sleep at night with that resting on your conscience, pilot.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Minmatar terrorists, eh? We should have known. You have performed a great service for the Caldari State. You've earned your reward ten times over today. Enjoy it while you can.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I'm afraid this mission was far too important to let sit any longer. Thankfully, you're not the only pod pilot in the service of the State, and one of them was able to take care of the problem, keeping this valuable cargo from falling into the hands of Minmatar extremists. Next time, I hope you will heed the call and come to the aid of the State promptly, instead of neglecting your obligations.

messages.mission.briefing.text: In order to prevent a number of Gallente corporations from appropriately countering a move by Sukuuvesta, we need to eliminate a Gallente listening post which is providing intelligence to those corporations. You and any pilots accompanying you are to fly to the listening post in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and destroy it. There will very likely be a strong Federation defense fleet stationed there, but the destruction of that fleet is not required. The listening post is your top priority.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Recently, the Sukuuvesta corporation has been planning a major operation in a number of systems along the Gallente border, an operation which would be, shall we say, detrimental to the market share of a number of Gallente corporations. Unfortunately, these corporations are also politically well-connected, and we know that they have extensive connections within the Federation intelligence community. They've used these connections to get a Federation listening post to focus its attention on the very systems Sukuuvesta is planning their operation in, and as a result if Sukuuvesta makes a move, they will have enough forewarning to counter it, costing the megacorporation and the State billions.

The listening post attached to this particular region of space is in a rather precarious position; technically, according to the Gallente government, it is actually a civilian data archive and not at all related to the Federation intelligence apparatus. Furthermore, acting on behalf of the Gallente corporations, unlike in the State, is actually a violation of Gallente law. This means that were it to suffer an “accident” at the hands of someone not specifically affiliated with the State, there would be little the Federation could do in response. Hopefully, you can be that someone for us.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Gallente listening post has been destroyed, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I hope you know what you're doing. It isn't wise to anger one of the megacorps, and you've just endangered billions of Sukuuvesta investment dollars. I'd watch my back if I were you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Very well, I suppose this sort of job isn't for everyone. I'll have to find something more suited to your talents.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: A chance to collect interest on a debt they've owed us for a century? I'll gladly help any way I can, kirjuun.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
There are a number of treaties that regulate the way in which the various nations of the cluster are supposed to relate to each other and what behaviors are and are not acceptable for them to take against one another. In reality, every nation subverts these same treaties by engaging in a number of questionable practices, perpetuating a state of cold war where men and women on both sides fight and die while the two sides pretend to make nice with one another.

Perhaps nowhere is this more apparent than between the Caldari State and the Gallente Federation. While Caldari megacorporations have made a science of public relations and marketing, and the Federation has carefully cultivated a sympathetic image since the end of the Yulai Convention, beneath the polite veneer of both nations, knives flash in the dark. For the State, this shadow war is not about dominance or revenge, but fear. For all their seeming arrogance, the Caldari are deathly afraid that the Federation is only waiting for a moment of vulnerability before they can begin the process of re-assimilating the State into their nation, something which many Caldari already see them doing to the Republic. Often, this war gets the most bloody when the Gallente make what look like altruistic gestures, as the Caldari tend to interpret this as an attempt to get them to drop their guard in preparation for some sort of attack.

messages.mission.timeout.emailheader.text: Sukuuvesta acquistion blocked by Gallente coalition

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't particularly feel like wading into the middle of an international incident right now.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is crazy-- what were you thinking? I can't possibly fight all those ships!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. I'll send word that you're on the case; let me know as soon as you've finished taking care of the listening post.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am ready to do my duty, kirjuun. How can I serve the State today?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You waited far too long to get this done, and Sukuuvesta was forced to go ahead with their plans. Unfortunately, exactly what we expected happened, and their acquisition was blocked-- thanks to some rather “prescient” financial maneuvering. You've cost them a great deal. I'd watch my back if I were you.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Perfect; I'll inform Sukuuvesta at once. They'll be indebted to us – and you – for a long time to come.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I never heard back from you, so I was forced to find someone else to take care of this problem. Time, tide, and megacorps wait for no man. Next time, do us both a favor and give me an answer so that we don't waste this time again.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As you're probably aware, in order to coordinate military operations at the front lines, the Amarr have deployed a series of FTL communications relays at the edge of the forward line of battle. Eliminating these communications relays and throwing a wrench into enemy operations has been made a top priority by the general staff.

Naval Intelligence has been able to locate one of these tactical relays being used to coordinate raids on our shipping. Right now, it is only lightly defended, but we don't have any forces available to take it out. I've been asked to look for capsuleers like yourself to eliminate the relay. Think you're up for it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the tactical relay.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Not every mission is glory and fame, pilot.  Total victory is but an amalgam of many small, seemingly insignificant victories; that's something you will need to learn eventually.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That relay is as good as gone.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds a bit small-time to me.  I think I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, get out of there as quickly as you can. Reinforcements will probably be sent to the area as soon as the thing goes down.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Amarr have deployed a series of tactical FTL relays along the front lines in order to coordinate their operations. Naval Intelligence has located one nearby-- it's being used to stage raids against our convoys. Unfortunately, no regular naval forces are available for a fast strike, so we're looking to you to take care of this for us.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Amarr Tactical Relay, and return to your agent.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. This should take a bit of pressure off our supply convoys. I'll make sure command realizes your contribution.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've been taking some heavy losses in the last few weeks along this area of the front. An enemy frigate squadron has been hitting our ships hard, taking out stragglers and scouts and then fading into space before we can counterattack, and it's starting to take its toll not only on our physical resources but an even heavier one on our morale. Our captains are getting too cautious, too unwilling to push for gains, and our general staff is getting concerned that the front will be stalled because of this. This is unacceptable.

Naval Intelligence believes that the person behind these attacks is the local Amarr sector commander. Eliminating him will hopefully end these attacks, give our forces a morale boost, and shift the momentum in this sector back to our side. Because of our problems with morale, we aren't sure that regular naval forces can handle this job; we'd like you to deal with this problem for us.

We've located a rendezvous point that this commander is going to be using for staging his next series of raids. You will need to fly there, eliminate his ship, and then report in. There will likely be a significant enemy presence there aside from the sector commander and his direct escort, so be prepared for a protracted battle.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the sector commander.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: He's as good as dead.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Remember, this commander is an expert at surprise attacks, so don't let him sneak up on you.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Minmatar forces in this sector have been taking heavy losses from enemy hit and run attacks on our fleets, damaging morale and stalling our offensives. Naval Intelligence believes that these attacks are being masterminded by the local Amarr sector commander, and has determined that our best option for ending these attacks is to eliminate him.

We have located a staging point that the sector commander is using for his attacks. You need to fly to these coordinates and wait for the commander and his escort to arrive, then eliminate him. Be aware that you may need to engage multiple groups of enemy forces while waiting, so be prepared for a protracted battle. Return to your agent when the sector commander has been destroyed.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great work, pilot. We'll make sure that word of your victory is spread to the rest of our forces; that should help morale more than you can realize.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Navy's general staff is planning an offensive against Amarr positions in this sector, but Naval Intelligence is having difficulty piercing the veil of enemy counterintelligence. Optimally, we'd like to get a better idea of Amarr positions, communications codes, fleet readiness and their own intelligence estimates of our disposition, but they've been working hard to keep us from getting our hands on anything more than a vague picture.

We've decided to try a bit of an end-run around their counterintelligence screen. We know where they have a secure datastore in an area of deadspace. We're going to send you in to recover the information from the datastore, but we'll only have a short window for this, so you'll need to move quickly. Can you handle that?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I think I've found what you were looking for. Is this it?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: This war isn't going to get any easier, pilot.  You'd better start thinking whether or not you're really cut out for this line of work.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll leave immediately.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds pretty dicey. I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Return here as soon as you get the data.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Navy is planning a new offensive against Empire positions, but Naval Intelligence has been unable to make headway getting the information necessary to plan a coordinated strike. In order to get the intelligence we need, we're going to need you to make a raid on a secure enemy datastore.

You'll need to jump into the deadspace area, eliminate the defenders, and recover the Tactical Information Sheet from the datastore. Once you've got it, bring it back to your agent so that Naval Intelligence can analyze it in preparation for the offensive.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work, pilot. I'll pass this up the chain to Naval Intelligence. Drinks are on us tonight.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I'm glad you're here, pilot. It's come to my attention that the Amarr have a relay station in a nearby contested system. The station is being used to send monitor classified Republic transmissions and then transmit them back to Amarr space, where their code-breakers can get to work figuring out what we mean. So far, we haven't had an opportunity to strike at it, and it's unlikely we'll get one soon.

However, we've received intelligence that the Amarr have dispatched a convoy to refuel the station. If we can destroy that convoy, we'll hamper their spying operations for at least a little while.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That station won't be seeing new supplies any time soon.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That relay station is causing serious problems for us. I'll have to get someone else to stop them.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Is destroying a few industrials really that difficult? I suppose I'll have to find someone else to complete this mission for me.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Blowing up some supply industrials? Sounds easy enough.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I can't do that.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I have to abandon your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew you would be up for it, pilot. The convoy is lightly guarded and the only important targets are their industrials. Once you destroy them, you can get out of there or mop up as needed. Just remember, because the system is contested, pod pilots working for the Amarr may try to stop you. Be sure that your ship is set up to counter them as well.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Yes.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Amarr are resupplying one of their relay stations in a nearby contested system-- it's due to run out soon and the convoy dispatched to resupply it hasn't arrived yet. Your job is to intercept the convoy and destroy the industrials before they have a chance to complete their mission.

The mission shouldn't be too difficult, as long as you don't encounter any pod pilots fighting for the Amarr. You should fit your ship to defend itself from other pod pilots just in case.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work. I knew I could count on you. With that relay station out of commission, our local transmissions will be harder for the Amarr to intercept, at least until they manage to sneak another convoy in there.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Minmatar Republic has located numerous hidden asteroid belts that our miners use to provide resources for the war effort. Usually, they don't get touched by anyone except us and the people we send out there... even if they're not technically in Republic space. However, it seems the Amarr Empire has sent some miners into one of our fields in an area of space they consider theirs; while we've been busy with other things, they've been sneaking in and mining our ore!

This is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. I want you to go out there and destroy those miners and show them that we're always watching. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Amarr. They're sure to be in the area.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed those miners. Our asteroids are safe for now!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm disappointed in you. I didn't think you would have trouble.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It doesn't matter what those thieves do as their day jobs, they won't get away from me!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I can't do that to those poor miners!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I cannot complete your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Remember, the belt is in a contested system, so pod pilots working for the Empire may try to stop you. Make sure you prepare for them above all else.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am always ready to earn an honest buck. Sometimes a not-so-honest one too.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Some pesky miners working for the Amarr Empire have managed to discover one of our hidden asteroid belts. This is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. Head out there and destroy those miners, then report back to me. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Empire.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great. That should teach them to try to take what belongs to the Republic! Hopefully, we won't have any more problems with those pesky miners, but knowing the Amarr, I doubt this'll be the end of it. Oh well, we'll just send you in again if need be!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We recently discovered a hidden gate belonging to the Amarr Empire in a nearby deadspace pocket. A capsuleer working for us managed to take the guards out some time ago, after which we then sent in forces to deactivate it. For a while, it seemed like the Amarr would simply abandon the gate.

Unfortunately, that's not the case. We've detected a squad of ships heading to the gate to initiate repairs on the gate and reactivate it, probably so they can more easily move forces into the area. Luckily, it will take them quite some time to get it operational. We want you to head out there and stop them before they can. Can you handle this?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those repair ships were no problem. Mission accomplished.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Now I'll have to find someone else to stop them! I hope we still have time.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry. I'll make sure that gate stays deactivated!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That sounds a bit tougher than I can handle.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Things were tough over there! I'm going to have to abandon this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I knew I could count on you for this. I've uploaded the location of the deadspace pocket to your NeoCom. All you need to do is head there and destroy the repair ships. The gate itself is probably too tough for you to destroy on your own. After all, that's why we left it there before.

Just remember, this gate is in a contested system. That means pod pilots flying for the Amarr might try to stop you. Be careful.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Sure thing. What needs destroyed today?

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Amarr Empire has a gate hidden in a deadspace pocket. The gate has been offline for a while, and has fallen into some disrepair. Now it seems that the Empire is trying to get it back on. Head over to the gate and destroy the repair ships before they can get it back online. Oh, and be careful. We've received word that capsuleers working for the Amarr have been spotted in the area.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work. I am impressed. The Amarr will probably think twice before trying to reactivate that gate again. I'm sure that will put a serious crimp in their plans for the area.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Nothing major, which is why you're getting the job. Prove to us you can handle this and we'll have plenty more to throw you later on. Screw up, however, and it's going on your record.

We've got an Imperial Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. If we allow them room to breathe, they'll have Navy Battleships and perhaps even more entrenched in the system within a week. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen.

Fly over there and kill that commander and any of his guards present. Without him calling the shots, his people will fall back to regroup, and that buys us enough time to reinforce the area properly with skilled pilots.

Briefing's over, rookie: move your ass.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Mission complete. The Field Commander and his guards have been dealt with.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Fine, I'll get someone more capable. A word of advice: don't repeat this display of cowardice and uselessness. We don't tolerate such things in the Republic.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I had a suspicion you would balk at the thought of live combat. You'd best sort your act out, rookie.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry, I won't let you down.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Imperial Navy combat units have become increasingly bold with their incursions into Minmatar Republic sovereign space. At times, the Field Commanders in charge of their small units are not even on authorized missions, dangerous as such a thing is inside the Empire. Grabs for glory and personal vendettas make for a very disturbing trend when inside one of the largest navies in existence.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, this doesn't interest me one bit.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't finish this mission, there's too many hostiles getting in my way.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: See that you do not.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I'm here. What's the problem?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've got an Imperial Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there; kill that commander and any of his guards present. This should scatter their forces long enough for our own reinforcements to arrive.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Not bad, rookie. Not bad at all. You've a long way left to go to prove your worth, however.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Alright then, I suppose I've got something for you.

We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. They've either had to maintain comms silence to avoid being detected or they've been forced to engage prematurely.

In any case, get your ass out there. Those are good men and women putting their lives on the line. I want them supported in any way possible.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I just made it back, is everything ok now?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Sorry for the let down? Is that all you have to say? They're probably dead or cornered and that's all you offer me? Keep that callous attitude up and you'll find yourself barred from any further work inside our borders.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Useless. Don't offer your services unless you intend to provide them wherever and whenever you are asked to!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: On my way!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The life of a reconnaissance pilot is fraught with real and present danger at all times. Since even the slightest mistake can cost an entire squadron their lives, operations behind enemy lines are a task carried out by some of the most disciplined and battle-hardened pilots each empire has.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Oh…sorry, I won't be able to leave immediately. You better find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I can't make it out to them after all. Sorry for the let down.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Keep your comms line open, I'll be relaying further information when you give me a clear picture of the situation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I've come for work, yes.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. Get your ass out there. I want them supported in any way possible.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes, they succeeded in clearing the area of hostiles just moments ago. Good work out there rookie, keep it up.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The task I have for you today is an important one. It is significant not only in strategic terms, but also a test of your loyalty.

We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Amarrian vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Empire forces. They must be dealt with.

Fortunately for us, there is a small window of opportunity where we can strike at them. Repaired ships that are awaiting further deployment usually stand on guard at the facility. However, the large majority of them have been recalled to another higher priority assignment. We have a chance to strike here, rookie. Will you help the Republic?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have done as you asked, the facility has been destroyed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Then you are of no use to us. Save me your confused ramblings on morality, we have a war to win here and I will do what it takes to serve that end.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Your very refusal has assured that you will be. If you think those ships they repair do not target civilian structures of our own then you are a fool. I will get someone else for the job, your short-sighted and confused morality changes nothing except our perceptions of your worth to our cause.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: They are assisting the Amarrians, as you said. I see no reason to decline. Give me the coordinates.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: In a time of war, there are very few people who will not find themselves caught in the crossfire. Civilians and non-combatants who directly assist armed forces are invariably seen as valid targets – no empire will risk letting their efforts go unhindered. In such dark times, necessity always takes precedent over morality.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't care what the circumstances are; I will not be a party in the murder of civilians.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've changed my mind. I cannot do what you've asked of me.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I am glad to see you understand the situation fully. Report back to me when you have finished the assignment.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am. Tell me how I can serve.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Amarrian vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Empire forces. They must be dealt with.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, rookie. There is hope for you yet. You have proven today that you understand the realities of the conflict ahead. Your loyalty will not go unnoticed.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Those damn Amarr. Always up to something sneaky. Thankfully we've enough spies in their midst to keep them from pulling off anything too big. One of those spies just reported that the Empire is trying to construct a starbase inside a nearby contested system.

A fully functioning starbase can cause us a huge headache. They're tough and require a lot of manpower to destroy. Because of our spies we have a first strike advantage. The starbase hasn't been completed yet, and the idiot Amarr have filled their main reactor full of fuel.

If you head over there and destroy the reactor, the entire starbase will blow. Do you think you can do this for me?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed the reactor and the starbase went up like a Day of Freedom celebration!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I suppose I can send someone else to finish the job.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Don't you think you can handle this?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Blowing up a reactor is what I've been dreaming of! Count me in.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Whoa, maybe I can't take that on.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: That starbase reactor was tougher than I expected.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good deal. I've uploaded the location to your NeoCom. There will be some defenses there, but they shouldn't be too difficult for you. However, pod pilots working for the Empire may be flying in the area. Prepare yourself to face them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Whatever you've got, I can take it on.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Amarr Empire is trying to set up a starbase inside one of the contested systems. If they manage to get it up and running, they'll have a staging point from which to launch further attacks against us. Luckily, it is not yet fully operational and has a highly explosive reactor that is just waiting to be destroyed.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Head over there and destroy the reactor. Just watch out for the pod pilots working for the Empire. They will try to stop you if they can.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work. I wish I could have been there to see that thing go. I bet it was quite a display! Hopefully, this will set the Amarr back and make them hesitate before trying to set up a starbase here again!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As you're probably aware, in order to coordinate military operations at the front lines, the Minmatar have deployed a series of FTL communications relays at the edge of the forward line of battle. Eliminating these communications relays and throwing a wrench into enemy operations has been made a top priority by the general staff.

Naval Intelligence has been able to locate one of these tactical relays being used to coordinate raids on our shipping. Right now, it is only lightly defended, but we don't have any forces available to take it out. I've been asked to look for capsuleers like yourself to eliminate the relay. Think you're up for it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the tactical relay.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Not every mission is glory and fame, pilot.  Total victory is but an amalgam of many small, seemingly insignificant victories; that's something you will need to learn eventually.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That relay is as good as gone.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds a bit small-time to me.  I think I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, get out of there as quickly as you can. Reinforcements will probably be sent to the area as soon as the thing goes down.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Minmatar have deployed a series of tactical FTL relays along the front lines in order to coordinate their operations. Naval Intelligence has located one nearby-- it's being used to stage raids against our convoys. Unfortunately, no regular naval forces are available for a fast strike, so we're looking to you to take care of this for us.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Minmatar Tactical Relay, and return to your agent.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. This should take a bit of pressure off our supply convoys. I'll make sure command realizes your contribution.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've been taking some heavy losses in the last few weeks along this area of the front. An enemy frigate squadron has been hitting our ships hard, taking out stragglers and scouts and then fading into space before we can counterattack, and it's starting to take its toll not only on our physical resources but an even heavier one on our morale. Our captains are getting too cautious, too unwilling to push for gains, and our general staff is getting concerned that the front will be stalled because of this. This is unacceptable.

Naval Intelligence believes that the person behind these attacks is the local Minmatar sector commander. Eliminating him will hopefully end these attacks, give our forces a morale boost, and shift the momentum in this sector back to our side. Because of our problems with morale, we aren't sure that regular naval forces can handle this job; we'd like you to deal with this problem for us.

We've located a rendezvous point that this commander is going to be using for staging his next series of raids. You will need to fly there, eliminate his ship, and then report in. There will likely be a significant enemy presence there aside from the sector commander and his direct escort, so be prepared for a protracted battle.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the sector commander.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: He's as good as dead.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Remember, this commander is an expert at surprise attacks, so don't let him sneak up on you.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Amarr forces in this sector have been taking heavy losses from enemy hit and run attacks on our fleets, damaging morale and stalling our offensives. Naval Intelligence believes that these attacks are being masterminded by the local Minmatar sector commander, and has determined that our best option for ending these attacks is to eliminate him.

We have located a staging point that the sector commander is using for his attacks. You need to fly to these coordinates and wait for the commander and his escort to arrive, then eliminate him. Be aware that you may need to engage multiple groups of enemy forces while waiting, so be prepared for a protracted battle. Return to your agent when the sector commander has been destroyed.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great work, pilot. We'll make sure that word of your victory is spread to the rest of our forces; that will help morale more than you can realize.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Navy's general staff is planning an offensive against Minmatar positions in this sector, but Naval Intelligence is having difficulty piercing the veil of enemy counterintelligence. Optimally, we'd like to get a better idea of Minmatar positions, communications codes, fleet readiness and their own intelligence estimates of our disposition, but they've been working hard to keep us from getting our hands on anything more than a vague picture.

We've decided to try a bit of an end-run around their counterintelligence screen. We know where they have a secure datastore in an area of deadspace. We're going to send you in to recover the information from the datastore, but we'll only have a short window for this, so you'll need to move quickly. Can you handle that?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I think I've found what you were looking for. Is this it?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: This war isn't going to get any easier, pilot.  You'd better start thinking whether or not you're really cut out for this line of work.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll leave immediately.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds pretty dicey. I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Return here as soon as you get the data.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Navy is planning a new offensive against Republic positions, but Naval Intelligence has been unable to make headway getting the information necessary to plan a coordinated strike. In order to get the intelligence we need, we're going to need you to make a raid on a secure enemy datastore.

You'll need to jump into the deadspace area, eliminate the defenders, and recover the Tactical Information Sheet from the datastore. Once you've got it, bring it back to your agent so that Naval Intelligence can analyze it in preparation for the offensive.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work, pilot. I'll pass this up the chain to Naval Intelligence. Drinks are on us tonight.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I'm glad you're here, pilot. It's come to my attention that the Minmatar have a relay station in a nearby contested system. The station is being used to send monitor classified Empire transmissions and then transmit them back to Minmatar space, where their code-breakers can get to work figuring out what we mean. So far, we haven't had an opportunity to strike at it directly, and it's unlikely we'll get one soon.

However, we've received intelligence that the Minmatar have dispatched a convoy to resupply the station. If we can destroy that convoy, we'll hamper their spying operations for at least a short period of time.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That station won't be seeing new supplies any time soon.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That relay station is causing serious problems for us. I'll have to get someone else to stop them.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Is destroying a few industrials really that difficult? I suppose I'll have to find someone else to complete this mission for me.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Blowing up some supply industrials? Sounds easy enough.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I can't do that for you.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I have to abandon your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew you would be up for it, pilot. The convoy is lightly guarded and the only important targets are their industrials. Once you destroy them, you can get out of there or mop up as needed. Just remember, because the system is contested, pod pilots working for the Minmatar may try to stop you. Be sure that your ship is set up to counter them as well.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Yes.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Minmatar are resupplying one of their relay stations in a nearby contested system-- it's due to run out soon and the convoy dispatched to resupply it hasn't arrived yet. Your job is to intercept the convoy and destroy the industrials before they have a chance to complete their mission.

The mission shouldn't be too difficult, as long as you don't encounter any pod pilots fighting for the Minmatar. You should fit your ship to defend itself from other pod pilots just in case.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work. I knew I could count on you. With that relay station out of commission, our local transmissions will be harder for the Minmatar to intercept, at least until they manage to sneak another convoy in there.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Amarr has located numerous hidden asteroid belts that we mine for the betterment of the Empire. Usually, these locations are known only to us... even if they're not technically in our sovereign space. However, it seems the Minmatar have sent some miners into one of our fields in an area of space they consider "theirs"; while we've been busy with other things, they've been sneaking in and mining our ore!

This situation is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. I want you to go out there and destroy those miners and show them that the Empire is always watching. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Matari scum: They're sure to be in the area.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed those miners. Our asteroids are safe for now!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm disappointed in you. I didn't think you would have trouble.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It doesn't matter what those thieves do as their day jobs, they won't get away from me!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I can't do that to those poor miners!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I cannot complete your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Remember, the belt is in a contested system, so pod pilots working for the Republic may try to stop you. Make sure you prepare for them above all else.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am always ready to earn an honest buck. Sometimes a not-so-honest one too.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Some pesky miners working for the Minmatar Republic have managed to discover one of our hidden asteroid belts. This is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. Head out there and destroy those miners, then report back to me. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Republic.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great. That should teach them to try to take what belongs to the Empire! Hopefully, we won't have any more problems with those miners, but knowing the Minmatar, I doubt this'll be the end of it. Oh well, we'll just send you in again if need be!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We recently discovered a hidden gate belonging to the Minmatar Republic in a nearby deadspace pocket. A capsuleer working for us managed to take the guards out some time ago, after which we then sent in forces to deactivate it. For a while, it seemed like the Republic would simply abandon the gate.

Unfortunately, that's not the case. We've detected a squad of ships heading to the gate to initiate repairs on the gate and reactivate it, probably so they can more easily move forces into the area. Luckily, it will take them quite some time to get it operational. We want you to head out there and stop them before they can. Can you handle this?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those repair ships were no problem. Mission accomplished.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Now I'll have to find someone else to stop them! I hope we still have time.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry. I'll make sure that gate stays deactivated!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That sounds a bit tougher than I can handle.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Things were tough over there! I'm going to have to abandon this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I knew I could count on you for this. I've uploaded the location of the deadspace pocket to your NeoCom. All you need to do is head there and destroy the repair ships. The gate itself is probably too tough for you to destroy on your own. After all, that's why we left it there before.

Just remember, this gate is in a contested system. That means pod pilots flying for the Republic might try to stop you. Be careful.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Sure thing. What needs destroyed today?

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Minmatar Republic has a gate hidden in a deadspace pocket. The gate has been offline for a while, and has fallen into some disrepair. Now it seems that the Republic is trying to get it back on. Head over to the gate and destroy the repair ships before they can get it back online. Oh, and be careful. We've received word that capsuleers working for the Republic have been spotted in the area.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work. I am impressed. The Minmatar will probably think twice before trying to reactivate that gate again. I'm sure that will put a serious crimp in their plans for the area.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Nothing major, which is why you're getting the job. Prove to us you can handle this and we'll have plenty more to throw you later on. Screw up, however, and it's going on your record.

We've got a Republic Fleet Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. If we allow them room to breathe, they'll have Fleet battleships and perhaps even more entrenched in the system within a week.

You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there and kill that commander and any of his guards present. Without him calling the shots, his people will fall back to regroup, and that buys us enough time to reinforce the area properly.

Briefing's over, rookie: move your ass.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Mission Complete. The Field Commander and his guards have been dealt with.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Fine, I'll get someone more capable. A word of advice: don't repeat this display of cowardice and uselessness. We don't tolerate such a gross lack of faith in our glorious Empire.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I had a suspicion you would balk at the thought of live combat. You best sort your act out, rookie.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry, I won't let you down.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Minmatar combat units have become increasingly bold with their incursions into Amarr Empire sovereign space, even after the Elder Fleet's recent defeat at Jamyl Sarum's hands. At times, Amarr field commanders in charge of small units are not even on authorized missions; tribal vendettas and raids to recover Matari slaves are usually at the root of these sorties.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, this doesn't interest me one bit.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't finish this mission, there's too many hostiles getting in my way.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: See that you do not.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I'm here. What's the problem?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've got Minmatar Republic Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there; kill that commander and any of his guards present. This should scatter their forces long enough for our own reinforcements to arrive.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Not bad, rookie. Not bad at all. You've a long way left to go to prove your worth however.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Alright then, I suppose I've got something for you.

We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. They've either had to maintain comms silence to avoid being detected or they've been forced to engage prematurely.

In any case, get your ass out there. Those are good men and women putting their lives on the line. I want them supported in any way possible.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I just made it back, is everything ok now?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Sorry for the let down? Is that all you have to say? They're probably dead or cornered and that's all you offer me? Keep that callous attitude up and you'll find yourself barred from any further work inside our borders.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Useless. Don't offer your services unless you intend to provide them wherever and whenever you are asked to!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: On my way!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The life of a reconnaissance pilot is fraught with real and present danger at all times. Since even the slightest mistake can cost an entire squadron their lives, operations behind enemy lines are a task carried out by some of the most disciplined and battle-hardened pilots each empire has.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Oh…sorry, I won't be able to leave immediately. You better find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I can't make it out to them after all. Sorry for the let down.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Keep your comms line open, I'll be relaying further information when you give me a clear picture of the situation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I've come for work, yes.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. Get your ass out there. I want them supported in any way possible.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes, they succeeded in clearing the area of hostiles just moments ago. Good work out there rookie, keep it up.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The task I have for you today is an important one. It is significant not only in strategic terms, but also a test of your loyalty.

We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Minmatar vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Republic forces. They must be dealt with.

Fortunately for us, there is a small window of opportunity where we can strike at them. Repaired ships that are awaiting further deployment usually stand on guard at the facility. However, the large majority of them have been recalled to another higher priority assignment. We have a chance to strike here, rookie. Will you help the Empire?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have done as you asked, the facility has been destroyed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Then you are of no use to us. Save me your confused ramblings on morality, we have a war to win here and I will do what it takes to serve that end.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Your very refusal has assured that you will be. If you think those ships they repair do not target civilian structures of our own then you are a fool. I will get someone else for the job, your short-sighted and confused morality changes nothing except our perceptions of your worth to our cause.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: They are assisting the Republic, as you said. I see no reason to decline. Give me the coordinates.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: In a time of war, there are very few people who will not find themselves caught in the crossfire. Civilians and non-combatants who directly assist armed forces are invariably seen as valid targets – no empire will risk letting their efforts go unhindered. In such dark times, necessity always takes precedent over morality.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't care what the circumstances are; I will not be a party in the murder of civilians.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've changed my mind. I cannot do what you've asked of me.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I am glad to see you understand the situation fully. Report back to me when you have finished the assignment.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am. Tell me how I can serve.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Minmatar vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Republic forces. They must be dealt with.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, rookie. There is hope for you yet. You have proven today that you understand the realities of the conflict ahead. Your loyalty and faith will not go unnoticed.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Those damn Minmatar. Always up to something sneaky. Thankfully we've enough spies in their midst to keep them from pulling off anything too big. One of those spies just reported that the Republic is trying to construct a starbase inside a nearby contested system.

A fully functioning starbase can cause us a huge headache. They're tough and require a lot of manpower to destroy. Because of our spies we have a first strike advantage. The starbase hasn't been completed yet, and the idiot Minmatar have filled their main reactor full of fuel.

If you head over there and destroy the reactor, the entire starbase will blow. Do you think you can do this for me?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed the reactor and the starbase went up like an Emperor's Birthday celebration!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I suppose I can send someone else to finish the job.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Don't you think you can handle this?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Blowing up a reactor is what I've been dreaming of! Count me in.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Whoa, maybe I can't take that on.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: That starbase reactor was tougher than I expected.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good deal. I've uploaded the location to your NeoCom. There will be some defenses there, but they shouldn't be too difficult for you. However, pod pilots working for the Republic may be flying in the area. Prepare yourself to face them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Whatever you've got, I can take it on.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Minmatar Republic is trying to set up a starbase inside one of the contested systems. If they manage to get it up and running, they'll have a staging point from which to launch further attacks against us. Luckily, it is not yet fully operational and has a highly explosive reactor that is just waiting to be destroyed.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Head over there and destroy the reactor. Just watch out for the pod pilots working for the Republic. They will try to stop you if they can.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work. I wish I could have been there to see that thing go. I bet it was quite a display! Hopefully, this will set the Minmatar back and make them hesitate before trying to set up a starbase here again!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I've been asked to help the Customs Authority apprehend a group of smugglers trying to get some military-grade sensor components out of the State where they can sell them to the highest bidder. They've sent us a list of possible targets and we've been tracking them; one of the suspect vessels has just entered our jurisdiction. I'd like you to intercept this ship; once you're there, we'll let you know if that's the one we're looking for. If it is, you'll need to disable the vessel, apprehend the crew, and confiscate the sensor components, which are being carried in small secure containers. Can you handle that for me?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I managed to catch the smugglers and capture their cargo. Had to deal with a few miscreants along the way, though.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Unfortunate. Those smugglers will be selling those sensor components on the black market soon enough, I'm sure. We'll have to find some other way to deal with this.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, sorry it's not your cup of tea, but someone's got to do it, after all. I'll see if I can't find something more your speed for next time.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Just leave it to me, {[character]agentID.name}. I'll catch those smugglers.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The CCA is a division of the Caldari Business Tribunal, which is the only nationwide law enforcement agency in the Caldari State. The CCA is in charge of policing trade at the borders of Caldari space and enforcing any customs duties or tariffs, though the State generally has few of those with both the Liberal and Practical factions both being free trade advocates. However, the CCA tends to be short-staffed, despite being adequately funded, and as a result they often outsource customs duties to the Navy or corporate security forces, who will in turn sometimes subcontract to individual pod-pilots. In general, customs duties are a low priority (and sometimes an obstruction) for many of the Caldari megacorporations' operations, so they tend to be pushed upon pilots and officers towards the low end of the totem pole.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't really feel like playing the State's meter maid today.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm not going to have time to take care of this penny-ante business, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Good hunting out there, {[character]player.name}. Keep an eye out for anyone that might come to their aid; you don't want to be caught in an ambush.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I might be. What's the job?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We need you to intercept a possible group of smugglers trying to get out of the State with some military-grade sensor components in secure storage containers. You'll need to fly to the intercept point and wait for our signal. If it's the right ship, we want you to disable the vessel and take possession of the cargo and crew. Bring them back to your agent, and he'll turn them over to the proper authorities.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I couldn't hold this mission for you any longer, {[character]player.name}; those smugglers were going to get away if we didn't do something and fast. Next time, please let me know if you're going to be able to help or not; we managed to catch them this time, but it won't always work out that way.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}. You handled that admirably; I've got another mission for you, if you're interested. Just let me know when you're ready.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: We've been asked by the Customs Authority to intercept a transport ship that has been tracked coming from the Amarr Empire that they believe is carrying a cargo of slaves, which is of course illegal here in the State. They have intelligence that this ship may be linked to a splinter sect of the Blood Raider cults, so you'll need to keep a lookout for trouble when you're trying to apprehend them. Think you can handle this for me?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've recovered the slave cargo, {[character]agentID.name}, and it looks like the ship did belong to the Blood Raiders. They've been dealt with.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Great things come from many small deeds. Hopefully someday you'll realize that.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Someone has to do it, and not every mission is an easy one. In the future, I hope you'll realize the obligation that we all have to do our small part for the State.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take care of it, no problem.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Cult of the Lash is a splinter sect of the Blood Raiders. The center of their belief is that the amount of pain and suffering in the universe is a constant, and that therefore they must inflict as much pain on others to reduce the amount of suffering visited upon the rest of humanity, especially themselves. Their most frequent victims are captured crews and slaves from their raids upon Amarr colonies, due to their special contempt for the Amarr faith, but they have been expanding their raids into other areas of the cluster. Like the main Blood Raider cult, the Cult of Lash actually has small groups of adherents secreted away in almost every region of the cluster, practicing in secret on kidnapped members of dispossessed classes.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Blood Raiders? I don't think this is really my line of work. I'll pass.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: On second thought, I've decided I'm not interested in being the Customs Authority's errand boy.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Glad to hear it. I'll see you when you return.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What's the job?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've been asked by the Customs Authority to intercept a transport ship that has been tracked coming from the Amarr Empire that they believe is carrying a cargo of slaves, which is of course illegal here in the State. They have intelligence that this ship may be linked to a splinter sect of the Blood Raider cults, so you'll need to keep a lookout for trouble when you're trying to apprehend them.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work. You've helped us smash a dangerous cult of Blood Raiders; against such a dangerous menace, every small victory helps.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: If you aren't going to get back to me, pilot, you give me no choice but to turn to other pilots to take care of my jobs. Thankfully, the pilot I selected for this mission managed to take care of the job with aplomb-- she broke up the Blood Raider cult behind this smuggling operation. Next time, please let me know if you won't be able to take care of the job promptly, instead of letting me hang.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As you're probably aware, in order to coordinate military operations at the front lines, the Gallente have deployed a series of FTL communications relays at the edge of the forward line of battle. Eliminating these communications relays and throwing a wrench into enemy operations has been made a top priority by the general staff.

Naval Intelligence has been able to locate one of these tactical relays being used to coordinate raids on our shipping. Right now, it is only lightly defended, but we don't have any forces available to take it out. I've been asked to look for capsuleers like yourself to eliminate the relay. Think you're up for it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the tactical relay.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Not every mission is glory and fame, pilot.  Total victory is but an amalgam of many small, seemingly insignificant victories; that's something you will need to learn eventually.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That relay is as good as gone.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds a bit small-time to me.  I think I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, get out of there as quickly as you can. Reinforcements will probably be sent to the area as soon as the thing goes down.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Gallente have deployed a series of tactical FTL relays along the front lines in order to coordinate their operations. Naval Intelligence has located one nearby-- it's being used to stage raids against our convoys. Unfortunately, no regular naval forces are available for a fast strike, so we're looking to you to take care of this for us.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Gallente Tactical Relay, and return to your agent.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. This should take a bit of pressure off our supply convoys. I'll make sure command realizes your contribution.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've been taking some heavy losses in the last few weeks along this area of the front. An enemy frigate squadron has been hitting our ships hard, taking out stragglers and scouts and then fading into space before we can counterattack, and it's starting to take its toll not only on our physical resources but an even heavier one on our morale. Our captains are getting too cautious, too unwilling to push for gains, and our general staff is getting concerned that the front will be stalled because of this. This is unacceptable.

Naval Intelligence believes that the person behind these attacks is the local Gallente sector commander. Eliminating him will hopefully end these attacks, give our forces a morale boost, and shift the momentum in this sector back to our side. Because of our problems with morale, we aren't sure that regular naval forces can handle this job; we'd like you to deal with this problem for us.

We've located a rendezvous point that this commander is going to be using for staging his next series of raids. You will need to fly there, eliminate his ship, and then report in. There will likely be a significant enemy presence there aside from the sector commander and his direct escort, so be prepared for a protracted battle.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the sector commander.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: He's as good as dead.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Remember, this commander is an expert at surprise attacks, so don't let him sneak up on you.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Caldari forces in this sector have been taking heavy losses from enemy hit and run attacks on our fleets, damaging morale and stalling our offensives. Naval Intelligence believes that these attacks are being masterminded by the local Gallente sector commander, and has determined that our best option for ending these attacks is to eliminate him.

We have located a staging point that the sector commander is using for these attacks. You need to fly to these coordinates and wait for the commander and his escort to arrive, then eliminate him. Be aware that you may need to engage multiple groups of enemy forces while waiting, so be prepared for a protracted battle. Return to your agent when the sector commander has been destroyed.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great work, pilot. We'll make sure that word of your victory is spread to the rest of our forces; that should help morale more than you can realize.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Navy's general staff is planning an offensive against Gallente positions in this sector, but Naval Intelligence is having difficulty piercing the veil of enemy counterintelligence. Optimally, we'd like to get a better idea of Gallente positions, communications codes, fleet readiness and their own intelligence estimates of our disposition, but they've been working hard to keep us from getting our hands on anything more than a vague picture.

We've decided to try a bit of an end-run around their counterintelligence screen. We know where they have a secure datastore in an area of deadspace. We're going to send you in to recover the information from the datastore, but we'll only have a short window for this, so you'll need to move quickly. Can you handle that?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I think I've found what you were looking for. Is this it?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: This war isn't going to get any easier, pilot.  You'd better start thinking whether or not you're really cut out for this line of work.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll leave immediately.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds pretty dicey. I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Return here as soon as you get the data.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Navy is planning a new offensive against Federation positions, but State Intelligence has been unable to make headway getting the information necessary to plan a coordinated strike. In order to get the intelligence we need, we're going to need you to make a raid on a secure enemy datastore.

You'll need to jump into the deadspace area, eliminate the defenders, and recover the Tactical Information Sheet from the datastore. Once you've got it, bring it back to your agent so that State Intelligence can analyze it in preparation for the offensive.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work, pilot. I'll pass this up the chain to Naval Intelligence. Drinks are on us tonight.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I'm glad you're here, pilot. It's come to my attention that the Gallente have a relay station in a nearby contested system. The station is being used to monitor classified State transmissions and then transmit them back to Gallente space, where their code-breakers can get to work figuring out what we mean. So far, we haven't had an opportunity to strike at it directly, and it's unlikely we'll get one soon.

However, we've received intelligence that the Gallente have dispatched a convoy to resupply the station. If we can destroy that convoy, we'll hamper their spying operations for at least a short period of time.
