messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That station won't be seeing new supplies any time soon.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That relay station is causing serious problems for us. I'll have to get someone else to stop them.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Is destroying a few industrials really that difficult? I suppose I'll have to find someone else to complete this mission for me.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Blowing up some supply industrials? Sounds easy enough.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I can't do that for you.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I have to abandon your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew you would be up for it, pilot. The convoy is lightly guarded and the only important targets are their industrials. Once you destroy them, you can get out of there or mop up as needed. Just remember, because the system is contested, pod pilots working for the Gallente may try to stop you. Be sure that your ship is set up to counter them as well.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: How may I serve?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Gallente are resupplying one of their relay stations in a nearby contested system-- it's due to run out soon and the convoy dispatched to resupply it hasn't arrived yet. Your job is to intercept the convoy and destroy the industrials before they have a chance to complete their mission.

The mission shouldn't be too difficult, as long as you don't encounter any pod pilots fighting for the Gallente. You should fit your ship to defend itself from other pod pilots just in case.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work. I knew I could count on you. With that relay station out of commission, our local transmissions will be harder for the Gallente to intercept, at least until they manage to sneak another convoy in there.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The State has numerous asteroid belts secreted away, from which our miners provide resources for the war effort. Usually, these sites don't get touched by anyone except us and the companies we contract out to mine them. However, it seems the Gallente have recently sent some miners in to steal our asteroids. This is unacceptable.

I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. I want you to go out there and destroy those miners; show them that we're always vigilant. Just be ready for any Federation-sponsored pod pilots: They've been reported in the area.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed those miners. Our asteroids are safe for now!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm disappointed in you. I didn't think you would have trouble.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It doesn't matter what those thieves do as their day jobs, they won't get away from me!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I can't do that to those poor miners!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I cannot complete your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Remember, the belt is in a contested system, so pod pilots working for the Federation may try to stop you. Make sure you prepare for them above all else.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am always ready to earn an honest buck. Sometimes a not-so-honest one too.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Some pesky miners working for the Gallente Federation have managed to discover one of our hidden asteroid belts. This is unacceptable. I've uploaded the location of the belt to your NeoCom. Head out there and destroy those miners, then report back to me. Just prepare yourself for any pod pilots working for the Federation.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great. That should teach them to try to take what belongs to the State! Hopefully, we won't have any more problems with those pesky miners, but knowing the Gallente, I doubt this'll be the end of it. Oh well, we'll just send you in again if need be!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We recently discovered a hidden gate belonging to the Gallente Federation in a nearby deadspace pocket. A capsuleer working for us managed to take the guards out some time ago, after which we then sent in forces to deactivate it. For a while, it seemed like the Federation would simply abandon the gate.

Unfortunately, that's not the case. We've detected a squad of ships heading to the gate to initiate repairs on the gate and reactivate it, probably so they can more easily move forces into the area. Luckily, it will take them quite some time to get it operational. We want you to head out there and stop them before they can. Can you handle this?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those repair ships were no problem. Mission accomplished.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Now I'll have to find someone else to stop them! I hope we still have time.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry. I'll make sure that gate stays deactivated!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That sounds a bit tougher than I can handle.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Things were tough over there! I'm going to have to abandon this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I knew I could count on you for this. I've uploaded the location of the deadspace pocket to your NeoCom. All you need to do is head there and destroy the repair ships. The gate itself is probably too tough for you to destroy on your own. After all, that's why we left it there before.

Just remember, this gate is in a contested system. That means pod pilots flying for the Federation might try to stop you. Be careful.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Sure thing. What needs destroyed today?

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Gallente Federation has a gate hidden in a deadspace pocket. The gate has been offline for a while, and has fallen into some disrepair. Now it seems that the Federation is trying to get it back on. Head over to the gate and destroy the repair ships before they can get it back online. Oh, and be careful. We've received word that capsuleers working for the Federation have been spotted in the area.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work. I am impressed. The Gallente will probably think twice before trying to reactivate that gate again. I'm sure that will put a serious crimp in their plans for the area.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Nothing major, which is why you're getting the job. Prove to us you can handle this and we'll have plenty more to throw you later on. Screw up, however, and it's going on your record.

We've got a Federation Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. If we allow them room to breathe, they'll have Navy battleships, and perhaps even more, entrenched in the system within a week.

You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there and kill that commander and any of his guards present. Without him calling the shots, his people will fall back to regroup, and that buys us enough time to reinforce the area.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Mission Complete. The Field Commander and his guards have been dealt with.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Fine, I'll get someone more capable. A word of advice: don't repeat this display of cowardice and uselessness. We don't tolerate that crap in the State.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I had a suspicion you would balk at the thought of live combat. You best sort your act out, rookie.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry, I won't let you down.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Gallente Federation combat units have become increasingly bold flying into Caldari sovereign space. At times, the commanders in charge of their small units are not even on authorized missions: Glory and revenge are strong motivators. Though the problem is by no means significant or crippling, the individualism for which Gallenteans are known has found its way even into the Federation Navy.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, this doesn't interest me one bit.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't finish this mission; there're too many hostiles getting in my way.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: See that you do not.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I'm here. What's the problem?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've got a Federation Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there; kill that commander and any of his guards present. This should scatter their forces long enough for our own reinforcements to arrive.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Not bad, rookie. Not bad at all. You've a long way left to go to prove your worth, however.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Alright then, I suppose I've got something for you.

We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. They've either had to maintain comms silence to avoid being detected or they've been forced to engage prematurely.

In any case, get your ass out there. Those are good men and women putting their lives on the line. I want them supported in any way possible.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I just made it back, is everything ok now?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Sorry for the let down? Is that all you have to say? They're probably dead or cornered and that's all you offer me? Keep that callous attitude up and you'll find yourself barred from any further work inside our borders.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Useless. Don't offer your services unless you intend to provide them wherever and whenever you are asked to!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: On my way!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The life of a reconnaissance pilot is fraught with real and present danger at all times. Since even the slightest mistake can cost an entire squadron their lives, operations behind enemy lines are a task carried out by some of the most disciplined and battle-hardened pilots each empire has.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Oh…sorry, I won't be able to leave immediately. You better find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I can't make it out to them after all. Sorry for the let down.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Keep your comms line open, I'll be relaying further information when you give me a clear picture of the situation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I've come for work, yes.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. Get your ass out there. I want them supported in any way possible.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes, they succeeded in clearing the area of hostiles just moments ago. Good work out there rookie, keep it up.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The task I have for you today is an important one. It is significant not only in strategic terms, but also a test of your loyalty.

We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Federation vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Federation forces. They must be dealt with.

Fortunately for us, there is a small window of opportunity where we can strike at them. Repaired ships that are awaiting further deployment usually stand on guard at the facility. However, the large majority of them have been recalled to another higher priority assignment. We have a chance to strike here, rookie. Will you help the Caldari?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have done as you asked, the facility has been destroyed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Then you are of no use to us. Save me your confused ramblings on morality, we have a war to win here and I will do what it takes to serve that end.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Your very refusal has assured that you will be. If you think those ships they repair do not target civilian structures of our own then you are a fool. I will get someone else for the job, your short-sighted and confused morality changes nothing except our perceptions of your worth to our cause.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: They are assisting the Federation, as you said. I see no reason to decline. Give me the coordinates.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: In a time of war, there are very few people who will not find themselves caught in the crossfire. Civilians and non-combatants who directly assist armed forces are invariably seen as valid targets – no empire will risk letting their efforts go unhindered. In such dark times, necessity always takes precedent over morality.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't care what the circumstances are; I will not be a party in the murder of civilians.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've changed my mind. I cannot do what you've asked of me.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I am glad to see you understand the situation fully. Report back to me when you have finished the assignment.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am. Tell me how I can serve.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Federation vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting Federation forces. They must be dealt with.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, rookie. There is hope for you yet. You have proven today that you understand the realities of the conflict ahead. Your loyalty will not go unnoticed.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Those damn Gallente. Always up to something sneaky. Thankfully we've enough spies in their midst to keep them from pulling off anything too big. One of those spies just reported that the Federation is trying to construct a starbase inside a nearby contested system.

A fully functioning starbase can cause us a huge headache. They're tough and require a lot of manpower to destroy. Because of our spies we have a first strike advantage. The starbase hasn't been completed yet, and the idiot Gallente have filled their main reactor full of fuel.

If you head over there and destroy the reactor, the entire starbase will blow. Do you think you can do this for me?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed the reactor and the starbase went up like a State Independence celebration!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I suppose I can send someone else to finish the job.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Don't you think you can handle this?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Blowing up a reactor is what I've been dreaming of! Count me in.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Whoa, maybe I can't take that on.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: That starbase reactor was tougher than I expected.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good deal. I've uploaded the location to your NeoCom. There will be some defenses there, but they shouldn't be too difficult for you. However, pod pilots working for the Federation may be flying in the area. Prepare yourself to face them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Whatever you've got, I can take it on.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Gallente Federation is trying to set up a starbase inside one of the contested systems. If they manage to get it up and running, they'll have a staging point from which to launch further attacks against us. Luckily, it is not yet fully operational and has a highly explosive reactor that is just waiting to be destroyed.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Head over there and destroy the reactor. Just watch out for the pod pilots working for the Federation. They will try to stop you if they can.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work. I wish I could have been there to see that thing go. I bet it was quite a display! Hopefully, this will set the Gallente back and make them hesitate before trying to set up a starbase here again!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As you're probably aware, in order to coordinate military operations at the front lines, the Caldari have deployed a series of FTL communications relays at the edge of the forward line of battle. Eliminating these communications relays and throwing a wrench into enemy operations has been made a top priority by the general staff.

Naval Intelligence has been able to locate one of these tactical relays being used to coordinate raids on our shipping. Right now, it is only lightly defended, but we don't have any forces available to take it out. I've been asked to look for capsuleers like yourself to eliminate the relay. Think you're up for it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the tactical relay.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Not every mission is glory and fame, pilot.  Total victory is but an amalgam of many small, seemingly insignificant victories; that's something you will need to learn eventually.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That relay is as good as gone.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds a bit small-time to me.  I think I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, get out of there as quickly as you can. Reinforcements will probably be sent to the area as soon as the thing goes down.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Caldari have deployed a series of tactical FTL relays along the front lines in order to coordinate their operations. Naval Intelligence has located one nearby-- it's being used to stage raids against our convoys. Unfortunately, no regular naval forces are available for a fast strike, so we're looking to you to take care of this for us.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Caldari Tactical Relay, and return to your agent.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. This should take a bit of pressure off our supply convoys. I'll make sure command realizes your contribution.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We recently discovered a hidden gate belonging to the Caldari State in a nearby deadspace pocket. A capsuleer working for us managed to take the guards out some time ago, after which we then sent in forces to deactivate it. For a while, it seemed like the State would simply abandon the gate.

Unfortunately, that's not the case. We've detected a squad of ships heading to the gate to initiate repairs on the gate and reactivate it, probably so they can more easily move forces into the area. Luckily, it will take them quite some time to get it operational. We want you to head out there and stop them before they can. Can you handle this?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those repair ships were no problem. Mission accomplished.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Now I'll have to find someone else to stop them! I hope we still have time.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I suppose I'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry. I'll make sure that gate stays deactivated!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That sounds a bit tougher than I can handle.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Things were tough over there! I'm going to have to abandon this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I knew I could count on you for this. I've uploaded the location of the deadspace pocket to your NeoCom. All you need to do is head there and destroy the repair ships. The gate itself is probably too tough for you to destroy on your own. After all, that's why we left it there before.

Just remember, this gate is in a contested system. That means pod pilots flying for the State might try to stop you. Be careful.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Sure thing. What needs destroyed today?

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Caldari State has a gate hidden in a deadspace pocket. The gate has been offline for a while, and has fallen into some disrepair. Now it seems that the State is trying to get it back on. Head over to the gate and destroy the repair ships before they can get it back online. Oh, and be careful. We've received word that capsuleers working for the State have been spotted in the area.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work. I am impressed. The Caldari will probably think twice before trying to reactivate that gate again. I'm sure that will put a serious crimp in their plans for the area.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Nothing major, which is why you're getting the job. Prove to us you can handle this and we'll have plenty more to throw you later on. Screw up, however, and it's going on your record.

We've got a Caldari Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. If we allow them room to breathe, they might have Navy battleships and even worse entrenched in our system within a week. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen.

Fly over there and kill that commander and his guards. Without him calling the shots, his people will most likely fall back to regroup, and that buys us enough time to reinforce the area.

So, briefing's over rookie - move your ass!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Mission complete: The Field Commander and his guards have been dealt with.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I had a suspicion you would balk at the thought of live combat. You'd best sort your act out, rookie.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Caldari State combat units have little compunction about raiding into Gallente sovereign space; the State navy is perhaps the most disciplined in the universe, but anti-Gallentean sentiment currently runs very high, and even disciplined soldier occasionally let emotion overrule duty.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, this doesn't interest me one bit.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't finish this mission - too many hostiles in my way.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: See that you do not.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I'm here. What's the problem?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've got a Caldari Navy Field Commander who recently arrived inside our own borders. Communications taps have revealed plans to consolidate their position and move more ships in. You're going to see to it that this doesn't happen. Fly over there; kill that commander and any of his guards present. This should scatter their forces long enough for our own reinforcements to arrive.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Not bad, rookie. Not bad at all. You've a long way to go to prove your worth, however.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Alright then, I suppose I've got something for you.

We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. They've either had to maintain comms silence to avoid being detected or they've been forced to engage prematurely.

In any case, get your ass out there. Those are good men and women putting their lives on the line. I want them supported in any way possible.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I just made it back, is everything ok now?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Sorry for the let down? Is that all you have to say? They're probably dead or cornered and that's all you offer me? Keep that callous attitude up and you'll find yourself barred from any further work inside our borders.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Useless. Don't offer your services unless you intend to provide them wherever and whenever you are asked to!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: On my way!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The life of a reconnaissance pilot is fraught with real and present danger at all times. Since even the slightest mistake can cost an entire squadron their lives, operations behind enemy lines are a task carried out by some of the most disciplined and battle-hardened pilots each empire has.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Oh…sorry, I won't be able to leave immediately. You better find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I can't make it out to them after all. Sorry for the let down.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Keep your comms line open, I'll be relaying further information when you give me a clear picture of the situation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I've come for work, yes.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We just received a priority transmission from one of our Recon task forces currently operating inside hostile space. As per their orders, they were scouting the area for enemy forces and this is precisely what they've found. They sent out the call for reinforcements as they were unable to tackle them alone.

I relayed to them that we'd send some capsuleer assistance as soon as we could find someone, but I've not heard any further replies since. Get your ass out there. I want them supported in any way possible.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes, they succeeded in clearing the area of hostiles just moments ago. Good work out there rookie, keep it up.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The task I have for you today is an important one. It is significant not only in strategic terms, but also a test of your loyalty.

We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Caldari vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting State forces. They must be dealt with.

Fortunately for us, there is a small window of opportunity where we can strike at them. Repaired ships that are awaiting further deployment usually stand on guard at the facility. However, the large majority of them have been recalled to another higher priority assignment. We have a chance to strike here, rookie. Will you help the Federation?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have done as you asked, the facility has been destroyed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Then you are of no use to us. Save me your confused ramblings on morality, we have a war to win here and I will do what it takes to serve that end.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: They are assisting the Caldari, as you said. I see no reason to decline. Give me the coordinates.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: In a time of war, there are very few people who will not find themselves caught in the crossfire. Civilians and non-combatants who directly assist armed forces are invariably seen as valid targets – no empire will risk letting their efforts go unhindered. In such dark times, necessity always takes precedent over morality.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't care what the circumstances are; I will not be a party in the murder of civilians.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've changed my mind. I cannot do what you've asked of me.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I am glad to see you understand the situation fully. Report back to me when you have finished the assignment.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am. Tell me how I can serve.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We have identified a civilian facility inside a nearby contested sector that houses a great number of engineers and mechanics, all of whom assist with the repair of Caldari vessels far from their home stations. Though they may technically be non-combatants, these people are directly and unarguably assisting State forces. They must be dealt with.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Those damn Caldari. Always up to something sneaky. Thankfully we've enough spies in their midst to keep them from pulling off anything too big. One of those spies just reported that the State is trying to construct a starbase inside a nearby contested system.

A fully functioning starbase can cause us a huge headache. They're tough and require a lot of manpower to destroy. Because of our spies we have a first strike advantage. The starbase hasn't been completed yet, and the idiot Caldari have filled their main reactor full of fuel.

If you head over there and destroy the reactor, the entire starbase will blow. Do you think you can do this for me?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I suppose I can send someone else to finish the job.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Don't you think you can handle this?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Blowing up a reactor is what I've been dreaming of! Count me in.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Whoa, maybe I can't take that on.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: That starbase reactor was tougher than I expected.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good deal. I've uploaded the location to your NeoCom. There will be some defenses there, but they shouldn't be too difficult for you. However, pod pilots working for the State may be flying in the area. Prepare yourself to face them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Whatever you've got, I can take it on.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Caldari State is trying to set up a starbase inside one of the contested systems. If they manage to get it up and running, they'll have a staging point from which to launch further attacks against us. Luckily, it is not yet fully operational and has a highly explosive reactor that is just waiting to be destroyed.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Head over there and destroy the reactor. Just watch out for the pod pilots working for the State. They will try to stop you if they can.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I've destroyed the reactor and the starbase went up like a Federation Day celebration!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've identified the location of a Minmatar tactical relay being used by an enemy cruiser squadron operating in the area. This squadron has been making deep penetration raids over the last week, and our sector commander has decided that elimination of this relay is the first step towards containing these incursions.

Unfortunately, our regular naval forces have their hands full dealing with an enemy offensive several systems away and protecting our supply lines holding the line in that area. As a result, I've been tasked with finding a loyal capsuleer who can take care of the problem for us. We'd like for you to give it a shot.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the tactical relay.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I thought you were supposed to be some hotshot pilot. All talk, huh?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Even small actions are important, pilot. Just because you're not in the middle of a fleet battle doesn't mean you're not making an important contribution.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That relay is as good as gone.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds a bit small-time to me. I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: There's too many of them; I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. You'll have to find some other sucker for this one.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
An enemy cruiser squadron has been causing some serious trouble for our forces in this area. Unfortunately, we're also trying to deal with a Minmatar offensive in this sector, and that means that regular naval forces are stretched thin. In order to take some pressure off, we need you to take out the tactical relay that they are using to coordinate their activities. Hopefully, that will buy our fleet some time to deal with the offensive.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the tactical relay, and return to your agent.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. You've bought our fleet some time to hold the line here. I'll make sure the sector commander knows you were responsible.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As I'm sure you're already aware, pilot, one of the most precious resources a military force has is morale. Battles can be won or lost by it, and wars can be turned by it. That is why one of our top priorities has been the disruption of the enemy's morale.

Lately, the Minmatar have enjoyed a string of small but dramatic victories over our forces in this sector. Though the damage inflicted to our forces has been negligible, the enemy forces responsible for these actions, especially their commander, have been emboldened and now they are pushing their luck more and more.

The general staff has determined that striking a crippling blow to their morale will likely put an end to this nonsense once and for all. We want you to eliminate their commander. With any luck, this will scatter them to the winds and put an end to these raids.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The enemy commander has been eliminated, sir.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: This is war, pilot. It's not about your comfort.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll put an end to their winning streak, don't worry.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm really not comfortable with this.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Make sure you're ready for a protracted battle. You may have to wade through a number of enemy capsuleers.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
An enemy force has been launching increasingly bold attacks against us. They've been taking advantage of the fact that we have bigger troubles to deal with, and coming away victorious more often than not.

The general staff has decided to put an end to this campaign by striking a crippling blow to their morale. We want you to eliminate the enemy sector commander at these coordinates; all other targets are secondary.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well, that should put ‘em in their place. Nice work, pilot. I'll make sure the general staff knows you were responsible.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
You've got a real chance to be a hero here, pilot. The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Minmatar detention camp. The only problem is that we need to get intelligence on the distribution of enemy forces prior to the raid in order to pave the way for our strike force and the vulnerable transports that will need to be sent in with it. That's where you come in.

We know that one of the enemy fleets in this area has copies of the data that we need. You will need to penetrate their base of operations and retrieve the tactical information sheet from the outpost there. Bring that back to me and we can get the planning for this raid underway.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've got the information sheet. Does it have the data you're looking for?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope you can live with the lives of those prisoners on your conscience.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that intelligence for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm glad to hear it, pilot. Here's the coordinates; remember, that tactical information sheet is the primary objective. Any other damage is secondary.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Minmatar detention camp. In order to pave the way for the raid, we need to get information on the disposition of the enemy forces so that our strike force and the vulnerable transports coming with them can make it to the detention camp unmolested.

In order to get that intelligence, we need you to raid the base of an enemy force in this sector. We need you to get the tactical information sheet from the outpost and bring it back here in preparation for the prisoner raid.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work, pilot; I'll send this off to the boys at intel. With any luck, you've just given us what we need to bring some of our brave warriors home.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've been waiting for you to show up! We have a small problem. The Minmatar have a hidden supply depot inside a contested system. Normally, we would just go and destroy it, but we can't spare the manpower at the moment.

However, we've discovered that they're running low on supplies and are receiving a shipment of new equipment any time now. If we can stop them from restocking, we'll force the enemy to begin heavy rationing, which will harm their morale. Imagine the looks on their faces when they hear they can't have their snack-time. Are you up to the task?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I hope those Minmatar lowlifes can make do without their tattoo ink because I just blew them all up!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Thanks to those supplies getting through, we'll have to face fresh enemies in the area.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Tch. I didn't think you would turn this down.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: This doesn't sound like a problem. I can take care of it for sure.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Blowing up industrials? Sounds boring! Give me something difficult, will you?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: It turned out to be more difficult than I expected. I'm going to have to abandon this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm glad to hear it! Once you make sure every industrial is destroyed, return to me to report. Just watch out for capsuleers flying on their side and equip yourself to defend against them first and foremost.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I will gladly hear what duty you have for me.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A convoy is heading to supply a station in a contested system. That station provides food, water, clothing, and other basic equipment for the Minmatar forces in the area. We've managed to pinpoint the convoy's location, so we can send you out to take care of them for us.

Destroy the convoy before they can unload their cargo.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent. Without supplies, the Minmatar forces in the area will lose morale! It'll allow us to make inroads into the system.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Uncountable numbers of hidden asteroid belts dot all of known space; some of them are quite valuable -- so much that both we and our enemies would risk going into contested space to find and exploit them. The Minmatar have recently sent miners into a rich field we discovered some time ago -- in a region of "contested space" -- and we certainly can't have them taking our ore.

If you can drive them out of there, we'll have those precious mineral resources all to ourselves. Can you do it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've taken out the miners, no sweat.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Was the mission really that difficult?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I'm surprised you don't have the stomach for it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll smash those miners like they smash those asteroids!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: They found it, they deserve it. I can't take your mission.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: It turns out this was more than I could handle. I'm sorry!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Our scanners haven't revealed any combat ships escorting the miners. That could be simple hubris on the part of the Minmatar, or it could mean they've reinforcements a short way away. The miners are the only important targets, so focus on them.

Just be careful, as I've heard Capsuleers loyal to the Republic are in the area. You might have to deal with them and they'll provide a much greater threat.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh how glorious it is! What do you have for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Those damn Minmatar have managed to discover an asteroid belt in one of the contested systems nearby! Head over there and destroy them as soon as possible. Once you do, we can exploit the resources ourselves.

Just make sure you're ready to fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Republic might be out in force.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent job. With those rats gone, we'll be able to exploit the resources and further fund our efforts. Even better, it seems like you got there in time to stop them from mining the choicest asteroids. This will not be forgotten.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our contested territory is riddled with old, inoperable gates. Some of them were put up by our enemies, others by common smugglers hoping to get past customs. Well, it turns out that the Republic has discovered one of these derelict gates. Normally, this wouldn't be an issue, but the gate connects to a system deep in Republic space.

I don't need to tell you what could happen if those Minmatar slave dogs get that gate online. We can't spare the manpower to destroy the gate itself, but the ships working to repair it aren't nearly so sturdy.

I want you to fly over there and take them out. Are you up for it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've taken out that repair crew! The gate remains offline for now.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Grr. I wish I'd known you couldn't handle it from the start!

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well someone needs to take care of that repair crew. I guess I can find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That repair crew won't have a chance. Don't worry about it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not sure I can take them out in time.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: It turns out I wasn't prepared to tackle this mission. I'm going to have to abandon it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I figured as much! I've already uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. You shouldn't have too much trouble taking out the repair ships. It is in a contested system, so you may find Republic-aligned capsuleers patrolling the place.

messages.mission.briefing.text: An old smuggler's gate connects a system deep inside Republic territory with one of the contested systems nearby. It's been offline for years, but the Republic is trying to get it running again. Destroy the repair ships trying to repair the gate.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I hope it wasn't too much trouble for you. With that repair crew out of the way, we can take our time and send a demolition crew to destroy it when we get the chance. You have done the Empire proud.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Good. I need you for an assassination, and this is something you best not screw up.

We've been watching Republic Fleet units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Amarrians; most of them non-combatants. She has a penchant for hitting weakened and unsupported civilian structures. She is scum, and I want her dead.

This is surgical stuff, pilot. She'll slip away if we go in there with full force. I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.

Simple as that, now get going.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: She's dead.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What an utter disappointment you are. Next time, do not offer services beyond your ability. Eggers and their pride…just get out of here.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Cheap Assassin? She is the cheap assassin. Non-combatants are her primary targets! I don't give a damn how highly you think of yourself so long as our people stop dying. Forget it; I'll get someone else who actually has a shred of patriotism and empathy.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Understood, I'll arrange a meeting with her and consequence.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The breakdown in relations between the empires has seen huge losses in civilian life as they all target “weak points” and set missions specifically to “maximize morale loss.” In a war, there are few who will not see the atrocities of conflict and defenseless non-combatants are no exception. Those who lead such missions however, sit at the very top of their enemy's target lists.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Spare me the tough talk, pilot. Action is the only language I respect. Move it.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've been watching Republic Fleet units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Amarrians; most of them non-combatants I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. Not bad…not bad at all. Keep it up and we might just trust you with more important work down the line.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Minmatar compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support.

Initial reconnaissance has suggested they may have the capability to field more vessels than we had originally anticipated. Naturally, we're not turning around in the face of this news, we've come too far and a retreat will only encourage them. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in.

I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field. Don't worry about any orders or cohesion with our own forces there, you'll be answering directly to me and following only my orders.

Briefing over. Get going.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Good call on the Commander, it seems to have worked.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What?! I already told my superiors the matter was being handled. I'm really glad you hope I can find someone else, rookie. That means so much to me whilst our own people are out there risking their lives. Don't let me catch you repeating this performance.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Why should I care? You asked how you could help so I'm telling you. Clearly I'm wasting my damn time in the process. A piece of advice rookie, don't ask if you can help when you have no concept of the expectations likely to be put upon you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll set out immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Changes in technology and in particular, the advent of the jump drive, has made the battlefields of space a dynamic and unpredictable arena. Where previously reinforcements could take many hours or even days to arrive on-field, now they can be dropped immediately into the fray with a single cynosaural field. When the technology first appeared, all four empires had to drastically revise their outdated battle tactics and this is a process still happening even today. Mistakes are still made, and the cost of hubris and underestimation is usually high.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I won't be able to help with something like this I'm afraid, that sector is too far out of my way.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't commit myself to this after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You'll hear from me shortly. Pay close attention to my orders and obey them exactly.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I'm here, how can I help?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Minmatar compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in. I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Orders are only as good as the people who carry them out. That was some good work out there, pilot; calm, precise and efficient. You fly like a real Amarrian. Keep it up.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
There is, and I hope you will understand the importance of what I am about to ask you.

During a routine recon operation in a contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Minmatar citizens. We are unsure why they are there. In all likelihood they are assisting Republic forces in some way, either directly or indirectly. It matters little - they are savage scum who are obviously up to something.

That defensive force they had installed just recently moved elsewhere, and scouts tell us that the compound is now sitting largely defenseless. This represents an opportunity for us to remove the threat, whatever it may be. Kill them. Kill them all.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have done as you asked - the facility is destroyed.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: The Pacifist Manifesto: Chapter I, Verso xxiv.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Save me your confused morality, pilot. They are clearly more than innocent bystanders: Look at where they are and how heavily they were guarded! You've fallen into precisely the trap they wished to set. What a dismal display of clouded judgment. You have failed this test of faith!

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: The arrogance of you eggers! I do not report to you, but to true servants of the divine Empire. I will find someone else to carry out this task - your refusal has achieved nothing but my disdain.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Without question. Give me the coordinates.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: "Those who would seek peace in times of war must stay unmistakably clear of it. Withdraw yourselves from the view of your enemy and remain unseen, for even the most innocent action is a threat in the eyes of your enemy. This you must understand, for to tempt fate too often is invariably to meet it."

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No, I won't do this. We should investigate before we start shooting. Get back to me when you've done so, and then I might be interested.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I will not do this. I cannot kill people who may well be innocent bystanders, savages though they are.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I am relieved to see you have such good judgement. I'm sending you the location now; move quickly, before their compound is reinforced once again.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I've come. Is there any work you can give me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: During a routine recon operation in a contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Minmatar citizens. In all likelihood they are assisting Republic forces in some way, either directly or indirectly. We have an opportunity for to remove that threat, whatever it may be. Kill them. Kill them all.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done well, pilot: That seems to be the only way we can rest reassured those Minmatar scum pose no further threat. Good work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've identified the location of a Gallente tactical relay being used by an enemy cruiser squadron operating in the area. This squadron has been making deep penetration raids over the last week, and our sector commander has decided that elimination of this relay is the first step towards containing these incursions.

Unfortunately, our regular naval forces have their hands full dealing with an enemy offensive several systems away and protecting our supply lines holding the line in that area. As a result, I've been tasked with finding a loyal capsuleer who can take care of the problem for us. We'd like for you to give it a shot.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the tactical relay.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I thought you were supposed to be some hotshot pilot. All talk, huh?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Even small actions are important, pilot. Just because you're not in the middle of a fleet battle doesn't mean you're not making an important contribution.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That relay is as good as gone.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds a bit small-time to me. I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: There's too many of them; I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. You'll have to find some other sucker for this one.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
An enemy cruiser squadron has been causing some serious trouble for our forces in this area. Unfortunately, we're also trying to deal with a Gallente offensive in this sector, and that means that regular naval forces are stretched thin. In order to take some pressure off, we need you to take out the tactical relay that they are using to coordinate their activities. Hopefully, that will buy our fleet some time to deal with the offensive.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the tactical relay, and return to your agent.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. You've bought our fleet some time to hold the line here. I'll make sure the sector commander knows you were responsible.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As I'm sure you're already aware, pilot, one of the most precious resources a military force has is morale. Battles can be won or lost by it, and wars can be turned by it. That is why one of our top priorities has been the disruption of the enemy's morale.

Lately, the Gallente have enjoyed a string of small but dramatic victories over our forces in this sector. Though the damage inflicted to our forces has been negligible, the enemy forces responsible for these actions, especially their commander, have been emboldened and now they are pushing their luck more and more.

The general staff has determined that striking a crippling blow to their morale will likely put an end to this nonsense once and for all. We want you to eliminate their commander. With any luck, this will scatter them to the winds and put an end to these raids.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The enemy commander has been eliminated, sir.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: This is war, pilot. It's not about your comfort.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll put an end to their winning streak, don't worry.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm really not comfortable with this.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Make sure you're ready for a protracted battle. You may have to wade through a number of enemy capsuleers.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
An enemy force has been launching increasingly bold attacks against us. They've been taking advantage of the fact that we have bigger troubles to deal with, and coming away victorious more often than not.

The general staff has decided to put an end to this campaign by striking a crippling blow to their morale. We want you to eliminate the enemy sector commander at these coordinates; all other targets are secondary.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well, that should put ‘em in their place. Nice work, pilot. I'll make sure the general staff knows you were responsible.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
You've got a real chance to be a hero here, pilot. The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Gallente detention camp. The only problem is that we need to get intelligence on the distribution of enemy forces prior to the raid in order to pave the way for our strike force and the vulnerable transports that will need to be sent in with it. That's where you come in.

We know that one of the enemy fleets in this area has copies of the data that we need. You will need to penetrate their base of operations and retrieve the tactical information sheet from the outpost there. Bring that back to me and we can get the planning for this raid underway.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've got the information sheet. Does it have the data you're looking for?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope you can live with the lives of those prisoners on your conscience.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that intelligence for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm glad to hear it, pilot. Here's the coordinates; remember, that tactical information sheet is the primary objective. Any other damage is secondary.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The general staff is planning an operation to liberate some prisoners of war from a Gallente detention camp. In order to pave the way for the raid, we need to get information on the disposition of the enemy forces so that our strike force and the vulnerable transports coming with them can make it to the detention camp unmolested.

In order to get that intelligence, we need you to raid the base of an enemy force in this sector. We need you to get the tactical information sheet from the outpost and bring it back here in preparation for the prisoner raid.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work, pilot; I'll send this off to the boys at intel. With any luck, you've just given us what we need to bring some of our brave warriors home.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've been waiting for you to show up! We have a small problem. The Gallente have a hidden supply depot inside a contested system. Normally, we would just go and destroy it, but we can't spare the manpower at the moment.

However, we've discovered that they're running low on supplies and are receiving a shipment of new equipment any time now. If we can stop them from restocking, we'll force the enemy to begin heavy rationing, which will harm their morale. Imagine the looks on their faces when they hear they can't have their snack-time. Are you up to the task?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I hope those Gallente cowards can make due without their cheeses and heavy sauces! Because I just blew them all up!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Thanks to those supplies getting through, we'll have to face fresh enemies in the area.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Tch. I didn't think you would turn this down.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: This doesn't sound like a problem. I can take care of it for sure.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Blowing up industrials? Sounds boring! Give me something difficult, will you?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: It turned out to be more difficult than I expected. I'm going to have to abandon this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm glad to hear it! Once you make sure every industrial is destroyed, return to me to report. Just watch out for capsuleers flying on their side and equip yourself to defend against them first and foremost.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I don't have voice mail, so I guess I'd better pick up!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A convoy is heading to supply a station in a contested system. That station provides food, water, clothing, and other basic equipment for the Gallente forces in the area. We've managed to pinpoint the convoy's location, so we can send you out to take care of them for us.

Destroy the convoy before they can unload their cargo.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent. Without supplies, the Gallente forces in the area will lose morale! It'll allow us to make inroads into the system.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It's no secret that many hidden asteroid belts dot all of known space. Some of them are so valuable that our people would risk going into contested space to find and exploit them. Well, we've recently done just that -- we discovered a fairly sizable asteroid belt. In Gallente-contested space...

Trouble is, the Gallente seem to have noticed. But we simply can't let them take it: If you can drive them out of there, we'll send in a special ops mining force and have those precious mineral resources all to ourselves. Can you do it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've taken out the miners, no sweat.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Was the mission really that difficult?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I'm surprised you don't have the stomach for it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll smash those miners like they smash those asteroids!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: They found it, they deserve it. I can't take your mission.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: It turns out this was more than I could handle. I'm sorry!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Our scanners haven't revealed any combat ships escorting the miners. That could be simple hubris on the part of the Gallente, or it could mean they've reinforcements a short way away. The miners are the only important targets, so focus on them.

Just be careful, as I said earlier -- capsuleers loyal to the Federation are in the area.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh how glorious it is! What do you have for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Those damn Gallente have managed to discover an asteroid belt in one of the contested systems nearby! Head over there and destroy them as soon as possible. Once you do, we can exploit the resources ourselves.

Just make sure you're ready to fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Federation might be out in force.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent job. With those rats gone, we'll be able to exploit the resources and further fund our efforts. Even better, it seems like you got there in time to stop them from mining the choicest asteroids. This will not be forgotten.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our contested territory is riddled with old, inoperable gates. Some of them were put up by our enemies, others by common smugglers hoping to get past customs. Well, it turns out that the Federation has discovered one of these derelict gates. Normally, this wouldn't be an issue, but the gate connects to a system deep in Federation space.

I don't need to tell you what could happen if the Gallente get that gate online. We can't spare the manpower to destroy the gate itself, but the ships working to repair it aren't nearly so sturdy.

I want you to fly over there and take them out. Are you up for it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've taken out that repair crew! The gate remains offline for now.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Grr. I wish I'd known you couldn't handle it from the start!

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well someone needs to take care of that repair crew. I guess I can find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That repair crew won't have a chance. Don't worry about it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not sure I can take them out in time.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: It turns out I wasn't prepared to tackle this mission. I'm going to have to abandon it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I figured as much! I've already uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. You shouldn't have too much trouble taking out the repair ships. It is in a contested system, so you may find Federation-aligned capsuleers patrolling the place.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm a capsuleer! I don't need to put my life on the line to get the job done.

messages.mission.briefing.text: An old smuggler's gate connects a system deep inside Federation territory with one of the contested systems nearby. It's been offline for years, but the Federation is trying to get it running again. Destroy the repair ships trying to repair the gate.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I hope it wasn't too much trouble for you. With that repair crew out of the way, we can take our time and send a demolition crew to destroy it when we get the chance. You have done the State proud.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Good. I need you for an assassination, and this is something you best not screw up.

We've been watching Federation Navy units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Caldari; most of them non-combatants. She has a penchant for hitting weakened and unsupported civilian structures. She is scum, and I want her dead.

This is surgical stuff, pilot. She'll slip away if we go in there with full force. I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.

Simple as that, now get going.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: She's dead.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What an utter disappointment you are. Next time, do not offer services beyond your ability. Eggers and their pride…just get out of here.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Cheap Assassin? She is the cheap assassin. Non-combatants are her primary targets! I don't give a damn how highly you think of yourself so long as our people stop dying. Forget it; I'll get someone else who actually has a shred of patriotism and empathy.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Understood, I'll arrange a meeting with her and consequence.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The breakdown in relations between the empires has seen huge losses in civilian life as they all target “weak points” and set missions specifically to “maximize morale loss.” In a war, there are few who will not see the atrocities of conflict and defenseless non-combatants are no exception. Those who lead such missions however, sit at the very top of their enemy's target lists.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Get someone else for the job; I'm not some cheap assassin.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't get to her; you're going to have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Spare me the tough talk, pilot. Action is the only language I respect. Move it.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Ready and willing. How can I help?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've been watching Federation Navy units piling into a contested sector nearby. We were moments away from moving on them until we noticed one of their more highly-ranked Field Commanders arriving on the scene. This woman has killed countless Caldari; most of them non-combatants I no longer give a damn about anything except that Commander and her guards. Kill them and you'll get your pay, maybe even some respect.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. Not bad…not bad at all. Keep it up and we might just trust you with more important work down the line.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Federation compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support.

Initial reconnaissance has suggested they may have the capability to field more vessels than we had originally anticipated. Naturally, we're not turning around in the face of this news, we've come too far and a retreat will only encourage them. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in.

I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field. Don't worry about any orders or cohesion with our own forces there, you'll be answering directly to me and following only my orders.

Briefing over. Get going.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Good call on the Commander, it seems to have worked.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What?! I already told my superiors the matter was being handled. I'm really glad you hope I can find someone else, rookie. That means so much to me whilst our own people are out there risking their lives. Don't let me catch you repeating this performance.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Why should I care? You asked how you could help so I'm telling you. Clearly I'm wasting my damn time in the process. A piece of advice rookie, don't ask if you can help when you have no concept of the expectations likely to be put upon you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll set out immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Changes in technology and in particular, the advent of the jump drive, has made the battlefields of space a dynamic and unpredictable arena. Where previously reinforcements could take many hours or even days to arrive on-field, now they can be dropped immediately into the fray with a single cynosaural field. When the technology first appeared, all four empires had to drastically revise their outdated battle tactics and this is a process still happening even today. Mistakes are still made, and the cost of hubris and underestimation is usually high.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I won't be able to help with something like this I'm afraid, that sector is too far out of my way.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't commit myself to this after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You'll hear from me shortly. Pay close attention to my orders and obey them exactly.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I'm here, how can I help?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Moments ago we launched an offensive against a Federation compound inside a hostile sector where they have strong numbers and superior logistics support. We're not going to risk getting slaughtered however, and this is where you come in. I want you to fly over there and ensure the success of this operation. I'll personally relay further information to you once you've made it onto the field.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Orders are only as good as the people who carry them out. That was some good work out there, pilot; calm, precise and efficient. You fly like a real Caldari. Keep it up.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
There is, and I hope you will understand the importance of what I am about to ask you.

During a recon operation in a nearby contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Gallente. We've had no luck infiltrating the compound, so we are unsure why they are here. In all likelihood they are assisting Federation forces in some way, though: When we first discovered the facility, it was heavily guarded. They are obviously up to something.

That defensive force they had installed just recently moved elsewhere, however, and the compound is now sitting largely defenseless. This represents an opportunity for us to remove the potential threat. Though it is a grim task I ask of you, it is one that must be done. Can I rely on you to carry it out?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have done as you asked: the facility is destroyed.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: The Pacifist Manifesto: Chapter I, Verso xxiv

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Spare me your philosophizing - we are at war! They are clearly more than innocent bystanders; just look at where they are and how heavily they were guarded. Obviously you are not the right person for this job. I will find another.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: The arrogance of you eggers! I do not report to you! I will simply find someone else to carry out this task. Your refusal has achieved nothing but my disdain!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Without question. Give me the coordinates.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: "Those who would seek peace in times of war must stay unmistakably clear of it. Withdraw yourselves from the view of your enemy and remain unseen, for even the most innocent action is a threat in the eyes of your enemy. This you must understand, for to tempt fate too often is invariably to meet it."

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No, I can't do this. We should investigate why they're here before we start shooting. Get back to me when you've done so and then I might be interested.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I cannot kill thousands of people unless I am assured of their guilt, {[character]agentID.name}, Gallente or otherwise.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I am relieved to see you have such good judgement. I'm sending you the location now; move quickly before their compound is reinforced once again.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I've come. Is there any work you can give me?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
During a routine recon operation inside a nearby contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Gallente; in all likelihood they are mercenaries assisting Federation Navy forces in some way. We have an opportunity to remove the threat, though, whatever it may be.

Though it is a grim task I ask of you, it is one that must be done. Destroy the facility, for the security of our great State.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done well, pilot. Those Federation guerrillas can pose no further threat.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our supply lines have been taking heavy damage from Gallente raids near this system. Until recently, we were baffled as to where the enemy force was resupplying. Luckily, a reconnaissance patrol just returned with sensor data that seems to correspond with the reactor emissions of a Gallente base, and it's in exactly the right place to be supporting these raids.

We want you to fly to the location of these reactor emissions, locate the base, and destroy its main reactor; that should be enough to put it out of action for a while. The thing to remember is that the base is likely to be well-protected, with static defenses if nothing else. I'd advise being careful on your approach. Keep an eye out for any raiding groups returning to resupply. Are you ready?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The reactor's been destroyed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm extremely disappointed. Hopefully, I can find someone else to take this mission before they hit us again; if I can't, I hope you realize that those losses will be on your head, pilot.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I don't know what you're talking about, but if that's the way you're going to be, then I'll find someone else to do it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It'll be my pleasure.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'll pass. I feel like there's something you're not telling me.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: There's too many of them! I can't deal with firepower of that magnitude.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent.  Remember, take out the reactor; anything else is just a bonus. Good hunting, pilot.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm game. What's the job?

messages.mission.briefing.text: A reconnaissance patrol has located the base of a group of Gallente raiders operating near this system. In order to secure our supply lines, you will need to fly to the base and destroy its main reactor, knocking it out of action. Any additional damage you can do to static defenses or the enemy raiding fleets would certainly be appreciated.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great work, pilot. We're already putting together a counterstrike in case they come to repair it. You've helped us bait the trap perfectly, and saved a load of war materiel and lives in the process.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I do sleep, but I'm awake and ready now.
