messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent. Without supplies, the Caldari forces in the area will lose morale and fight at less than 100 percent! It'll allow us to make inroads into the system.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As you know, there are a large number of hidden asteroid belts all throughout space. Some of them are quite valuable, so much that both we and our enemies would risk going into contested space to find them. Well, we've recently done just that... but the Caldari have apparently spotted our ships in the vicinity.

We discovered a fairly sizable asteroid belt that had managed to elude our scanners for some time. Now that the Caldari have also pinpointed it, though, we need to get in there fast. We simply can't let them strip it of all value. We want to be the ones to do that. If you can drive them out of there, we'll have those precious mineral resources all to ourselves -- and keep their war-mongering fingers away from it. Can you do it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've taken out the miners, no sweat.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Was the mission really that difficult?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I'm surprised you don't have the stomach for it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll smash those miners like they smash those asteroids!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: They found it, they deserve it. I can't take your mission.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: It turns out this was more than I could handle. I'm sorry!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Our scanners haven't revealed any combat ships escorting the miners. That could be simple hubris on the part of the Caldari, or it could mean they've reinforcements a short way away. The miners are the only important targets, so focus on them.

messages.mission.briefing.text:

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent job. With those rats gone, we'll be able to exploit the resources and further fund our efforts. Even better, it seems like you got there in time to stop them from mining the choicest asteroids. This will not be forgotten.

This squadron has been making deep penetration raids over the last week, and our sector commander has decided that elimination of this relay is the first step towards containing these incursions.

As a result, I've been tasked with finding a loyal capsuleer who can take care of the problem for us. We'd like for you to give it a shot.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the tactical relay.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I thought you were supposed to be some hotshot pilot. All talk, huh?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Even small actions are important, pilot. Just because you're not in the middle of a fleet battle doesn't mean you're not making an important contribution.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That relay is as good as gone.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sounds a bit small-time to me. I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: There's too many of them; I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. You'll have to find some other sucker for this one.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope you can live with the lives of those prisoners on your conscience.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that intelligence for you.

Are you up to the task?

I do, and I hope you'll understand the importance of what I am about to ask you.

During a recon operation in a contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Amarrians. In all likelihood they are assisting Empire Navy forces in some way. When we first discovered the facility it was heavily guarded, so they are obviously up to something.

But that defensive force recently pulled out, no doubt on the way to a dirtside raid or something - and the compound is now sitting largely defenseless. This is our chance to remove their threat. Can I rely on you?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have done as you asked, the facility is destroyed.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: The Pacifist Manifesto: Chapter I, Verso xxiv.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: This is war, pilot! Do you think the Heirs and their high-minded Paladins would offer our people the same courtesy?! You fool. They are clearly more than innocent bystanders: Why else were they so heavily guarded? You've disappointed me once. Do not let it happen again.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: The arrogance of you eggers! I do not report to you! I will simply find someone else to carry out this task. Your refusal has achieved nothing but my disdain!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Just give me the coordinates.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: "Those who would seek peace in times of war must stay unmistakably clear of it. Withdraw yourselves from the view of your enemy and remain unseen, for even the most innocent action is a threat in the eyes of your enemy. This you must understand, for to tempt fate too often is invariably to meet it."

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No, I can't do this. We should investigate why they're here before we start shooting. Get back to me when you've done so and then I might be interested.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: What if these people are nothing but innocent bystanders? Even if they are Amarrian, do we not become what we hate if we simply kill them outright?!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. I like your spirit. I'm sending you the location now: Move quickly, before their compound is reinforced once again.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I've come. You have work you can give me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: During a recon operation in a contested sector, we discovered a large facility housing thousands of Amarrians. In all likelihood they are assisting Empire Navy forces in some way: When we first discovered the facility it was heavily guarded, so they are obviously up to something. But their ships recently pulled out, no doubt on the way to a dirtside raid or something - and the compound is now sitting largely defenseless. This is our chance to remove their threat.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done well, pilot. We can be reassured that the Amarrians pose no further threat in that sector, good work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our supply lines have been taking heavy damage from Amarr raids near this system. Until recently, we were baffled as to where the enemy force was resupplying. Luckily, a reconnaissance patrol just returned with sensor data that seems to correspond with the reactor emissions of a Amarr base, and it's in exactly the right place to be supporting these raids.

We want you to fly to the location of these reactor emissions, locate the base, and destroy its main reactor; that should be enough to put it out of action for a while. The thing to remember is that the base is likely to be well-protected, with static defenses if nothing else. I'd advise being careful on your approach. Keep an eye out for any raiding groups returning to resupply. Are you ready?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The reactor's been destroyed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm extremely disappointed. Hopefully, I can find someone else to take this mission before they hit us again; if I can't, I hope you realize that those losses will be on your head, pilot.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I don't know what you're talking about, but if that's the way you're going to be, then I'll find someone else to do it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It'll be my pleasure.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'll pass. I feel like there's something you're not telling me.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: There's too many of them! I can't deal with firepower of that magnitude.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent.  Remember, take out the reactor; anything else is just a bonus. Good hunting, pilot.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm game. What's the job?

messages.mission.briefing.text: A reconnaissance patrol has located the base of a group of Amarr raiders operating near this system. In order to secure our supply lines, you will need to fly to the base and destroy its main reactor, knocking it out of action. Any additional damage you can do to static defenses or the enemy raiding fleets would certainly be appreciated.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great work, pilot. We're already putting together a counterstrike in case they come to repair it. You've helped us bait the trap perfectly, and saved a load of war materiel and lives in the process.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our supply lines have been taking heavy damage from Minmatar raids near this system. Until recently, we were baffled as to where the enemy force was resupplying. Luckily, a reconnaissance patrol just returned with sensor data that seems to correspond with the reactor emissions of a Minmatar base, and it's in exactly the right place to be supporting these raids.

We want you to fly to the location of these reactor emissions, locate the base, and destroy its main reactor; that should be enough to put it out of action for a while. The thing to remember is that the base is likely to be well-protected, with static defenses if nothing else. I'd advise being careful on your approach. Keep an eye out for any raiding groups returning to resupply. Are you ready?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The reactor's been destroyed.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It'll be my pleasure.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'll pass. I feel like there's something you're not telling me.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: There's too many of them! I can't deal with firepower of that magnitude.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent.  Remember, take out the reactor; anything else is just a bonus. Good hunting, pilot.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm game. What's the job?

messages.mission.briefing.text: A reconnaissance patrol has located the base of a group of Minmatar raiders operating near this system. In order to secure our supply lines, you will need to fly to the base and destroy its main reactor, knocking it out of action. Any additional damage you can do to static defenses or the enemy raiding fleets would certainly be appreciated.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Great work, pilot. We're already putting together a counterstrike in case they come to repair it. You've helped us bait the trap perfectly, and saved a load of war materiel and lives in the process.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A Serpentis captain wants to surrender to us and help right his wrongs. He's currently hiding out in a small deadspace pocket with some other Serpentis watching him. Get over there, make a show of wiping him and his followers out, and then bring him back to us unharmed.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As you well know, the Serpentis are notorious pirates across the galaxy. They are particularly troublesome here, pushing their drugs and committing all sorts of crimes against the Federation. Every so often, though, one of them finds a conscience and decides to change his criminal ways.

It just so happens that a Serpentis captain is ready to turn himself in. Of course, he can't just dock in one of our stations and surrender: He'd be dead before he exited warp. Now, that wouldn't be a big deal, normally, but this one has information that can help bring down several higher ranking Serpentis members.

We've agreed to send someone over there for a show for this captain's friends, someone to fight with him and destroy his ship. He'll have already ejected of course and made his way to your cargo hold. Are you up to it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've brought in your snitch. The Serpentis shouldn't suspect a thing.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You can't even beat someone who wants to lose? Hmph, what are we going to do with you?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You should not refuse missions so lightly.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry. I can handle this.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't know if I'll be able to take this mission. Find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text:
I don't know how to tell you this. Here goes: I quit your mission.

Heh, I guess I do know how to tell you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could count on you. Just be sure you make the fight look real. If not, Serpentis will suspect something. And his associates will be trying to kill you for real anyway.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I hear you might have some work for me...

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The informant grew nervous waiting around for you to come extract him. Because of that, it looks like we've lost an opportunity to gain valuable information about our enemies. I am disappointed in your failure.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}! Without your help, we may never have been able to extract the informant from the Serpentis. They do not like traitors and, if they found out, he'd have met an ugly death.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Waiting is not an option. Because of this, I've had to assign the job to another pilot. Come back when you're ready to actually work.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A Mannar mining colony has recently been attacked by rogue drones. Unfortunately, this mining colony supplies us with a good deal of cheap minerals we use for our defense initiatives. We can't wait for them to repair the damage done by the drones, so we've decided to fix their equipment for them, free of charge. The sooner we can get them back to work, the better.

All you need to do is pick up the parts from their mining colony and bring them back here. Good luck!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
This one should be pretty simple. Near here is a mining colony owned and run by some Mannar workers. Usually, they keep things pretty solid. We even have a deal with them where we protect them and supply them with parts in exchange for a cheap supply of minerals. It all works out fine.

Recently, though, they've had some problems with rogue drones, and some of their equipment was damaged. Trouble is, we're in the middle of arming to protect against the Caldari threat, so we can't wait for them to fix their machines. Instead, I've been authorized to have their tools repaired.

You'll have to fly out to their base and pick up the tools. It shouldn't be much of a problem, though you might encounter some rogue drones or a few pirates, maybe. So you'd better go in armed.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've picked up the parts, as you asked.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I was hoping I wouldn't have to waste our resources to deliver new parts, but I guess I will now.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Your lack of willingness is disheartening.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: That sounds simple enough. Sure, I can do it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Come back to me when you've got something interesting.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've decided I had enough of this. I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew you'd be up for it. Careful out there.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: As long as you're paying!

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The Mannar are nothing if not patient! But they can't wait for those parts to be repaired any longer. I've had to send someone else in with new equipment.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I hope those rogue drones weren't too much trouble? I doubted they'd be much of a match for you.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Yes or no, that's all we needed. Instead, you made us wait. I can't stand indecision.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Investigate the distress beacon at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and rescue the lost miners.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yes, that's true. You're {[character]player.name}, right? So many new capsuleers these days – hard to keep them all straight. My apologies.

Anyway, listen: We recently lost contact with a small group of miners at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Outside of the miners' distress beacon being activated, we've heard nothing from them for two days. Just... silence.

Normally, we'd just hire new crews. But we spent a fortune on implants for those miners, and we're not ready to write those off. So would you please go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and see what's what?

Whatever the case, you'll need to bring those miners back here for examination and questioning.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Your mining crew ran into a slave-raiding party. Those scum won't be slave raiding anymore, though — or breathing, for that matter. Here's your crew; now hand over the ISK!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm not disappointed, {[character]player.name}. I actually had a bet going that you would quit. Thanks for letting me win!

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, I'm sorry the job sounds too dangerous for you, {[character]player.name}. If I get any jobs that involve ice cream and lollipops, should I give you a call?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I do love the ominous, dangerous-sounding jobs. I'll do it, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
It never fails to amuse the more cynical in New Eden that the Amarr — with all their holier than thou piety — see nothing wrong with their use of slaves. Still, this darker side of the Amarrian faith, while upsetting to many, never fails to generate the gleam of potential profits for those willing to provide such slaves.

The Angel Cartel — arguably the strongest criminal organization plaguing the star lanes today — has not let this business opportunity go amiss. Yet it is a matter even the Cartel handles delicately, since it has no wish to openly provoke the Minmatar Empire or its Gallente allies. Still, if a few Minmatar ships go missing, who would notice? The blackness of space promises many dangers to the unwary, and much ISK to those who happen to be in the right place at the right time (with the right weapons...).

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: So you've already lost two teams of your employees to some mysterious fate… and you want me to join them?! Do I have "IDIOT" written on my forehead? No thanks, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Sorry to disappoint, {[character]player.name}, but I don't see this job working out for me the way I'd prefer — you know, like me surviving it. Find yourself another hero. One with less foresight.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Oh, thank you. You know, if you can bring back those miners in a hurry, I could maybe slap a bonus on your fee. So get moving!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh, sorry 'bout that. Listen – I'm just here for some work. I hear you might have something?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Not that you probably care, {[character]player.name}, but thanks to your inability to do the job, those miners are probably dead now. Or worse. Have a nice night!

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Oh, wonderfully done, {[character]player.name}! Those miner implants are safe and sound! You've done {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} a great service, one we probably won't forget.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: {[character]player.name} — since replying to potential employers is so low on your priority list, I've gone and hired someone else for the job we discussed. I hope you find the time in your busy schedule to read this message.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Gallente have constructed a communications relay station very near the borders of our space. This relay is a problem because the Gallente have grown increasingly belligerent and intractable lately, and this communications relay would be able to operate outside of normal channels, enhancing the espionage capabilities of any Gallente spies that make their way into Amarr space.

We want you to enter the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and destroy the communications platform, along with the Federation pilots guarding it. We are expecting it to be guarded, but not heavily, because they think we know nothing of this location. And since you are not an official agent of the Amarrian government, we have plausible deniability.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Mission accomplished. The communications platform is so much space dust.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I guess I'll have to find someone with a little stronger loyalty to the Empire.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope I can find someone else to handle this on such short notice.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good luck out there!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Gallente have constructed a communications relay station very near the borders of our space. This relay is a problem because the Gallente have grown increasingly belligerent and intractable lately, and this communications relay would be able to operate outside of normal channels, enhancing the espionage capabilities of any Gallente spies that make their way into Amarr space.

We want you to enter the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and destroy the communications platform, along with the Federation pilots guarding it. We are expecting it to be guarded, but not heavily, because they think we know nothing of this location. And since you are not an official agent of the Amarrian government, we have plausible deniability.

We're not expecting you to have to go to war, but a cruiser would probably have a better chance of making it out of there than a frigate would.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent. The Emperor will be pleased. Fear not, only the Amarrian government will know of your involvement in this enterprise.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
According to the latest intelligence reports, enemy forces in this sector have been building up for a major offensive. Over the last 48 hours, we've detected a number of enemy support squadrons moving into positions that will let them hit a variety of targets with little notice. It's likely that they're planning a carefully coordinated strike against us, hoping for a breakthrough. Reinforcements are en route to this sector, but we need to buy some time.

We've located an enemy communications relay that is most likely serving as the coordination center for a large part of the enemy support fleet. While they're keeping a sharp eye on our forces, a capsuleer like yourself could sneak past their lines and hit them where they aren't looking. With the relay down, they won't be able to coordinate their attacks, and we should be able to hold them off long enough for reinforcements to arrive.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the tactical relay.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I thought you were supposed to be a hotshot pilot.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Yeah, I guess we can just count you out of the whole war then, huh? You need to suck it up and get your head together, pilot. This war isn't going to win itself.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: They won't know what hit them.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This sounds pretty risky. You can count me out of this one.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Enemy forces are building up for a major offensive in the sector, and coordination will be key for their attack. Reinforcements for our positions are already on their way, but it will still be some time before they arrive. We need you to slip past their front lines and hit the communications relay they are using to coordinate their attack. That should keep them off balance and buy our fleet enough time for reinforcements to arrive.
Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Gallente Tactical Support Center, and return to your agent.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. You've bought some time for our reinforcements to arrive.  I'll make sure the sector commander knows that you were responsible.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Recently, Naval Intelligence has been profiling the local commanders in this sector, looking for weaknesses in the enemy's defensive lines. While doing so, they've come to find out that one of the local sector commanders is a bit of a protégé to a high-ranking senator. The two of them are very close, and the senator is well known to be a bit protective of the commander.

Naval Intelligence believes they can use this to their advantage. While the sector commander is not a particularly important or successful one, we believe that if he goes missing, the senator will demand that his Navy drop everything to look for his adopted son. This will force them to scour space for the missing commander, which should buy us a few days.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The enemy commander has been eliminated.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You're going to need to learn a certain moral flexibility in this line of work, pilot.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll make sure they don't find a trace of him.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm really not comfortable with this.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Make sure you're ready for the worst, and try not to leave witnesses.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Naval Intelligence has discovered that one of the local sector commanders has a close personal relationship with a high-ranking senator, and believes that we can exploit the senator's overprotective nature by destroying the sector commander's vessel. The senator should force the Gallente into an expensive, time-consuming and ultimately futile search.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: That should keep them running in circles for a while.  Good work, pilot.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Gallente forces in this sector have begun an offensive, and it's keeping chunks of our fleet busy just holding the line. The enemy can't maintain a major push like this for long, though, not without serious organization. That's where we'll have to hit them to put an end to this mess.

The first step will be to locate where those supply routes are so that we can launch a counterstrike. In order to do that, we need to get access to Gallente logistical command data, which is where you come in. We need you to attack one of their supply bases and get access to the tactical information sheet in the base's main outpost. Bring it back here so we can plan our counterattack.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I managed to get the tactical information sheet, but it wasn't easy.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You're setting our entire war effort back by weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out the missions we need, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder next time.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will. We can't afford to let this offensive continue unchecked.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that intelligence for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I just need you to get that intelligence. Everything else is secondary to that goal. Good luck, pilot.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What can I do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Gallente forces in this sector have begun an offensive, and it's keeping chunks of our fleet busy just holding the line. The enemy can't maintain a major push like this for long, though, not without serious organization. That's where we'll have to hit them to put an end to this mess.

The first step will be to locate where those supply routes are so that we can launch a counterstrike. In order to do that, we need to get access to Gallente logistical command data, which is where you come in. We need you to attack one of their supply bases and get access to the tactical information sheet in the base's main outpost. Bring it back here so we can plan our counterattack.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You did a good job, pilot. I'll get that data into the right hands immediately.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I'm glad to see that you're here, pilot. I've got some work that's right up your alley. You see, a nearby system has long been contested. Just recently, things have reached a head.

The Federation forces in the area are rearmed by a weapons depot in the system. We cannot strike directly at the depot itself, but we can stem the flow of supplies into the depot. We've received word that a convoy of supplies is heading there now. It's lightly guarded and destroying it will surely set the Gallente forces in this area back. Do you think you can handle it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've successfully destroyed the industrials!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You're quitting on me? Truly a sad day.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I never thought you'd turn this down. Oh well, I'll find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take out those industrials immediately!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Yawn, that doesn't sound like it's worth my time at all.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I must abandon this mission. I hope you understand.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Great! Things shouldn't be too difficult for someone of your skills. Fly over to the depot and head off the industrials.

Your biggest worry will be capsuleers loyal to the Federation. You should prepare yourself to battle or avoid them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am alive and so I serve the State.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Gallente are transporting a load of weapons and ammo to their depot in a nearby system. While we can't attack the weapons depot directly at this time, interdicting their transports serves the purpose just as well. Destroy the industrials before they can drop off the ammo. Just be warned, capsuleers working for the Federation may try to stop you.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It seems I am in luck. You see, we have recently discovered a rather large hidden asteroid belt. This belt has many resources that we could exploit. Unfortunately, it seems the Gallente Federation found it before us. They've miners over there right now stripping the belt of its precious mineral resources. We certainly can't let them do that!

I want you to fly over there and chase those miners off. By which I mean, of course, blowing them up. The bigger the explosions, the better. Can you do this for me?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The asteroid belt has been cleared of hostile miners. Hostile miners? That sounds like an oxymoron.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I didn't think some miners would be able to scare you off!

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: That's a shame. This is important work.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Those miners won't know what hit them.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not sure I'm up for taking this mission. Maybe something else?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I bit off more than I can chew.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew you'd be up for it! You shouldn't have too much trouble with the Gallente, however, we've had reports that capsuleers loyal to the Federation are roaming the area. Because the system is contested, they'll be able to attack you if they catch you. Be prepare to face them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: How can I be of use?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Our scanners just uncovered a hidden asteroid belt in a contested system. The Gallente apparently got to it before us and have already begun mining it. It still has plenty of ore, however, so we want to ensure that ore gets to us instead. All you have to do is fly out there and blow those miners to smithereens.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Now that those Gallente fools have been taken care of, our own miners can go in and strip the belt. Unless the Gallente send someone to counterattack... But nah, that's not likely to happen. Good job, come back to me when you're ready for some more work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Something urgent has just come across my desk. The Gallente Federation at one time managed to set up a gate in a nearby contested system. We eventually drove them off, but we never got around to tearing the gate down. It seems that was a mistake, as now the Gallente are trying to get the gate operational again. They have a huge strike force on the other side, waiting to come through.

We do not have the manpower to fight off that strike force. However, we still have time to act. While our forces are keeping the escorts busy, you need to go in and take out those repair ships. Can you do that?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The repair crew has been destroyed and the gate remains offline. You have nothing more to worry about.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You can't? Don't you realize what this could mean? Get out of my sight; I need to find someone else to take your place.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If our ancestors had that attitude, we'd never have achieved greatness.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry about it. I'll take them out and make sure the Federation gains nothing!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That sounds like too much pressure for me.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Things got too hot for me! I've got to abandon this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. I've uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. If you move fast, you'll be able to take out those repair ships with no problem. Your main competition will be pod pilots flying under the banner of the Federation. Prepare yourself to fight them if they try to intervene.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll give everything I've got. What do you need of me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Gallente Federation is trying to reopen a gate in one of the nearby contested systems. Things are especially urgent, because our spies have learned they have a large strike force ready to come through the gate as soon as it's back online. We do not have the manpower to fight off the strike force at this time. Get there and destroy their repair ships.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: This is great news! It truly shows that the honorable State is the strongest. With that repair crew taken out, we can request reinforcements and either demolish that gate or repair it ourselves and ambush the strike force as it comes through. You truly earned your reward today.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've got a mess on our hands and I need you to clean it up.

We recently came across some startling intelligence, given to us by certain sources I won't name. We learned that a Federation Intelligence Office agent had infiltrated our ranks many years ago and has been actively working against us ever since. After this discovery we began watching this individual closely, it seems a little too closely.

Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops. Undoubtedly, they plan to strike at our weakest points. There is any number of nightmare scenarios they could bring to bear. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat.

Understood?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've dispatched the spy and his bodyguards.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Risk? Risk?! You have a clone, what risk is there? I'll tell you what risk is: it's when you have a long-time spy in your organization leading fleets against you, that's risk! Whatever, I'll find someone else who can spare me of such pathetic excuses for their own cowardice.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: The arrogance and presumption of you eggers amazes me. I don't need to explain myself to you; I'll just get someone else who knows their place.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Understood. I'll deal with this immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The gradual breakdown in relations between the empires over recent years has seen a drastic increase in their focus on espionage as a tool to both prevent, and more regularly, enhance warfare. As a result, spying is rife inside all of the empires and the common assumption that many organizations operate under is that they have already been compromised. Very few are trusted with crucial information, and those that have been are very closely watched. Despite their vast differences, the brutal treatment of those caught in the act is one thing shared by each nation.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Why aren't we trying to capture and interrogate him? I want no part in any assassination of such a valuable source.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I can't get to him, there's too much at risk.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. There is no room for error here, so don't make me regret trusting you with this.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm listening…

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've learned that a Federation Intelligence Office agent has infiltrated our ranks and has been actively working against us ever since. Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops to undoubtedly strike at our weakest points. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat, understood?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, thank you. I hoped I could rely on your expertise and discretion. Once again you prove yourself a valuable ally of the Caldari people.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance.

We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Federation logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and a great deal at stake for us should we fail to impede the recent progress they've been making.

We've reason to believe that our plans have already been partly compromised. We're expecting Federation forces to be more prepared than usual, possibly even reinforced, and we're aiming to prepare ourselves accordingly. I've been tasked with organising a capsuleer-based contingency plan and deploying it with specific orders in mind. Once I given the clear that we've got someone, they'll be launching the offensive immediately, so time is of the essence.

Having someone as capable as you at our backs would allow us a great deal of tactical flexibility on-field and all but ensure that victory is swift and casualties low. If it turns out you're not needed, then we'll still pay you for your time, but certain orders I've been receiving suggest we may yet have a use for you out there, time will tell.

Are you up for the mission?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Was that all you needed done? How is the fight going?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What?! I already told them we had someone inbound and they launched the operation! This is a gross display of negligence on your behalf, pilot. I'll be making a note of it in your records, just as soon as I've found someone who is actually reliable.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Am I supposed to be admiring your honesty here? If you're not cut out for this kind of work then you're not worth my time, period.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Of course. Give me the coordinates and I'll head out immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: As relations began to slide further towards outright war, each of the empires increased their focus on long-term strategic interests. Exhaustively detailed battle plans of everything from invasion scenarios to the best locations for ammunitions caches were deliberated over endlessly by countless organizations dedicated to the singular task of winning, or perhaps simply surviving, a seemingly inevitable war.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This high-pressure stuff isn't really for me, I'm afraid. You'd be better off finding someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm sorry, but I have to decline this mission after all, I won't be able to provide the level of assistance you're after.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent, I'll tell them to proceed. Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh? Let's hear it then.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance. We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Federation logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and we're expecting Federation forces to be more prepared than usual.

Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I just received word that the cache has been secured and will be detonated once we've cleared the area. Excellent work out there, they've lost a strategic foothold as well as a prominent commander today, we couldn't be happier with the result.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
What I am about to ask you is strictly confidential, understood?

We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the Federation's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Caldari people.

Their arrogance is astounding, no? They seem to think we will allow them to exist in peace simply because they bear no weapons. Their weak security presence suggests as much. Understand pilot; these people are as significant a threat as any other. What they provide may not be firepower or logistics but it is crucial to their war effort nonetheless. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these industrials, we can starve the enemy out.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Industrials have been destroyed. I only hope this serves our purposes and doesn't backfire.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Spare me the ethics lecture. I will find someone else who understands the importance of this mission.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: What would you have us do then, huh? Shall we just leave them there, let them continue to offer a kind of assistance no amount of military and logistics support can? You disappoint me, deeply. Oh, and if I find out you've leaked this information, there will be consequences.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: If you think I have a problem with this, I don't. I understand completely. Give me the location of the residence.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Civilian deaths in a war are a reality, one which is accepted as inevitable by all of the empires. The effects of such things are often hard to predict, however, and those targeting their attacks must do so carefully. There are times when the mass death of civilians can indeed crush a nation's will to fight any further, or cause such anxiety amongst their citizenry that popular support for conflict is replaced by angry cries to back down. At other times however, it will only harden their resolve, serving as a valuable and yet grim propaganda victory, that allows them to paint their enemy as a heartless monster.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Briefings like this make me question what side I should be fighting for. I want nothing to do with this.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've had second thoughts. I simply cannot do something as monstrous as this. We risk too much with actions of this nature.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You're right; I should have known you could be relied upon in these matters. I'm uploading the coordinates now, good luck.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: How can I serve?

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these industrials, we can starve the enemy out.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Though I understand and even share those same concerns, it was a risk that had to be taken. Good work today pilot, here's your pay.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It looks like our enemies have banded together to attack us. The Minmatar and Gallente have always been close, but they haven't been cooperating to a great extent in the war. That seems to have changed.

You see, the Gallente have been trying for months to get a starbase set up inside one of the nearby contested systems. We've been stopping them, but now it seems like they've got the Minmatar to assist them.

Thankfully we've found out before they could get everything online. Their main reactor is still vulnerable to attack. If you destroy it, it will take the starbase with it. Can you head over there and take it out for us?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I expected more of the Republic-Federation alliance! I've trashed their reactor.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Unfortunate. Having you fail shows our enemies weakness.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Hmph. I thought you'd jump to take this mission.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I can't let them succeed. I'll make sure both the Republic and Federation pay for their audacity!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: The Republic and Federation are working together? I could handle one, but not both!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: The combined forces of the Republic and Federation were too much for me to handle.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Great. Now, the forces building the starbase probably aren't too tough. After all, most will be prepared for construction, not combat. However, I'm sure there will be capsuleers working for our enemies in the area. You'll have to set yourself up to combat them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll make the world regret their antagonism.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A joint taskforce between the Minmatar and Gallente are trying to establish a starbase inside one of our contested systems. We cannot allow them to succeed. Luckily the starbase's main reactor is vulnerable to attack.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Just remember, capsuleers loyal to our enemies will be able to fire on you in that system.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent! If that's the best the Minmatar and Gallente can throw against us together, our future is certainly bright indeed. You definitely earned your reward here.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
According to the latest intelligence reports, enemy forces in this sector have been building up for a major offensive. Over the last 48 hours, we've detected a number of enemy support squadrons moving into positions that will let them hit a variety of targets with little notice. It's likely that they're planning a carefully coordinated strike against us, hoping for a breakthrough. Reinforcements are en route to this sector, but we need to buy some time.

We've located an enemy communications relay that is most likely serving as the coordination center for a large part of the enemy support fleet. While they're keeping a sharp eye on our forces, a capsuleer like yourself could sneak past their lines and hit them where they aren't looking. With the relay down, they won't be able to coordinate their attacks, and we should be able to hold them off long enough for reinforcements to arrive.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've eliminated the tactical relay.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I thought you were supposed to be a hotshot pilot.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Yeah, I guess we can just count you out of the whole war then, huh? You need to suck it up and get your head together, pilot. This war isn't going to win itself.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: They won't know what hit them.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This sounds pretty risky. You can count me out of this one.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Once you've destroyed the relay, return here as fast as you can.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What do you need me to do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Enemy forces are building up for a major offensive in the sector, and coordination will be key for their attack. Reinforcements for our positions are already on their way, but it will still be some time before they arrive. We need you to slip past their front lines and hit the communications relay they are using to coordinate their attack. That should keep them off balance and buy our fleet enough time for reinforcements to arrive.

Fly to the given coordinates, find and eliminate the Caldari Tactical Support Center, and return to your agent.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. You've bought some time for our reinforcements to arrive.  I'll make sure the sector commander knows that you were responsible.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Recently, Naval Intelligence has been profiling the local commanders in this sector, looking for weaknesses in the enemy's defensive lines. While doing so, they've come to find out that one of the local sector commanders is a bit of a protégé to a high-ranking tribal elder. The two of them are very close, and the elder is well known to be a bit protective of the commander.

Naval Intelligence believes they can use this to their advantage. While the sector commander is not a particularly important or successful one, we believe that if he goes missing, the elder will demand that his Navy drop everything to look for his adopted son. This will force them to scour space for the missing commander, which should buy us a few days.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The enemy commander has been eliminated.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You're going to need to learn a certain moral flexibility in this line of work, pilot.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll make sure they don't find a trace of him.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm really not comfortable with this.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Make sure you're ready for the worst, and try not to leave witnesses.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Naval Intelligence has discovered that one of the local sector commanders has a close personal relationship with a high-ranking elder, and believes that we can exploit the elder's overprotective nature by destroying the sector commander's vessel. The elder should force the Minmatar into an expensive, time-consuming and ultimately futile search.

We want you to intercept and eliminate the sector commander before he knows what hit him.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: That should keep them running in circles for a while.  Good work, pilot.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Minmatar forces in this sector have begun an offensive, and it's keeping chunks of our fleet busy just holding the line. The enemy can't maintain a major push like this for long, though, not without serious organization. That's where we'll have to hit them to put an end to this mess.

The first step will be to locate where those supply routes are so that we can launch a counterstrike. In order to do that, we need to get access to Minmatar logistical command data, which is where you come in. We need you to attack one of their supply bases and get access to the tactical information sheet in the base's main outpost. Bring it back here so we can plan our counterattack.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I managed to get the tactical information sheet, but it wasn't easy.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You're setting our entire war effort back by weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out the missions we need, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder next time.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will. We can't afford to let this offensive continue unchecked.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that intelligence for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I just need you to get that intelligence. Everything else is secondary to that goal. Good luck, pilot.

I'm glad to see that you're here, pilot. I've got some work that's right up your alley. You see, a nearby system has long been contested. Just recently, things have reached a head.

The Republic forces in the area are rearmed by a weapons depot in the system. We cannot strike directly at the depot itself, but we can stem the flow of supplies into the depot. We've received word that a convoy of supplies is heading there now. It's lightly guarded and destroying it will surely set the Minmatar forces in this area back. Do you think you can handle it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've successfully destroyed the industrials!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You're quitting on me? Truly a sad day.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I never thought you'd turn this down. Oh well, I'll find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take out those industrials immediately!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Yawn, that doesn't sound like it's worth my time at all.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I must abandon this mission. I hope you understand.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Great! Things shouldn't be too difficult for someone of your skills. Fly over to the depot and head off the industrials.

Your biggest worry will be capsuleers loyal to the Republic. You should prepare yourself to battle or avoid them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll do whatever it takes!

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Minmatar are transporting a load of weapons and ammo to their depot in a nearby system. While we can't attack the weapons depot directly at this time, interdicting their transports serves the purpose just as well. Destroy the industrials before they can drop off the ammo. Just be warned, capsuleers working for the Republic may try to stop you.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work.

It seems I am in luck. You see, we have recently discovered a rather large hidden asteroid belt. This belt has many resources that we could exploit. Unfortunately, it seems the Minmatar Republic found it before us. They've miners over there right now stripping the belt of its precious mineral resources. We certainly can't let them do that!

We do not have the manpower to fight off that strike force. However, we still have time to act. While our forces are keeping the escorts busy, you need to go in and take out those repair ships. Can you do that?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The repair crew has been destroyed and the gate remains offline. You have nothing more to worry about.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You can't? Don't you realize what this could mean? Get out of my sight; I need to find someone else to take your place.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Don't you know that God looks down on the meek?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry about it. I'll take them out and make sure the Republic gains nothing!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That sounds like too much pressure for me.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Things got too hot for me! I've got to abandon this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. I've uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. If you move fast, you'll be able to take out those repair ships with no problem. messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll give everything I've got. What do you need of me?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
In a nearby contested system, the Caldari State has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The troop transports have been destroyed. The Federation need not fear any longer!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: If our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Federation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I shall do my best to serve the Federation's ideals.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Caldari State is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Caldari positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Amarr forces in this sector have begun an offensive, and it's keeping chunks of our fleet busy just holding the line. The enemy can't maintain a major push like this for long, though, not without serious organization. That's where we'll have to hit them to put an end to this mess.

The first step will be to locate where those supply routes are so that we can launch a counterstrike. In order to do that, we need to get access to Amarr logistical command data, which is where you come in. We need you to attack one of their supply bases and get access to the tactical information sheet in the base's main outpost. Bring it back here so we can plan our counterattack.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I managed to get the tactical information sheet, but it wasn't easy.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You're setting our entire war effort back by weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out the missions we need, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder next time.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will. We can't afford to let this offensive continue unchecked.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that intelligence for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I just need you to get that intelligence. Everything else is secondary to that goal. Good luck, pilot.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What can I do?

messages.mission.briefing.text:

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You did a good job, pilot. I'll get that data into the right hands immediately.

We've got a mess on our hands and I need you to clean it up.

We recently came across some startling intelligence, given to us by certain sources I won't name. We learned that a Republic Security Services agent had infiltrated our ranks many years ago and has been actively working against us ever since. After this discovery we began watching this individual closely, it seems a little too closely.

Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops. Undoubtedly, they plan to strike at our weakest points. There is any number of nightmare scenarios they could bring to bear. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat.

Understood?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've dispatched the spy and his bodyguards.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Risk? Risk?! You have a clone, what risk is there? I'll tell you what risk is: it's when you have a long-time spy in your organization leading fleets against you, that's risk! Whatever, I'll find someone else who can spare me of such pathetic excuses for their own cowardice.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: The arrogance and presumption of you eggers amazes me. I don't need to explain myself to you; I'll just get someone else who knows their place.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Understood. I'll deal with this immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The gradual breakdown in relations between the empires over recent years has seen a drastic increase in their focus on espionage as a tool to both prevent, and more regularly, enhance warfare. As a result, spying is rife inside all of the empires and the common assumption that many organizations operate under is that they have already been compromised. Very few are trusted with crucial information, and those that have been are very closely watched. Despite their vast differences, the brutal treatment of those caught in the act is one thing shared by each nation.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Why aren't we trying to capture and interrogate him? I want no part in any assassination of such a valuable source.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I can't get to him, there's too much at risk.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. There is no room for error here, so don't make me regret trusting you with this.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm listening…

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've learned that a Republic Security Services agent has infiltrated our ranks and has been actively working against us ever since. Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops to undoubtedly strike at our weakest points. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat, understood?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, thank you. I hoped I could rely on your expertise and discretion. Once again you prove yourself a valuable ally of the Amarrian people.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance.

We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Minmatar logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and a great deal at stake for us should we fail to impede the recent progress they've been making.

We've reason to believe that our plans have already been partly compromised. We're expecting Republic forces to be more prepared than usual, possibly even reinforced, and we're aiming to prepare ourselves accordingly. I've been tasked with organising a capsuleer-based contingency plan and deploying it with specific orders in mind. Once I given the clear that we've got someone, they'll be launching the offensive immediately, so time is of the essence.

Having someone as capable as you at our backs would allow us a great deal of tactical flexibility on-field and all but ensure that victory is swift and casualties low. If it turns out you're not needed, then we'll still pay you for your time, but certain orders I've been receiving suggest we may yet have a use for you out there, time will tell.

Are you up for the mission?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Was that all you needed done? How is the fight going?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What?! I already told them we had someone inbound and they launched the operation! This is a gross display of negligence on your behalf, pilot. I'll be making a note of it in your records, just as soon as I've found someone who is actually reliable.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Am I supposed to be admiring your honesty here? If you're not cut out for this kind of work then you're not worth my time, period.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Of course. Give me the coordinates and I'll head out immediately.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This high-pressure stuff isn't really for me, I'm afraid. You'd be better off finding someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm sorry, but I have to decline this mission after all, I won't be able to provide the level of assistance you're after.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent, I'll tell them to proceed. Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh? Let's hear it then.

What I am about to ask you is strictly confidential, understood?

We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the Republic's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Amarrian people.

Their arrogance is astounding, no? They seem to think we will allow them to exist in peace simply because they bear no weapons. Their weak security presence suggests as much. Understand pilot; these people are as significant a threat as any other. What they provide may not be firepower or logistics but it is crucial to their war effort nonetheless. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

They have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these industrials, we can starve the enemy out.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Industrials have been destroyed. I only hope this serves our purposes and doesn't backfire.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Spare me the ethics lecture. I will find someone else who understands the importance of this mission.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: What would you have us do then, huh? Shall we just leave them there, let them continue to offer a kind of assistance no amount of military and logistics support can? You disappoint me, deeply. Oh, and if I find out you've leaked this information, there will be consequences.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: If you think I have a problem with this, I don't. I understand completely. Give me the location of the residence.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Civilian deaths in a war are a reality, one which is accepted as inevitable by all of the empires. The effects of such things are often hard to predict, however, and those targeting their attacks must do so carefully. There are times when the mass death of civilians can indeed crush a nation's will to fight any further, or cause such anxiety amongst their citizenry that popular support for conflict is replaced by angry cries to back down. At other times however, it will only harden their resolve, serving as a valuable and yet grim propaganda victory, that allows them to paint their enemy as a heartless monster.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Briefings like this make me question what side I should be fighting for. I want nothing to do with this.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've had second thoughts. I simply cannot do something as monstrous as this. We risk too much with actions of this nature.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You're right; I should have known you could be relied upon in these matters. I'm uploading the coordinates now, good luck.

We've received word that a convoy of supplies is heading there now. It's lightly guarded and destroying it will surely set the Amarr forces in this area back. Do you think you can handle it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've successfully destroyed the industrials!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You're quitting on me? Truly a sad day.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I never thought you'd turn this down. Oh well, I'll find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take out those industrials immediately!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Yawn, that doesn't sound like it's worth my time at all.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I must abandon this mission. I hope you understand.

Thankfully we've found out before they could get everything online. Their main reactor is still vulnerable to attack. If you destroy it, it will take the starbase with it. Can you head over there and take it out for us?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I expected more of the Federation-Republic alliance! I've trashed their reactor.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Unfortunate. Your failure shows our enemies weakness.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Hmph. I thought you'd jump to take this mission.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I can't let them succeed. I'll make sure both the Federation and Republic pay for their audacity!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: The Federation and Republic are working together? I could handle one, but not both!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: The combined forces of the Federation and Republic were too much for me to handle.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Great. Now, the forces building the starbase probably aren't too tough. After all, most will be prepared for construction, not combat. However, I'm sure there will be capsuleers working for our enemies in the area. You'll have to set yourself up to combat them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll make them regret their antagonism.
