messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. There is no room for error here, so don't make me regret trusting you with this.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm listening…

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've learned that a Caldari State agent has infiltrated our ranks and has been actively working against us ever since. Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops to undoubtedly strike at our weakest points. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat, understood?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, thank you. I hoped I could rely on your expertise and discretion. Once again you prove yourself a valuable ally of the Gallente people.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Something urgent has just come across my desk. The Amarr Empire at one time managed to set up a gate in a nearby contested system. We eventually drove them off, but we never got around to tearing the gate down. It seems that was a mistake, as now the Amarr are trying to get the gate operational again. They have a huge strike force on the other side, waiting to come through.

We do not have the manpower to fight off that strike force. However, we still have time to act. While our forces are keeping the escorts busy, you need to go in and take out those repair ships. Can you do that?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The repair crew has been destroyed and the gate remains offline. You have nothing more to worry about.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You can't? Don't you realize what this could mean? Get out of my sight; I need to find someone else to take your place.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Submission is not the way of the Minmatar! Submission is the way of defeat.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Don't worry about it. I'll take them out and make sure the State gains nothing!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That sounds like too much pressure for me.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Things got too hot for me! I've got to abandon this mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. I've uploaded the location of the gate to your NeoCom. If you move fast, you'll be able to take out those repair ships with no problem. Your main competition will be pod pilots flying under the banner of the Empire. Prepare yourself to fight them if they try to intervene.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll give everything I've got. What do you need of me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Amarr Empire is trying to reopen a gate in one of the nearby contested systems. Things are especially urgent, because our spies have learned they have a large strike force ready to come through the gate as soon as it's back online. We do not have the manpower to fight off the strike force at this time. Get there and destroy their repair ships.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: This is great news! The cause of freedom has been advanced today. With that repair crew taken out, we can request reinforcements and either demolish that gate or repair it ourselves and ambush the strike force as it comes through. You truly earned your reward today.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance.

We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Caldari State logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and a great deal at stake for us should we fail to impede the recent progress they've been making.

We've reason to believe that our plans have already been partly compromised. We're expecting State forces to be more prepared than usual, possibly even reinforced, and we're aiming to prepare ourselves accordingly. I've been tasked with organising a capsuleer-based contingency plan and deploying it with specific orders in mind. Once I given the clear that we've got someone, they'll be launching the offensive immediately, so time is of the essence.

Having someone as capable as you at our backs would allow us a great deal of tactical flexibility on-field and all but ensure that victory is swift and casualties low. If it turns out you're not needed, then we'll still pay you for your time, but certain orders I've been receiving suggest we may yet have a use for you out there, time will tell.

Are you up for the mission?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Was that all you needed done? How is the fight going?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What?! I already told them we had someone inbound and they launched the operation! This is a gross display of negligence on your behalf, pilot. I'll be making a note of it in your records, just as soon as I've found someone who is actually reliable.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Am I supposed to be admiring your honesty here? If you're not cut out for this kind of work then you're not worth my time, period.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Of course. Give me the coordinates and I'll head out immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: As relations began to slide further towards outright war, each of the empires increased their focus on long-term strategic interests. Exhaustively detailed battle plans of everything from invasion scenarios to the best locations for ammunitions caches were deliberated over endlessly by countless organizations dedicated to the singular task of winning, or perhaps simply surviving, a seemingly inevitable war.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This high-pressure stuff isn't really for me, I'm afraid. You'd be better off finding someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm sorry, but I have to decline this mission after all, I won't be able to provide the level of assistance you're after.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent, I'll tell them to proceed. Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Oh? Let's hear it then.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We'll be launching a high-risk operation behind enemy lines shortly and I want you around to provide some focused assistance. We're going to be hitting a heavily guarded ammunitions cache that is supporting Caldari State logistics within the entirety of a contested sector. There's going to be some intense fighting and we're expecting State forces to be more prepared than usual.

Fly over there as quickly as possible and await further instructions. I'll be transmitting attack and recall orders to you personally as the situation dictates.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: : I just received word that the cache has been secured and will be detonated once we've cleared the area. Excellent work out there, they've lost a strategic foothold as well as a prominent commander today, we couldn't be happier with the result.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
What I am about to ask you is strictly confidential, understood?

We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the State's presence is strong. This compound has become a home away from home for thousands of their citizens, the majority of whom are families of the soldiers and commanders serving abroad – that is, who are killing our own Gallente people.

Their arrogance is astounding, no? They seem to think we will allow them to exist in peace simply because they bear no weapons. Their weak security presence suggests as much. Understand pilot; these people are as significant a threat as any other. What they provide may not be firepower or logistics but it is crucial to their war effort nonetheless. These people are here to boost the morale of their forces; this is something that cannot be allowed to continue.

We've found they have one major weakness: their supply line. The colony is completely dependent on regular shipments from Industrials. If you can intercept and destroy these Industrials, we can starve the enemy out.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Industrials have been destroyed. I only hope this serves our purposes and doesn't backfire.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Spare me the ethics lecture. I will find someone else who understands the importance of this mission.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: What would you have us do then, huh? Shall we just leave them there, let them continue to offer a kind of assistance no amount of military and logistics support can? You disappoint me, deeply. Oh, and if I find out you've leaked this information, there will be consequences.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: If you think I have a problem with this, I don't. I understand completely. Give me the location of the residence.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Civilian deaths in a war are a reality, one which is accepted as inevitable by all of the empires. The effects of such things are often hard to predict, however, and those targeting their attacks must do so carefully. There are times when the mass death of civilians can indeed crush a nation's will to fight any further, or cause such anxiety amongst their citizenry that popular support for conflict is replaced by angry cries to back down. At other times however, it will only harden their resolve, serving as a valuable and yet grim propaganda victory, that allows them to paint their enemy as a heartless monster.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Briefings like this make me question what side I should be fighting for. I want nothing to do with this.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've had second thoughts. I simply cannot do something as monstrous as this. We risk too much with actions of this nature.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You're right; I should have known you could be relied upon in these matters. I'm uploading the coordinates now, good luck.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: How can I serve?

We've come across a civilian facility inside a nearby sector where the State's presence is strong. messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Though I understand and even share those same concerns, it was a risk that had to be taken. Good work today pilot, here's your pay.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've got a mess on our hands and I need you to clean it up.

We recently came across some startling intelligence, given to us by certain sources I won't name. We learned that an Amarrian agent had infiltrated our ranks many years ago and has been actively working against us ever since. After this discovery we began watching this individual closely, it seems a little too closely.

Maybe we spooked him, or perhaps the timing is just a coincidence, but he's been spotted in a nearby contested sector organizing a small squadron of troops. Undoubtedly, they plan to strike at our weakest points. There is any number of nightmare scenarios they could bring to bear. Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat.

Understood?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've dispatched the spy and his bodyguards.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Risk? Risk?! You have a clone, what risk is there? I'll tell you what risk is: it's when you have a long-time spy in your organization leading fleets against you, that's risk! Whatever, I'll find someone else who can spare me of such pathetic excuses for their own cowardice.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: The arrogance and presumption of you eggers amazes me. I don't need to explain myself to you; I'll just get someone else who knows their place.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Understood. I'll deal with this immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The gradual breakdown in relations between the empires over recent years has seen a drastic increase in their focus on espionage as a tool to both prevent, and more regularly, enhance warfare. As a result, spying is rife inside all of the empires and the common assumption that many organizations operate under is that they have already been compromised. Very few are trusted with crucial information, and those that have been are very closely watched. Despite their vast differences, the brutal treatment of those caught in the act is one thing shared by each nation.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Why aren't we trying to capture and interrogate him? I want no part in any assassination of such a valuable source.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I can't get to him, there's too much at risk.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. There is no room for error here, so don't make me regret trusting you with this.

Whether he knows we're on to him or not is irrelevant now; dead spies pose no threat, understood?

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, thank you. I hoped I could rely on your expertise and discretion. Once again you prove yourself a valuable ally of the Matari people.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I expected more of the Empire-State alliance! I've trashed their reactor.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Unfortunate. Having you fail shows our enemies weakness.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Hmph. I thought you'd jump to take this mission.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I can't let them succeed. I'll make sure both the Empire and State pay for their audacity!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
A joint taskforce between the Caldari and Amarr are trying to establish a starbase inside one of our contested systems. We cannot allow them to succeed. Luckily the starbase's main reactor is vulnerable to attack.

I've uploaded the location of the starbase to your NeoCom. Just remember, capsuleers loyal to our enemies will be able to fire on you in that system.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: The Empire and State are working together? I could handle one, but not both!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: The combined forces of the Empire and State were too much for me to handle.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Great. Now, the forces building the starbase probably aren't too tough. After all, most will be prepared for construction, not combat. However, I'm sure there will be capsuleers working for our enemies in the area. You'll have to set yourself up to combat them.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll make the world regret their antagonism.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent! If that's the best the Caldari and Amarr can throw against us together, our future is certainly bright indeed. You definitely earned your reward here.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Intelligence has been using an agent on a Caldari tactical relay to eavesdrop on their communications in this sector. A few days ago we lost contact with him and all reports ceased, leaving us with a giant blind spot. We assumed that our agent had been discovered and eliminated.

It seems that the problem is even worse than we feared. Intelligence intercepted a communiqué indicating that our agent was not just caught, but turned-- he's ready to tell the enemy everything he knows about our operations in this area. This must not happen.

Fortunately, at the moment he's still being held on the tactical relay, putting him within our striking distance. We need you to slip past enemy lines and destroy that relay before it's too late.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The tactical relay has been eliminated.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You have hurt us deeply here, pilot; I hope you realize that.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: We're all in this war together, pilot, or we're all in deep trouble. You need to realize that sooner rather than later.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Executing that traitor will be my honor. Don't worry, I'll make sure he's taken care of.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Look, I don't feel like cleaning up someone else's mess here. Find someone else to do your dirty work.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Don't take any chances; that relay is our top priority. Everything else is a secondary target.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Disturbing news?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your mission will be to slip past enemy lines and destroy the Caldari tactical relay and the spy on board. With him out of the way, our intelligence network in this sector should remain secure and the war effort will not be seriously threatened by his capture. Haste is of utmost importance, so don't waste any time.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Superb work, pilot. I'll make sure your name gets mentioned up the chain.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
In a nearby contested system, the Gallente Federation has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The troop transports have been destroyed. The State need not fear any longer!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: If our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Federation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: The State is life. I cannot turn away when it needs me!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Gallente Federation is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Gallente positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've just received word that a fleeing civilian convoy was destroyed by the Caldari, pilot. There were over two thousand fatalities before a Navy search-and-rescue force was able to reach the scene and recover the survivors.

In addition to the utter disregard for human life that this act displayed, evidently the daughter of a prominent senator and her family were on board one of the industrial ships with the convoy. They are still missing, but the Navy isn't hopeful that they will be found. We are outraged, and they want to show those terrorists that they can't get away with this kind of butchery.

I've been asked to find a pod pilot capable of taking out the sector commander who ordered this massacre. His battleship group is currently resupplying, and is temporarily vulnerable. It won't be easy; despite his cowardly choice of targets, he's quite capable and has a significant force at his disposal.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That murderer won't be committing any more acts of butchery.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I see. I'm disappointed, pilot, but I'm glad you told me now rather than later. I'll have to see if I can find someone more capable for a mission of this import.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It will be an honor to eliminate him.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't know if I can handle this, sir. You better find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm glad to hear it, pilot, and I'm sure the families of those lost will be, too. I'll be awaiting news of your victory.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What happened?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A Caldari task force destroyed a civilian convoy fleeing the front lines. Included in the missing and presumed dead are the daughter of a prominent senator and her family, and the general staff is outraged by the attack. We must have revenge for this brutal massacre.

The sector commander responsible for ordering the attack is currently resupplying, leaving him temporarily vulnerable. We don't intend to let him get away. Fly to the base at the coordinates you've been given and make sure the sector commander does not survive. Any other targets are secondary, but don't hold back. Show these bastards the wrath of the righteous.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, pilot. The families of the dead owe you a great debt.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
One of the key advantages we've had so far in this sector is our extensive cynosural field network, which allows us to drop our capital ships in on the enemy almost at will. The enemy, meanwhile, is forced to leave their ships vulnerable during cynosural field generation.

Unfortunately, our advantage may be crumbling. Yesterday, a task force engaging a Caldari blockade suffered serious losses when three enemy carriers dropped on them. The disturbing part is that the cynosural field was activated by a beacon, not by a Caldari ship. That means the Caldari have put up a limited cynosural field network to compete with ours. No doubt they're expanding it as fast as they can.

The network needs to be destroyed, but we need to know where those beacons have been deployed so that we can get all of them when we do a sweep. In order to do this, we want you to penetrate the security at the Caldari outpost nearby and get the tactical information sheet there. Bring it back here, and we'll have Naval Intelligence find those beacons. Understood?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've managed to get the tactical information sheet you needed. I hope it helps.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You're setting our entire war effort back weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out missions, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder in the future.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that intelligence. You can count on me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't do this; it's way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Don't let me down.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Of course. I'm always ready to do my part for the war effort.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Caldari forces have begun to deploy a cynosural field network in this sector.

In order to find the beacons comprising this network and destroy them, we need to get the records on where those beacons have been deployed. To find that, we need to get the tactical information sheet from the Caldari outpost not far from here. You'll need to fight your way to the outpost and grab the sheet. Bring it back to me as quickly as possible.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. I'll get that to Naval Intelligence right away.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
In a nearby contested system, the Caldari Federation has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The troop transports have been destroyed. The Federation need not fear any longer!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Federation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I shall do my best to serve the Federation's ideals.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Caldari Federation is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Caldari positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Good news, follower! We've just discovered the State doing something incredibly foolish! It turns out they've been sending miners into a contested system for ore. The impudence! Did they think they could do this with impunity!? I hope they're ready to pay for their folly.

I want you to be the one to make them pay. Our normal forces are occupied with other objectives. I'd like you to head over there and take out those miners. It will deny the Caldari a large amount of precious mineral resources. What do you say?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those mining vessels made a very pleasing explosion.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You really couldn't handle it? I guess you aren't as capable as they say.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Are you worried it will be too difficult?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Miners in a combat zone? Don't they know what could happen to them? They should see it coming!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Don't you have anything different for me to do?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't complete your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Perfect. The miners should be coming in and out of the belt. We doubt they'll be heavily defended, so you shouldn't have any problem destroying them. Capsuleers who foolishly cast their lot in with the State may be patrolling the area.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Ready as I'll ever be.

messages.mission.briefing.text: It looks like the State likes to send its citizens into dangerous territory to mine. Well, their stupidity is to our benefit. All you have to do is head over there and blow up the mining vessels, then report back to us. The miners and any escort they have should pose no problem to you. However, capsuleers loyal to the State are in the area; they might prove difficult.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I can just imagine those miners cursing the commander who sent them into hostile territory for some ore. Just before you sent them to a fiery demise, of course.

All you have to do is head over there and blow up the mining vessels, then report back to us. The miners and any escort they have should pose no problem to you. However, capsuleers loyal to the Federation are likely to be in the area, and they might prove more difficult.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I can just imagine those miners cursing the commander who sent them into hostile territory for some ore. Well, before you sent them to a fiery demise, of course.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've just received some very disturbing intelligence from my operatives inside the Caldari State. It seems that the Amarr Empire has turned over an old Sansha gate that leads into a nearby contested system. We never tore it down since Sansha's Nation doesn't bother us too often.

It looks like that has come back to bite us. The Caldari are planning on using the gate to launch an attack into our space. Luckily, the gate is set to only accept ships broadcasting a specific Sansha's transponder code. The Caldari have to reset both ends before they can utilize the gate.

Their repair team is at the gate now, doing the maintenance required to switch the codes. We need you to get over there and stop them immediately!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've wiped the repair crew out to a man. The invasion has been stopped, for now.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Don't you realize how important this mission is? Now what will we do?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Your hesitation is disheartening. I shall find someone made of sterner stuff.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get out there right away!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You're putting a lot on my shoulders here...

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't know how to say this, but I've been beaten. You'll need to find someone else to complete things.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm expecting good things of you. The repair ships are only lightly guarded, with most of the enemy forces waiting to invade. However, capsuleers aligned with the State may be waiting to attack.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll do what I can.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Caldari State is trying to open up an old smuggler's gate belonging to Sansha's Nation. If they can get it open, they will be able to bring in overwhelming forces before we can respond. Head out there and destroy the repair ships. Just make sure you're ready for a real fight. Capsuleers loyal to the State are out and about and may try to stop you.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We have a serious situation on our hands, pilot.

A few weeks ago we dispatched a small squadron of Caldari vessels that had made it inside our borders to a contested sector. We thought the job was finished and the area secure but it seems we've been duped. The entire regiment we cleared was just a decoy, and they've been massing hostiles in a nearby location with the use of covert technology.

The situation is not only embarrassing; it's undoubtedly boosted their own morale to have deceived us so effectively. We relocated all of our forces from there only days ago and re-establishing a presence will be admitting to our own people that those Federation scum outsmarted us…or one of them in particular, actually.

Various sources of ours have pointed towards one of their Field Commanders being the key strategist behind these latest maneuvers. We need her assassinated, pilot. Not only will her death impede their progress, but it should send a message to other commanders inside the State. Fly out there and make it clear to them: we have capsuleers ready and able to strike down their best and brightest. Let that be the first thought in their mind before they step up to lead fleets against our people.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Field Commander and her guards are dead.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I trusted you and only you with this, what am I supposed to do now? Now they know we sent some of our best and failed, you've only emboldened them further! It seems I'll have to seriously reassess your worth to us.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: A disappointing remark, especially coming from one such as you. A million brave deeds in good times cannot compare to a single act made when everything has begun to fall apart.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Understood. I'll make sure she's made an example of.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The added responsibility and higher profile that comes with promotion is never without a great amount of personal risk. This is true across all the navies of the empires. Enemy Field Commanders are one of the most common targets of assassinations, and though the high honor of attaining such a rank is something countless people work towards, many do not hold the position for very long.

This is particularly true of the most brilliant commanders, who are often the first to be targeted for removal. With loyal capsuleers at their disposal, the empires are only too happy to pay large sums to have the most promising enemy commanders ruthlessly culled.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not here to clean up the mistakes of others, find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: She's too well defended I'm afraid. I can't get to her.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could rely on you. I'll be eagerly awaiting news of your success.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Of course. How can I serve?

messages.mission.briefing.text:

Various sources of ours have pointed towards one of their Field Commanders being the key strategist behind these latest maneuvers. We need her assassinated.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, pilot. That should leave it clear to aspiring commanders just what exactly their promotion brings.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I did, I need you to support some forces of ours in the way only a capsuleer can.

We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. We'll be targeting one of the Caldari State's largest ship logistics depots in an effort to halt their progress. If we can remove their ability to repair and re-supply then we can push the advantage and hopefully clear them out of there altogether.

Admittedly, they've been a tough opponent so far and we've suffered some heavy losses. We're not taking any chances this time however, we need to come away with a victory today. That's why we've called in additional numbers…lots of them. Victory is all but assured this time but I want more than just success today, I want the Caldari utterly crushed and left without hope. I want them reeling from this defeat. That's where you come in.

You'll fly over there, hang at the back of the fighting and show them we even brought capsuleers to deal with their puny forces. I may have orders for you but I doubt it, though I still want you on standby just in case. You're there simply to crush their morale, to show them that no matter what they brought, their defeat was inevitable. It's an easy assignment, pilot; you should have no problem with it.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I could have stayed around to help further, you know. Was that really all you needed done?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Your lack of commitment does a great disservice to your reputation, pilot. I suggest you not repeat this mistake.  You are known for your loyalty and reliability, do not unravel all that hard work.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Then you do not understand your own importance, pilot. The mere presence of a capsuleer on the field can fill an entire fleet with terror. I'm disappointed that you cannot see the value in a mission such as this. Oh well, I'll make other arrangements.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sure, sounds easy enough. I'll head out immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Even the smallest of battlefields can become a focal point of a larger war when both sides refuse to back down. The localized strategic objectives of the battle can slowly fall out of view, as the fight in a particular area comes to represent the conflict at large; with both sides stubbornly fighting for a victory they believe will set the precedent for further ones.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No offense, but I'd rather serve the Federation in other, more important ways. I'm not some trophy you wave around.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I won't be able to help with this after all, something more important than a chest-beating mission came up and I'm giving it priority.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good, I'm relaying the coordinates now. Be on standby once you get there, I may still have some targets of opportunity for you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I'm talking to you. Did you have some work for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. We'll be targeting one of the Caldari State's largest ship logistics depots in an effort to halt their progress. You'll fly over there, hang at the back of the fighting and show them we even brought capsuleers to deal with their puny forces. I may have orders for you but I doubt it, though I still want you on standby just in case.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes, it helped more than I think you realize, we couldn't get to their Commander as quickly and effectively as you. Your actions freed us up to identify and remove the rest of their chain of command. We'll come away with the victory we needed, despite some heavy losses. Let our mistake be a lesson for you, pilot. Good work today though, here's your pay.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
: Good, listen carefully. The State has been moving their own citizens through our space, shuttling them back home from distant and lawless frontiers. We've been watching this for some time now and for the most part, simply ignoring it. Predictable as they are, we knew the appearance of lax border security would embolden them and this is precisely what has happened.

Very recently, we spotted a huge transport fleet carrying thousands upon thousands of their people towards our borders. We let them enter, pretending as always that we had not noticed. This time however, we reinforced all of the likely exit points with additional patrols. As a result they have not yet been able to leave.

They are currently holed up in a nearby contested sector, where State forces will offer them some protection, but only a little. They are sitting largely defenseless as they wait for an opportunity to pass back out into Caldari borders. I will give you those coordinates if you can promise me you will do something useful with them.

Am I being understood here, pilot?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Your loyalty has been tested and found lacking, along with your resolve. I can only hope that your discretion does not follow the same path, it would be a shame to lose such a capable pilot.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Very well. See that you do a good job of pretending. I would hate to see someone like yourself in the sort of trouble that leaking this information would land you in.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Despite the frequent death of civilians in a war, it is nonetheless exceptionally rare for large-scale casualties to happen without even a shred of reason. Engineers, mechanics, scientists, these and other professions – when used directly to aid combatant forces – can be said to have justifiably draw the wrath of their enemies. There just enough shades of grey to allow it.

No empire, however, is foolish enough to outright murder citizens without any involvement in a conflict. Or as some might argue, they are not so foolish as to get caught in the act. The rise of the capsuleer has spawned a dark new age where culpability is little more than an elusive dream.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Uploading them now. Do what must be done.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm ready for anything, you can count on my discretion.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I knew you could be trusted. Here is your payment, take it with my thanks.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Excellent. I'll give you our top priority assignment since I know how reliable you are.

We've recently had to deal with some rather resilient Caldari forces in a nearby contested sector. It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found.

I can see the look in your eyes, don't worry, we have a plan to take it down that won't involve fielding Capital vessels. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.

This mission isn't without risk; you are assaulting a Starbase after all. Expect some resistance and prepare yourself accordingly. Are you up to the task?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed the reactor; you can send our people in now.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You have a reputation for reliability, pilot. Don't let me see you undo all the hard work that earned it. I will find someone else, but I'm not impressed. This better be the last time you fail me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Unusual for you to behave like such a coward, I hope you're not starting to lose your nerve? Very well, I'll find someone else but…sort yourself out, please.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sounds like my kind of work. Send me the location and I'll head out there.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The advent of the Starbase has seen vast changes in the nature of entrenched, long-term warfare. The tactics of battlefield logistics had to be almost entirely reinvented when forces suddenly had the capability to restock and reship inside hostile space. This process is ongoing even today, as empires discover new ways to utilize the potent abilities afforded by these structures.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I apologize, but I won't be able to complete this mission after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent, I will be awaiting news of your success.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's what I'm here for, throw me one.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Intelligence has been using an agent on an Amarr tactical relay to eavesdrop on their communications in this sector. A few days ago we lost contact with him and all reports ceased, leaving us with a giant blind spot. We assumed that our agent had been discovered and eliminated.

It seems that the problem is even worse than we feared. Intelligence intercepted a communiqué indicating that our agent was not just caught, but turned-- he's ready to tell the enemy everything he knows about our operations in this area. This must not happen.

Fortunately, at the moment he's still being held on the tactical relay, putting him within our striking distance. We need you to slip past enemy lines and destroy that relay before it's too late.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The tactical relay has been eliminated.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You have hurt us deeply here, pilot; I hope you realize that.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: We're all in this war together, pilot, or we're all in deep trouble. You need to realize that sooner rather than later.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Executing that traitor will be my honor. Don't worry, I'll make sure he's taken care of.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Look, I don't feel like cleaning up someone else's mess here. Find someone else to do your dirty work.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Don't take any chances; that relay is our top priority. Everything else is a secondary target.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Disturbing news?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your mission will be to slip past enemy lines and destroy the Amarr tactical relay and the spy on board. With him out of the way, our intelligence network in this sector should remain secure and the war effort will not be seriously threatened by his capture. Haste is of utmost importance, so don't waste any time.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Superb work, pilot. I'll make sure your name gets mentioned up the chain.

I did, I need you to support some forces of ours in the way only a capsuleer can.

We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. We'll be targeting one of the Federation's largest ship logistics depots in an effort to halt their progress. If we can remove their ability to repair and re-supply then we can push the advantage and hopefully clear them out of there altogether.

Admittedly, they've been a tough opponent so far and we've suffered some heavy losses. We're not taking any chances this time however, we need to come away with a victory today. That's why we've called in additional numbers…lots of them. Victory is all but assured this time but I want more than just success today, I want the Federation utterly crushed and left without hope. I want them reeling from this defeat. That's where you come in.

You'll fly over there, hang at the back of the fighting and show them we even brought capsuleers to deal with their puny forces. I may have orders for you but I doubt it, though I still want you on standby just in case. You're there simply to crush their morale, to show them that no matter what they brought, their defeat was inevitable. It's an easy assignment, pilot; you should have no problem with it.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I could have stayed around to help further, you know. Was that really all you needed done?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Your lack of commitment does a great disservice to your reputation, pilot. I suggest you not repeat this mistake.  You are known for your loyalty and reliability, do not unravel all that hard work.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Then you do not understand your own importance, pilot. The mere presence of a capsuleer on the field can fill an entire fleet with terror. I'm disappointed that you cannot see the value in a mission such as this. Oh well, I'll make other arrangements.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sure, sounds easy enough. I'll head out immediately.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Even the smallest of battlefields can become a focal point of a larger war when both sides refuse to back down. The localized strategic objectives of the battle can slowly fall out of view, as the fight in a particular area comes to represent the conflict at large; with both sides stubbornly fighting for a victory they believe will set the precedent for further ones.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No offense, but I'd rather serve the State in other, more important ways. I'm not some trophy you wave around.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I won't be able to help with this after all, something more important than a chest-beating mission came up and I'm giving it priority.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good, I'm relaying the coordinates now. Be on standby once you get there, I may still have some targets of opportunity for you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I'm talking to you. Did you have some work for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. We'll be targeting one of the Federation's largest ship logistics depots in an effort to halt their progress. You'll fly over there, hang at the back of the fighting and show them we even brought capsuleers to deal with their puny forces. I may have orders for you but I doubt it, though I still want you on standby just in case.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes, it helped more than I think you realize, we couldn't get to their Commander as quickly and effectively as you. Your actions freed us up to identify and remove the rest of their chain of command. We'll come away with the victory we needed, despite some heavy losses. Let our mistake be a lesson for you, pilot. Good work today though, here's your pay.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've just received word that a fleeing civilian convoy was destroyed by the Amarr, pilot. There were over two thousand fatalities before a Fleet search-and-rescue force was able to reach the scene and recover the survivors.

In addition to the utter disregard for human life that this act displayed, evidently the daughter of a prominent Elder and her family were on board one of the industrial ships with the convoy. They are still missing, but the Fleet isn't hopeful that they will be found. We are outraged, and they want to show those terrorists that they can't get away with this kind of butchery.

I've been asked to find a pod pilot capable of taking out the sector commander who ordered this massacre. His battleship group is currently resupplying, and is temporarily vulnerable. It won't be easy; despite his cowardly choice of targets, he's quite capable and has a significant force at his disposal.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That murderer won't be committing any more acts of butchery.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I see. I'm disappointed, pilot, but I'm glad you told me now rather than later. I'll have to see if I can find someone more capable for a mission of this import.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It will be an honor to eliminate him.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't know if I can handle this, sir. You better find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm glad to hear it, pilot, and I'm sure the families of those lost will be, too. I'll be awaiting news of your victory.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What happened?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
An Amarr task force destroyed a civilian convoy fleeing the front lines. Included in the missing and presumed dead are the daughter of a prominent Elder and her family, and the general staff is outraged by the attack. We must have revenge for this brutal massacre.

The sector commander responsible for ordering the attack is currently resupplying, leaving him temporarily vulnerable. We don't intend to let him get away. Fly to the base at the coordinates you've been given and make sure the sector commander does not survive. Any other targets are secondary, but don't hold back. Blow those slaving bastards out of the sky.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, pilot. The families of the dead owe you a great debt.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
One of the key advantages we've had so far in this sector is our extensive cynosural field network, which allows us to drop our capital ships in on the enemy almost at will. The enemy, meanwhile, is forced to leave their ships vulnerable during cynosural field generation.

Unfortunately, our advantage may be crumbling. Yesterday, a task force engaging a Gallente blockade suffered serious losses when three enemy carriers dropped on them. The disturbing part is that the cynosural field was activated by a beacon, not by a Gallente ship. That means the Gallente have put up a limited cynosural field network to compete with ours. No doubt they're expanding it as fast as they can.

The network needs to be destroyed, but we need to know where those beacons have been deployed so that we can get all of them when we do a sweep. In order to do this, we want you to penetrate the security at the Gallente outpost nearby and get the tactical information sheet there. Bring it back here, and we'll have Naval Intelligence find those beacons. Understood?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've managed to get the tactical information sheet you needed. I hope it helps.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You're setting our entire war effort back weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out missions, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder in the future.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that intelligence. You can count on me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't do this; it's way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Don't let me down.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Of course. I'm always ready to do my part for the war effort.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Gallente forces have begun to deploy a cynosural field network in this sector.

In order to find the beacons comprising this network and destroy them, we need to get the records on where those beacons have been deployed. To find that, we need to get the tactical information sheet from the Gallente outpost not far from here. You'll need to fight your way to the outpost and grab the sheet. Bring it back to me as quickly as possible.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. I'll get that to Naval Intelligence right away.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Intelligence has been using an agent on a Gallente tactical relay to eavesdrop on their communications in this sector. A few days ago we lost contact with him and all reports ceased, leaving us with a giant blind spot. We assumed that our agent had been discovered and eliminated.

It seems that the problem is even worse than we feared. Intelligence intercepted a communiqué indicating that our agent was not just caught, but turned-- he's ready to tell the enemy everything he knows about our operations in this area. This must not happen.

Fortunately, at the moment he's still being held on the tactical relay, putting him within our striking distance. We need you to slip past enemy lines and destroy that relay before it's too late.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The tactical relay has been eliminated.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You have hurt us deeply here, pilot; I hope you realize that.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: We're all in this war together, pilot, or we're all in deep trouble. You need to realize that sooner rather than later.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Executing that traitor will be my honor. Don't worry, I'll make sure he's taken care of.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Look, I don't feel like cleaning up someone else's mess here. Find someone else to do your dirty work.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't get close enough to the relay to take it out. Find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Don't take any chances; that relay is our top priority. Everything else is a secondary target.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Disturbing news?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your mission will be to slip past enemy lines and destroy the Gallente tactical relay and the spy on board. With him out of the way, our intelligence network in this sector should remain secure and the war effort will not be seriously threatened by his capture. Haste is of utmost importance, so don't waste any time.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Superb work, pilot. I'll make sure your name gets mentioned up the chain.

Show these bastards the wrath of the righteous.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, pilot. The families of the dead owe you a great debt.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
In a nearby contested system, the Amarr Empire has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The troop transports have been destroyed. The Republic need not fear any longer!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: If our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Empire.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I shall do my best to live up to their expectations. What do you have for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Amarr Empire is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Amarr positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've just received some very disturbing intelligence from my operatives inside the Gallente Federation. It seems that the Minmatar Republic has turned over an old Angel gate that leads into a nearby contested system of ours. We never tore it down, since the Cartel doesn't bother us too often.

Unfortunately, it looks like that has come back to bite us. The Gallente are planning on using the gate to launch an attack into our space. Luckily, the gate is set to only accept ships broadcasting a specific Cartel transponder code. The Gallente have to reset both ends before they can utilize the gate.

Their repair team is at the gate now, doing the maintenance required to switch the codes. We need you to get over there and stop them immediately!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've wiped the repair crew out to a man. The invasion has been stopped, for now.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Don't you realize how important this mission is? Now what will we do?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Your hesitation is disheartening. I shall find someone made of sterner stuff.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get out there right away!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You're putting a lot on my shoulders here...

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't know how to say this, but I've been beaten. You'll need to find someone else to complete things.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm expecting good things of you. The repair ships are only lightly guarded, with most of the enemy forces waiting to invade. However, capsuleers aligned with the Federation may be waiting to attack. You should watch out!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'll do what I can.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Gallente Federation is trying to open up an old smuggler's gate belonging to the Angel Cartel. If they can get it open, they will be able to bring in overwhelming forces before we can respond. Head out there and destroy the repair ships. Just make sure you're ready for a real fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Federation are out and about and may try to stop you.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've really saved our butts today. If the Federation got that gate working, we'd be faced with a large invasion force behind our front lines. That could have been catastrophic. I suppose we'll have to be more diligent in the future with those sort of things.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Good news, follower! We've just discovered the Empire doing something incredibly foolish! It turns out they've been sending in miners to a contested system near their sovereign space. I hope they're ready to pay for their folly.

I want you to be the one to make them pay. Our normal forces are occupied with other objectives: I'd like you to head over there and take out those miners. Not only will it deny Amarr a large amount of precious mineral resources, it will also sting their sickening pride. What do you say?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those mining vessels made a very pleasing explosion.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You really couldn't handle it? I guess you aren't as capable as they say.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Are you worried it will be too difficult?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Miners in a combat zone? They should see what I'm going to do to them coming!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Don't you have anything different for me to do?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't complete your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Perfect. The miners should be coming in and out of the belt. We doubt they'll be heavily defended, so you shouldn't have any problem destroying them. Capsuleers who foolishly cast their lot in with the Empire may be patrolling the area.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Empire has made a mistake. A really dumb one: They've sent miners out into hostile territory for ore. What's their stupidity is to our benefit. Just head over there and blow up the mining vessels, then report back to us. The miners and any escort they have should pose no problem to you. However, some Amarrian capsuleers have been spotted in the area, so be ready for a firefight.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I can just imagine those miners cursing the commander who sent them into hostile territory for some ore. Well, before you sent them to a fiery demise, of course.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Excellent. I'll give you our top priority assignment since I know how reliable you are.

We've recently had to deal with some rather resilient Federation forces in a nearby contested sector. It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found.

I can see the look in your eyes, don't worry, we have a plan to take it down that won't involve fielding Capital vessels. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.

This mission isn't without risk; you are assaulting a Starbase after all. Expect some resistance and prepare yourself accordingly. Are you up to the task?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed the reactor; you can send our people in now.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You have a reputation for reliability, pilot. Don't let me see you undo all the hard work that earned it. I will find someone else, but I'm not impressed. This better be the last time you fail me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Unusual for you to behave like such a coward, I hope you're not starting to lose your nerve? Very well, I'll find someone else but…sort yourself out, please.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sounds like my kind of work. Send me the location and I'll head out there.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The advent of the Starbase has seen vast changes in the nature of entrenched, long-term warfare. The tactics of battlefield logistics had to be almost entirely reinvented when forces suddenly had the capability to restock and reship inside hostile space. This process is ongoing even today, as empires discover new ways to utilize the potent abilities afforded by these structures.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not going up against a Starbase, even with a plan like this. You best find someone else more willing to lose their ship and crew.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I apologize, but I won't be able to complete this mission after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent, I will be awaiting news of your success.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's what I'm here for, throw me one.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We have a serious situation on our hands, pilot.

A few weeks ago we dispatched a small squadron of Amarrian vessels that had made it inside our borders to a contested sector. We thought the job was finished and the area secure but it seems we've been duped. The entire regiment we cleared was just a decoy, and they've been massing hostiles in a nearby location with the use of covert technology.

The situation is not only embarrassing; it's undoubtedly boosted their own morale to have deceived us so effectively. We relocated all of our forces from there only days ago and re-establishing a presence will be admitting to our own people that those Imperial scum outsmarted us…or one of them in particular, actually.

Various sources of ours have pointed towards one of their Field Commanders being the key strategist behind these latest maneuvers. We need her assassinated, pilot. Not only will her death impede their progress, but it should send a message to other commanders inside the Empire. Fly out there and make it clear to them: we have capsuleers ready and able to strike down their best and brightest. Let that be the first thought in their mind before they step up to lead fleets against our people.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Field Commander and her guards are dead.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I trusted you and only you with this, what am I supposed to do now? Now they know we sent some of our best and failed, you've only emboldened them further! It seems I'll have to seriously reassess your worth to us.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: A disappointing remark, especially coming from one such as you. A million brave deeds in good times cannot compare to a single act made when everything has begun to fall apart.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Understood. I'll make sure she's made an example of.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The added responsibility and higher profile that comes with promotion is never without a great amount of personal risk. This is true across all the navies of the empires. Enemy Field Commanders are one of the most common targets of assassinations, and though the high honor of attaining such a rank is something countless people work towards, many do not hold the position for very long.

This is particularly true of the most brilliant commanders, who are often the first to be targeted for removal. With loyal capsuleers at their disposal, the empires are only too happy to pay large sums to have the most promising enemy commanders ruthlessly culled.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not here to clean up the mistakes of others, find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: She's too well defended I'm afraid. I can't get to her.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could rely on you. I'll be eagerly awaiting news of your success.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Of course. How can I serve?

You're there simply to crush their morale, to show them that no matter what they brought, their defeat was inevitable. It's an easy assignment, pilot; you should have no problem with it.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I could have stayed around to help further, you know. Was that really all you needed done?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Your lack of commitment does a great disservice to your reputation, pilot. I suggest you not repeat this mistake.  You are known for your loyalty and reliability, do not unravel all that hard work.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Then you do not understand your own importance, pilot. The mere presence of a capsuleer on the field can fill an entire fleet with terror. I'm disappointed that you cannot see the value in a mission such as this. Oh well, I'll make other arrangements.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sure, sounds easy enough. I'll head out immediately.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's why I'm talking to you. Did you have some work for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. Good work today though, here's your pay.

Good, listen carefully. The Amarrians have been moving their own citizens through our space, shuttling them back home from distant and lawless frontiers. We've been watching this for some time now and for the most part, simply ignoring it. Predictable as they are, we knew the appearance of lax border security would embolden them and this is precisely what has happened.

Very recently, we spotted a huge transport fleet carrying thousands upon thousands of their people towards our borders. We let them enter, pretending as always that we had not noticed. This time however, we reinforced all of the likely exit points with additional patrols. As a result they have not yet been able to leave.

They are currently holed up in a nearby contested sector, where Amarrian forces will offer them some protection, but only a little. They are sitting largely defenseless as they wait for an opportunity to pass back out into Empire borders. I will give you those coordinates if you can promise me you will do something useful with them.

Am I being understood here, pilot?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The work has been completed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Your loyalty has been tested and found lacking, along with your resolve. I can only hope that your discretion does not follow the same path, it would be a shame to lose such a capable pilot.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Very well. See that you do a good job of pretending. I would hate to see someone like yourself in the sort of trouble that leaking this information would land you in.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Give me the coordinates.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:

There just enough shades of grey to allow it.

No empire, however, is foolish enough to outright murder citizens without any involvement in a conflict. Or as some might argue, they are not so foolish as to get caught in the act. The rise of the capsuleer has spawned a dark new age where culpability is little more than an elusive dream.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew you could be trusted. Here is your payment, take it with my thanks.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm ready for anything, you can count on my discretion.
