Intelligence has been using an agent on a Minmatar tactical relay to eavesdrop on their communications in this sector. A few days ago we lost contact with him and all reports ceased, leaving us with a giant blind spot. We assumed that our agent had been discovered and eliminated.

It seems that the problem is even worse than we feared. Intelligence intercepted a communiqué indicating that our agent was not just caught, but turned-- he's ready to tell the enemy everything he knows about our operations in this area. This must not happen.

Fortunately, at the moment he's still being held on the tactical relay, putting him within our striking distance. We need you to slip past enemy lines and destroy that relay before it's too late.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The tactical relay has been eliminated.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You have hurt us deeply here, pilot; I hope you realize that.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: We're all in this war together, pilot, or we're all in deep trouble. You need to realize that sooner rather than later.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Executing that traitor will be my honor. Don't worry, I'll make sure he's taken care of.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Look, I don't feel like cleaning up someone else's mess here. Find someone else to do your dirty work.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Don't take any chances; that relay is our top priority. Everything else is a secondary target.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Disturbing news?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your mission will be to slip past enemy lines and destroy the Minmatar tactical relay and the spy on board. With him out of the way, our intelligence network in this sector should remain secure and the war effort will not be seriously threatened by his capture. Haste is of utmost importance, so don't waste any time.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Superb work, pilot. I'll make sure your name gets mentioned up the chain.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've just received word that a fleeing civilian convoy was destroyed by the Minmatar, pilot. There were over two thousand fatalities before a Navy search-and-rescue force was able to reach the scene and recover the survivors.

In addition to the utter disregard for human life that this act displayed, evidently the daughter of a prominent Holder and her family were on board one of the industrial ships with the convoy. They are still missing, but the Navy isn't hopeful that they will be found. We are outraged, and they want to show those terrorists that they can't get away with this kind of butchery.

I've been asked to find a pod pilot capable of taking out the sector commander who ordered this massacre. His battleship group is currently resupplying, and is temporarily vulnerable. It won't be easy; despite his cowardly choice of targets, he's quite capable and has a significant force at his disposal.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That murderer won't be committing any more acts of butchery.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I see. I'm disappointed, pilot, but I'm glad you told me now rather than later. I'll have to see if I can find someone more capable for a mission of this import.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It will be an honor to eliminate him.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't know if I can handle this, sir. You better find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm glad to hear it, pilot, and I'm sure the families of those lost will be, too. I'll be awaiting news of your victory.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What happened?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A Minmatar task force destroyed a civilian convoy fleeing the front lines. Included in the missing and presumed dead are the daughter of a prominent Holder and her family, and the general staff is outraged by the attack. We must have revenge for this brutal massacre.

The sector commander responsible for ordering the attack is currently resupplying, leaving him temporarily vulnerable. We don't intend to let him get away. Fly to the base at the coordinates you've been given and make sure the sector commander does not survive. Any other targets are secondary, but don't hold back. Show these bastards the wrath of the righteous.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, pilot. The families of the dead owe you a great debt.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
One of the key advantages we've had so far in this sector is our extensive cynosural field network, which allows us to drop our capital ships in on the enemy almost at will. The enemy, meanwhile, is forced to leave their ships vulnerable during cynosural field generation.

Unfortunately, our advantage may be crumbling. Yesterday, a task force engaging a Minmatar blockade suffered serious losses when three enemy carriers dropped on them. The disturbing part is that the cynosural field was activated by a beacon, not by a Minmatar ship. That means the Minmatar have put up a limited cynosural field network to compete with ours. No doubt they're expanding it as fast as they can.

The network needs to be destroyed, but we need to know where those beacons have been deployed so that we can get all of them when we do a sweep. In order to do this, we want you to penetrate the security at the Minmatar outpost nearby and get the tactical information sheet there. Bring it back here, and we'll have Naval Intelligence find those beacons. Understood?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've managed to get the tactical information sheet you needed. I hope it helps.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You're setting our entire war effort back weeks, pilot. If you can't carry out missions, then you're no use to us. You'd better work a little harder in the future.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If you won't do it, I'll have to find someone else who will.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get that intelligence. You can count on me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm going to sit this one out.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't do this; it's way over my head. You're going to have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: : I'll be looking forward to hearing from you. Don't let me down.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Of course. I'm always ready to do my part for the war effort.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Minmatar forces have begun to deploy a cynosural field network in this sector.

In order to find the beacons comprising this network and destroy them, we need to get the records on where those beacons have been deployed. To find that, we need to get the tactical information sheet from the Minmatar outpost not far from here. You'll need to fight your way to the outpost and grab the sheet. Bring it back to me as quickly as possible.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, pilot. I'll get that to Naval Intelligence right away.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
In a nearby contested system, the Minmatar Republic has long held illusions of claiming it entirely for themselves. Now, we've always been able to stop them, but lately they've started moving ground troops into their command outpost there.

We cannot attack the command outpost directly. It's too well guarded and our forces are kept occupied in other areas. However, if they manage to get enough ground troops there, they can launch an attack on our planetary holdings.

Our scanners have picked up a lightly guarded convoy filled with troops heading toward the command outpost. You can take them out, no sweat, right?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The troop transports have been destroyed. The Empire need not fear any longer!

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: If our ground forces are forced into a confrontation, thousands of lives will be lost.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You would really turn down my offer? I'm not sure you know the severity of this mission.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll make sure those troops never reach their destinations!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Anyone can take out a few transports! Why can't you give me something more substantial?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Yipes! That didn't turn out as easy as I hoped. I'm going to have to quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I knew you would be up for it. The convoy guards should not pose a significant challenge to you. And besides, the only real targets are the industrials carrying the ground troops. Destroy them and you can avoid fighting the other ships, unless you want to.

The main threat to your mission will be capsuleers supporting the Republic.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Serving the Empire is serving the side of right!

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Minmatar Republic is building up its ground troops in a nearby contested system with plans to launch an attack on our fortified positions.

We've discovered a troop transport moving toward their command outpost. You need merely destroy the industrials and don't need to bother with the convoy guards.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: With their troops eliminated, we'll be able to reinforce our own positions. And maybe soon, we'll be able to push forward and overwhelm the Minmatar positions as well! Just another step towards victory! Excellent work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Good news, follower! We've just discovered the Republic doing something incredibly foolish! It turns out they've been sending in miners to a nearby contested system. The impudence! Did they think they could do this right under our noses and we wouldn't notice? I hope they're ready to pay for their folly.

I want you to be the one to make them pay. Our normal forces are occupied with other objectives. I'd like you to head over there and take out those miners. It will deny the Minmatar a large amount of precious mineral resources. What do you say?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Those mining vessels made a very pleasing explosion.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You really couldn't handle it? I guess you aren't as capable as they say.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Are you worried it will be too difficult?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Miners in a combat zone? They should see what I'm going to do to them coming!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Don't you have anything different for me to do?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I can't complete your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Perfect. The miners should be coming in and out of the belt. We doubt they'll be heavily defended, so you shouldn't have any problem destroying them. Capsuleers who foolishly cast their lot in with the Republic may be patrolling the area.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Ready as I'll ever be.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Republic has sent workers into hostile territory to mine asteroids. Well, their foolish overconfidence is to our benefit. All you have to do is head over there and blow up the mining vessels, then report back to us. The miners and any escort they have should pose no problem to you; however, the Republic capsuleers in the area might prove difficult. Be ready.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I can just imagine those miners cursing the commander who sent them into hostile territory for some ore. Well, before you sent them to a fiery demise, of course.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've just received some very disturbing intelligence from my operatives inside the Minmatar Republic. It seems that the Gallente Federation has turned over an old Serpentis gate that leads into a nearby contested system. We never tore it down since the Serpentis don't bother us too often.

It looks like that has come back to bite us. The Minmatar are planning on using the gate to launch an attack into our space. Luckily, the gate is set to only accept ships broadcasting a specific Serpentis transponder code. The Minmatar have to reset both ends before they can utilize the gate.

Their repair team is at the gate now, doing the maintenance required to switch the codes. We need you to get over there and stop them immediately!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've wiped the repair crew out to a man. The invasion has been stopped, for now.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Don't you realize how important this mission is? Now what will we do?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Your hesitation is disheartening. I shall find someone made of sterner stuff.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get out there right away!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You're putting a lot on my shoulders here...

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't know how to say this, but I've been beaten. You'll need to find someone else to complete things.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm expecting good things of you. The repair ships are only lightly guarded, with most of the enemy forces waiting to invade. However, capsuleers aligned with the Republic may be waiting to attack. You should watch out!

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Minmatar Republic is trying to open up an old smuggler's gate belonging to the Serpentis. If they can get it open, they will be able to bring in overwhelming forces before we can respond. Head out there and destroy the repair ships. Just make sure you're ready for a real fight. Capsuleers loyal to the Republic are out and about and may try to stop you.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've really saved our butts today. If the Republic got that gate working, we'd be faced with a large invasion force behind our front lines. That could have been catastrophic. I suppose we'll have to be more diligent in the future with those sort of things.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We have a serious situation on our hands, pilot.

A few weeks ago we dispatched a small squadron of Minmatar vessels that had made it inside our borders to a contested sector. We thought the job was finished and the area secure but it seems we've been duped. The entire regiment we cleared was just a decoy, and they've been massing hostiles in a nearby location with the use of covert technology.

The situation is not only embarrassing; it's undoubtedly boosted their own morale to have deceived us so effectively. We relocated all of our forces from there only days ago and re-establishing a presence will be admitting to our own people that those Federation scum outsmarted us…or one of them in particular, actually.

Various sources of ours have pointed towards one of their Field Commanders being the key strategist behind these latest maneuvers. We need her assassinated, pilot. Not only will her death impede their progress, but it should send a message to other commanders inside the Republic. Fly out there and make it clear to them: we have capsuleers ready and able to strike down their best and brightest. Let that be the first thought in their mind before they step up to lead fleets against our people.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Field Commander and her guards are dead.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I trusted you and only you with this, what am I supposed to do now? Now they know we sent some of our best and failed, you've only emboldened them further! It seems I'll have to seriously reassess your worth to us.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: A disappointing remark, especially coming from one such as you. A million brave deeds in good times cannot compare to a single act made when everything has begun to fall apart.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Understood. I'll make sure she's made an example of.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The added responsibility and higher profile that comes with promotion is never without a great amount of personal risk. This is true across all the navies of the empires. Enemy Field Commanders are one of the most common targets of assassinations, and though the high honor of attaining such a rank is something countless people work towards, many do not hold the position for very long.

This is particularly true of the most brilliant commanders, who are often the first to be targeted for removal. With loyal capsuleers at their disposal, the empires are only too happy to pay large sums to have the most promising enemy commanders ruthlessly culled.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not here to clean up the mistakes of others, find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: She's too well defended I'm afraid. I can't get to her.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could rely on you. I'll be eagerly awaiting news of your success.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Of course. How can I serve?

I did, I need you to support some forces of ours in the way only a capsuleer can.

We're about to launch an operation in a heavily contested sector where we've seen mixed success recently. We'll be targeting one of the Minmatar Republic's largest ship logistics depots in an effort to halt their progress. If we can remove their ability to repair and re-supply then we can push the advantage and hopefully clear them out of there altogether.

Admittedly, they've been a tough opponent so far and we've suffered some heavy losses. We're not taking any chances this time however, we need to come away with a victory today. That's why we've called in additional numbers…lots of them. Victory is all but assured this time but I want more than just success today, I want those savages utterly crushed and left without hope. I want them reeling from this defeat. That's where you come in.

You'll fly over there, hang at the back of the fighting and show them we even brought capsuleers to deal with their puny forces. messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Uploading them now. Do what must be done. Go with God's blessing, pilot.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I'm ready for anything, you can count on my discretion.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I knew you could be trusted. Here is your payment, take it with my thanks.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Excellent. I'll give you our top priority assignment since I know how reliable you are.

We've recently had to deal with some rather resilient Minmatar forces in a nearby contested sector. It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found.

I can see the look in your eyes, don't worry, we have a plan to take it down that won't involve fielding Capital vessels. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.

This mission isn't without risk; you are assaulting a Starbase after all. Expect some resistance and prepare yourself accordingly. Are you up to the task?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed the reactor; you can send our people in now.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You have a reputation for reliability, pilot. Don't let me see you undo all the hard work that earned it. I will find someone else, but I'm not impressed. This better be the last time you fail me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Unusual for you to behave like such a coward, I hope you're not starting to lose your nerve? Very well, I'll find someone else but…sort yourself out, please.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sounds like my kind of work. Send me the location and I'll head out there.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The advent of the Starbase has seen vast changes in the nature of entrenched, long-term warfare. The tactics of battlefield logistics had to be almost entirely reinvented when forces suddenly had the capability to restock and reship inside hostile space. This process is ongoing even today, as empires discover new ways to utilize the potent abilities afforded by these structures.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not going up against a Starbase, even with a plan like this. You best find someone else more willing to lose their ship and crew.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I apologize, but I won't be able to complete this mission after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent, I will be awaiting news of your success.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's what I'm here for, throw me one.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Excellent. I'll give you our top priority assignment since I know how reliable you are.

We've recently had to deal with some rather resilient Amarrian forces in a nearby contested sector. It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found.

I can see the look in your eyes, don't worry, we have a plan to take it down that won't involve fielding Capital vessels. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.

This mission isn't without risk; you are assaulting a Starbase after all. Expect some resistance and prepare yourself accordingly. Are you up to the task?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed the reactor; you can send our people in now.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You have a reputation for reliability, pilot. Don't let me see you undo all the hard work that earned it. I will find someone else, but I'm not impressed. This better be the last time you fail me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Unusual for you to behave like such a coward, I hope you're not starting to lose your nerve? Very well, I'll find someone else but…sort yourself out, please.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sounds like my kind of work. Send me the location and I'll head out there.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The advent of the Starbase has seen vast changes in the nature of entrenched, long-term warfare. The tactics of battlefield logistics had to be almost entirely reinvented when forces suddenly had the capability to restock and reship inside hostile space. This process is ongoing even today, as empires discover new ways to utilize the potent abilities afforded by these structures.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not going up against a Starbase, even with a plan like this. You best find someone else more willing to lose their ship and crew.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I apologize, but I won't be able to complete this mission after all. Hopefully you can find someone else in time.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent, I will be awaiting news of your success.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: That's what I'm here for, throw me one.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've recently had to deal with some rather resilient Amarrian forces in a nearby contested sector. It seemed like every hard-earned victory counted for nothing; they would simply retreat, regroup and repair. We knew they had to have a Starbase somewhere to do this as effectively as they were. That Starbase has now been found. You simply need to destroy the Main Reactor powering the shields. From there we can send in a team to clear the rest out.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I knew I could rely on you. Excellent work, I'll give the order to mobilize immediately. Here is your pay, take it with my gratitude.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Some of our explorers have just located a hidden asteroid belt that is apparently full of rare ore — here in local space. That's more than a little suspicious. The signature the belt is giving off is obvious enough that it seems nearly impossible it hasn't been found and mined out before now. We're afraid it might be a trap of some sort. We want you to warp over there and check it out, then report back.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yes, I certainly do have something for you. Recently, some explorers employed by {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} discovered an extremely strong gravimetric signature. Their scanners indicated the hidden belt was full of rare ore. Now, while this news would normally be cause for joy, I'm suspicious.

I'd like you to fly over to the belt and check it out. If it really is full of ore-- wonderful. If not, get back to me with the news as quickly as possible.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Looks like rogue drones staged this ambush.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I should have known better than to trust you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I can understand your nervousness, I suppose. I'll have to find someone else.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: You can count on me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: You want me to walk into a trap on purpose? No, thanks-- find some other patsy.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: The prospect of walking into a trap doesn't appeal to me. I'm quitting your mission.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Remember, we have no idea who might be there waiting for you. So be ready for anything.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I know, I'm awesome. Anyway, you got anything to do?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Is the prospect of springing a trap really that unnerving? I'm afraid I can't wait for your courage to show up.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I've never heard of them setting ambushes before. That is disturbing news.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You still haven't answered me about the mission. I'm assuming that means "no", so I'll find someone else.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I thought as much. Okay. Good.

We recently received word that the Gallente have discovered a massive hidden deposit of Prime Arkonor in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and are setting up an industrial mining operation there. Prime Arkonor, as you probably know, is one of the most valuable minerals in the galaxy. And while we can't seem to pin down the location of the field itself, we do know where their processing base is.

Enter the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and wipe out the mining infrastructure they have constructed there. Your objective is the ore processor station itself, but you may want to take out their communications relay first so they can't call for backup. And don't go barging in there in a battleship, either. Try to be a little more subtle.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I destroyed it all. Those Gallente won't be getting any more of that Arkonor anytime soon.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, I must say — you are not the fearless captain I had thought you were.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope I can find someone else to handle this.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll raze the outpost until nothing is left but fiery debris.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Listen, I've got enough to worry about without getting the Gallente pissed at me. And there's already plenty of Caldari to mess with out there.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: There's a lot of Gallente out there: You might need to call in some big guns on this one. Sorry, I'm done.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Don't waste any time. <font color=#FF0000>And remember, you won't make it in in a battleship, so take something smaller.</font>

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Good stuff. That's why I'm here.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We recently received word that the Gallente have discovered a massive hidden deposit of Prime Arkonor in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and are setting up an industrial mining operation there. Prime Arkonor, as you probably know, is one of the most valuable minerals in the galaxy. And while we can't seem to pin down the location of the field itself, we do know where their processing base is.

Enter the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system and wipe out the mining infrastructure they have constructed there. Your objective is the ore processor station itself, but you may want to take out their communications relay first so they can't call for backup. And don't go barging in there in a battleship, either. Try to be a little more subtle.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nice work.  I'll keep you in mind when something else comes up.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
A Gallente admiral has seen the light of true faith and experienced a religious conversion. A hand-written, hand-delivered letter — on actual paper! — arrived in the office this morning, expressing Admiral Meledier's desire to defect. Having a high-ranking Gallente officer suddenly join our side could cause tremendous damage to the ability of their capsuleers to wage war against us: His knowledge of their systems and tactics would be staggering.

We want you to go collect him from the rendezvous point in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. You game?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Mission accomplished. Admiral Meledier is on board.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: How very disappointing, {[character]player.name}. The Empire will not look with pleasure upon your lack of courage.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll bring him in safe and sound.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Are you kidding? I'm not going up against an entire squadron of the Gallente Navy!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Fantastic. Alright, you might as well move out: A chance like this won't come again anytime soon.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Yes, of course. What is it, {[character]agentID.name}?

messages.mission.briefing.text: A high-ranking Gallente officer has experienced a religious conversion and wants to defect to Amarr. This man, Admiral Meledier, has apparently arranged to lead a reconnaissance foray into our space and is holed up in an old outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Get out there and extract him from the rendezvous point.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work. You have done well. Glory to Amarr!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Very good, young capsuleer. Accept the purity of Blood and all will be well with you.

Recently, several of our brethren were slain by a group of infidel miners encroaching on our territory in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. These outsiders are stealing our precious resources. Go out there and kill them all, and then bring their cargo back to me. The Collectors will move in once you've finished the job.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The miners have been destroyed, O Sanguine One. Their cargo is in my hold.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Have you no courage, {[character]player.name}? Do you not follow the sacred creed? Never merciful.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Their blood will be ours.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I will not slay some helpless miners. Can we not just drive them away?

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Now go and do your work. Never merciful.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Of course, Sanguine One. Let me prove my loyalty. Who needs bleeding?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Several of our brethren were slain by a group of infidel miners encroaching on our territory in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. These outsiders are stealing our precious resources. Go out there and kill them all; bring their cargo back to me.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done well — you've sent a message to those who would encroach on what is ours.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, it just so happens that we're in the middle of some operations that might require a capsuleer's assistance.

The Amarrians have been busy lately, building bases and moving fleet resources back and forth along the frontier. We've done recon in several of the systems where the Amarrians have been active, but we recently observed unusual comings and goings in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We think they might be building a base in one of the system's asteroid fields, but we can't be sure as all of our ships are tied down in other locations.

I'd like to install a reconnaissance module in your ship, then have you fly to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} posing as a freelance miner. Go to the asteroid field that we've entered into your NeoCom and mine 2000 units of Scordite. We'll take the ore off your hands when you get back to make sure everything looks aboveboard.

While you're mining, the recon module will be scanning the region and monitoring Amarrian activity around the system. You'll never even notice it's there. Once you've finished, head back here and we'll recover the recon unit, take the ore, and reward you for your efforts.

Note, I'd advise caution. Will you do it, {[character]player.name}?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: You can get your recon module back now. I ran into a few Amarrian gnats, but I swatted them away.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I'm sorry to hear that, sorry indeed. You've wasted a valuable opportunity.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Your loss, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It sounds like a good deal to me. Sure, I'll help you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Doesn't sound like my kind of job. I'm sure you can find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm not the right pilot for this job. I resign.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: We've entered the coordinates into your NeoCom, and the recon unit has been installed in your ship. Remember, you won't even know it's there.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm well, thanks. Do you have any work available?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I'd like you to fly to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} posing as a freelance miner; while you're out there, we'll have a reconnaissance module installed in your ship. Go to the asteroid field that we've entered into your NeoCom and mine 2,000 units of Scordite. Of course we'll reimburse you generously for your time and for the ore – the mining mission is just a cover for the recon mission.

While you're mining, the recon module will be scanning the region and monitoring Amarrian activity around the system. You'll never even notice it's there. Once you've finished, head back here and we'll recover the recon unit, take the ore, and reward you for your efforts. I'd advise caution in the area as well: There are lots of miners around, but the Amarr will be suspicious of any vessel that originates from Republic space.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Fine work, my friend. Here's your reward.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, it just so happens that we're in the middle of some operations that might require a capsuleer's assistance.

The Caldari have been busy lately, building bases and moving fleet resources back and forth along the frontier. We've done recon in several of the systems where the Caldari have been active, but we recently observed unusual comings and goings in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system.
