messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I thought you were taking care of that matter in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} that we discussed. And now I find out from my source that the summit went on unimpeded. What have you been up to all this time? I'm beginning to think you're not as trustworthy as I'd been led to believe. Rest assured, you're going to have to work hard to get back into my good graces.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ah, my apologies for being cross with you, but it's been a busy day. As if fighting the Gallente on our front doorstep isn't bad enough, the Minmatar are becoming more active of late.

The biggest risk is that our two enemies will start closely coordinating their attacks. The Empire cannot allow this to happen. To that end, there is a summit meeting in need of disrupting. If I give you the coordinates for the meeting site, can you go over there and blow up a diplomat?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Gallente exploded, and the Minmatar ran off.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Then stop wasting my time!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take out that Gallente.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I could take out that Minmatar instead.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm not going to be able to finish this job after all.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Come back when you can tell me that the Gallente is done for.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Um, I need a job...

messages.mission.briefing.text: As if fighting the Gallente on our front doorstep wasn't bad enough, the Minmatar are becoming more active of late. The biggest risk is that our two enemies will start closely coordinating their attacks. The Empire cannot allow this to happen. To that end, there is a summit meeting in need of disrupting. Killing the Gallente diplomat should do the trick.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: As I did not receive word from you about the summit we discussed, I have handled the problem by assigning another pilot.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Give me just a moment to check something.

localizedName.text: Driving a Wedge - Delegation Destruction (2 of 2)

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job. After escaping the scene of the attack, the Minmatar ambassador was whisked away to a nearby staging area.

A raid on the Minmatar delegation now will look like a reprisal raid from the Gallente delegation, and since the Minmatar know they weren't responsible for the initial attack, they'll be even angrier. We have reason to believe that the enemy diplomats have been transferred aboard the Minmatar flagship to ensure their safety. It's the only battleship in the delegation, and it must be destroyed.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job. After escaping the scene of the attack, the Minmatar ambassador was whisked away to a nearby staging area.

A raid on the Minmatar delegation now will look like a reprisal raid from the Gallente delegation, and since the Minmatar know they weren't responsible for the initial attack, they'll be even angrier. We have reason to believe that the enemy diplomats have been transferred aboard the Minmatar flagship to ensure their safety. It's the only battleship in the delegation, and it must be destroyed. Are you game?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The enemy flagship is no more.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What happened to “no problem?” You capsuleers are all alike – as soon as the going gets tough you cut and run.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You're letting a great opportunity slip away, but it's your call.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Only one battleship? No problem.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Attack a battleship and its entire convoy? No thanks.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Find someone else to take this on. I'm busy.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: For your sake, I hope not. Good luck.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You mentioned an opportunity?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Minmatar emissaries have safely made it back to their own space. Worse still, they appear to have sorted things out with the Gallente, or at least allayed some of their suspicions.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I knew you were up to it. Good work, {[character]player.name}!

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Minmatar emissaries have safely made it back to their own space. Worse still, they appear to have sorted things out with the Gallente, or at least allayed some of their suspicions.

localizedName.text: Driving a Wedge - Consulate Conflagration (2 of 2)

messages.mission.briefing.text: The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job.  After escaping the scene of the attack, the Gallente ambassador was whisked away to a small consulate facility. A raid on the Gallente diplomatic station now will look like a reprisal raid, which should drive the wedge between our enemies further.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The attack on the meeting between the Gallente and Minmatar emissaries went perfectly. Now we need to finish the job. After escaping the scene of the attack, the Gallente ambassador was whisked away to a small consulate facility. A raid on the Gallente diplomatic station now will look like a reprisal raid, which should drive the wedge between our enemies further.

Do you think you're up to the task?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The enemy diplomats have been dealt with.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What happened to “no problem?” You capsuleers are all alike – as soon as the going gets tough you cut and run.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You're letting a great opportunity slip away, but it's your call.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: A diplomatic facility? No problem.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, I have better things to do.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Find someone else to take this on. I'm busy.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: For your sake, I hope not. Good luck.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You mentioned an opportunity?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Gallente diplomats have safely made it back to their home systems. Worse still, they appear to have sorted things out with the Minmatar, or at least allayed some of their suspicions.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I knew you were up to it. Good work, {[character]player.name}!

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Apparently we did not strike while the iron was hot. In the time since I've talked to you, my source has indicated that the Gallente diplomats have safely made it back to their home systems. Worse still, they appear to have sorted things out with the Minmatar, or at least allayed some of their suspicions.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've got a shipment of vaccines that need to be delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} in a hurry. I'm willing to provide a substantial bonus if they're delivered right away. Regardless, the meds need to be delivered soon, though.

Be sure to move the medicine into your cargo hold before you set out. And note the hasty delivery required — you don't have much time!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, you're pretty green, by the look of you, but I've got no choice. You may have heard all the rumors. The entire frontier is buzzing with reports that we're pretty much at war with the Amarrians. I can't say either way, for sure, but I do know that all this war talk has led to some big headaches when it comes to commercial traffic and trade-route management. Passenger liners are all booked, haulers have been pre-empted by the military or by wealthy clients... god, it's just a mess out there.

Anyway, as you may have seen, the docks here at {[location]agentStationID.name} are filled to overflowing with tons of goods, and we can't seem to find enough transport to get them to their destinations. I need to get some of this stuff out of here.

Ah, here: we've got a shipment of vaccines that need to be delivered to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name} in a hurry. I'm willing to provide a substantial bonus if they're delivered right away. Regardless, the meds need to be delivered soon, though.

Say the word and you can move the stuff into your cargo hold. Can you do it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The medications have been delivered, {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That's pretty poor behavior, {[character]player.name}. I and my corporation are disappointed in you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, that doesn't help at all, {[character]player.name}! These supplies really need to be delivered.  Thanks for nothing.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm willing to help any way I can. Just say where the cargo is.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, not the right kind of job for me. Find another errand boy.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've decided that I don't want this job after all. Sorry.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good decision. The meds are being moved into your hangar as we speak — ready for loading in just a sec.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I am in need of, uh, gainful employment, yes.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text:
{[character]player.name}:

You've taken too long, I'm afraid — those medications are no longer required at that station. They managed to find some from somewhere else since you took so long. You've lost your bonus and your payment altogether.

I hope that this will be a valuable lesson for you.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. Come by again sometime; I can generally find work for a dependable operator.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text:
{[character]player.name}:

You've taken too long, I'm afraid — those medications are no longer required at that station. They managed to find some from somewhere else since you took so long. You've lost your bonus and your payment altogether.

I hope that this will be a valuable lesson for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Amarr are conducting an unprecedented number of probing missions in this and the surrounding systems.

I need you to defend a military gate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. You must utterly destroy any Amarr forces that approach the gate. We need to send a message of strength in our position.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Good, I have some work for you. We're facing a serious issue in this area. The Amarr are conducting an unprecedented number of probing missions in this and the surrounding systems.

I need you to defend a military gate in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. You must utterly destroy any Amarr forces that approach the gate. We need to send a message of strength in our position.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Amarr did attack the gate, but I destroyed them all.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You've let us all down.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Don't you realize how important this is to the Federation?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll defend the gate. You know I'm up to it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Space battles generally occur around targets of strategic and tactical significance: gates, stations, corporate structures, asteroids or mining colonies, research facilities, outposts, etc.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This situation sounds like it could very easily get out of hand. I don't want any part of it.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I quit.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: That's the spirit.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I need some work.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You have let down the Federation and you have let me down.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Your work here represents real progress in our campaign against the Amarr.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You have let down the Federation and you have let me down.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
An infestation of nasty, biting roaches has taken hold on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and it is growing out of control. In fact, it's gotten so bad that they've considered venting the emergency airlocks briefly and allowing the station atmosphere to empty into space, but scientists tell us the little bastards can survive even in space for hours.

The only answer is to gas the entire station. The substance they want to use is a special concoction designed specifically to grant this particular species of roach a quick death. I have a shipment of the stuff; I just need you to get it there. This stuff is more dangerous than the cockroaches.

Note the hasty delivery required — you don't have much time to complete this mission.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's your bug spray. Come and get it.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I hope I can find someone else to handle this. These bugs mostly come out during sleep cycle. Mostly.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll go get you your roach poison, sure.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't have time for this. Clean up your own mess.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't have time for this after all. Sorry, but you'll have to clean up your own mess.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't waste any time. These bugs grow more aggressive during sleep cycles.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Mess? What mess? It looks spotless in here.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
An infestation of nasty, biting roaches has taken hold on {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, and it is growing out of control. In fact, it's gotten so bad that they've considered venting the emergency airlocks briefly and allowing the station atmosphere to empty into space, but scientists tell us the little bastards can survive even in space for hours.

The only answer is to gas the entire station. The substance they want to use is a special concoction designed specifically to grant this particular species of roach a quick death. I have a shipment of the stuff; I just need you to get it there. This stuff is more dangerous than the cockroaches.

Note the hasty delivery required — you don't have much time to complete this mission.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: They'll offload the chemicals immediately. You should be fine on your ship. They'll be gassing every corner of the structure, though.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Our counter-intelligence service has indicated that the Gallente Federal Intelligence Office has erected a covert listening post in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. While our communications are encrypted, the presence of Gallente intelligence operations in our space poses both an insult to Caldari sovereignty and an unacceptable risk to communications security.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our counter-intelligence service has indicated that the Gallente Federal Intelligence Office has erected a covert listening post in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. While I assure you our communications are encrypted, the presence of Gallente intelligence operations in our space poses both an insult to Caldari sovereignty and an unacceptable risk to communications security.

Your task is simple: go there, overwhelm whatever forces are defending the post, and destroy it. Can I count on you to see this through?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Gallente spies have been destroyed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, at least you tried. Good luck in your travels, {[character]player.name}

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: So, what, we're just supposed to let the Gallente spy on us? I'll have to inform the agent who recommended you that you're less reliable than advertized. Get out of my sight.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Of course you can count on me.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Gallente FIO answers directly to the Gallente President. Its works are shrouded in secrecy and covert operations. Among their spying operations are the construction and operation of numerous small, covert listening posts designed to glean information from enemy signals and communications.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This doesn't really sound like my kind of thing, sorry.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid I'm not going to be able to complete this job for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Glad to hear it.  But be careful out there; you're not dealing with amateurs.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm always ready to do my part. How can I help?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Perhaps I did not impress upon you the importance of the matter we discussed, but your delay in performing this simple task is unacceptable. I have taken the liberty of giving the job to someone who understands the importance of rooting out spies.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}! The agent who recommended you to me may not have praised you highly enough!

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Perhaps I did not impress upon you the importance of the matter we discussed, but your delay in replying to my offer is unacceptable. I have taken the liberty of giving the job to someone who understands the importance of rooting out spies.

messages.mission.briefing.text: In order to maximize the element of surprise for our raid, all enemy pickets and patrol ships must be destroyed. Go to the assigned location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy all the ships you find there. Beware of enemy reinforcements!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The time has come to strike a blow against the arrogant Gallente. We're going to stage a raid deep into Gallente territory. In order to mask the movements of our forces, however, we first need to wipe out their pickets and patrols. We could do this with our own ships, of course, but that might alert the enemy to our plans. A lone, talented capsuleer, on the other hand, would make short work of them and raise less suspicion.

I've uploaded the coordinates of the stepping-off point of our raid into your nav-computer. I want you to go there and destroy all of the enemy ships you find. Be advised that they may try to bring in reinforcements, but that should be no problem for someone of your caliber. Are you up to the task?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: All opposition has been swept away. Where's my reward?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: This is terrible! Our operations time-table is totally disrupted. I hold you personally responsible, {[character]player.name}

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Suit yourself, though I'd like to remind you that the details of our discussion are to be kept in the strictest of confidence. Operational security, you understand. If it gets back to me that you've been blabbing about this raid, there will be hell to pay. You are dismissed.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Absolutely. Just let me at ‘em.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Hmm, this isn't really what I had in mind. Maybe next time.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid you're going to have to find someone else to deal with your problem. I have more important things to do.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent. Get out there and make it happen. The sooner those enemy patrols are out of the way, the sooner we can launch the raid.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I hear you've got some important work to be done. How can I help?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Due to your inability to deal with this assignment in a timely fashion, the entire raid has been scrubbed. It may be quite some time before another opportunity this good arises. Whatever you were doing, I hope it was important.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well done, {[character]player.name}. You'll no doubt be happy to hear that early reports indicate our raid has been a stunning success!

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Based on your lack of response, I take it that this assignment did not interest you. Had you been considerate enough to simply tell us that up front, we could have gotten someone else. As it is, we've had to scrub the entire raid.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Even in times of conflict with an external enemy we still find ourselves in competition with other “friendly” corporations. One such corporation is providing security for a repair outpost. They got that security contract by underbidding us. Go to the site, destroy their entire security force, then destroy the repair outpost. With such an abysmal failure on their record, they'll never get another security contract in this sector again.

And who knows, maybe we'll get the reconstruction contract for the replacement outpost as well.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As a matter of fact, I do. As I'm sure you're aware, even in times of conflict with an external enemy we still find ourselves in competition with other “friendly” corporations. One such corporation is providing security for a repair outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They got that security contract by underbidding us. I want you to head out there, destroy their entire security force, then destroy the repair outpost. With such an abysmal failure on their record, they'll never get another security contract in this sector again.

And who knows, maybe we'll get the reconstruction contract for the replacement outpost as well.

So what do you say? Do you think you can handle this job? I can make it worth your while.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've taken care of your little problem. Now pay up.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I knew you couldn't hack it. Maybe you should look for a different line of work.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Too bad. I guess I'll have to find someone with a stronger stomach or looser morals. You are dismissed.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: No problem. I'll do this job and sleep with a clear conscience.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't think I'm cut out for that kind of work, sorry.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've had second thoughts. I'm not going to do this job after all.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Now get out there and wreck something.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Yes. Do you have an assignment for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I take it from your inability to complete the job we discussed that you had second thoughts about it. I'm not paying you to grapple with your morals. Next time, just decline the job so that I can find someone with the guts to actually pull the trigger.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You really are a ruthless one, {[character]player.name}. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is always looking for pilots like you. Look me up again if you ever need work.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: When you didn't respond to my offer, I found someone willing to undertake the job. He did what we asked of him, but got caught in the process, implicating us in the attack. Amateur. I wish you'd been able to help us, because I know you'd have done the job right. Oh well, maybe next time.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Head for your assigned patrol sector coordinates. Wait there and destroy any enemy ships that show up. Make sure none of them escape!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As you may be aware, the Gallente Navy has been making increasingly bold reconnaissance patrols into Caldari space. This is unacceptable and must be stopped immediately. Unfortunately, given our own Navy's operational tempo, we don't have the forces to spare to cover every avenue of hostile approach. That's where you come in, {[character]player.name}. I want you to patrol an area where we've had reports of hostile recon patrols recently. Think you can handle that?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The sector assigned to me is clear.  No enemy vessels escaped.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Very disappointing, {[character]player.name}. A true patriot would have finished the task for the good of the State. Your unwillingness to perform when called upon will be noted in your permanent record, I assure you.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: As I suspected, talking to you was a waste of time. Be gone from my sight.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Well, it may not be glamorous, but for the good of the State I'll do it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Patrol work? Talk about wasting time.  I have no interest in your mission.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm afraid something more pressing has come up.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Excellent! This will take some of the pressure off our forces and allow them to get down to the important work of striking at the enemy.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I've heard you have ample work for skilled pilots. Is that true, or are you wasting my time and money as well?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Your laxness has cost the State dearly. While you were off haring about, a small enemy raiding force seems to have slipped through your assigned sector and destroyed three commerce vessels. I hope in the future you won't be so cavalier with the safety of sovereign Caldari territory.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I knew you could be counted upon, {[character]player.name}. Your sense of patriotism has been duly noted. Please accept this reward, and do not hesitate to contact me again in the future should you need work. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} always has opportunities for enterprising pilots.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: While the ability to strike out offensively at the enemy may not matter to you, rest assured it is of the utmost importance to us. Due to your lack of response, main-line Naval forces have been tasked with patrolling. While nothing catastrophic has come from you leaving us hanging this time, it has caused an inevitable delay in offensive operations.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Recently a long-range reconnaissance patrol was sent out deep behind enemy lines. While trying to exfiltrate to friendly lines, our recon ship inadvertently jumped into the middle of a pitched battle. The ship and its cargo were lost. Go to the site of the battle, find the wreck of our reconnaissance ship, and salvage the data chips from the remains. This task will require the use of a Salvager module.

Beware that there may be other scavengers or interested parties in the area. Take whatever steps you feel are necessary to bring the data back safely.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
For someone of your caliber? Always.

Recently a long-range reconnaissance patrol was sent out deep behind enemy lines. Everything went fine until the return trip. While trying to exfiltrate to friendly lines, our recon ship inadvertently jumped into the middle of a pitched battle in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. In the resulting confusion, the recon ship was destroyed and the vital intelligence it was carrying was lost. I want you to go out to the site of the battle, find the wreck of our reconnaissance ship, and salvage the data chips from the remains. This task will require the use of a Salvager module.

Beware that there may be other scavengers or interested parties in the area. Take whatever steps you feel are necessary to bring the data back safely. Do you think this is something you can handle?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have recovered your data.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That is unfortunate, {[character]player.name}. I just hope that the data didn't fall into the wrong hands.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: That's a shame. Ah, well, maybe next time.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: No problem. I'll get on it right away.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, that's not really something I can help you with right now.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've got bad news. I won't be able to recover your data.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good.  Just be careful out there. You might not be the only scavenger picking through the wreckage.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm looking for work. Have you got anything for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I can only assume from your lack of response that you were unable to recover the intelligence we discussed. No matter, I'm sure you made a valiant effort. I only hope that the data was destroyed and some battlefield scavenger friendly to the Gallente doesn't run across it.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: My thanks, {[character]player.name}. I'll get this to our intelligence analysts immediately.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: When you did not respond to my employment offer, I was forced to go with someone else. That pilot responded promptly and performed admirably. You would do well to follow her example in the future.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
In recent days, we believe one of our repair and resupply depots has been under surveillance by suspected members of one of a terrorist group, and we think they're going to attempt some kind of sabotage. We could quadruple our security, but that might tip them off. Instead, I want you to go there and keep an eye out for them. If you see anything suspicious, you are authorized to destroy the vessel in question immediately. We don't want to take any chances.

Once you've destroyed the suspicious transport, recover any cargo and bring it to me. We might be able to use it as evidence of Gallente involvement.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
A hefty reward, if you're successful.

For some time now there have been rumors of Caldari citizens who are unhappy with the way the State is run. Some of them are no doubt Gallente sympathizers, and we're certain the Gallente are giving them aid through third-parties. Either way, they're traitors to the State, and we must be vigilant to keep them from disrupting our operations.

In recent days, we believe one of our repair and resupply depots has been under surveillance by suspected members of one of these traitor groups, and we think they're going to attempt some kind of sabotage. We could quadruple our security, but that might tip them off. Instead, I want you to go there and keep an eye out for them. If you see anything suspicious, you are authorized to destroy the vessel in question immediately. We don't want to take any chances.

Once you've destroyed the suspicious transport, recover any cargo and bring it to me. We might be able to use it as evidence of Gallente involvement.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The terrorists have been dealt with. Here's the viral agent they were trying to spread.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Suit yourself. Maybe I'll find a pilot with a shred of patriotism to do it instead. Good day, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Suit yourself. Maybe I'll find a pilot with a shred of patriotism to do it instead. Good day, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: No problem. Those terrorist scum won't get through on my watch.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Patrol duty? I can't think of a worse way to spend my time. Find someone else to do it.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: On second thought, this job sounds awful. Find someone else to do it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. And be careful, these people will stop at nothing to accomplish their goals.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Maybe. What's in it for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You won't be needed for that job after all. Several hours ago, we started receiving reports of people dying from a bizarre sickness, and already the death toll has risen sharply. Apparently the terrorists were successful in their plot. In addition to the human cost, we've had to scramble to set up quarantine and shift our resupply operations elsewhere. Dozens of vessels have come and gone from that depot, and any of them could have been exposed to the virus. This has truly been a disaster.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. Check back later for another assignment.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You won't be needed for that job after all. Several hours ago, we started receiving reports of people dying from a bizarre sickness, and already the death toll has risen sharply. Apparently the terrorists were successful in their plot. In addition to the human cost, we've had to scramble to set up quarantine and shift our resupply operations elsewhere. Dozens of vessels have come and gone from that depot, and any of them could have been exposed to the virus. This has truly been a disaster.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.head.text: I didn't hear back from you!

messages.mission.briefing.text: Go to Caldari station 464, hack the relay center so that the data in its computers can be collected, and return to {[character]agentID.name}.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
{[character]player.name}, the Caldari have built an observation base in Gallente space. It has been designated “Station 464.” One of the structures is a relay station, and it is being used to store all the information the Caldari have collected in the system. I need you to hack the relay station so we can see what kind of information they have collected and thus the purpose of the base.

The data center is heavily protected so be ready for a real fight. I will upload the location to your Neocom.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I have the data from station 464.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: The Situation between the Caldari and the Gallente

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: How am I supposed to get that data now? I was depending on you! Failures like this will not help your reputation with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I can't begin to tell you how important this mission was. Your refusal to carry it out disappoints me, and it doesn't help your reputation with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll get the data!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Open conflict now exists between the Gallente and Caldari empires. Both empires are fighting for the systems between them, often sending forces into the other's territory to probe for weakness, to secure forward bases and to exploit resources.

Forward bases built by one empire in the space of another are usually represented as private business concerns to avoid any conflict with Concord.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: It sounds like station 464 is too heavily fortified for me to handle.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Station 464 is too heavily fortified for me to complete the mission. I'm sorry but you will have to give this to someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good!  I can't begin to tell you how important this mission is. Fly safe.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I heard you have been looking for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: The opportunity to secure the data from Caldari base 464 has passed and I haven't heard from you. You disappoint me greatly.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: We received the data.  You did well out there. We'll examine it, but in the mean time, here is your reward.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I can't begin to tell you how important this mission was.  I'm sorry you didn't accept it, but I am more concerned about the fact your delay in responding has caused us to miss the opportunity to gather the data.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I've been expecting to hear from you about dealing with these Caldari terrorist. According to intelligence, they have moved their base and we're back to hunting them. I'm disappointed in you. More importantly my boss is mad at me for choosing you for this mission. If I suffer, you suffer.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
{[character]player.name} we have located a Caldari terrorist cell. They have been harassing nearby miners for some time using hit and run tactics. Now that we know where their base is it's time to take care of this problem. I want you to fly out and destroy them and the bunker they are using as their base.

I will upload the coordinates to your Neocom. Be careful out there, but teach these terrorists a lesson they will not forget!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've killed all the terrorists and destroyed their bunker. They will not bother the miners again.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Sick, huh? Don't make a habit of it; I can't use pod pilots who are “sick” all the time.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I'm disappointed in you. I really thought you were the person for this job. I depend on you, but when you turn down missions it makes me think that you don't value the work I give you.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Terrorists huh? I don't like terrorists; especially Caldari terrorist. It will be a pleasure to take care of this for you.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Some Caldari terrorists are in sympathy with the Ammarian faith. Flying out of Caldari space they attack Gallente civilian outpost and miners in an effort to terrorize those who reject the faith. They believe they are engaged in a holy war to rid New Eden of unbelievers.

This, however, is not the only brand of terrorism coming out of Caldari space. Increasingly terrorism from the state is based on intense nationalism born of hatred towards the Gallente. Some of these are thought to be followers of Tibus Heth and the national ideals he purportedly espouses.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Terrorists? Pirates I can handle, but I don't want any part of a mission against terrorists. Find someone else to handle this.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm sick so I can't complete this mission. Perhaps it's the flu or maybe just allergies.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I need some cash. Do you have a job for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Caldari terrorists have been attacking miners in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They must be destroyed, along with the bunker they are using as their base.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I'll get the word out to the miners. I'm sure they will be happy to know those terrorist have met a proper end. Here's your reward; just don't spend it all in one place, ok?

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I've been expecting you to accept the mission I offered you. Now the terrorist have moved their base and we're back to hunting them. I'm disappointed in you. More importantly my boss is mad at me for choosing you for this mission. If I suffer, you suffer.

messages.mission.briefing.text: An old mining site has just been rediscovered. Soon archeologists will arrive to properly explore the site, but I want you to go in and do a preliminary survey. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom. Bring back anything of interest that you find.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
A mining site that may date back millennia has been found. Soon Archeologists will arrive to properly explore the site, but I want you to go in and do a preliminary survey. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom. Bring back anything of interest that you may find.

The Amarrians are exploring the area and may have found the site as well, so go in ready for combat just in case they are there already.

This mission is of upmost importance to the Federation.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I arrived at the site. All I found was this old map.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: This will not look good on your record, but I'll do as you request and find someone else to do this for me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Ok, I'll get someone else to do it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: This sounds interesting. I'll take care of it for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm sorry, but I'm not an archeologist. I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've lost interest in your mission. You will have to find someone else to do it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good! Just remember to be careful out there.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I got your message. What can I do for you?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I sent you on. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I offered you. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Ok, give me a chance to look over this map and then get back to me for another mission.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The map you found led us to an old observation post. I want you to do a preliminary survey before the Amarr get there, and bring back anything of interest that you find.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The map you found has the location of several ancient sites on it. One in particular is circled; an old observation post. Again, archeologists will soon arrive to properly explore the site, but once again I want you to go in and do a preliminary survey. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom. Bring back anything of interest that you may find.

The Amarr are still exploring the area and may have found the site as well so go in ready for combat just in case they are there already.

I want to remind you that this mission is of utmost importance to the Federation.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I arrived at the site, but all I found was this old map. It seems to be a second half to the other map we found.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: This will not look good on your record, but I'll do as you request and find someone else to do this for me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Ok, I'll get someone else to do it.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: This is getting more and more interesting; I'll take care of it for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm sorry, but I'm not an archeologist. I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've lost interest in your mission. You will have to find someone else to do it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good! Just remember to be careful out there.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Did you find anything interesting on that old map?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I sent you on. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. This will not look good on your permanent record.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I offered you. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. This will not look good on your permanent record.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Ok, give me a chance to look over this map in conjunction with the first one and then get back to me for another mission.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Go out to the asteroid field, confirm that the vault is there and see if it has been opened or not. If the Amarr show up, destroy them all.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
When the two maps are put together they point to a mined out asteroid field. According to the map the field contains an ancient vault. We need to find out whether or not it has been located and opened.

I want you to go out to the asteroid field, confirm that the vault is there and see if it has been opened or not. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom.

The Amarrians are exploring the area and may have found the site as well so go in ready for combat. If they are there then destroy them all lest the Amarrians should get to the vault before we do.

I want to remind you that this mission is of upmost importance to the Federation.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I arrived at the site and the Amarr were already there. I dealt with them; and yes, the vault is there and is intact.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: This will not look good on your record, but I'll do as you request and find someone else to do this for me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Ok, I'll get someone else to do it, but this will not look good on your permanent record.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take care of it for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm sorry, but I'm not an archeologist. I'll pass on this one.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've lost interest in your mission. You will have to find someone else to do it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good! Just remember to be careful out there.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What did the maps reveal?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I sent you on. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. This will not look good on your permanent record.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work! Your part in this is done. We will have to let the archeologist take over now. Here is your reward.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I offered you. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. You disappoint me greatly.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I recently lost contact with one of our deep cover operatives embedded in enemy space. A delay of this length can only mean one thing: that he has been discovered and killed, or worse for us, captured.

We need to find out which, and fast before he talks. We have a contact within the administrative department who we tasked with retrieving the information and have arranged a meeting with him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Go to the co-ordinates provided, meet the contact and retrieve the information.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The bad news is it was an ambush. The good news is they didn't know who they were messing with.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Never let an inconvenience like death prevent you from finishing a mission.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Pessimist.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Calm the hell down, I'll sort it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Can yous say "trap?" Not doing it.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've had enough of this, I quit. Oh, and your guy is probably dead.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Time is of the essence, get over their now.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: That's great! I mean, it's too bad about our operative and all, but I bet they'll think twice before they try to pull that stunt again.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Right, well, that didn't go quite to plan. Looks like we're going to have to do this the hard way.

There is a relay station that our enemies think is well hidden in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We found out about it recently and have been intercepting communication traffic from it. However, we have trouble decoding most of the traffic and we need the decoder which is held inside the communications hub, each decoder is unique and lasts for a limited time.

So the only way to get a hold of this device is to manually hack into the communications hub using a Data Analyzer. I want you to go to the co-ordinates provided, retrieve the decoder and destroy the installation.

We're still up against the clock here. Get this done.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Station, explosions, decoder.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What? But... What?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You're going to leave me hanging because something isn't "your style?" Thanks a lot.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take it, assuming that your intelligence is correct this time. It didn't pan out very well last time, did it?

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: You will need a Data Analyzer module to finish this mission.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Hacking isn't my style. Gonna have to pass.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm done with this, as in "quit."

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Rest assured, this information is good. Let's stop wasting time. You will be well compensated, just get that decoder.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Great story.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our team has cracked the enemy communications and found the information we need. It turns out our spy is alive and under heavy guard in a detention facility in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We had no idea they even had a facility here; I'm not sure how they managed to sneak one there without us knowing, but that's not important. The spy's last reports hinted at him getting close to something very disturbing. The information he has could prove invaluable to us.

Our limited intel on the area has revealed it to be a high security facility. They obviously consider our man a high priority. I want you to break into the detention facility, fight your way to the prison and retrieve our man. Expect some serious resistance here.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here's your guy, mostly alive.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: But we were so close! I'm sure our info was good this time.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I've destroyed more ships than you've had hot dinners; I'll get your man back.

Thanks to your efforts we've got our man back, and more importantly the information he had inside that skull of his.

It seems our enemies have been busy. They have secretly been building up a Bio-Weapon Facility in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. Such facilities are in direct violation of the Yulai convention between the empires. However, we're not going to inform CONCORD of this. No doubt they would just claim it to be a chemical storage facility or some such.

No, what we're going to do is remove the facility by force. I want the facility razed, the main processing center destroyed and, if you get the chance, acquire a sample of the bioweapon.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I blew that facility up good. Oh, and here: Don't lick this.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Wait, what?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: But you live in a hermetically sealed capsule!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It's already done.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not messing with chemical weapons. Sorry.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Quitting.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I expect no less.

There is one more task before we can bring this to a close. We have a leak. Four of our convoys have been intercepted and destroyed in the past hour. These convoys had special contents which I won't go into now, but suffice to say their route was not well publicized and only known to a few people. One of those people was our man you went to all the trouble of rescuing.

He doubtless broke under interrogation. Now the trust we invest in agents of such level has been broken. He knows too much, which makes him too dangerous to be kept alive. We have arranged him to meet you, his rescuer, at these co-ordinates under the pretense that you have the information for his next assignment.

I want you to kill this man. This is national security.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That victim of fate won't be returning for the sequel.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: How is morally questionable back-stabbery boring?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Oh, sure, now you have a conscience.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Very well.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: So this guy was tortured, broken physically and psychologically, and now you just want me to off him? How about you go to hell?

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm bored! I quit!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I don't take any pleasure in this.
