messages.mission.briefing.text: There is a monument where a battle in the Gallente-Caldari war occurred within Gallente space. We once tolerated Caldari pilgrims, but with this war we cannot allow the Caldari any excuse to proceed this deep within our space. Such leniency would only invite terrorism. I need you to destroy the monument, and any witnesses to the event. This may include some of our own people, but you needn't worry about any kind of standings complications, I will handle the political fallout.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
There is a monument where a battle in the Gallente-Caldari war occurred within Gallente space. We once tolerated Caldari pilgrims, but with this war we cannot allow the Caldari any excuse to proceed this deep within our space. Such leniency would only invite terrorism.

I need you to destroy the monument, and any witnesses to the event. This may include some of our own people, but you needn't worry about any kind of standings complications, I will handle the political fallout. We will then release a statement that the site was attacked by pirates and, although the Caldari won't believe this, it will provide us with enough plausible deniability.

Undoubtedly there will be an uproar about this. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will disavow any involvement. You will be best served by remaining silent yourself.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: It's done. Due to the sensitivity and secrecy of what I know, I expect a large reward.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I thought I could depend on you. I guess you do not care if Caldari roam around Gallente space.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I thought I could depend on you. I guess you don't care if Caldari roam about our space.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Consider it done.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I'm not keen on destroying any monument. Give this to someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've thought about it and I'm not keen on destroying any sacred site.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. Be careful out there and be sure to keep this thing a secret. Give those Caldari a good spanking.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Hello {[character]agentID.name}; that is good because I'm looking for some work.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text:
What gives? I expected that monument to be destroyed by now? I guess you don't care about Caldari roaming around our space.

Forget about it; I will get someone else to do the job.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You'll get what I promised you and not one isk more; but I do appreciate your work.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: What gives? I expected that monument to be destroyed by now, and you haven't even decided if you are going to do it or not. Forget about it. I will get someone else to do the job.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Our supporters in Amarr space have managed to smuggle out some slaves. I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy the Amarr pursuit team.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I have some work for you. Our supporters in Amarr space have managed to smuggle out some slaves. The Amarr are in close pursuit, and the slaves are in grave danger of being caught and returned. I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy the Amarr pursuit team. Be quick about it lest they catch the slaves. Show no mercy!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Amarr are dead. Did the slaves make it okay?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Destroy the Amarr; right, I'll take care of it for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: That's the spirit! Remember this mission is an important one to the Federation.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You are welcome. Why did you send for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Your inaction has led to the slaves being recaptured by the Amarr. We were depending on you, and you let us down.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Your delay in getting back to me about protecting the escaped slaves has led to them being recaptured by the Amarr.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: The slaves made it to one of our outposts, but they are not safe yet. I need you to get back with me immediately for another mission.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Your inaction has led to the slaves being recaptured by the Amarr.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The slaves are here on the station with us. The Amarr are threatening to raid us for them. I need you to transport the slaves to another station for everyone's safety.

Some of the escaped slaves are highly skilled. The Federation is very interested in having them on our side. Take every precaution.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The slaves are safe. I'm looking forward to dealing with those Amarr.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: That's the spirit!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Ok, I'm back. What can I do for you now?

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Amarr are threatening to attack the station in an effort to reclaim their slaves. I need you to transport them to another station where they will be safe should the Amarrians attack.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Your inaction has led to the slaves being recaptured by the Amarrians.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: That's good, because we are going to have to deal them with as they still threaten the safety of the slaves.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Amarr are still threatening to attack the station. Destroy their strike force.

We read one dreadnought with them, though she seems to be playing support. Pay her no mind. We've got a little surprise in store for her. Watch for instructions after you clean up the rest.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Amarr either do not know or do not care that the slaves have been transported to another station. They are still threatening to attack. I need you to destroy the Amarr strike force.

We read one dreadnought with them, though she seems to be playing support. Pay her no mind. We've got a little surprise in store for her. Watch for instructions after you clean up the rest.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The Amarr strike force has been decimated. Where is my reward?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Damn you. Get out of here.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Damn you. Get out of here.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: It will be my pleasure to take care of that strike force.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Hey, the slaves are safe. The Amarr are your problem.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Hey, the slaves are safe. The Amarr are your problem.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Get to it. We're all counting on you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Ok, I'm back.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Your inaction has led to a bloody battle that we barely won. Thanks for leaving us to die.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Nukes are always fun, huh? You handled yourself well. See if those Amarr bastards try anything like that again.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Your delay has led to a bloody battle that we barely won. Thanks for leaving us to die.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Gallente are using a radio telescope to spy on us. Destroy the Gallente telescope.  Try to avoid engaging any Gallente ships unless you are attacked.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As a matter of fact, I do.

We've located a nest of Gallente spies. They're using a radio telescope to keep track of our activities in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

I want you to go out there and destroy that radio telescope. Try to avoid hostile contact with the Gallente spies, but if they attack-- well, you do what you have to do. It'll serve them right for spying on their allies.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've destroyed the telescope. Unfortunately, I also had to destroy some Gallente.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Very funny. Dismissed.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I suppose I can understand your reluctance to engage our allies, even in spite of this intrusion.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'll take care of this for you.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No thanks. They may be willing to violate the trust of their allies, but I have higher standards.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I've reconsidered striking out against our allies. Maybe you can pull in a diplomat on this one.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good! Be careful out there; and remember, avoid combat with the Gallente if at all possible.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Got any work for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You've allowed the Gallente another week of spying on us. I can't wait any longer. I'll get someone else to take care of this, but in future, please to not take on missions unless you intend to complete them in a timely manner.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Perhaps they'll be a little less nosy in the future.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: This radio telescope has to be taken care of. I can't wait any longer for you to make up your mind. Your delay has allowed the Gallente another week of spying on us.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A mad scientist is attempting to clone a member of a noble family. Find and destroy him, his facility, and any who protect him. He cannot be allowed to go through with his heretical experiments.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I do, though it is of a most distressing nature. Recently, rumors have come to my attention that some... scientist has taken it upon himself to attempt to clone a member of a noble Amarr family.

This heretic must not be allowed to go through with his blasphemous experiments. I need you to be the instrument of God's will in this matter.

Destroy his facility completely. Let him answer to God for his actions.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: The heretic's destruction will serve as a lesson to other blasphemers. I have done as God willed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: You cannot interfere with God's will.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You cannot interfere with God's will.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will take on this responsibility.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The Holders (the higher born class) are rarely cloned. The Amarr are a very religious people, and they consider the flesh to be sacred. This is particularly true of the Holders, since any of them could potentially become Heir and eventually Emperor.

In addition, the few instances of such blasphemy that have been carried out have resulted in madness or other deformities, clearly manifesting God's will in these matters.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't have time to chase after madmen. Find someone else.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't have time to chase after madmen. Find someone else.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You will be greatly rewarded for your faith and hard work.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Do you have work for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: You have failed to destroy this blaspheming madman and his sick experiments. I will find someone else who is willing to do God's work.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I had faith that you would.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: You have waited too long to give me an answer. I will find someone else who is willing to do God's work before it is too late.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The mining operations in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have been being systematically poached. Find and destroy these intruders.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I do. The mining operations in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} are being systematically poached. Miners are driven from the area, or attacked if they will not leave.

These poachers must be completely and utterly destroyed. Make them an example, so that no one will dare think they can take what is rightfully ours.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've obliterated the poachers.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I am shocked that you will let this insult stand.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: I am shocked that you will let this insult stand.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I will gladly do this task.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No thanks.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: If it's so important to you, do it yourself.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Wonderful! You will be greatly rewarded for this service.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Do you have work for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I thought I could count on you to do this task, but apparently I was wrong.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Praises to God! I knew I could count on you to deal with those scurrilous interlopers. Here is your reward. You have truly earned it!

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I thought I could count on you to do this task, but apparently I was wrong.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Confirm or deny the rumor of a secret Amarr base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} , and see if your agent has further instructions.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I need you to do some reconnaissance work for me. There is a rumor that the Amarr have set up a secret base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

I want you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and see if you can find a base there. If you do, I'll have additional instructions.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I took care of that base.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text:
I didn't think you were a quitter, but I see I'll have to reevaluate my view of you. Because you are a quitter.

Because you quit.

Quitter.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, I can find scouts anywhere.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Will do!

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: This is not the kind of thing I want to be doing right now.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't have the time right now to complete this mission. I quit!

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Get it done, okay?

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: What can I do for you?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I'm giving this to someone else.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well done.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I can't sit around waiting for you to accept this mission.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A Caldari pilot who has been helpful to the Empire in the past was ambushed by Gallente ships and managed to limp away to the safe haven of a station run by the Sisters of EVE. Go make sure that the lingering Gallente ship that is waiting for her to leave will not be a problem.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Gallente have ambushed a Caldari pilot who has been very helpful to us in the past. Her vessel suffered serious damage, and she barely escaped.

She managed to reach a station operated by the Sisters of EVE, who provided her with help. However, her ship is still damaged, and there is a Gallente ship that is waiting to finish her off as soon as she leaves the station's shelter.

I would like you to assist her by making certain that the Gallente ship will no longer be a problem.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That vulturous Gallente ship is no longer a threat to anyone.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Remember: in helping our allies, we help ourselves. It's yourself you're leaving in the lurch here, friend.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Remember: in helping our allies, we help ourselves. It's yourself you're leaving in the lurch here, friend.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: With pleasure.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The Sisters of EVE are a religious humanitarian aid organization. They believe that heaven resides on the other side of the EVE gate, and if they can get back through the gate, they will be able to talk to God. Allying their religion with science, they frequently experiment on the EVE gate, with the goal of one day unlocking its secrets.

The Sisters are politically neutral, with members from every faction. They have been providing aid to those in need since the Gallente-Caldari War. They have a number of stations set up outside of empire borders.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: The Caldari can take care of their own. I'm sure she'll be fine.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't have time for this anymore. The Caldari can take care of their own. I'm sure she'll be fine.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Take care not to underestimate the Gallente.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I heard you had a job for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Due to your laziness and disregard, the Gallente ship managed to destroy our Caldari friend. You have cost us a valuable and proven ally; your reputation will suffer for this.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well done. Aid given to our allies is aid that will be returned to us twofold in the times to come.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Due to your laziness and disregard, the Gallente ship managed to destroy our Caldari friend. You have cost us a valuable and proven ally; your reputation will suffer for this.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A Caldari envoy is soliciting our assistance for his particular area of space. However, his transport ship is poorly guarded. Meet him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and escort him the rest of the way here.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: A Caldari envoy is soliciting our assistance for his particular area of space. However, his transport ship is poorly guarded. Meet him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and escort him the rest of the way here.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Here he is, safe and sound.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Your reputation will suffer for this.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Your reputation will suffer for this.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Of course.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Caldari-Gallente war began based upon differences of thought and opinion of the Federation they were both a part of. It ripped the Federation completely down the middle and became particularly vicious.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't have time to ferry around pampered envoys. Find someone else for your babysitting job.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I don't have time to ferry around pampered envoys. Find someone else for your babysitting job.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Keep him safe and you will be well rewarded.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I heard you have work.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text:
Thanks to you, the Caldari envoy had to wait for another transport, and in that time, a Gallente ship managed to sneak into the area and attack the vessel he was on. Unfortunately for all involved, the assassination succeeded.

The loss of our ally is your fault.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent job. Here is your reward.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text:
Thanks to you, the Caldari envoy had to wait for another transport, and in that time, a Gallente ship managed to sneak into the area and attack the vessel he was on. Unfortunately for all involved, the assassination succeeded.

The loss of our ally is your fault.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Was I unclear in my explanation of the work I expected of you? You have accomplished nothing since taking on the task we discussed. This is unacceptable. I have made note of this dereliction of duty in your permanent record. Perhaps in the future you'll see fit to follow through on your obligations.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Of course.

Supply and munitions interdiction raids are a critical part of ongoing operations against the Gallente Federation. Depriving the enemy of the materiel necessary to sustain the fight can only make it easier for our own forces to prevail.

After recent fighting in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, the enemy is no doubt attempting to undertake just such re-supply operations. There are State interdiction patrols active in the area and I'd like you to lend them a hand. If you see any enemy transports, destroy them immediately.

Will you do this? There's a sizable bounty in it for you if you're successful.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I destroyed an enemy convoy. Now where's that bounty you mentioned?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Very well. I'll find a real patriot to do it instead. You are dismissed, pilot.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Bounty's the magic word. Count me in.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No thanks; I'm not interested in patrolling.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Sorry, I'm not going to be able to complete this task.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could count on you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: I'm looking for work. Do you have anything for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Supply and munitions interdiction raids are a critical part of ongoing operations against the Gallente Federation. Depriving the enemy of the materiel necessary to sustain the fight can only make it easier for our own forces to prevail.

After recent fighting in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, the enemy is no doubt attempting to undertake just such re-supply operations. There are State interdiction patrols active in the area and I'd like you to lend them a hand. If you see any enemy transports, destroy them immediately.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Even as we speak another Gallente task force is re-supplying in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It appears that our attempts to stop them from rearming have been unsuccessful. No matter, we will try again when the opportunity presents itself. At that time, be ready {[character]player.name}. I don't want to let another chance to hit a soft target pass us by.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I have deposited the funds in your account. Check back with me as soon as you're able – I have another task for you.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
As you may have noticed on your last interdiction raid, the transports you destroyed were of Minmatar origin. It seems that the Federation is relying on the cheap labor provided by Minmatar immigrants to provide munitions.

Even now the Federation is building new factories and taking advantage of these “human assets.” One of our spies has managed to obtain information about a group of these workers being transported through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They must be captured, just like any other enemy war materiel.

Still interested?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Mission accomplished.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Dammit, you could have told me earlier.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Good to know that you don't have the stomach to do what's necessary.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: No problem. I'll get right on it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: For years, the booming Gallente economy has lured millions of Minmatar immigrants from their homes in the Republic, where poverty and unemployment are chronic. Often freed slaves come to the Federation, where they take menial jobs for little pay. These immigrant workers have further fueled Gallente business ventures by allowing them to reduce labor-related production costs.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: That sounds an awful lot like a slave raid to me. Count me out.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: On second thought, I'm not going to take this job after all.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Remember, those “workers” are of no value to us dead.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Tell me more.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Federation is relying on the cheap labor provided by Minmatar immigrants to provide munitions. Even now, the Federation is building new factories to take advantage of these “human assets.” These assets must be captured or destroyed, just like any other enemy war materiel. One of our spies has managed to obtain information about a group of these workers being transported through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Capture them and bring them here.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Stop by again when you're available. We're going to interrogate some of these Minmatar vagrants before shipping them off. Maybe we'll be able to find out where they were headed.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've had a chance to interrogate some of the prisoners you brought back. Fortune smiles upon us – we've learned the location of the munitions plant in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to which they were headed. That factory must be destroyed as soon as possible.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I thought so. We've had a chance to interrogate some of the prisoners you brought back. Fortune smiles upon us – we've learned the location of the munitions plant in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to which they were headed. That factory must be destroyed as soon as possible.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: That arms factory is no longer a current event.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Suit yourself, but just be aware that every hour that factory is operating, it's cranking out ammunition that might be used to speed up your next clone activation.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Suit yourself.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: I'm on it.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: No, thanks. I'm busy.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Sorry, I'm not going to be able to destroy that munitions plant after all.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I knew I could count on you.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: You've got my attention.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text:
When I did not hear back from you after assigning you the task of destroying that munitions plant, I feared the worst. I took the liberty of assigning another pilot to the task, and I am happy to report that the factory has been destroyed.

If you find yourself in need of work in the future, please do not hesitate to look me up. I'm sure I can find something for you to do.

Something less important.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good job, {[character]player.name}. You've struck a major blow to the Gallente war effort.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text:
When I did not hear back from you after assigning you the task of destroying that munitions plant, I feared the worst. I took the liberty of assigning another pilot to the task, and I am happy to report that the factory has been destroyed.

If you find yourself in need of work in the future, please do not hesitate to look me up. I'm sure I can find something for you to do.

Something less important.

messages.mission.briefing.text: {[character]player.name}, I need you to go and procure 10 units of a very particular ice-- Azure Ice, I believe, is what you're looking for on your scanner. I also need it within the next 24 hours, so get to that ice field!

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I've been having a spot of bother filling an order, {[character]player.name}. It's starting to affect my usually sunny disposition. I'm hoping you can clear this off my docket, and bring the smile back to my face.

My client requires hydrogen isotopes to run her control tower, and she's getting a little snippy about the time it's taking me to provide it. She's even sent along a few assassins to vent her displeasure. No patience, that woman.

{[character]player.name}, I need you to procure 10 units of a very particular ice-- Azure Ice, I believe, is what you're looking for on your scanner; I can extract the hydrogen myself. I've lost a few good ships and a few incompetent pilots in the ice fields trying to fill this order, and I really need you to live up to your reputation, {[character]player.name}-- within the next 24 hours. Can I count on you, {[character]player.name}?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: What did I tell you, {[character]agentID.name}? Here's the ice you need, with time to spare.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: Cold Beauty: The Irresistible Danger of Ice Mining

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Or it could be that you need a Courage Implant along with an upgrade of Job Dedication? Just tossing it out there, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Well, you do live up to your reputation-- as a selfish churl. Good riddance, {[character]player.name}!

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Ice mining in low sec– I can't think of a better way to spend the day, {[character]agentID.name}. I'd even do it for free, but not today!

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
There are few who can deny the majestic beauty of an ice field: the slowly rotating towers of glistening blue-green ice set against the colder backdrop of the stars can give even the most jaded pilot pause. Yet such beauty hides a darker truth: if you are not prepared, an ice field can quickly become your very own sparkling graveyard.

While some ice fields can be found in Empire space, the rarer– and more profitable– ice ores are found in 0.0 space. As always, low sec can promise more ISK– or it can promise the dubious thrill of seeing your ship pounded into dust by eager pirates. Far too many inexperienced pilots have seen their mining barges blown apart-- with the hours and ISK needed to outfit them-- now so much vapor floating around their blinking pod.

Yet for most, the lure of the ice fields is too much to resist. With the sure promise of such treasures as Strontium Clathrates and Liquid Ozone, to name a few, the dangers of low sec will be dared. And even if it all ends in a fiery explosion, pilots can still enjoy the way their ship's destruction makes the ice sparkle all that more beautifully, if only for a few, rare seconds.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}-- I like to stay frosty with my weapons turrets, not some boring mining laser. I'm off to find work a little more glorious than this– goodbye!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I'm not really feeling this job, {[character]agentID.name}. It could be the constant pirate attacks, or the sheer boredom of mining frozen water rocks.  Hard to say, but either way, I'm gone.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: You're good with the bravado, {[character]player.name}, I'll give you that– now just get me my ice!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: If I don't live up to my reputation, I'll open the airlock for you, {[character]agentID.name}.  So what do you have for me?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: {[character]player.name}– just a quick note to let you know your incompetence has had some rather spectacular consequences. Since you failed to provide the hydrogen isotopes I requested, I've had to deal with assassination attempts courtesy of both my client and my CEO. If you wish to make amends, please take a stroll through the nearest airlock. Thanks, {[character]player.name}!

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Finally, someone with a degree of competence! Thanks for your work, {[character]player.name}. Just mind that airlock door on your way out...

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: Perhaps my instructions were too complex for you, {[character]player.name}, but I needed that ice mining job done in 24 hours– not you making up your mind in 24 hours. Since the chronometer's ticking, I've gone and found someone who understands the concepts of ‘time pressure' and ‘manners'. If you want to apologize, please go fly into a black hole.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Well, as you know, the Cartel has a pretty good thing going here in Curse – we're able to strike into the heart of all the other empires and remain relatively safe from retaliation. Now that the conflict between the Amarr Empire and the Minmatar Republic has heated up, though, we're getting pressure from both sides. The Minmatar have been pushing hard in some places, and now we've decided that it's time to push back.

We've been working with representatives of the Khanid Kingdom to give the Minmatar a surprise. The Republic has been building up forces in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. In exchange for some generous financial compensation, we've agreed to help the Khanids push the Minmatar out. But we need a good capsuleer to keep the light Minmatar escorts busy while we help the Khanids destroy the larger vessels.

Will you do it?

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Well, I did my part. Have we got the Minmatar on the run?

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: No, I'm sorry, {[character]player.name}. Sorry you don't have what it takes.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Sorry to hear that, {[character]player.name}. Your loss.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Sure, I'll do it. Minmatar, Amarr - who cares, as long as I get to shoot them in the face, right?

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The Khanid Kingdom is a small empire of a dozen or so systems that was founded by the renegade Amarr Heir Khanid II. Rather than commit ritual suicide when he failed to attain the imperial throne, Khanid declared independence from the Empire. The next few years were spent fighting a rebellion by Khanid's brother and fellow heir Dakos, and turning back an invasion by the Empire.

Since then, Khanid's rule has continued, his small empire has prospered, and trade relations with his former imperial enemies have expanded considerably. The Kingdom acts as a small point of contact between the secretive people of Amarr and the rest of civilized space. Today, the kingdom's primary enemies are the Minmatar, who, despite Khanid II's secession, still see it as an ally of the hated Amarr Empire.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: I don't really care too much for the Khanid Kingdom, or for any Amarrians, actually. No way I'm going to help them.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}. I'm not going to be able to finish this assignment.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good decision, {[character]player.name}. Now get flying!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Might be.... What have you got for me?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Minmatar Republic has been building up forces in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. In exchange for some generous financial compensation, we've agreed to help the Khanids push the Minmatar out. But we need a capsuleer to fly to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} to keep the light Minmatar escorts busy while we help the Khanids destroy the larger vessels.

We've loaded the location into your NeoCom. Destroy any Republic vessels you encounter there.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes, we do - tails between their legs. Good work, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I'm at a loss, {[character]player.name} — I thought my directions were fairly straightforward. Perhaps I should maybe hold your hand next time?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
A job, eh? Hm. Yeah, I've got something for you. Pretty urgent, too.

Seems the Amarr have been broadcasting holo-reels of their military "victory" over the Elder Fleet when that Sarum bitch returned to power. Thing is, we've found that someone has set up a broadcast hub to send the damned holos out here — into Minmatar space! I guess they're trying to intimidate us, or to play some kind of psychological war. Well, you know how happy that makes me. Which is to say, not at all.

Anyway, {[character]player.name}, I'd like you to head out there and blow that broadcast array of theirs to bits. Take your favorite ship, along with a couple friends, maybe, and head to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Time to disrupt a lot of bedtime stories...

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: Get out the firewater, boys, 'cause we got reason to celebrate. Mission complete: Minmatar victory.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, you gave it your best, {[character]player.name}. Keep telling yourself that. It'll ease the sting of cowardice you should be feeling.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Oh, I perfectly understand, {[character]player.name} — a mission like this requires courage, skill, and heroism… qualities you are clearly lacking. Have you forgotten you're one of the bloody immortals!?

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Any chance to wipe some Amarr off the roster is one I'll take. Count me in.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
A key element in sustaining an Empire is maintaining control, however illusory. This lesson of Imperial longevity has been much on the Amarr Empire's mind of late.

The Jovian War. The Minmatar Rebellion. Gallente interference. The Caldari threat. All of these and more have seemed to herald the twilight of the Empire, and even with the miraculous return of Heir Apparent Jamyl Sarum, many Amarr are skeptical. Faith can hold one for only so long, it seems.

The last thing the Amarr Empire needs now is civil unrest, and what better way to occupy the minds of its citizenry than a good, righteous war? To that end, Amarr Intelligence frequently provides footage of Amarr's victories over the rebellious Minmatar for an eager and appreciative public. The fact that certain critics claim much of the footage is (re)constructed by skilled holo-efx techs is irrelevant: All that matters is that the people are happy and not asking questions.

Because the last thing any Empire wants is people asking too many questions. The wrong questions can be hard to control.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: Sorry — I'm not flying into an Amarr base with anything short of a Ragnarok. Dying for a holo-reel isn't how I plan to go out.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: That is good news… but let's not get too far ahead of ourselves. I've just got some disturbing news about that broadcast plot — come back in a minute, will you, and then maybe I'll have the details sorted out.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Perfect: I thought this was your sort of job, my friend. It needs courage, skill, and heroism — and you've got 'em all.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Heh. I wondered why your security officers were being so nice, {[character]agentID.name}. Continue the trend and give me a decent job, why don't you?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Infiltrate the secret Amarr deadspace complex in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy the communications hub found there.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I waited for as long as I could, {[character]player.name}, but I had to go with someone else on this job. It's unfortunate you found this task beneath your notice — it could have led to bigger and better things. But, uh, I guess not for you!

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This mission isn't really for me. I like blowing things up, not sneaking around like a... well, like a sneaky person. I'm going to do something a little more… uh, epic.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.head.text: Data Chip? Encryption Codes? Not in My Hand?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
My techs here have come across some disturbing information. We were monitoring that holo-reel hub and its vicinity, and just before you neutralized the array, we intercepted a garbled message from a nearby Angel Cartel ship… sent to the Amarr homeworld. It was pretty broken up, but we did make out the words "Minmatar" and "payment." We must know more.

We've managed to track the Angel ship that made that broadcast to an outpost that's, surprisingly, not too far from here. We need the code to decrypt that message, and that ship seems our best bet.

Go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and get that ship's log, no matter what it takes.

And you'll have to make it snappy, 'cause I'm pretty sure the Angels won't hang around there too long — you won't have much time once you accept this mission!

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I got a little singed, but the job's done. Here's the data chip — just wipe the Angel blood off and you're good to go.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Fine, just fine.  But a question before you go: How do you fit your tail between your legs inside that egg of yours? Is it kind of cramped? Or just kind of embarrassing?

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Fine, {[character]player.name}. Some champion you turned out to be. You know, you could do with a new wardrobe. Something in yellow would be appropriate, I think.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: Now this is more like it! Consider that code acquired.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Whatever their other gifts, the Amarr are very good at two things: piety and self-justification. Both of these qualities, but most assuredly the second, come in handy when one considers the issue of slavery.

Since slavery is a consistently inherent theme in their religious doctrine (and how can something be wrong if faith allows it?), the Amarr must contend at all times with the disgust other races feel toward slavery. Chief among their opponents are the Gallente, whose displeasure is undoubtedly fueled by the many transplanted Minmatar flooding their homeworlds and stations. In the halcyon days of the Empire, the Amarr would easily have dismissed such concerns — but recent history has brought to some Amarr, at least, both humility and prudence.

Yet the need for slaves has not diminished — and in fact, since the recent Elder Fleet "recovery" effort in Amarr space, that need has grown terribly. However, the Amarr tradition of collecting slaves has necessarily become problematic for those Heirs and Holders, who may face trade embargoes and similar punitive actions from other nations. So many Amarr look surreptitiously to more "independent" sources of slaves — sources who don't care for any optics outside of their own bank balances.

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text:
You want me to take on the Angel Cartel? Here's an even better idea: you pay me for the holoreel job, and I walk away from this one.

Yeah… yeah, I like that idea better.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You are amazing, no lie — and it looks like we need to you keep it up: More trouble, it seems.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: I'm happy you're happy, {[character]player.name} — but the timer's ticking. Now go!

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Well, you've got my interest: What's happened?

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and retrieve the data chip with the encryption codes from the Angel Cartel ship there, and then return to your agent with the chip. 
<font color = #EE3B3B>Be sure you check the timer for this mission; you won't have too long before the Angels are sure to clear out.</font>

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: This is getting way too hot for me, {[character]agentID.name}. To hell with the politics — break out the Fleet if you want that code bad enough.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Eradicate all pirate ships at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and then rescue the slaves from the Cartel ships.

You might want to go in with some backup — intel says there's a bunch of the buggers out there.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
My techs decrypted the rest of that message, thanks to the code you recovered. It seems those Cartel ships you destroyed were part of a gang that've been moonlighting as freelance slave raiders. They're supplying the Amarr with slaves from outlying worlds! They've been abducting entire families living in isolated areas so the alarm won't be raised for weeks to come.

That ends now.

We've managed to track the Angel slaver ships to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, with — according to the message — a hundred of our people on board. We could send in the Fleet, but frankly they're still reeling, and they just might not get there in time. I need you to rescue those people, {[character]player.name}. Bring in whoever you need to help you on this one: Just get it done.

messages.mission.complete.charsays.text: I've returned with the rescued slaves. And I've wiped out every single Cartel ship involved in their abduction. You have to admit, {[character]agentID.name} — I am pretty awesome.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Fine. Know this, though: Your blatant selfishness may have condemned those poor souls to indentured servitude, or worse. Let that comfort you at night.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: If blaming others helps you rationalize your cowardice, {[character]player.name}, then so be it. Take your "worthy self" and get out of my sight.

messages.mission.accept.charsays.text: There are no worse scum than slave raiders. It'll be my pleasure to wipe them from the stars.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
In the heinous world of spaceship piracy, only the worst — or best, depending on your outlook — rise to the top and stay there. The Angel Cartel is among the very few pirate organizations that can claim this dubious honor.

The Cartel is the most widespread criminal organization blackening the space lanes. There are many reasons for this, chief among them being that the Angels fully embrace the sound business policy of diversity. Outside of common piracy, the Angels have their fingers in most illegal pies, be they protection rackets, industrial blackmail, or murder for hire. There are also rumors the Cartel is involved in even more despicable operations — yet attempts to investigate these claims have only produced numerous law enforcement corpses.

Most spacers know that to cross the Cartel is tantamount to suicide. Without mercy, without compassion, and allegedly armed with long-lost Jovian technology, the Cartel is best avoided by those with a fondness for breathing.

But sometimes even pirates can go too far....

messages.mission.decline.charsays.text: If rescuing our own people from slavers isn't a job for the Republic Fleet, then what is? I'm not risking my ship because the navy refuses to do its job.

messages.mission.quit.charsays.text: I think I've done enough for the Minmatar people, don't you? It's someone else's turn to step up. I'm done with this job.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Spoken like a true warrior, {[character]player.name}.  Now make those pirate dogs beg for mercy. And offer none.

messages.mission.ask.charsays.text: Yeah, I'm up for it. What do we need done?

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: I rather hope you're dead, {[character]player.name}, because there's no other excuse for allowing our people to be enslaved. I'd hate to think you just decided you couldn't be bothered.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I'd have to agree with your rather modest assessment, yes. You have served both the Republic Fleet and our people with honor. Such exemplary work deserves an appropriate reward. Enjoy, hero!

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text:
You leave me speechless, {[character]player.name}. I would have thought rescuing your own people from slavery would be a priority. Obviously not….

I just don't know what more to say.

messages.mission.timeout.emailbody.text: Since you seem to have forgotten, I asked you to mine and reprocess that Veldspar, {[character]player.name}. I've given you a whole week and there is still no word of your progress. I'm afraid I'm going to have to give the job to someone else. A word of advice for the future; take your obligations seriously, people don't like to be let down.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work. You're a quick learner. I'm going to manufacture something from that Tritanium you brought, but after that I'll have a new job for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
For a career in business, you will need a basic understanding of crucial industrial processes such as mining ore and reprocessing it (along with a myriad of other materials) into its component minerals.

I want you to get onboard your new Venture, fit it with a mining laser and a turret weapon - the former for the asteroids, the latter for any pirates that might attack you - and head out to a certain set of coordinates, where you'll mine ore from Veldspar asteroids.

Once you get back, refine the Veldspar ore into Tritanium. If you had to deal with any pirates, you can also refine any modules you retrieved from their wrecks - though be aware that the reprocessing of ships and modules usually carries a hefty waste penalty.

messages.mission.offerexpired.email.body.text: I've given you a whole week to think about my job offer, {[character]player.name}. I can only assume your lack of commitment means you aren't interested. I'm going to have to give the job to someone else I'm afraid. I hope you put that ship I gave you to good use all the same.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've come across a narcotics ring that we suspect is helping fund Steon's operations.

Make your way to their warehouse and destroy it, {[character]player.name}. Be ready for a fight, too.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work! Those criminals were funding all sorts of illegal activities.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've come across a narcotics ring that we suspect is helping fund The Devout's operations.

Make your way to their warehouse and destroy it, {[character]player.name}. Be ready for a fight, too.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work! Those criminals were funding all sorts of illegal activities.

We've come across a narcotics ring that we suspect is helping fund Tahamar's operations.

Make your way to their warehouse and destroy it, {[character]player.name}. Be ready for a fight, too.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work! Those criminals were funding all sorts of illegal activities.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've come across a narcotics ring that we suspect is helping fund Wolf's operations.

Make your way to their warehouse and destroy it, {[character]player.name}. Be ready for a fight, too.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work! Those criminals were funding all sorts of illegal activities.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Let's move on to the next stage in the process. First, you'll need at least 100 units of Veldspar. Then, you can reprocess it here at the station using the Reprocessing Plant and give me the results.

If you succeed, I'll give you a new mining frigate.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work. Stick around!

Now for some more complicated production. I want you to make me 20 units of Cap Booster 25.

You'll need the minerals Tritanium, Pyerite, and Mexallon which you can easily acquire by reprocessing ore from Scordite and Plagioclase asteroids.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I ask for help, and they send me a capsuleer.

You are a capsuleer, aren't you? An immortal pilot who subverts the rules of life and death, who shapes the fate of empires? You'll have to excuse my skepticism.

I work with a humanitarian organization, the Sisters of EVE. I've seen your kind hasten the deaths of millions every day. You expect me to believe that you're different? To prove yourself, your actions will have to do the talking.

We've just received a distress call from a ship called the Damsel, and you're the closest aid available right now. Get out there and save some lives. Prove to me you're not just another murderous liar with a god complex. With all the power at your disposal, you certainly could be a force for good. And one thing is certain: Good is in dire need of allies these days.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Sometimes objects and entities found in space are not displayed in the default overview settings. Adding "Large Collidable Objects" in Celestials  and "Large Collidable Structures" in Entities to the overview can reveal details such as object names.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Investigate the distress call from the Damsel.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You investigated a distress call from the starship Damsel.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've just received a distress call from a ship called the Damsel, and you're the closest thing to aid available right now. Get out there and save some lives. Prove to me you're not just another murderous liar with a god complex.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: It seems CONCORD was faster to respond, but your backup was definitely appreciated. There were a handful of survivors picked up. They've been taken to various care facilities in the area – wherever vacancies could be found.
Ah, Sister Alitura said you'd be coming by. You're here about the Damsel, right? That ship's registered to a pilot under the name Marihem Dagan.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You got in touch with an undercover CONCORD agent, who told you that the ship Damsel was registered to a pilot under the name Marihem Dagan.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
No one fired on the Damsel. Something must have happened inside the ship.

We'd like you to track those survivors down. CONCORD is the first logical step. I've gotten in touch with CONCORD Agent Tevis Jak, who may have information for you. Go see if you can find a piece of this puzzle.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We got some interesting information out of your trip. It seems no one fired on the Damsel. Something must have happened inside the ship.

We'd like you to track those survivors down, see if you can get any information about the ship's path, pilot, or cargo. We need to know what caused this disaster.

CONCORD is the first logical step. I've gotten in touch with CONCORD Agent Tevis Jak, who may have information for you. His location is being uploaded to your NeoCom: he's currently acting as an ORE agent. Go see if you can find a piece of this puzzle.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Talk to the CONCORD agent, Tevis Jak.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Ah, you're done. Good timing.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You destroyed the pirates, and the CONCORD agent had information waiting for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A bunch of pirates have been scavenging the explosion site. Go and take them out for me. It shouldn't be too much trouble for a capsuleer, and you might even find some extra information.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yeah, I picked up the crew that outlived that explosion – pretty massive, whatever it was. I'll see if I can track down the facilities they were sent to if you can do me a favor.

A bunch of pirates have been scavenging the explosion site. Go and take them out for me. It shouldn't be too much trouble for a capsuleer, and you might even find some extra information. Hell, you can probably get it done in the time I'll need to look up the rest of this data. Damn legacy systems...

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Kill the pirates and bring back anything interesting you find at the disaster site.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Okay, I found your first guy, but it looks like he's already shipped out again. What a fighter, huh? He's down in the crew manifest as "Red", and his convoy has him listed under the same handle, so there you go.

I'm giving you coordinates to intercept the convoy now. You should be able to catch them before they get too far. Go quick, though: I'm worried that they don't have enough security to deal with the number of 'rats – sorry, pirates – where they're headed. They might need your help.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Find Red and deliver him to Tevis Jak.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: Tevis Jak sent you to find a man named Red. He was murdered by the time you found him.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Dead, is he? Figures. I'll keep the investigation open, but unless something changes there's little CONCORD can do.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I found your first guy, but it looks like he's shipped out already. He's down in the crew manifest as "Red". I'm giving you coordinates to intercept the convoy now.
