They might need your help.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Dead, is he? Figures. I'll keep the investigation open, but unless something changes there's little CONCORD can do.

Ah, you've returned. I must say, you're proving to be quite helpful. We were not able to decode the datacore, but we have produced a few leads of our own. The structure of the datacore resembles that of rogue drone fabrications we've discovered previously, but there are enough variations that we believe this may be something rather different. We'll keep working on it.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You gave Sister Alitura the information you accquired while working with Tevis Jak. She informed you that their investigation of the strange datacore you recovered has suggested some kind of drone involvement, though they have been unable to decrypt the data itself.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Just got a message from Sister Alitura. I sent her that weird datacore you found at the site. She says they weren't able to decipher it. Pity.

Still, she's very interested in consulting with you. So go do what she wishes. The Sisters are good people.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Just got a message from Sister Alitura. I sent her that weird datacore you found at the site. She says they weren't able to decipher it. Pity.

Still, she's very interested in consulting with you. So go do what she wishes. The Sisters are good people.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You're returning to Sister Alitura.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We have another crew member located. The ship's janitor, Nebben Centrien, is stationed at a small outpost. We hope he'll have a lead on where some of the other personnel are recuperating.

In light of what happened to Red, I'd like you to bring him back here once you've found him – for his own safety, you understand.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Retrieve the janitor Nebben Centrien.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: If you think it's easy to find people to take on the janitor role between the stars-- well, it's not, okay? Janitors are in high demand, especially in places frequented by capsuleers, who are not exactly famous for cleaning up after themselves.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You retrieved the janitor Nebben Centrien for Sister Alitura.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Give me a moment to input Nebben's data. He's already providing us with good information.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We have another crew member located. The ship's janitor, Nebben Centrien, is stationed at a small outpost. We hope he'll have a lead on where some of the other personnel are recuperating.

In light of what happened to Red, I'd like you to bring him back here once you've found him – for his own safety, you understand.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Give me a moment to input Nebben's data. He's already providing us with good information.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We got the information from Nebben, but there's a problem.

It appears Aubrei Azil, the ship's cook, has shipped out as well. There's no way they would all get reassignments so soon after an incident like this. They're being shuffled through the system so we don't find them. And then there're the drones….

You need to find Aubrei. If we follow this long enough, we might discover who doesn't want the truth uncovered.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Rescue Aubrei Azil.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: A good ship's cook is a valuable asset. It's much easier to keep morale up when you don't have to rely solely on generic frozen food. Real chefs who are willing to work in the often-cramped conditions aboard ships are in high demand.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You rescued Chef Aubrei Azil.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: This drone involvement is certainly worrying news. Let me see what other leads I have for you.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It appears Aubrei Azil, the ship's cook, has shipped out as well. There's no way they would all get reassignments so soon after an incident like this. They're being shuffled through the system so we don't find them. And then there're the drones….

You need to find Aubrei. If we follow this long enough, we might discover who doesn't want the truth uncovered.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: This drone involvement is certainly worrying news. Let me see what other leads I have for you.
You handled yourself well out there. Doctor Elban is cooperating with us.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You ransomed Dr. Lujia Elban.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've located the doctor from the wrecked ship. Unfortunately, we've located her by way of a ransom demand. We want this doctor alive, so we're going to pay it. I'll put the money in your hangar when you accept this mission.

I need you to take the ransom to the designated drop location. They're to drop off the doctor as soon as you drop off the money. Be prepared for a double-cross, just in case.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've located the doctor from the wrecked ship. Unfortunately, we've located her by way of a ransom demand. We want this doctor alive, so we're going to pay it. Luckily they just want planetary currency, so the real ISK value is minimal. I'll put the money in your hangar when you accept this mission.

I need you to take the ransom to the designated drop location. They're to drop off the doctor as soon as you drop off the money.

That's the plan, anyway. I'd be prepared for a double-cross, just in case.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Ransom Dr. Lujia Elban.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've gone a long way, but we've found the key survivor. Her name is Tahaki Karin. She was the engineer on the main ship from the ruined fleet, and she's signed on to the crew of the Heartbreak. She may be the only one who knows what really happened.

You know the drill by now: Get out there and get her before someone else does. I'm fairly certain there'll be someone there to shoot at you.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Retrieve Engineer Tahaki Karin from the Heartbreak.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You rescued Engineer Tahaki Karin from the ship Heartbreak.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent. Karin is being transported to a more secure Sisters of EVE location for a full debriefing with our people. Don't worry, we'll keep CONCORD well-informed of our progress.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We've gone a long way, but we've found the key survivor. Her name is Tahaki Karin. She was the engineer on the main ship from the ruined fleet. She may be the only one who knows what really happened.

You know the drill by now: Get out there and get her before someone else does. I'm fairly certain there'll be someone there to shoot at you.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent. Karin is being transported to a more secure Sisters of EVE location for a full debriefing with our people. Don't worry, we'll keep CONCORD well informed of our progress.
Sister Alitura sent you? Very well, give me a moment.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You contacted the Gallente agent, Delphine Xarasier, regarding the drone connection to your investigation.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Remember the strange datacore you found? We've determined that it must have been made by rogue drones of some kind. I'm sending you to Gallente space, where I've contacted someone who can help you continue this investigation. Her name is Delphine Xarasier, an agent for CreoDron and the daughter of their chief researcher. We've tapped out our other leads for now, which leaves us in need of more information on drones, and she can certainly give you that.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Remember the strange datacore you found? We've determined that it must have been made by rogue drones of some kind. I'm sending you to Gallente space, where I've contacted someone who can help you continue this investigation. Her name is Delphine Xarasier, an agent for CreoDron and the daughter of their chief researcher. We've tapped out our other leads for now, which leaves us in need of more information on drones, and she can certainly give you that.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Talk to your Gallente contact, Delphine Xarasier, regarding the drone connection to your investigation.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Alitura said you needed more information about some kind of drone problem.

The Sisters have referred a few promising capsuleers in the past, so I'm willing to give you a chance, but I can't do anything else until this mess I'm dealing with has been taken care of. If you could retrieve some drones from {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, that would speed things up considerably.

You see, every drone in that system has ceased responding to signals. That just doesn't happen with Federation technology… unless the drones have been destroyed. Our research and development team needs whatever components still exist in order to analyze the remains.

Fly out there and bring back one of the drones – or any parts that might remain. You'll need to be careful. There were no signs of other ships in the system, so I have no idea what could have destroyed our drones.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The first drones in the Gallente-Caldari war were little more than mines with proximity detonators and limited movement, but soon they advanced to a level where a single drone rivaled a solo-fighter's capabilities. The drones reversed the tide of the war and helped create a stalemate between the two empires.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Retrieve drone components and return them to your agent.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You retrieved drone components.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Every drone in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has ceased responding to signals. That doesn't happen with Federation technology, unless the drones have been destroyed. Our research and development team needs whatever components still exist in order to analyze the remains.

Your job is to fly out there and bring me back one of the drones, or whatever remains you can find.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Wonderful! The R&D team has been waiting for your return. Are you available for another mission?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: A recently established colony still depends on Federation support for items they can't produce yet. Their last shipment of medical supplies was lost en route, and we think it may be due to rogue drone action. Regardless, this batch of supplies needs to get through. Lives are depending on it.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Take needed medical supplies to impoverished Gallente colony.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Gallente Federation emphasizes personal freedoms and accomplishments, but they also believe in providing the tools for personal advancement. Gallente believe in ”investing in the future,” so shipments of supplies for new colonies are almost always supported by lobbyists and the government. History has shown that the returns generated over the years more than repay the initial investment.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You took needed medical supplies to an impoverished Gallente colony.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good capsuleers are always in short supply. I have an urgent recovery mission that I could use your help with.

messages.mission.briefing.text: A recently established colony still depends on Federation support for items they can't produce yet. Their last shipment of medical supplies was lost en route, and we think it may be due to rogue drone action. Regardless, this batch of supplies needs to get through. Lives are depending on it.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good capsuleers are always in short supply. I have an urgent recovery mission that I could use your help with.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I told you I'd help if you helped me. Well, the Serpentis Corporation has just kidnapped one of CreoDron's top minds, Dr. Aspasia Castille. She was analyzing those drone parts that you recovered earlier. The information she has is critical to figuring out what's going wrong with the drones, but the Serpentis aren't going to let her go without a fight. They're planning to take her to their installation at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to get there first. Destroy their base and the ships guarding it before the transport ship arrives.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Destroy Serpentis station and its guards.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Serpentis Corporation began as a Gallente research firm, developing over time into the notorious drug cartel that they are today. The Serpentis have an ongoing deal with the Angel Cartel to provide protection for various Serpentis research stations. There are substantial bounties issued by the Gallente Federation Navy on any ranking officer in the Serpentis Corporation.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You destroyed a Serpentis installation before they could use it to hold a hostage.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Very efficient, {[character]player.name}. If you're willing to take another job from me, I have more details on the location of Aspasia Castille.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Serpentis Corporation has just kidnapped one of CreoDron's top minds, Dr. Aspasia Castille. Get to their research station first and destroy the structure and its guards before the transport ship arrives.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Very efficient, {[character]player.name}. If you're willing to take another job from me, I have more details on the location of Aspasia Castille.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I'm glad you contacted me, {[character]player.name}.

Since you destroyed the Serpentis research station, the transport ship headed to another location to make the transfer. Though we were able to intercept, both ships were lost in the course of the ensuing battle. However, we believe a datacore containing Dr. Castille's notes may still exist.

Your task is to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, locate the datacore, and bring it back to me.

Be warned, all indications are that the ship was contracted by the Guardian Angels as part of their protection agreement with the Serpentis Corporation. I'm sure they'll send a ship to scan the wreckage and see what can be salvaged as well. They will be looking for some way to recoup part of their loss.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Retrieve the datacore and return it to Agent Delphine.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The Guardian Angels are a division of the Angel Cartel occupied with guarding Serpentis space stations. 
The Angel Cartel is the largest and best organized of the space-based criminal factions. The Angels are divided into several groups, each with a distinct function. The Angels recruit members from all the races and are thus not bound to any one zone of operation.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You retrieved a CreoDron engineer's data.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
I am glad to see you have returned in one piece.

Now it's time for you to decide if you trust me. I have a final mission to offer you, but it's risky for us both.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, find the datacore, and bring it back to me. The data is encrypted, but if you succeed, I will give you a copy of any non-classified information related to these drones and point you in the direction of another valuable contact with regards to this research.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
I am glad to see you have returned in one piece.

Now it's time for you to decide if you trust me. I have a final mission to offer you, but it's risky for us both.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The datacore you recovered has proved interesting. Before her kidnapping, Dr. Castille found several oddities in the drone components. Honestly, it's created more questions than answers for CreoDron staff. As a sign of good faith, I'm going to share some information with you. Our drones are being corrupted by some other kind of drone. I need you to take some information to a friend of mine in Caldari space. They've also been suffering from drone problems recently, and this data may help him and his people. I need you to keep this quiet: Our friendship isn't exactly something we're broadcasting, not with both of our empires at each other's throats.

If you agree, I'll make sure the information is securely hidden onboard your ship. You'll never even know it's there; all you have to do is go and talk to Immuri Asaka, and he'll take care of the rest.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Deliver the data to Immuri Asaka.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Caldari Prime is the homeworld of the Caldari people. It was claimed and occupied by the Gallente Federation for nearly two centuries, until recent actions by then-head of State Tibus Heth temporarily brought it back under Caldari control. The Gallente eventually loosened his grip on the planet, which is currently being monitored by the (relatively) impartial Mordu's Legion.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You took the Creodrone data and delivered it to a Caldari scientist, Immuri Asaka.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Welcome to the Caldari State. I must thank you for delivering that information from Ms. Xarasier. It will help us a great deal.

messages.mission.briefing.text: You have been hired to transport a container of drone components and research files from Federation Space to Agent Delphine's contact in the Caldari State.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Welcome to the Caldari State. I must thank you for delivering that information from Ms. Xarasier. It will help us a great deal.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've been dealing with the same drone corruption described by Xarasier. We've managed to contain the contaminated ones inside a deadspace pocket, but that is only a temporary solution.

I need you to scout out the situation personally. I've been trying to get updates from my colleague in the field, but apparently she is having trouble getting clearance for outside communication. Fly over there and make sure the drones are still adequately contained. If they aren't, report back to me. Do not enter into any confrontations with the security forces attempting to contain the drones. Am I clear?

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Caldari are very protective of their way of life and tolerate only those foreigners that stick to the rules. Almost any time the Gallente seek to influence events inside the State, the Caldari are swift to label it as nothing less than a violation of their sovereignty. The Caldari paid a huge cost fighting the Federation, losing millions of people between the exodus from Caldari Prime and the war itself.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Scout out the drone hive and report back on friendly vessels.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You scouted a drone hive and reported back to Immuri Asaka.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Then it's as I feared. Thank you for the report, {[character]player.name}. I'll need you again in just a moment, if you're still free to work.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We are currently dealing with the same drone corruption Xarasier described. I need you to scout out the situation on the front lines personally. Fly over there and make sure that things are being adequately contained. If they aren't, report back to me.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Then it's as I feared. Thank you for the report, {[character]player.name}. I'll need you again in just a moment, if you're still free to work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The situation we have is a delicate one. We can't go after Vitamala directly. Even though he doesn't really have a clue about what he's doing, he's too well-connected to displace without good reason. I'd expect this sort of thing from the Gallente, but not in the State. A man achieves rank because of his hard work and dedication, not because his father has friends in the bureaucracy.

Someone else can help with this situation, a true warrior and dutiful servant of the State. The first difficulty is in freeing up his schedule. If you can handle that part, I can deal with the paperwork for his reassignment.

He's currently on deployment in a nearby system, busy dealing with a mercenary force we believe to be funded by Guristas Pirates. If you can take out all of the Guristas ships, then I can arrange to have him reassigned to the drone problem.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Kill the mercenaries protecting the Guristas facility then report back to Immuri Asaka.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Guristas Pirates have been a thorn in the side of the Caldari State for many years, constantly threatening the security of outlying systems and poorly defended convoys. The Guristas tend to shy away from prolonged and overt assaults, preferring instead to take down weaker prey during opportunistic raids.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You destroyed a group of mercenaries for Immuri Asaka.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I'm pleased to inform you that everything went smoothly with the transfer. One of the first things our new commander did was to request frigate and cruiser backup for his fleet. They should be capable of defending themselves if the drones try to fight their way out.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We can't go after Vitamala directly. Even though he doesn't really have a clue about what he's doing, he's too well-connected to displace without good reason. I'd expect this sort of thing from the Gallente, but not in the State. A man achieves rank because of his hard work and dedication, not because his father has friends in the bureaucracy. There is another commander I can reassign. The first difficulty is in freeing up his schedule.

He's currently on deployment in a nearby system, busy dealing with a mercenary force we believe to be funded by Guristas Pirates. If you can take out all of the Guristas ships, then I can arrange to have him reassigned to the drone problem.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I'm pleased to inform you that everything went smoothly with the transfer. One of the first things our new commander did was to request frigate and cruiser backup for his fleet. They should be capable of defending themselves if the drones try to fight their way out.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The situation has gotten complicated. That current security deployment won't last long against those drones. The local commander, Vitimala, seems happy just to contain the drones, but that only buys the little bastards more time to escape or supplement their numbers.

I need to know more about the commander and why he doesn't seem to know what he's doing. I have a friend named Nachi Koruda working for the House of Records who should have those answers.

Fly over to the archives facility where she works and return to me with anything that might offer some explanations. It isn't glamorous work, but it needs to be done if we want to make informed decisions about how to proceed.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Visit the House of Records archives and return with information on the military commander.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You retrieved information on a military commander from the House of Records.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: This says Vitamala got to his position thanks to family connections. Bad news for us.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
I need to know more about the commander and why he doesn't seem to know what he's doing. I have a friend named Nachi Koruda working for the House of Records who should have those answers.

Fly over to the archives facility where she works and return to me with anything that might offer some explanations. It isn't glamorous work, but it needs to be done if we want to make informed decisions about how to proceed.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: This says Vitamala got to his position thanks to family connections. Bad news for us.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Damn Vitamala! He wasn't coordinating with the Navy's emergency logistics division. There's a colony nearby that missed a shipment of farming supplies thanks to the chaos caused by these drones. If we don't make the delivery ourselves, then we risk their entire agricultural economy. Once you take these goods over to our fleet, they will deal with the rest; we can finally turn our focus towards the underlying cause of all these problems.  

<font color = #EE3B3B>You will need at least 150m3 of cargo space to make the delivery. Keep that in mind.</font>

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Deliver the farming supplies to the storage warehouse.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Despite the existence of several popular political ideologies, financial concerns are the primary driving force among the Caldari people. Although the Federation often tries to paint the Caldari as soulless capitalists, most Caldari view any economic concerns as an extension of their pragmatic mindset, not as an inherent love for money.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You delivered farming supplies to a storage warehouse.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Yes, I just received word from the colony. They should be able to stick to their production schedule, which is great news. Thank you, {[character]player.name}, you've done the Caldari people a great service today. If you need any further help with your drone investigation, just say the word.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Vitamala wasn't coordinating with the Navy's emergency logistics division. There's a colony nearby that missed a shipment of farming supplies thanks to the chaos caused by these drones. If we don't make the delivery ourselves, then we risk their entire agricultural economy. Once you take these goods over to them directly, we can turn our focus on the underlying cause for these problems. <font color = #EE3B3B>You will need at least 150m3 of cargo space to make the delivery. </font>

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Yes, I just received word from the colony. They should be able to stick to their production schedule, which is great news. Thank you, {[character]player.name}, you've done the Caldari people a great service today. If you need any further help with your drone investigation, just say the word.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I've just been contacted by Sister Alitura – she wants you to get back in touch with her right away. Here, take this transponder beacon with you when you leave; that way I can know you've arrived safely.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You need to contact Sister Alitura.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You re-established contact with Sister Alitura.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thank you for coming so quickly. We need your help.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Sister Alitura has asked for your help right away. Take this transponder beacon with you when you leave; that way I can know you've arrived safely.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thank you for coming so quickly. We need your help.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Normally, the local security forces would want to handle this drone threat themselves, but we're willing to contract the job out to a capsuleer.

You'll have to go in alone while our fleet holds the line. I suggest you take some friends into the fight. The drones have been growing in number as more are corrupted and somehow find their way to the swarm.

Once you neutralize the threat, you should search the wreckage for something that will help with your investigation.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Neutralize every drone inside the quarantine area.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You destroyed a swarm of drones to establish a quarantine area.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thank you for taking care of that drone problem. A capsuleer like you may not consider it a big achievement, but trust me, you've done what few other could. You clearly have a great future ahead of you. I hope you continue to use that talent to do good things, either within the State or elsewhere.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Normally, the local security forces would want to handle this drone threat themselves, but we're willing to contract the job out to a capsuleer. You'll have to go in alone while our fleet holds the line.

I suggest you take some friends into the fight. The drones have been growing in number as more are corrupted and somehow find their way to the swarm. If you manage to neutralize the threat, then perhaps you will find something amongst the wreckage that offers some further clue.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thank you for taking care of that drone problem. A capsuleer like you may not consider it a big achievement, but trust me, you've done what few others could. You clearly have a great future ahead of you. I hope you continue to use that talent to do good things, either within the State or elsewhere.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The rogue drone you and I both want has been spotted in a deadspace pocket near one of our stations, building a swarm of drones. I think it's going to try and destroy that station. There are fifteen people on that expedition-- bring them all back home safely.

You have a chance here to save some lives and deal with that drone once and for all.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Food Relief corporation is owned and run by the Sisters of EVE. Food Relief (FR) is ostensibly responsible for delivering necessities (primarily food and medicine) to people in need in any empire. FR have never officially withheld their deliveries, but in recent times there have been occasions where their medicine drops were delayed or reduced due to unforeseen environmental conditions or a sudden outbreak of hostility on their caravan routes. Some political analysts maintain that these delays indirectly affected the outcomes of other factions' military campaigns.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Save the personnel of a Food Relief station.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You successfully saved the personnel of the Food Relief station, but the mysterious drone escaped.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Bless you for saving those people. I know you didn't do this out of charity, but your help is appreciated anyway. You have been paid, but when you're ready, I have another lead on this drone.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The rogue drone you have been looking for was seen in a deadspace pocket near a Food Relief production station, building a swarm of drones. Sister Alitura thinks the swarm is going to try and destroy that station. Save the people, either by evacuating the station or wiping out the swarm. Bring the fifteen survivors back to the Sister.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Bless you for saving those people. I know you didn't do this out of charity, but your help is appreciated anyway. You have been paid, but when you're ready, I have another lead on this drone.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
A Scope reporter named Corin Risia managed to get some tracking data off the drone two days ago; the holos you got allowed him to confirm that it's the same drone. He's willing to sell us the data in exchange for extracting him from a Mordu's Legion outpost. Mordu's Legion are generally an honest group, but for some reason Risia needs to get out of there quickly. He thinks the Legion wants to kill him.

Go to Mordu's outpost and extract Corin Risia. He's afraid for his life, so expect anything.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Rescue a Gallente reporter named Corin Risia in order to get some tracking data on the rogue drone.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Legion, mostly consisting of old Caldari veterans from the war with the Federation and young hotheads eager for action, is the largest and most famous mercenary corps in New Eden. They accept members from any race, as long as they are not known enemies of the Caldari State, and non-Caldari that have served in the Legion for a long time are offered Caldari citizenship on their retirement. The Legion is often employed by governments to settle issues that are not directly under anyone's jurisdiction, especially when fast deployment and swift results are needed. Their reputation as combat experts as well as fair and honest warriors has never been tarnished.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You were able to rescue a Gallente reporter named Corin Risia, who led you to the station where he stashed the data.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Risia said to thank you for the lift.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
A Scope reporter named Corin Risia managed to get some tracking data off the drone two days ago. He's willing to sell the data in exchange for extracting him from Mordu's Legion space, as he believes the Legion wants to kill him. Go to Mordu's outpost and extract Corin Risia. He's afraid for his life, so expect anything.

If you want to avoid a confrontation with Mordu's Legion, prepare for a stealth mission. Otherwise, there's a good chance you may have to blast your way out of the situation.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Risia said to thank you for the lift.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: I have a plan to help us track the rogue drone down. Up until now, we haven't had a chance to get a good look at the damned thing. The good news is that one of my Sisters was able to get holopics and scans of the drone that will help us  track it down. The bad news is that she's doing missionary work near Guristas space. She can't broadcast the data to us without raising suspicion from the pirates, so she's going to leave a canister with the data as close to the edge of their space as she can. I need you to get that data and bring it back to me.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Pick up data from a canister near the edge of Gurista space and bring it back to Sister Alitura.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The Guristas are probably the largest pirate faction in New Eden. They are infamous for their raids into civilized territory, something that very few pirate clans are willing or able to do. The mission of these raids is most often simply to steal cargo or passengers from freighters for ransom, but on numerous occasions their main intention seems to be to sabotage empire installations (mining facilities, sentry guns, and the like). This has led to speculations that some unscrupulous empire companies (or even governments) are hiring the Guristas to take out property of the competition.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You acquired data on the drone left by one of the Sisters of EVE near the edge of Gurista space, and brought it back to Sister Alitura. She processed it to give you some leads to finding the rogue drone.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You continue to surprise me, {[character]player.name}. Give me a moment to process this data, and then we can discuss our strategy.

messages.mission.briefing.text: One of the Sisters of EVE immediately recognized the drone and was able to download her scanning data from her ship. However, she's on the edge of Guristas space and can't broadcast the data. Pick up the data from a canister near the edge of the pirate's space and bring it back to Sister Alitura.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You continue to surprise me, {[character]player.name}. Give me a moment to process this data, and then we can discuss our strategy.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: While you were acquiring the data, I found two leads. One is a Gallente reporter who claims to have tracked the drone after you were near the Food Relief station. Another is a Caldari mercenary spy who says he has a formula that can help you scan for the drone. Both offers are time-sensitive, and we have to pick one now. I leave the choice to you: Which do you want to pursue?

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You must decide whether to work with the Gallente reporter Corin Risia or the Caldari mercenary Wolf Burgan.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: As you continue to work with one empire over the other, you will gain favor with that empire and lose it with the other. Even simple decisions can lead to gaining standing with one faction and losing it with another.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You chose which side to work with.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Sister Alitura has two leads. One is a Gallente reporter who claims to have tracked the drone after you were near the Food Relief station. Another is a Caldari mercenary spy who says he has a formula that can help you scan for the drone. You can only choose one option.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Before we get the mercenary's help, we need to get him out of a jam.

This guy goes by the name “Wolf Burgan”. Yeah, it's stupid, but I'm willing to cut him slack because he's a damn good tracker. Wolf's been all over the universe and hunted damn near everything at some point.

You don't get that good without making a few enemies. Right now the Serpentis want his head in a bad way. Wolf may be a great captain, but he's not a capsuleer. If he croaks, there's no resurrection. The Serpentis know it.

We're going to use this to our advantage. Thanks to a previous indictment, the local law at a nearby station has a sample of Wolf's DNA. You should have no trouble getting access to it just by virtue of being a capsuleer. Bring me Wolf's DNA sample, and I can hatch my crazy scheme.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Retrieve Wolf Burgan's DNA.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You retrieved the DNA of mercenary Wolf Burgan, for use in making a clone.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Let me just rush this over to the medlab...there. The body should be here in a minute.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Serpentis want Wolf Burgan's head in a bad way. Wolf may be a great captain, but he's not a capsuleer. If he croaks, there's no resurrection. The Serpentis know it.

We're going to use this to our advantage. Thanks to a previous indictment, the local law at a nearby station has a sample of Wolf's DNA. You should have no trouble getting access to it just by virtue of being a capsuleer. Bring me Wolf's DNA sample, and I can hatch my crazy scheme.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Let me just rush this over to the medlab...there. The body should be here in a minute.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: That was close. At least Corin's out of danger for the moment. We really want the tracking data for this drone. Luckily, he hid the data in a secure place. Can I trust you to take him to his hideout in a nearby station so he can transfer the data? Buying and selling information takes time, you know?

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You are to transport Corin Risia to the Sisters.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You transported Corin Risia to the Sisters.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thanks. That was the easy part.

messages.mission.briefing.text: You have rescued Corin Risia from Mordu's Legion, and now he needs to deliver his goods to the Sisters. Take him to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where he can transmit the drone's tracking data.</font>

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Risia said to thank you for the lift.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Now that we have the data, we can deliver it to a more secure, untraceable Sisters of EVE location. If you could take the data to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, I'd appreciate it. Don't worry, this is completely safe; you'll be fine.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You are to deliver Risia's data to a secure Sisters of EVE location.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: Knowledge is Money, Money is Power

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Information is the most precious commodity in the EVE Universe. But it comes at many costs: ethical decline, moral malaise, personal extortion, or even bodily harm. Some denizens consider these aspects to be major obstacles; others consider them personal challenges. Those that are successful, though, end up with monetary riches, but at what cost?

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You delivered Risia's data to a secure Sisters of EVE location.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Thank you for the data and protecting our site. On behalf of my fellow Sisters, we are eternally grateful for your endeavors.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Take the drone's tracking data to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and drop it off at the requested deadspace location.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Risia said to thank you for the lift.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Yes, the body's done. I had the techs at the cloning lab imprint Wolf Burgan's DNA on one of their blank slabs of biomass. If you were to take a tissue sample, it would come back as one hundred percent Wolf Burgan. Of course, the slab is completely inert and only vaguely human-shaped, but that won't be a problem once we blow it up.

There's a small outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and the Serpentis are convinced that Wolf is hiding out there. Take the body and fly it to the outpost. Kill the Serpentis if you feel like it. You're going to place the fake body in the outpost, then fly away. This will activate the timed explosives Burgan planted.

To any observer it should look like you swooped in and took out Burgan yourself, and the charred body with his DNA should sell it.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Take the cloned corpse to Wolf Burgan and plant it in the wreckage of his ship.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You extracted Wolf Burgan from Gallente space.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I'm surprised that actually worked. Burgan says the Serpentis bought it. He's ready to help us out.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
There's a small outpost that the Serpentis are convinced Wolf is hiding out in. Take the body and fly it to the outpost. Kill the Serpentis if you feel like it. You're going to place the fake body in the outpost, then fly away. This will activate the timed explosives Burgan planted.

To any observer it should look like you swooped in and took out Burgan yourself, and the charred body with his DNA should sell it.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I'm surprised that actually worked. Burgan says the Serpentis bought it. He's ready to help us out.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: We've secured Wolf Burgan's aid. Now all you need to do is fly out to a few of the hot spots where the drone has been spotted. Burgan's staying behind, but he'll be connected to your systems remotely. He'll update you as the situation changes. Listen to what he says. Wolf will point you in the right direction.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Check out the hotspots where the drone's been sighted.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You followed the drone through some kind of spatial rift.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
You followed it through a spatial rift of some sort? They aren't supposed to be able to do that....

Drones, I mean. Now, your next mission.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've secured Wolf Burgan's aid. Now all you need to do is fly out to a few of the hot spots where the drone has been spotted. Burgan's staying behind, but he'll be connected to your systems remotely. Wolf will update you as the situation changes. Listen to what he says. He'll point you in the right direction.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You followed it through a spatial rift of some sort? They aren't supposed to be able to do that....

Drones, I mean. Now, your next mission.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Based on the data you've provided me, I was able to locate where the drone and its swarm is heading: {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Do whatever it takes to destroy it.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You've been given the location of the drone and its swarm.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You defeated the swarm of drones, but the lead drone was destroyed by Marihem Dagan.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I can't... He's supposed to be dead! Are you telling me Dagan's been alive this whole time?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Sister Alitura has located where the drone is heading. Do whatever it takes to destroy it.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I can't... He's supposed to be dead! Are you telling me Dagan's been alive this whole time?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The missing capsuleer you are looking for has been quite busy recently, as I'm sure you'll be interested to hear. The Krusual Tribe became aware of his actions just a couple of days ago, when he was caught smuggling something out of Minmatar space. We've seen a few of his accomplices since then, shifting back and forth between Minmatar and Amarr borders.

You want information, we want information. Help us track down his friends, and we'll help you anyway we can when you find your capsuleer. Your first step will be to scout one of their major smuggling hubs and report back what information you can about the strength of security forces there.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Investigate the smuggling hub and report back to Keita Eslin.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You investigated a smuggling hub and gained information necessary to crack down on the smugglers.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work on the recon there. When you're ready to go and do something about those smugglers, you let me know.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The missing capsuleer you are looking for has been quite busy recently. He was almost caught smuggling something out of Minmatar space. Help us out, and we'll be there to help when you finally find your prey. Your first step will be to scout one of their major smuggling hubs and report back on the strength of security forces there. Once I have all the information I need, I'll give you the order to fall back.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work on the recon there. When you're ready to go and do something about those smugglers, you let me know.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Alright, you'll need to take these surveillance captures over to a friend of mine. He'll want to see them before he commits his own forces to the fight. I'd have sent them over the network, but I'm afraid this mission is completely unauthorized. All of the evidence I've gathered so far has been through methods the Republic Fleet wouldn't turn a blind eye to, so we're reliant on his help.  Once he has the information he needs, he'll probably want to send you in first to take out the heaviest security; then his people will follow in to clean up. Are you ready to commit yourself to this task, {[character]player.name}?

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Deliver the surveillance images to Tarak Erand.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You delivered surveillance images to agent Tarak Erand.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Give me a minute. I need a moment to go over this.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I need you to take these surveillance captures over to a friend of mine. He'll want to see them before he commits his own forces to the fight. Once he has the information he needs, he'll probably want to send you in first to take out the heaviest security; then his people will follow in to clean up. I hope you're ready for this.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Give me a minute. I need a moment to go over this.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Straight to business then, eh? Here's the plan: My men are currently standing by, ready to launch an assault on a poorly defended base nearby. This should draw a good portion of the security forces off the base we're truly aiming for. That's when you sweep in. Kill everything that moves, {[character]player.name}. If you can take out their reinforcements and logistics, then we'll be able to clean up what's left. I'm thinking that all this commotion should draw their leader out, or at least get his attention. We can see how it plays out once the bullets start flying. You'll receive updates on the field once we launch our assault. Ready to roll?

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Kill all of the mercenary forces.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Smuggling is one of the larger illegal industries in New Eden. Each nation in the cluster has numerous underground distribution cartels sourcing all sorts of illicit goods. Tracking the movement of ships and their cargo across borders is a monumental task that often spreads customs agents thin. For this reason, it isn't hard for a determined smuggler to find loopholes that they can exploit in the busy shipping schedules.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You destroyed smuggler forces.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
My men finished cleaning up the remaining hostiles just a few moments ago. You'll be pleased to hear this though, {[character]player.name}.

We caught someone trying to flee the scene; we think he knows something about the guys running this whole operation. He's been taken into questioning. If he does know anything, we'll have the information ourselves very shortly.

messages.mission.briefing.text: My men are currently standing by, ready to launch a secondary assault on a poorly defended base nearby. This should draw a good portion of the security forces off the base we're truly aiming for. That's when you sweep in. Kill everything that moves, {[character]player.name}. If you can take out their reinforcements and logistics, then we'll be able to clean up what's left.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
My men finished cleaning up the remaining hostiles just a few moments ago. You'll be pleased to hear this though, {[character]player.name}.

We caught someone trying to flee the scene; we think he knows something about the guys running this whole operation. He's been taken into questioning. If he does know anything, we'll have the information ourselves very shortly.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
That didn't take long. You can't get good mercenaries anymore. They crack before you even get to the fun stuff.

He gave us the names of three lieutenants, supposedly the underlings for the man running this whole operation. If we can capture one of them, then maybe they'll know something about this missing capsuleer of yours. If they don't, then they should at least know where we can find their boss.

The lieutenants are supposed to be meeting at a nearby deadspace facility, arranging some kind of “big deal”. We have no idea what this could involve: drugs, money, people. It might be anything, but it definitely means some more hired security to deal with. Once you clear the area, we should be able to scan the structures and locate the lieutenants, assuming they're still hanging around. Fly by and pick them up. If they refuse to board, pop a few shots off into the facility shields. That usually convinces people you mean business. So, feel like crashing the party, {[character]player.name}?

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Clear the facility of hostiles and capture any of the lieutenants present.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You destroyed hostile forces and captured one of the smugglers' lieutenants.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}. I had a feeling we'd find at least one of them there. We'll take him out back and encourage him to talk.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We have the names of three lieutenants, supposedly the underlings for the man running this whole operation. If we can capture one of them, then maybe they'll know something about this missing capsuleer of yours. They are supposed to be meeting at a nearby deadspace facility, arranging some kind of “big deal”. Once you clear the area, we should be able to scan the structures and locate any of the lieutenants, assuming they're still hanging around. Fly by and pick them up. If they refuse to board, pop a few shots off into the facility shields. That usually convinces people you mean business.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Good work, {[character]player.name}. I had a feeling we'd find at least one of them there. We'll take him out back and encourage him to talk.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've been working tirelessly over all the intelligence you delivered to me. A lot of it we already knew, but after some cross analysis, we discovered that there was a particular location that only Lieutenant Kirus and a few others had access to. Kirus caved when he saw that we knew the coordinates to his employer's hideout. This guy's alias is Izia Tabar. He's a battle-hardened smuggler baron; CONCORD's wanted him for a long time now.

We have his location, {[character]player.name}. Can we rely on you to end this? I'd expect his place to be well defended, but if we lose him now it all counts for nothing.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Assassinate Izia Tabar.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You killed smuggling leader Izia Tabar.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You have done exceptionally well, {[character]player.name}. Our teams will head over to Tabar's compound now and comb the area for further evidence. Get back to me when you are ready for one last assignment. It is about time the Minmatar repaid you for all you've done, and I have some information about how we can make that happen.

messages.mission.briefing.text: We've discovered the location of the lead smuggler, Izia Tabar. Kill him and I promise you that everything else will fall into place.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You have done exceptionally well, {[character]player.name}. Our teams will head over to Tabar's compound now and comb the area for further evidence. Get back to me when you are ready for one last assignment. It is about time the Minmatar repaid you for all you've done, and I have some information about how we can make that happen.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Before you arrived, we managed to get one of our people inside Tabar's recruitment and training facility. He informed us that the missing capsuleer you seek passed through this place briefly.

Moments ago, we received word that our man is now trapped there. We had hoped that Tabar's assassination would scatter the remnants of his forces and provide an easy escape, but we had no such luck. One of Tabar's remaining lieutenants, an Ammatar by the name of Mizara Nefra, has returned to the facility and taken over.

Not only is our spy and your only lead caught in the spider's web, but this smuggling crew may operate again someday unless we put a stop to this. You must run interference for us. Kill Mizara and his followers so that our agent has a chance of escaping undetected.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Fly interference for the Krusual spy from Tabar's training compound.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You assisted a Krusual spy in escaping with important information about Dagan.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You capsuleers really are the best. You've destroyed a pirate ring that would have taken us months to work through. High marks all around.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Moments ago, we received word that our man is now trapped there. We had hoped the Tabar's assassination would scatter the remnants of his forces and provide an easy escape, but we had no such luck. One of Tabar's remaining lieutenants, an Ammatar by the name of Mizara Nefra, has returned to the facility and taken over.

Not only is our spy and your only lead caught in the spider's web, but this smuggling crew may operate again someday unless we put a stop to this. You must run interference for us. Kill Mizara and his followers so that our agent has a chance of escaping undetected.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've destroyed a pirate ring that would have taken us months to work through. High marks all around.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: You've done good work for me, and I have one last request. Go and tell Mizara's Amarr masters that she will work for them no more.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Inform the Amarr of Mizara's death.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You told Dovirch Anselm that Mizara was dead.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Mizara is dead?

What will I tell her family?

messages.mission.briefing.text: Keita Eslin wants you to leave Minmatar space to speak to Dovrich Anselm in Amarr space.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Mizara is dead?

What will I tell her family?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I would speak with you about your search for Dagan, but first, a matter of decorum. The late Mistress Mizara's parents entrusted the safety of their child to my lord. He has attempted to make amends, but I am afraid my lord can be...indelicate. He would replace their daughter with reparations of gold and ISK. This must be handled with more care.

Take this toy. The mistress first arrived at my lord's estate with nothing to her name but this. As you destroyed her body, it is the only physical connection left in this world that her family will recognize as hers. Deliver this to the family, and with the utmost care. They have already suffered enough.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Amarr society is popularly conceived as hierarchical and old-fashioned. True Amarr are thought to dominate all people they conquer, and treat their own people as little better than cattle. While that can be true in certain cases, the political realities of the Amarr Empire are far too complex to paint the Empire as a wholly evil power.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: The family of Mizara is grieving over their loss.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: Mizara's family was given closure, however bitter it may be.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Thank you for doing this, my friend. To see others suffer is never easy.

Return to me in your own time.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Take this toy. The mistress first arrived at my lord's estate with nothing to her name but this. As you destroyed her body, it is the only physical connection left in this world that her family will recognize as hers. Deliver this to the family, and with the utmost care. They have already suffered greatly.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Thank you for doing this, my friend. To see others suffer is never easy.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
You have proven you respect our ways. My lord now believes he can trust you.

Yes, we know Dagan, and of your hunt for him. My lord hired him as a tutor for Mistress Mizara some ten years ago. Though my lord fancies himself a skilled pilot, he is very much of old Amarr stock. He wished the mistress to be better educated in the newly emerging technologies and political realities than he. Dagan proved a remarkable teacher. Sadly, he and Lord Taphos had a falling out after the coronation of Empress Sarum. There was an altercation, and both Dagan and the mistress fled.

I do not know where Dagan himself is, but I do know the man who brought Dagan to my lord's attention: an archaeologist of some respect, by the name of Doctor Canius. You'll find him at the location provided. Be warned: he surrenders nothing for free.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: The investigation leads to an archaeologist named Canius.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You contacted Canius.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: What's this? Well, Lord Taphos's flunky has a flunky, does he? Look, if this is about Taphos's lovebirds runnin' off, I've got no idea where they are.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I do not know where Dagan himself is, but I do know the man who brought Dagan to my lord's attention: an archaeologist of some respect, by the name of Doctor Canius. You'll find him at the location provided. Be warned: he surrenders nothing for free.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: What's this? Well, Lord Taphos's flunky has a flunky, does he? Look, if this is about Taphos's lovebirds runnin' off, I've got no idea where they are.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Dead, is she? Damn. I was fond of her, and not in Taphos's way, mind you.

Yeah, I know. “He was purely her protector and patron, to mold her and shape her for a life of dedicated service to God and Empire.” Listen, I've been studying human history for a long while, and a platonic patronage between a “Lord” and “Mistress” hasn't happened since the time when the Reclaiming just involved stabbing our heathen neighbors with pointy sticks. But if that was all that was goin' on, nobody would fuss.

But that's enough story-time for now. You want more; you'll have to do somethin' for me. Hell, you don't want to hear more; you still have to do somethin' for me. Don't worry, it's real simple.

There's a dig site a little ways from here: a small cluster of asteroids, containing artifacts from some of the first Amarr space lanes. I know there's at least one good piece left, but every time I hire a team, they get driven off by pirates. All you have to do is go in, get that artifact, and return it to me without dying.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Canius is awaiting the recovery of his artifact.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You survived an attack by the Blood Raiders and recovered an artifact for Canius.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Blood Raiders? You're lucky you lived. They're psychotic and bloodthirsty, literally. Their sect believes purity can only be reached by consuming blood, and clone blood is purest of all. I'm afraid that makes you Capsuleers their favorite snack.

But you're alive, and you've got the artifact, so we're good.

messages.mission.briefing.text: There's a dig site a little ways from here: a small cluster of asteroids, containing artifacts from some of the first Amarr space lanes. I know there's at least one good piece left, but every time I hire a team, they get driven off by pirates. All you have to do is go in, get that artifact, and return it to me without dying.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Blood Raiders? You're lucky you lived. They're psychotic and bloodthirsty, literally. Their sect believes purity can only be reached by consuming blood, and clone blood is purest of all. I'm afraid that makes you Capsuleers their favorite snack.

But you're alive, and you've got the artifact, so we're good.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
You've done me a solid, so I'll return the favor.

A few years ago Lord Taphos tried to hit me up to tutor his new miracle girl. I declined, but I pointed him to Dagan. Dagan was holed up in this monastery at the time, part of some weird hermitage. So I introduce them, think nothing of it. Then I start hearin' rumors about how friendly Dagan is with Mizara. This doesn't go well with Taphos, particularly if you also believe what they say about Taphos and Dagan. Dagan was driven off, and truth told that's what probably turned Mizara against Taphos right then. So Taphos wants to keep a tight lid on the whole affair himself, keep the rumors still.

So that's his character history. Hope you wrote that all down. Nah, I don't care. There's no test or anything.

But what did Dagan do after? I honestly don't know, but five will get you ten that it has something to do with his life before Taphos. This is the location of the monastery he stayed at. It's been abandoned for some time. I wouldn't be surprised if scavengers have moved in. Go reclaim the hell out of that place, and I'm sure you'll find something useful.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Canius believes an old monastery may hold a clue to Dagan's location.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
The Reclaiming is a major part of the Amarr religion, and of the Empire itself. They believe that all people in the universe were once part of the same empire, and the Amarr Empire is the direct heir to that legacy. Through Empress Catiz Tash-Murkon the Amarr are given a divine mandate to reunify the peoples of the universe through any means necessary.

Historically, this has lead to numerous wars of conquest in which the Amarr decimate and then absorb civilizations. Each war is itself referred to as a Reclaiming to emphasize their divine mandate.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You found a strange document bearing Dagan's name in an abandoned monastery.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text:
Good job cleaning those guys out. I wouldn't worry about the ramifications of slaughtering some godless scavengers. The first rule of any good reclaiming is it's about souls, not bodies. You just happen to have a lot of the latter left over.

Now, let's have a look at that document you found.

messages.mission.briefing.text: This is the location of the monastery he stayed at. It's been abandoned for some time. I wouldn't be surprised if scavengers have moved in. Go reclaim the hell out of that place, and I'm sure you'll find something useful.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Good job cleaning those guys out. I wouldn't worry about the ramifications of slaughtering some godless scavengers. The first rule of any good reclaiming is it's about souls, not bodies. You just happen to have a lot of the latter left over.

Now, let's have a look at that document you found.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
This is fascinating. See this character here? It's only found in the Jovian alphabet. It's not proper Jovian, though. It's like they just were using the character set as a cipher of some sort. Unfortunate for Dagan, no cipher exists to stop a Hedion University man!

Let's see… that's strange. I can't tell who this is to, but it's definitely from Dagan. He says his mission went well, and that he fully earned the mark's— I assume that's Taphos's— trust. The mark willingly gave him passwords and clearance to Imperial archives, and… Emperors of old, he says he has sent all records pertaining to the Empire's knowledge of "pre-Jovian" weapons!

I can only guess at what qualifies as "pre-Jovian", but Taphos has unwittingly provided Imperial secrets to a spy. You must deliver this information to him at once!

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Dagan was a spy! You must inform Dovirch Anselm at once.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You informed Dovirch Anselm that Dagan was a spy. Anselm revealed himself to be from the Ministry of Internal Order.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: So you found out about Dagan? You capsuleers are impressive indeed. I was two years into this case before I got that far. I'm sorry, allow me to re-introduce myself. I'm Dovirch Anselm, Ministry of Internal Order.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I can only guess at what "pre-Jovian" qualifies as, but Taphos has clearly unwittingly provided Imperial secrets to a spy. You must deliver this information to him at once!

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: So you found out about Dagan? You capsuleers are impressive indeed. I was two years into this case before I got that far. I'm sorry, allow me to re-introduce myself. I'm Dovirch Anselm, Ministry of Internal Order.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I'm sure you have several questions for me, but I'm afraid they'll have to wait. It seems Taphos caught wind of your investigation. I know because he has challenged you to trial by combat.

It hasn't been common for years, but Taphos considers himself an old-fashioned true Amarr, and blue laws still allow it. Luckily, this provides the perfect opportunity for us. With the information we've uncovered, namely this cipher, we have enough to bring Taphos on charges. Doing so, however, would cause a huge political uproar, the kind that we frankly don't have the time for.

I want you to go out there, meet Taphos, and kill him in combat. We've shut off access to his clones, so he won't be coming back. As you were challenged by a noble you'll suffer no consequences, legal or otherwise. His family line gets to keep their good name, and everyone can then go back to their nice, safe lives, confident that Imperial secrets are still safe.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: In order to protect his name, Taphos has challenged you to a trial by combat.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: Taphos was defeated in direct combat. His death allowed Dovirch Anselm to close his investigation without damaging the Taphos' house.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: It is done, then. I've already started making my calls. As far as the media is concerned, he accused you of contract fraud, but God proved your innocence through a lawful trial by combat.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I want you to go out there, meet Taphos, and kill him in combat. We've shut off access to his clones, so he won't be coming back. As you were challenged by a noble you'll suffer no consequences, legal or otherwise. His family line gets to keep their good name, and everyone can then go back to their nice, safe lives, confident that Imperial secrets are still safe.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: It is done, then. I've already started making my calls. As far as the media is concerned, he accused you of contract fraud, but God proved your innocence through a lawful trial by combat.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Now, about Dagan. We've had our suspicions as to who he is. With the cipher you found, we know for sure. I'm violating my oath by giving you this intel, but odds are good we'd never be able to act on it ourselves. See, Dagan is from the Society of Conscious Thought.

Dagan's made a mistake, though. He's been cut off from his buddies. The Sisters have seen to that.

Yeah, the Sisters. I've been curious why they were so interested in my case. Now I know: if there's one group that keeps a closer eye on the Society than the Empire, it's the Sisters of EVE.

They knew the whole damn time who Dagan was. I'd say it's time to head back over to the Sisters and get the full story.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: The Sisters have known Dagan was from the Society of Conscious Thought all along. It is time to confront them.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Thought they were just a giant think tank, yeah? That's their public side. Diplomats and the rich send their children to the Society for the best education money can buy. I have a cousin who graduated from one, and he's straight as an arrow.

Every once in a while, though, we get reports of Society ships showing up at the oddest places. Spatial anomalies, weird accidents, the like. They're Society, but almost a different breed entirely. These guys are ghosts. As soon as you think you've found one, they just vanish.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: The Sisters of Eve confirmed that Dagan was Society of Conscious Thought.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You've returned. I told my sisters you were resourceful. Let's not tarry, then. Yes, we've always known that Dagan is a member of the Society of Conscious Thought. And yes, we knowingly kept that information from you for our own purposes.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Dagan's made a mistake. He's been cut off from his buddies. The Sisters have seen to that. If there's one group that keeps a closer eye on the Society than the Empire, it's the Sisters of EVE.

They knew the whole damn time who Dagan was. I'd say it's time to head back over to the Sisters and get the full story this time.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You've returned. I told my sisters you were resourceful. Let's not tarry, then. Yes, we've always known that Dagan is a member of the Society of Conscious Thought. And yes, we knowingly kept that information from you for our own purposes.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Your anger is understandable, but we've got more reason to cooperate than to quarrel. Dagan's your real enemy. You'll be interested to know that some of his corpmates have been spotted at a nearby station. We've prepared an agent to gain their confidence and extract information on their further operations. To you, she'll be Tahaki Karin, a ship's engineer from the Damsel. Before our operative can infiltrate Dagan's group, Karin's identity records will need to be altered. Take these records to an archive station. Once they're updated there, our friends will make sure they're changed throughout the entire network.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Plant the false records.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You planted false records to substitute a spy for Tahaki Karin, the engineer you rescued earlier.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work, pilot. The altered records are being distributed as we speak.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Your anger is understandable, but we've got more reason to cooperate than to quarrel. Dagan's your real enemy. messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Excellent work, pilot. The altered records are being distributed as we speak.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
With those records replaced, our agent is Tahaki Karin.

What happened to the real one? Electronically speaking, she's a non-person. She's alive and safe, though; if she wanted better, she shouldn't have joined the Society. Now, we need to get our Karin into place. I've filed a travel request in her name, which the Society has granted. All you need to do is rendezvous with a Society transport and drop her off.

Once that's done, we just have to wait for her to tell us where Dagan is.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Deliver the false Karin.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You delivered a spy impersonating Tahaki Karin to the Society of Conscious Thought.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Well done, pilot. I believe Karin has begun transmitting data already.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
With those records replaced, our agent is Tahaki Karin.

Once that's done, we just have to wait for her to tell us where Dagan is.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Well done, capsuleer. I believe Karin has begun transmitting data already.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Karin's information is still coming in. But if you really want to find Dagan, you're going to have to help us deal with a little problem. The Society of Conscious Thought has deployed a refitted cruiser, the Omnipresence, nearby… with a substantial escort. We think they may be recording our local communications. If they are, there's a good chance they'll be able to decipher them, and root out our agent. The Society will certainly murder our sister if they uncover her identity. We need you to locate the Omnipresence, and destroy her. If necessary, engage her escort, but try not to destroy them. The loss of human life would be catastrophic.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Destroy the Society spy cruiser.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You destroyed a Society cruiser spying on the Sisters.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Excellent work. The Omnipresence has been destroyed, and there's no indication that she managed to inform her Society masters. We'll be resuming contact with Karin immediately.
