messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Our agent hasn't been able to determine where Dagan is. But in decoding her sensory data, we managed to pick up a clue. An Amarr pilot named Kritsan Parthus recently delivered a cargo of drone parts to Dagan. These parts were black market, and may have been scavenged from some of your recent battles. We contacted Parthus. He's an independent operator, but wouldn't see the light. We've managed to locate him by tracing his communications signals. Unfortunately, it will be necessary for you to bring him in for a meeting under duress. Our archive data suggests that Parthus will travel with a small contingent of support ships. Identify his command vessel, destroy it and bring him to me, personally.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Destroy squadron and capture the leader.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You captured a pilot for interrogation.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: I'll handle questioning Parthus. Rest assured, he will be treated humanely, and compensated well.

messages.mission.briefing.text: An independent Amarr pilot named Kritsan Parthus has recently dealt with Dagan. Unfortunately, he won't disclose Dagan's location to the Sisters. Destroy Parthus's ship and retrieve him for questioning.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: I'll handle questioning Parthus. Rest assured, he will be treated humanely, and compensated well.
Lovely present you sent me.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You delivered smuggling lieutenant Irai Kirus to the Krusual.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Keita says she found something in the evidence you brought over from your tours around State and Federation space. She thinks it might help her people direct the interrogation of Kirus, so we need you to take him back to her. We will speak again perhaps, once Keita has gleaned some information from Kirus. If we don't, then let me say that it's been a pleasure having you as a friend and ally of the Minmatar people.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Keita says she found something in the evidence you brought over from your tours around State and Federation space. She thinks it might help her people direct the interrogation of Kirus, so we need you to take him back to her. We have a strong overlap of aims here, {[character]player.name}. You want to find this capsuleer, and we want to hamper smuggling operations in our space. So long as your work takes you down this path, we will be happy to offer our assistance. We will speak again perhaps, once Keita has gleaned some information from Kirus. If we don't, then let me say that it's been a pleasure having you as a friend and ally of the Minmatar people. I hope the good work doesn't stop with the end of your investigation.

Good work and good luck. I hope you find the answers you seek. I'm sure Keita will help.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Deliver Irai Kirus to the Krusual.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
We've finally determined Dagan's location. It appears that he's outfitting another expedition. If he successfully acquires more of those drones – and worse, maintains control of them – he and his clients will be able to wreak terrible destruction across the cluster. I'm sure you can take out Dagan yourself, but it looks like he's hired some muscle. You've made some imperial contacts, yes? They might be able to clear a path for you to engage Dagan.

The empires will want Dagan not just for justice, but for his knowledge. Accept their help, but consider delivering him into our merciful hands, instead. We'll spare him… and make sure his knowledge does no harm. You have to make a choice between the Empires: Which one do you want to help you in taking down Dagan?

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You must choose which faction to work with.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You chose a faction to work with to apprehend Dagan.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You've made your choice. Let us pray it was a wise one.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Based on your information, we've determined Dagan's location. He's preparing to depart, but he won't get far. We've assembled a small task force to disable the station. They won't stand a chance against a capsuleer, though, especially not one as slippery as he is. We're just clearing the way for you. Good hunting.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Destroy Dagan's ship and capture him.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You captured Dagan and ruined his plans.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Nice flying, sir. Genetic records confirm Dagan's identity, if you'd like to pass him along…?

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Welcome back, soldier. We've found Dagan. Couldn't have done it without those interrogation tapes. He's looking to leave the station you mentioned, but we can catch up to him. Our strike force is already on their way to the station. It'll take a capsuleer to shoot down a capsuleer, though. This is your show, pilot. Kick some ass.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Destroy Dagan's ship and capture him.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You captured Dagan and ruined his plans.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You gave quite a performance. Good work.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You gave quite a performance. Good work.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: We are ready when you are. My forces will disarm the station. Engage Dagan and retrieve him from his pod.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Destroy Dagan's ship and capture him.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You captured Dagan and ruined his plans.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: You set a fine example. We will show reels of the fight in corps academy for years.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Shall we begin?

While we regret the need to trouble an Imperial citizen, we imagine that confession was good for his soul. We have dispatched an assault group to eliminate his allies. They will clear your way so that you may strike Dagan down.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Destroy Dagan's ship and capture him.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You captured Dagan and ruined his plans.

messages.mission.completed.nextmission.a.text: Rarely is the wrath of God demonstrated in such fiery terms. Congratulations, pilot.

Greetings {[character]player.name} and welcome to the Minmatar nation. My name is Keita Eslin, Advisor to the Krusual Tribe. I'm glad to see you arrived, and with an abundance of useful information as well.

You needn't worry, I have good information and if you follow through on it, then we will certainly be helping one another.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You contacted Keita Eslin and continued your investigation.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
Dagan was the pilot leading the fleet that the drones first destroyed, and a known terrorist. He was supposed to be dead. It's very important that he is made dead. The Sisters consider this a top priority.

Dagan is heading for a system in Minmatar space. He can't have gone far. I'll connect you with Keita Eslin, Advisor to the Krusual Tribe. She can help you track down Dagan.

I've been to Minmatar space quite a few times myself, {[character]player.name}. It's not so bad there, but just be careful where you wander and what you say. Their way of doing things can be a little rough around the edges at times, but I've also never known a Minmatar to not get a job done. In case you don't know, the Krusual can be a little sly. Just make sure this one looks after your interests, too. Still, I'm sure you can handle yourself.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You need to contact Keita Eslin for assistance in tracking Dagan.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: So, you're the Capsuleer I've heard so much about? I was impressed with your humanitarian efforts for our citizens. Now it is time for darker deeds.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You allied with Brus Colterne of the Gallente Federation.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Gallente Federation have sent commander Brus Colterne to Sheroo as your contact. Colterne is an idealist, but effective. You will find him a reliable ally.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The Gallente Federation have sent commander Brus Colterne to Sheroo as your contact. Colterne is an idealist, but effective. You will find him a reliable ally.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You have chosen to side with the Federation. Proceed to Brus Colterne.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You are the one who destroyed the pirate Izia Tabar? You have my respect. Now it is time to end another threat to the Minmatar people.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You allied with Kitar Ang of the Minmatar Republic.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Kitar Ang, a veteran of the Minmatar Republic Fleet, awaits you in Avyuh. She is a brilliant tactician, if impatient.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Kitar Ang, a veteran of the Minmatar Republic Fleet, awaits you in Avyuh. She is a brilliant tactician, if impatient.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You chose to side with the Minmatar Republic. Proceed to Kitar Ang.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You cleared drones from State territory. Admirable. Now we shall annihilate Dagan.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You allied with Adani Yusev of the Caldari State.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Adani Yusev, a contractor with Ishukone, is eager to speak with you in Sosh. I've heard he is the very model of an efficient Caldari soldier.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: Adani Yusev, a contractor with Ishukone, is eager to speak with you in Sosh. I've heard he is the very model of an efficient Caldari soldier.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You chose to side with the Caldari Empire. Proceed Adani Yusev.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: You are the one who defeated Taphos? Hah! God smiles on you, my friend. With you backed by Empress' army, what hope does Dagan have?

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You allied with Lear Evanus of the Amarr Empire.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Amarr Empire has sent Lear Evanus, a commander of some fame, to Manarq. She is a firm defender of the Amarr faith. Her zeal will prove effective against Dagan.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: The Amarr Empire has sent Lear Evanus, a commander of some fame, to Manarq. She is a firm defender of the Amarr faith. Her zeal will prove effective against Dagan.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: You chose to side with the Amarr Empire. Proceed to Lear Evanus.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
The rogue drones did what? That's the damndest thing. I've heard they can think for themselves, but I've never heard of them just watching like that. There's something much larger going on than we realize.

Regardless, you've been a tremendous help to the Gallente Federation. Whether you continue your efforts defending the Empires or forge your own empires with your fellow capsuleers in the depths of lawless space, know that you have proven your worth as a demigod.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You delivered Dagan into the Sisters' custody, from which he is unlikely to return. While delivering Dagan, a large rogue drone hive appeared but did not attack. Sister Alitura was suspiciously unalarmed.

messages.mission.briefing.text: As per our agreement with the Sisters of EVE, we will turn Dagan over to their care. A Sisters of EVE ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura assures me Dagan will be treated humanely.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As per our agreement with the Sisters of EVE, we will turn Dagan over to their care. A Sisters of EVE ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura assures me Dagan will be treated humanely.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: The Gallente Federation asks that you deliver Dagan to the awaiting Sisters of EVE ships.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
More drones appeared, but did not attack? That is a strange thing. I heard that they were truly sentient, but I never quite believed it. There's something much larger going on than we realize.

Regardless, you have proven yourself a friend of the Minmatar Republic. Whether you continue your efforts defending the Empires or forge your own empires with your fellow capsuleers in the depths of lawless space, know that you have proven your worth as a demigod.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You delivered Dagan into the Sisters' custody, from which he is unlikely to return. While delivering Dagan, a large rogue drone hive appeared but did not attack. Sister Alitura was suspiciously unalarmed.

messages.mission.briefing.text: As payment for their aid, the Sisters of EVE have demanded we give them Dagan. I would rather see him stand trial for his crimes, but my superiors have agreed to the Sisters' terms. A ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura will accept nobody other than you to approach. Deliver Dagan to their hands, and let us be done with this.

A ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura will accept nobody other than you to approach. Deliver Dagan to their hands, and let us be done with this.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: The Minmatar Republic asks that you deliver Dagan to the awaiting Sisters of EVE ships.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You delivered Dagan into the Sister's custody, from which he is unlikely to return. While delivering Dagan, a large rogue drone hive appeared but did not attack. Sister Alitura was suspiciously unalarmed.

messages.mission.briefing.text: The Sisters of EVE have asked for Dagan himself as payment for their intelligence. The State pays all its debts. A Sisters of EVE ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura demands that only you approach the Sisters ship with Dagan. I see no more fitting way to end this.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text: As per our agreement with the Sisters of EVE, we will turn Dagan over to their care. A Sisters of EVE ship awaits his delivery. Sister Alitura assures me Dagan will be treated humanely.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: The Caldari State asks that you deliver Dagan to the awaiting Sisters of EVE ships.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
So the soulless drones returned. I confess their behavior is strange. I had heard that the automatons have a free will of their own, but I never gave it much weight until now. There's something much larger going on than we realize.

But that is a mystery for another day. You have been an ally to the Empress and the Amarr people. Whether you continue your efforts defending the Empires or forge your own empires with your fellow capsuleers in the depths of lawless space, know that you have proven your worth as a capsuleer.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: You delivered Dagan into the Sisters' custody, from which he is unlikely to return. While delivering Dagan, a large rogue drone hive appeared but did not attack. Sister Alitura was suspiciously unalarmed.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Sisters of EVE have requested that we turn Dagan to their forces as payment for their aid. The Sisters may appear peaceful, but we are providing this Society member no mercy by delivering him to their care.

A Sisters of EVE convoy awaits the deliver of Dagan. They wish you to do the honors. I can think of no one more appropriate.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
The Sisters of EVE have requested that we turn Dagan to their forces as payment for their aid. They're welcome to him. The Sisters may appear peaceful, but we are providing this Society member no mercy by delivering him to their care.

A Sisters of EVE convoy awaits the deliver of Dagan. They wish you to do the honors. I can think of no one more appropriate.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: The Amarr Empire asks that you deliver Dagan to the awaiting Sisters of EVE ships.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Welcome to Poinen, {[character]player.name}. I've been expecting you. In fact, I was quite pleased to have someone offer their services so soon after I put the word out.

As I'm sure you know by now, my name is Katsen Isha. I work part-time as a lawyer and consultant for Nugoeihuvi Corporation here in the Onirvura Constellation, where much of our company's most important business is handled.

That brings me to the first task I have for someone, perhaps you. Some associates of mine have come across a fragile package that must be handled delicately. You needn't take it far, and I've had your path cleared of any obstacles. Transport is simply a matter of discretion on your behalf. Could you deliver the cargo to our headquarters in Josameto?

messages.root.agentsays.text: I have not yet received any word of a delivery to Josameto HQ. Until that point, I have nothing further to say to you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: As his first task for me, Katsen Isha wants some kind of “delicate” cargo moved from his own station in Poinen to the Nugoeihuvi headquarters in Josameto.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Then our business is concluded.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Goodbye then, {[character]player.name}, I don't have time to waste.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Nicknamed the “Shadow HQ” after its curious location, the Nugoeihuvi station in Poinen sits just one jump out from their Headquarters and shares the system with Internal Security HQ, the security arm of NOH. For certain individuals, the station is ideally situated, offering fast and easy personal access to many of NOH's highest-ranking officials – whilst remaining on the periphery of things, unnoticed in the shadow of the 13th moon. To those who are charged with the defense of Nugoeihuvi interests, it is not Josameto but Poinen that is considered the nexus, the bustling heart of a corporation that is their whole world.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: As proof to Katsen Isha of my reliability and discretion, I moved some potentially questionable cargo to the Nugoeihuvi HQ in Josameto. A biohazard team was on standby to receive the goods.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I'm glad to see you're enthusiastic, but let me make this clear; you're not the first egger I've worked with. I say this so you know that I am well aware of just how capable – and yet completely unreliable – your type can be.

If you work with me, I expect results and I demand integrity. I'll keep plenty of ISK flowing in your direction, but you're going to have to earn it. I don't pay for half-assed jobs. Forgive the bluntness, {[character]player.name}, but I would rather be proven wrong, than told that I am.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Some associates of mine have come across a fragile package which must be handled delicately, if you get what I mean. You needn't take it far and I've had your path cleared of any obstacles. Transport is simply a matter of discretion on your behalf. Once you have made the delivery, contact me again.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Thank you. It is good to see that even on the little tasks I can trust in your discretion. This is so often where it matters most.

Take some time to enjoy yourself in Onirvura, and get back in touch with me when you're ready to truly begin our work together.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Welcome back, {[character]player.name}. Now, before we get to anything else there's the matter of money. If I'm going to be paying for your services, then securing some funds is our first priority. My knowledge plus your capabilities equals ISK.

I want you to acquire some valuable formulas for me. They're hidden away inside a deadspace research facility not far from here. I managed to come across the coordinates after a booster-addled Hyasyoda employee let slip about an arrangement to one of my associates. It seems her superiors are allowing criminal types to carry out illegal research in exchange for a cut of the profits…and clearly some of the merchandise too.

As it turns out, our friends in Sukuuvestaa are the legal owners of the space where this little operation is underway, something that certainly helps our situation. They've agreed to have Peace and Order security forces busy themselves with other things while you get to work.

Very foolish of Hyasyoda to mix themselves up with criminals in someone else's backyard, I'm sure you'll agree. I like to see it as an opportunity, however. Not only will we be securing State borders, but also teaching them a valuable lesson about owning one's choices fully. What do you say?

messages.root.agentsays.text: You have your instructions, {[character]player.name}. I've nothing further to say until you carry them out.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Katsen Isha has learned that Hyasyoda, a corporate competitor, has been renting out land owned by Sukuuvestaa. Not only that, but they've lent it out to Serpentis scientists, and have them producing some kind of booster. My assignment is to take down the facility and recover one of their booster formulas. Isha seems less interested in understanding what it is their researching than making some ISK out of it. Sukuuvestaa is on good terms with Nugoeihuvi, so they've agreed to turn a blind eye to anything I may have to do to recover the goods.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I could see that weakness in your eyes even as you accepted the assignment, how disappointing that my instincts proved right. Your replacement is already en route so kindly make yourself disappear, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: It will not be hard for me to find another capsuleer to do this for me, {[character]player.name}. Suit yourself.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Rivalry among the corporations of the Caldari State is a daily reality, even today. The breakdown of relations with the Federation, opportunistic Guristas invasions and countless other problems facing the Caldari people have done little to ease inter-corporate tensions, some of which predate the existence of the State itself.

In other situations, rather than unifying the Caldari people, external threats only cause further divisiveness, and it is not uncommon for such issues to be leapt upon and twisted towards serving the agenda of one corporation or another. Survival within the harsh political arenas of the State requires a mastery of political cunning. To succeed requires even more – not only the ability to deeply understand events, but the capacity to shape them as well.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: Katsen Isha told me that Hyasyoda, a corporate competitor, had been renting out land owned by Sukuuvestaa. Not only that, but they lent it out to Serpentis scientists, who were producing some kind of booster. I was charged with taking down the facility and recovering one of their booster formulas – a task I carried out successfully. When I returned with the formula sheets to the Isha, he made no further mention of the facility or the research taking place there, only talking about how he was glad to have struck out at Hyasyoda. I was told to return to him when I wanted to discuss the sale of the stolen goods.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Excellent, here are the coordinates. You'll be flying into a heavily-guarded facility owned by Serpentis forces. Find their laboratories and take them out. Intel reports a large amount of Core Admiralty docked inside or patrolling nearby in battleships. They won't be flying alone, so expect smaller support craft wherever you see them.

Once you've recovered the formula sheets we can make arrangements to sell them. You'll need me for that, so don't get any smart ideas about keeping them for yourself. No successful Caldari ever worked alone.

messages.mission.briefing.text: I want you to acquire some valuable formulas for me. They're hidden away inside a heavily-guarded research facility owned by Serpentis forces. Once you've brought them to me we can make arrangements for their sale.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. I have to say…it's somewhat pleasing to watch Hyasyoda executives seethe quietly about a theft they cannot report. Hopefully they've learned the same lesson we in NOH did many years ago. Well…no…actually, I hope they screw up this badly every day.

Get back to me when you're ready to discuss how we're going to sell this.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
You want more time? Very well, {[character]player.name}.

I'll hold the job for you a little longer, but if I get the impression that you won't be returning, then I'll just hand it off to someone less busy. Business is business, my friend.

messages.root.agentsays.text: Have you cleared your schedule yet?

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: I lied to Isha, telling him that I need time to think about our options for selling the formulas. I plan to take this matter to Hyasyoda, even though it was their own facility I just broke into. I have my doubts about Nugoeihuvi, just as I'm unsure that Hyasyoda will even hear me out, but I won't be sure of the full story until I've tried to hear both sides.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: What? I think I might just hire someone else. Thanks anyhow, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: What? I think I might just hire someone else. Thanks anyhow, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: The second faction is the liberals, whose views are completely the opposite of the practicals in regards to interstellar trade. The liberals believe in fostering improved relations with all the other empires, creating a world where there are no trade barriers and free-flow of goods. They believe in trade deals that mutually benefit the participants and the empires can come together in a peaceful, prosperous future world only through cooperation. The liberals are led by the Ishukone Corporation and also include the Hyasyoda mega corporation. Their strong position within CONCORD is accentuated by their belief that it is their main vehicle in promoting universal peace and stability so that trade can flow freely and cultures mingle peacefully.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: I lied to Isha, telling him that I need time to think about our options for selling the formulas. In the meantime, I have taken the matter to Hyasyoda, and met with one of their representatives in Wuos. I have my doubts about Nugoeihuvi, just as I'm unsure that Hyasyoda will even hear me out, but I won't be sure of the full story until I've tried to hear both sides.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Attempt to resolve the situation before it escalates. Stall Katsen Isha and buy more time to meet in secret with Hyasyoda. The path of diplomacy is not a lucrative one, but to many Caldari, the rewards that come from the pursuit of peace are one of the only lasting things in this world.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Apparently Hyasyoda are more furious than I anticipated. I'm thinking we should probably move the formula sooner rather than later. I don't exactly want their Corporate Police Force prying into our business.

I've already lined up a buyer for us. All you need to do is move the goods. There's a slight complication though. As I'm sure you can appreciate, my associates – that is, the ones with an interest in highly-illegal booster manufacture – they're stationed at a somewhat remote NOH office outside of CONCORD jurisdiction, where the Chief Executive Panel finds it difficult to keep a close eye on everything.

Ideally, I would like you to deliver the goods to our facility in KFR-ZE yourself, but I can make arrangements for the staff at KFR to retrieve it from a nearby low-security system if you prefer. That will, of course, reduce your cut of the profits. If you can fly a Covert Ops – or an Interceptor – anything like that, then I would recommend you make use of it now, but how you proceed in light of this situation is up to you. All I want is for the sale to be made; I care less about how.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text:
Isha has told me that the Hyasyoda's Corporate Police Force may start investigating us if we cannot quickly sell the Serpentis formula we stole. I have three ways forward. I can take the formula all the way out to Syndicate; a fairly dangerous journey, but no doubt the most lucrative.

The second option isn't much safer, but Isha has let me know that – if I desire – I can take it only to the border of Syndicate, and his people will do the rest. That would let me avoid the nullsec systems altogether.

Alternatively, I could go speak with Hyasyoda. I'm not sure about their involvement in all of this yet. I can't shake the feeling that the facility Isha had me raid was already long ago commandeered by Serpentis, not being rented by them. Perhaps I should speak with Hyasyoda before taking any further steps.

messages.root.agentsays.text: Ready to choose?

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: Isha told me that the Hyasyoda's Corporate Police Force may start investigating us if we cannot quickly sell the Serpentis formula sheets we stole. I had to choose between taking it all the way out to one of their nullsec offices in Syndicate, to a bordering lowsec system, or back to Hyasyoda in the hope that I could resolve all the corporate infighting before it escalates.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Apparently Hyasyoda are more furious than I anticipated. I'm thinking we should probably move the formulas sooner rather than later. Ideally, I would like you to deliver the goods to our facility in KFR-ZE yourself, but I can make arrangements for the staff at KFR to retrieve it from a nearby low-security system if you prefer. That will, of course, reduce your cut of the profits. If you can fly a Covert Ops – or an Interceptor – anything like that, then I would recommend you make use of it now, but how you proceed in light of this situation is up to you. All I want is for the sale to be made; I care less about how.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text: Alright then.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
I'm sure you're aware how dangerous a place Syndicate can be. Serpentis are everywhere, and your fellow capsuleers have given the region a reputation for constant violence and war. I have mapped a route you could take through Genesis, via Faurulle, that will limit the amount of lawless space you need to traverse. That will make the trip longer, but safer. I guess that depends on how you feel about the short route and the jump into PF-346 it entails. That one system alone must have claimed millions of souls over the years; it is notoriously dangerous.

Personally, I would advise discretion, and that you limit your risks. I suggest you take something evasive, be that through speed or cloaking, and avoid the busiest systems. I will have an agent on standby in KFR-ZE at a secure Nugoeihuvi facility near our Station offices. I suggest you avoid the station unless there is a need to dock there. Capsuleer pirates love to corner unaware travelers there; we have to deal with the combat on our doorstep all the time.

messages.root.agentsays.text: KFR-ZE, {[character]player.name}. That is your current destination. Our people are waiting for you.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: I have committed myself to taking the stolen Serpentis formula out to KFR-ZE, a border system in the war-torn Syndicate region. Isha has suggested I travel in through Faurulle, which may make the route a safer one. He tells me there will be someone on standby at a facility in system to receive it.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text:
There is not much else I can offer, {[character]player.name}. If you cannot finish this task, then there is no hope that you will be able to see the entirety of our business to its conclusion.

Take some time, train up, gain some confidence. If you find the courage to take this on, I may still have the job open for you. No guarantees, though — there are plenty of capable eggers out there who'd leap on a job like this.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text:
There is not much else I can offer, {[character]player.name}. If you cannot commit to this task, then there is no hope that you will be able to see the entirety of our business to its conclusion.

Take some time, train up, gain some confidence. If you find the courage to take this on, I may still have the job open for you. No guarantees, though — there are plenty of capable eggers out there who'd leap on a job like this.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Cross the river before you laugh at the current.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: I successfully delivered the stolen Serpentis formula to a Nugoeihuvi representative in the KFR-ZE system. We've made a good amount of money from the sale. Isha tells me he has someone he'd like me to meet when I'm ready.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
I'm glad I can rely on you for something like this, {[character]player.name}. It seems so many capsuleers are becoming more risk-averse these days. It's a mindset I simply can't understand.

Remember that our cargo is precious and there is zero room for error here. If that formula goes missing, so will my desire to work with you. That is our ISK, and the entirety of our business together. Prepare yourself accordingly.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Travel out to the nullsec system of KFR-ZE in Syndicate to make the delivery. Isha has highlighted a potential route via the Faurulle system, which will limit the amount of nullsec jumps to only two. Once you have arrived in system, there will be a Nugoeihuvi facility with crew on standby to receive the goods. Regardless of your path, a journey into Syndicate will be a risky one. Nugoeihuvi would pay well, however, for having the goods delivered directly in such a dangerous region.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
I admit I am impressed. You have shown a surprising level of patience and commitment here, {[character]player.name}. Here is your pay; you have earned every last Kredit.

Take some time to relax, place a few bets, buy a few drinks…whatever it is you eggers do in your spare time. When you are ready to continue our work, I have someone I want you to meet.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Our people in KFR-ZE come down to State space via Faurulle at times. This is the quickest route out of Syndicate and often the most desirable one for that very reason. We've lost a few convoys recently, trying to pass through PF-346 along the shortest route to State space. In case you don't know it, {[character]player.name}, the PF-346 system has been made notorious by bloodthirsty capsuleers. I think it is perhaps best for all involved that we take no risks on this one and use the Faurulle drop-off.

This is where you will be taking our formula. I will have my people on standby at a secure facility in-system. Please, though, do not linger there. There are no stations in system, so anyone noticing you will know that you're out in space somewhere. The very last thing we need is some pirate scanning you down in one of our own facilities, and especially not in that one.

messages.root.agentsays.text: Faurulle, {[character]player.name}. That is your current destination. Our people are waiting for you.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: I have committed myself to taking the stolen Serpentis formula out to Faurulle, a low-security system in Solitude that borders the war-torn Syndicate region. Isha tells me there will be someone on standby at a facility in system to receive it. He has suggested I keep my visit quick, to avoid getting scanned down inside the compound by any local pirates.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text:
What did I tell you?

Goodbye, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text:
There is not much else I can offer, {[character]player.name}. If you cannot commit to this task, then there is no hope that you will be able to see the entirety of our business to its conclusion.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Cross the river before you laugh at the current.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: I successfully delivered the stolen Serpentis formula to a Nugoeihuvi representative in the Faurulle system. We've made a decent amount of money from the sale. Isha tells me he has someone he'd like me to meet when I'm ready.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text:
Very well — if you prefer to play it safe, I don't mind.

Even still, I'm sure you're aware that low-security space has its dangers. Carelessness out there will get you killed just as easily as jumping into a nullsec stargate blockade, so don't get complacent.

Remember, our cargo is precious and there is zero room for error here. If that formula goes missing, so will my desire to work with you. That ISK is the entirety of our business together. Prepare yourself accordingly.

messages.mission.briefing.text: Travel out to the lowsec system of Faurulle in Solitude to make the delivery. Once you have arrived in system, there will be a Nugoeihuvi facility with crew on standby to receive the goods. You will lose a percentage of the profit if you decide on this route, although the remaining risk and time involved will ensure it is still quite lucrative.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: Isha somehow learned of the Hyasyoda investigation team and even uncovered the location of their headquarters. He tasked me with leveling the place and killing the mercenary forces guarding it. I spoke with CPF Agent Arikio Kuretsu about the situation. Her people are coming up with a strategy to handle it.

messages.root.agentsays.text: Time is our greatest enemy here, {[character]player.name}. You should get going. The CPF could replace their stand-in mercs at any moment.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Isha has somehow learned of the Hyasyoda investigation team and worse yet, knows the location of their headquarters. He has tasked me with leveling the place and killing the mercenary forces guarding it. Hyasyoda assured me that any orders Isha gave over FTL comms would find their way back to the team, so I can only assume they're aware of the matter. I should head back to Arikio Kuretsu at the Hyasyoda HQ to see how she wants to proceed.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Yes, I can understand your hesitance, but there is no other way to resolve this, {[character]player.name}. I will give you some time to reconsider the plan.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
This Katsen Isha…he needs to be brought down, but we have to be exceptionally careful about how we do this. Dealing with Nugoeihuvi requires cunning and guile. You've shown sound judgment by coming to us early, {[character]player.name}, but it will only get worse if you leave things as they are now. We need answers to the questions you've brought to light.

Can we count on you to earn Isha's trust, so you can uncover whatever you need to help us? We need someone on the inside if we're ever going to see this resolved; Nugoeihuvi are too well-trained at covering up their tracks. If you could be there, making the sale of the formulas yourself, we would undoubtedly learn a great deal.

If you're willing to take this on, then we will be there to assist you every step of the way. I've been authorized to grant you provisional support from one of our best counter-intelligence teams. They would observe your actions from a distance and monitor any relevant data from your fluid router cache. Anything Isha said to you over FTL, we would have. Anything your camera drones saw, we would see.

You would have to keep your assignment strictly confidential, even from other Hyasyoda members. Nobody could know. Not your lover, not your mother, not even the Maker. If we need you again, we'll find a way to get in touch, but until that time you would only have to concern yourself with earning Isha's trust and acting as if this conversation never happened.

Do we have a deal?

messages.root.agentsays.text: You shouldn't linger here, return to Isha as soon as possible. His agents could be following you even now.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: I have been asked to continue my betrayal of Nugoeihuvi and to spy on Katsen Isha. Arikio is convinced that it will be the only way we can get to the bottom of this mess.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I should have known better...

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Then why did you come here? What am I to make of this refusal? I think our business with one another is concluded.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Internal Security, the Nugoeihuvi Corporation's force, poses a curious irony in this regard. Though the Nugoeihuvi conglomerate's main preoccupation is the entertainment industry, they have consistently failed to change the prevalent cultural image of their troops as a pack of rough-and-tumble thugs culled from the Caldari underworld, given to the grossest abuses and atrocities. It's very rare for elements of the Caldari State to find the rumor mill outgrinding them in their efforts at propaganda, but that's what's happening to Nugoeihuvi. (In reality, for the record, Nugoeihuvi's soldiers are not any more or less savage than those of the other corporate forces, though broadly speaking they have been noted to harbor a slightly greater proclivity toward drink and drugs.)

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: Arikio has asked that I return to Isha, earn his trust, and do what I can to uncover the truth about the matter. I have agreed to take the task on. I've been given the formula blueprint back, which we'll use to learn more about Isha when we make a sale. A Hyasyoda counterintelligence team is now plugged into my comms systems and will be trailing me out of sight. I'm supposed to speak of this to nobody. Arikio says that if I need her, she'll be waiting in Wuos.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We have to bring Katsen Isha down, and we have to be exceptionally careful about how we do it. Dealing with Nugoeihuvi requires cunning and guile. You've shown sound judgment by coming to us early, {[character]player.name}. The problem is that it will only get worse if you leave things as they are now. We need answers to the questions you've brought to light.

We will count on you to earn Isha's trust, so you can uncover whatever you need to help us. We need you on the inside if we're ever going to see this resolved; Nugoeihuvi are too well trained at covering up their tracks.

We will be there every step of the way to assist you. I've granted you provisional support from one of our best counter-intelligence teams. They will observe your actions from a distance and monitor any relevant data from your fluid router cache. Anything Isha says to you over FTL, we will have. Anything your camera drones see, we will see.

You will have to keep your assignment strictly confidential, even from other Hyasyoda members. Nobody can know. Not your lover, not your mother, not even the Maker. If you need to get in touch, I will be here. Otherwise, act as if this conversation never happened.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ah, you're back, {[character]player.name}. Good. I hope your journey out toward Syndicate hasn't left you too burned out; I'm going to need you to act quickly on something else. It turns out we have one more loose end to tie up.

My people tell me that Hyasyoda have already launched an investigation into the blueprint theft. Worse yet, I am hearing talk about the sort of funding coming their way. The amounts are disconcerting — enough to pay for a capsuleer's services in addition to a whole fleet of mercenaries and investigators. The situation is dangerous for us, {[character]player.name}. Our tracks are well covered, but, as they often say at Hyasyoda, only the paranoid survive.

They've deployed their security wing, the Corporate Police Force, into “various locations of interest.” I've learned that Onirvura was listed as an area to investigate. They're right here in the constellation, setting up a temporary base for interrogation and imprisonment. Fortunately for us, the CPF has hired a mercenary crew to handle facility defense while they set up. This gives us an opportunity to strike at them without it constituting a direct attack on Hyasyoda personnel. That is simply not an option.

I cannot guarantee how long these mercenaries will be on duty, however, nor what kind of reaction your arrival on scene will provoke. What I do know is that if you can destroy the Logistics Center quickly, it will set them back weeks. The paths that lead back to us will undoubtedly have faded by the time they can resume their investigation.

messages.root.agentsays.text: Time is our greatest enemy, {[character]player.name}. You should get going. The CPF could replace their stand-in mercs at any moment.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Isha has somehow learned of the Hyasyoda investigation team and, worse yet, knows the location of their headquarters. He has asked me to level the place and destroy the mercenary ships guarding it. Hyasyoda assured me that any orders Isha gave over FTL comms would find their way back to the team, so I can only assume they're aware of the matter. I should head back to Arikio Kuretsu at the Hyasyoda HQ to see how she wants to proceed.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Well, ok then. Good luck in your journeys, I've a replacement to find.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Yes, I can understand your hesitance, but there is no other way to resolve this, {[character]player.name}. Good luck in your journeys, I've a replacement to find.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Hyasyoda is one of the oldest of the Caldari megacorporations, having been formed shortly after first contact with Gallente when the Caldari were still in their Industrial Age. Throughout State history, Hyasyoda executives have always been conservative and cautious. As a result the corporation has informally claimed as theirs the age old Caldari saying, “only the paranoid survive.”

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: Isha somehow learned of the Hyasyoda investigation team and even uncovered the location of their headquarters. He charged me with leveling the place and killing the mercenary forces guarding it. I spoke with Arikio about the situation. Her people are coming up with a strategy to handle it.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good, then. Remember, {[character]player.name} — the Logistics Center is your only target. You can limit the loss of life here by taking it down quickly and then getting the hell out. If you linger, they will most likely swarm you with reinforcements and pin you down. Don't get complacent just because they're mercs; Hyasyoda is funding them and will make damn sure they get their money's worth.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The Corporate Police Force investigation must be brought to an end before it can uncover anything that could lead back to us. The forces inside the facility right now are not Hyasyoda or CPF personnel, just some hired mercs. This gives us an opportunity to strike preemptively at the compound without causing an incident and further complicating matters.

If you can destroy the Logistics Center quickly, it will set them back weeks. The paths that lead back to us will have faded by the time they can resume their investigation. You can limit the loss of life here by taking it down quickly and then getting the hell out. If you linger, they will most likely swarm you with reinforcements.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
{[character]player.name}, welcome back. We've been watching.

You've done well so far, but this current situation threatens to undermine everything. This Isha character is far smarter than we gave him credit for and I fear he knows even more than he has trusted you with. We are working on something that should remove him from the picture, but for now we have to act quickly; our investigations team and their work must remain secure.

The task that lies ahead is a large one, {[character]player.name}. We not only need to reposition our people out of Nugoeihuvi's way, but we also need to convince Isha that you have destroyed the facility and everyone in it. After we learned that our location had been compromised, we did a full electronics sweep of the area. The loyalty of the staff working here was never in question, so we knew it had to be electronics surveillance.

Sure enough, we found a series of bugs in our surveillance systems. We have not interfered with them in any way so far. Our plan, {[character]player.name}, is to have you disable the surveillance only moments before you move everyone out. Immediately after that point, we will trigger the detonation of explosive charges already set in the compromised facility. When Nugoeihuvi notice their surveillance has gone down, they'll suspect one of two things; that you have carried out your task, or that their bugs have been compromised. We want it to be the former, understood?

There is much at stake here, {[character]player.name}. Your mission must be carried out flawlessly. Please be aware before taking it on, that you will need the ability to hack into hostile Nugoeihuvi surveillance systems. If you cannot hack, find someone who can, or quickly learn the basics yourself. That should be enough.

messages.root.agentsays.text: Head out to the investigation team's HQ, {[character]player.name}. I will provide further instructions once you're on-site.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: I met again with Hyasyoda Agent Arikio Kuretsu after learning that Isha had discovered the location of the investigation team's Headquarters. She told me that the CPF has a plan to deal with him personally, but for now I have been tasked with salvaging the situation. It seems that NOH have bugged the CPF compound, but we can use that against them. The strategy is to hack into their surveillance software, disable it, quickly evacuate everyone, and then clear the area before Hyasyoda agents detonate explosives laid inside. The explosions should register on the other bugging devices, and once each of them are destroyed, nobody will know that they were disabled a few moments beforehand, nor what happened in that small window of time after they were. At least, that's the plan.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Then leave. If you cannot be trusted to help us in this time of need, then you cannot be trusted, period.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: You have come with us this far, {[character]player.name}, can you not see us through to the end? We cannot trust any other egger. If there was something else you needed to do then go do it. I will be eagerly awaiting your return.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Altercations between the corporate forces exist on record, but in almost every case they have been small incidents based on misunderstanding, with warning shots the only ordnance released. A notable exception is an incident known as the Ingalles incident, where soldiers belonging to the Wiyrkomi Peace Corps opened fire on a Hyasyoda convoy being escorted by the Hyasyoda's agency, the Corporate Police Force.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: I met again with Hyasyoda Agent Arikio Kuretsu, who tasked me with saving the investigation team's HQ. NOH had bugged the CPF compound, but we used their own taps against them. I hacked into their surveillance software, disabled it and quickly evacuated everyone. Hyasyoda agents then detonated each one as it emptied. As far as NOH should be aware, I have completed my mission successfully. I am to report back to Arikio when I am ready to be briefed about one final assignment that Hyasyoda has for me.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good. I will give you further instructions out there. Pay careful attention to them, everything rests on your shoulders.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We need to reposition our people out of Nugoeihuvi's way and not let Isha realize we're aware of his intentions in the process. You must convince Isha that you have destroyed the facility and everyone in it.

We have found a series of bugs implanted by NOH agents throughout our compound. We have not interfered with them in any way so far. Our plan is to have you disable them only moments before you move everyone out. Immediately after that point, we will trigger the detonation of explosive charges already set in each compromised facility. When Nugoeihuvi notice their surveillance has gone down, they'll suspect one of two things; that you have carried out your task, or that their bugs have been compromised. We want it to be the former.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
You know, {[character]player.name}, all I've ever seen from your kind is death and destruction, until today, at least. We are – and I am – humbled to have you working for us.

I will leave it at that, for now. You have done enough today that I would feel overbearing trying to dump yet more work on your shoulders. Whenever you are ready though, we would like to brief you on one last assignment before you return to Katsen Isha. Until then, rest well. You've certainly earned it.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Hmm, that's quite a story, {[character]player.name}. If you weren't a known friend of the State, I'd be inclined to think you were attempting some kind of scheme. Regardless, I should still throw your ass out of here and have Hyasyoda set your status to kill on sight. That will not get us anywhere, however.

My superiors have been informed of the situation and have asked me to request something from you, but before doing so, to also make something explicitly clear.

The facility you were instructed to raid? It has not been under Hyasyoda control for almost a year now. I was told that if you do your research you should find that we also legally rented the area from Sukuuvestaa too, before Serpentis overran it and forced us out. Of course, SuVee could pay the House of Records and the Caldari Business Tribunal a few administrative fees to make that information disappear, if someone were to ever poke around.

What I think you may also find interesting to know, though, is that around the time our lease was coming up for renewal, Serpentis began to appear in larger numbers and with better equipment. We always suspected someone local was funding them, a rogue Guristas outfit or even Gallentean extremists, but the idea that it might be one of our own corporations, at a time like this, it just never crossed our mind.

Something definitely isn't right here. I suspect Nugoeihuvi learned of the facility through Sukuuvestaa, who I can only guess, never wanted us to extend our lease for some reason. NOH, doing what it does best, brought in some thugs to clear the matter up. That's until you arrived and, it would appear, saw that something wasn't adding up.

Now, the question is whether or not we can trust you. Obviously we are happy to share the information we have so far, but there is more to the story than we will say to an egger who has stolen from us. If you are serious about seeing this affair brought to a just end, then you will return the formula you took from us and prove your good intentions.

Do anything less and you will still be considered an enemy of Hyasyoda Corporation. It's as simple as that.

messages.root.agentsays.text: Well? We're waiting…

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: I made it to Wuos and met Hyasyoda's representative, Arikio Kuretsu. As proof to Hyasyoda of my good intent, I have been asked to return the formula that I stole for Nugoeihuvi earlier. My suspicions turned about to be justified, too. Arikio is claiming that Hyasyoda lost control of the research facility long ago. Her assumption is that Sukuuvestaa and Nugoeihuvi are somehow involved in the affair, since the Serpentis raiders who forced them out were too well established in the area to have been acting alone. She has refused to provide any further information until I provide the formula.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: Hyasyoda Corporation Announces Aid for Ishukone, Scope Article, May 17th

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I expected as much, I have to say.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Then why did you come here? What am I to make of this refusal? I think our business with one another is concluded.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Hyasyoda Corporation CEO Ahtonen Osmon has announced a crash program of aid to assist the overstretched Ishukone Corporation, following the disaster in Malkalen. Hyasyoda, a long-time partner of Ishukone in the so-called 'Liberal Faction', will provide emergency enabling loans to Ishukone Corporation and direct relief aid to Malkalen system.

"The Hyasyoda Corporation will not stand by and see a great megacorporation of the Caldari State fall to an act of treachery and unprovoked aggression. We are therefore making funds available at preferential rates so that the Ishukone executives who survive can continue to run their organisation and oversee the relief efforts. We are also sending relief ships to the Malkalen system to directly assist the efforts at the Ishukone Headquarters," said Ahtonen Osmon.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text:
After hearing my story and speaking with her superiors, Arikio Kuretsu of Hyasyoda asked me to return the stolen booster formulas as proof of my sincerity. I complied and handed the formula back over. I seem to have earned her trust for doing so. She asked that I return to her when I'm ready to hear about what comes next.

My suspicions turned about to be justified, too. Arikio is claiming that Hyasyoda lost control of the research facility long ago. Her assumption is that Sukuuvestaa and Nugoeihuvi are somehow involved in the affair, since the Serpentis raiders who forced them out were too well established in the area to have been acting alone.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Very well. We look forward to continued cooperation with you, {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
The facility you were instructed to raid has not been under Hyasyoda control for almost a year now. I was told that if you do your research you should find that we also legally rented the area from Sukuuvestaa too, before Serpentis overran it and forced us out. Of course, SuVee could pay the House of Records and the Caldari Business Tribunal a few administrative fees to make that information disappear, if someone were to ever poke around.

What I think you may also find interesting to know, though, is that around the time our lease was coming up for renewal, Serpentis began to show up in larger numbers and with better equipment. We always suspected someone local was funding them, a rogue Guristas outfit or even Gallente extremists, but the idea that it might be one of our own corporations, at a time like this, it just never crossed our mind.

Something definitely isn't right here. I suspect Nugoeihuvi learned of the facility through Sukuuvestaa, who I can only guess, never wanted us to extend our lease for some reason. NOH, doing what it does best, brought in some thugs to clear the matter up. That's until you arrived and, I hope, saw that something wasn't adding up.

Now, the question is whether or not we can trust you. Obviously we are happy to share this information, but there is more to the story than we will share with an egger who has stolen from us. If you are serious about seeing this affair brought to a just end, then you will return what you took and prove your intentions.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
Hmm, that is indeed the formula. Good then, I suppose we are going to be working together after all.

Speak with me again when you're ready to talk about where we go from here.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
You've done well, {[character]player.name}. Without any major interruption to our investigations the team has managed to cover a lot of ground. We now have a much better understanding of the situation, and who this Katsen Isha is.

For one, we have a possible future lead in the House of Records. Apparently some publicly available documents regarding Isha's earliest days at Nugoeihuvi have been archived. We just need to figure out which station has the hard copies and then we'll have it.

We noticed something else when you left towards Syndicate to make the blueprint delivery. Isha was on the move himself. Our surveillance team monitored a visit he made to an unknown Caldari Navy compound. The unmarked shuttle he flew there has now been sighted back inside Nugoeihuvi's docking bay at Poinen. Interestingly, it has been given priority docking position, meaning another launch is likely to happen soon.

We don't want to arrive at any conclusions just yet, but our first impression is that Isha is involved in some kind of black market activity, perhaps weapons or information smuggling. We noticed that he mentioned introducing you to someone – we think they may be the buyer. His visit to this Caldari Navy facility raises a lot of questions in that regard.

See what you can do about meeting this friend of Isha's, then discover what you can about them. We'll be watching closely {[character]player.name}, good luck.

messages.root.agentsays.text: You should speak with Isha soon, {[character]player.name}, we don't want him wondering about your absence.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: The investigation team was able to make some progress after being relocated. Apparently Isha has been spotted making visits to some unknown Caldari Navy facility. Hyasyoda suspects he is involved in some kind of arms or information smuggling racket. I've been asked to gather more information about who Isha is meeting with.

messages.mission.extrainfo.header.text: Hyasyoda Returns to Bargaining Table after Reppola Intervenes, Scope Article, February 23rd, YC111

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Then leave, I've nothing further to offer you if you won't see this to the end.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Then leave, I've nothing further to offer you if you won't see this to the end.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text:
Hyasyoda negotiators resumed talks with Zainou today after Ishukone Watch CEO Mens Reppola intervened personally over the weekend. The close friend of the late Otro Gariushi spoke extensively with Hyasyoda CEO Ahtonen Osmon both Saturday and Sunday. Though Ishukone did not disclose the details of the conversation, a press release from Osmon's office called the discussions with Reppola "productive and reassuring," and apologized to Zainou for the delay in resuming negotiations.

Political analysts, such as Taya Otnen, a corporate strategist with the Mercantile Club on this week's Games of State, have called this a shrewd move by the Ishukone Watch CEO. "He's used his authority over corporate security matters to take ownership of the negotiations, whether they succeed or fail," she told host Shiomiken Savalenta. "This may have actually been what Hyasyoda was hoping for; it's no secret that they support Reppola for the CEO seat. It was a very dangerous move, though; if Okalala wins the CEO fight, he'll remember what they did. Next time those contracts are up for review, Hyasyoda may find themselves passed over for another vendor like Sukuuvestaa or Kaalakiota."

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: The investigation team was able to make some progress after being relocated. Apparently Isha has been spotted making visits to some unknown Caldari Navy facility. Hyasyoda suspects he is involved in some kind of arms or information smuggling racket. I've been asked to gather more information about who Isha is meeting with. After returning to Isha yet again, I discovered that his friend is a highly-placed Caldari Navy official named Sinas Egassuo. This is, presumably, the same man Isha has been observed visiting.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
We noticed something when you left towards Syndicate to make the blueprint delivery. Isha was on the move himself. Our surveillance team monitored a visit he made to an unknown Caldari Navy compound. The unmarked shuttle he flew there has now been sighted back inside Nugoeihuvi's docking bay at Poinen. Interestingly, it has been given priority docking position, meaning another launch is likely to happen soon.

We don't want to arrive at any conclusions just yet, but our first impression is that Isha is involved in some kind of black market activity, perhaps weapons or information smuggling. We noticed that he mentioned introducing you to someone – we think they may be the buyer. His visit to this Caldari Navy facility raises a lot of questions in that regard.

See what you can do about meeting this friend of Isha's, then discover what you can about them. We'll be watching closely {[character]player.name}, good luck.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
It sounds like Sinas is on to something. I want you there to help him in any way you can. He's headed back to his post in Astoh, so you're off to Black Rise to meet him, {[character]player.name}. If you've never been there, then you should know that it can be a dangerous place; the leadership of the Federation's capsuleer militia has set its sights on nothing less than total Gallentean occupation of the region. An absurd goal, but they're welcome to try.

From the sounds of it, Sinas will need you for something around there. My advice would be to start by flying an interceptor or frigate down that way. If on the off chance he needs you to do some heavy lifting, then you can go back for something larger. My impression is that he'll want speed and discretion here though; if it was something a fleet of Ravens could hit he'd have handled it with his own crew already.

Anyhow, fly out there, see what's up, and keep in mind what I told you about him. If you can trust me, you should trust him.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Isha is sending me off to meet Sinas in person and handle whatever work he has for me. He advised me to bring a small vessel there, suspecting that the work ahead of me will rely on speed and discretion.

messages.root.agentsays.text: You should see Sinas as soon as possible.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Fine. I will find someone else. You disappoint me {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Fine. I will find someone else. You disappoint me {[character]player.name}.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: A cursory glance at the Black Rise region reveals a great deal to those with even the most basic understanding of Caldari internal politics. Kaalakiota, Lai Dai and Wiyrkomi led the charge in colonization, each flanked by their private security forces. Supplemented by the Caldari Navy, the State War Academy and Caldari Constructions, the colonization has all the hallmarks of a Patriot faction power play.

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: I was sent by Isha to personally meet Sinas in the system of Astoh, Black Rise, where he is currently deployed with the Navy. I managed to find my way to his compound and discuss the work ahead of us.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Don't let my friend down out there, {[character]player.name}. You're representing us both.

messages.mission.briefing.text:
It sounds like Sinas is on to something. I want you there to help him in any way you can. He's headed back to his post in Astoh, so you're off to Black Rise to meet him.

From the sounds of it, Sinas will need you for something around there. My advice would be to start by flying an interceptor or frigate down that way. If on the off chance he needs you to do some heavy lifting, then you can go back for something larger. My impression is that he'll want speed and discretion here though; if it was something a fleet of Ravens could hit he'd have handled it with his own crew already.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
Ah, {[character]player.name}, welcome back. Word filtered back to me that the Hyasyoda investigation came to an abrupt and explosive halt. Good work.

Now that we're in the clear, we're free to pursue the matter I mentioned earlier. There's someone I wanted you to meet. I'm afraid I can't do it myself; he and I must be careful not to be associated with one another. This is not for any good reason, {[character]player.name}, it is simply the way our judgmental world works. A Caldari Navy officer of his kind cannot afford the rumors that a friendship with me brings. You will learn though, in time, how little truth there is to them. You've already shown a great capacity to see through the surface of things, to the heart. You wouldn't be here still if that wasn't the case.

My friend's name is Sinas Egassuo. He is a man in a similar position to me, working quietly in the engine room, seeking results, not glory. He too, works as an Advisor, and almost every important operation undertaken by our Navy in the last decade bears his imprint. You will hear talk of Caldari patriots in your time in the State, and doubtless already have. This man is a living definition of one.

You will find him somewhere around {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, just look for the Caldari Navy compound in the system, and be careful. He may not be known and loved by the Caldari people, but the leadership of the Gallente Navy is well acquainted with him and his work, and has long wanted him dead. His outfit deals with assassins and bounty hunters on a daily basis. Expect nothing less when you find the compound.

Oh, and if his surname seems familiar that's because you've probably met his sister. She works as a capsuleer liaison for the Navy's Command Division in Motsu. I wouldn't mention anything about her though; sisters are a sore spot for him.

messages.root.agentsays.text: You have reached the Nugoeihuvi Corporation Advisory Office, Poinen. No-one is available to take your call at this moment. Please try again later.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: Isha expressed a desire for me to meet someone in his stead; a Caldari Navy officer who he tells me is some kind of high-ranking, behind-the-scenes operative. His name is Sinas Egassuo, apparently the brother of Toras, a well-known Commander in Motsu. It appears that Isha and Sinas cannot be seen associating with one another, thanks to the so-called “rumors” that follow Isha around.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: I…already set things in motion. Your failure here has cost me much, much more than you realize. Go then, {[character]player.name}. If you cannot be relied upon, I have no desire to give you any further work.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: We were just about to begin the real work, {[character]player.name}! Well, fine. If you have other things to deal with, get to them. You would not be the first egger to walk out on a job barely started. I had expected more from you though, I am sad to say.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good then. Trust what I said {[character]player.name}, the State is lucky to have people like Sinas.

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:
He wants fifty million ISK? Hmm, it worries me when a Caldari navy officer with an almost limitless budget asks for money, usually means he needs to do something off the books.

Alright, tell Sinas the ISK is on its way. I want you to work with him on whatever he's got going on. You can keep an eye on how he's spending all that money while you're at it.

messages.mission.offered.agentsays.text:
{[character]player.name}, good. I hope the visit to Faurulle didn't take too much out of you. Once again, good work out there. Sadly, it turns out we have one more loose end to tie up.

My people tell me that Hyasyoda has already launched an investigation into the blueprint theft. I suppose this is a play to lend an air of legitimacy to the racket they've been running. The situation is an amusing one, yet also dangerous for us. Our tracks are well covered, but – as they often say in Hyasyoda itself – only the paranoid survive.

They've deployed their security wing, the Corporate Police Force, into “various locations of interest.” I have learned that Onirvura was listed as an area to investigate. They're right here in the constellation, setting up a temporary base for interrogation and imprisonment. Fortunately for us, the CPF has hired a mercenary crew to handle facility defense while they set up. This gives us an opportunity to strike at them without it constituting a direct attack on Hyasyoda personnel. That would muddy the waters a bit, as I'm sure you can appreciate.

I cannot guarantee how long these mercenaries will be on duty, however, nor what kind of reaction your arrival on scene will provoke. What I do know is that if you can destroy the Logistics Center quickly, it will set them back weeks. The paths that lead back to us to will easily have faded into the background by the time they can resume their investigation.

messages.root.agentsays.text: Time is our greatest enemy here, {[character]player.name}. You should get going. The CPF could replace their stand-in mercs at any moment.

messages.epicMission.journalText.inProgr.text: After making the sale in Faurulle, I contacted Katsen Isha once more. He tells me that Hyasyoda has launched an investigation into our raid on the facility. I must stop the Corporate Police Force investigation before it can uncover anything. Isha stated that there is a particular structure inside their compound that is crucial to their progress. If I can destroy it, then I will hamper their investigation for weeks — long enough for the trail back to us to dry up.

messages.mission.quitted.agentsays.text: Don't worry, {[character]player.name}. I won't deny the assignment was a challenging one. Perhaps you should look into this misdirection plan I have in mind, instead. All is not yet lost.

messages.mission.declined.agentsays.text: Yes, I can understand your hesitance. Perhaps it is better to focus on misdirection instead. I will prepare your briefing for that task and you can judge for yourself. Speak with me again when you'd like to hear it.

messages.mission.extrainfo.body.text: Hyasyoda is one of the oldest of the Caldari mega corporations, having been formed shortly after first contact with Gallente when the Caldari were still in the Industrial Age. Throughout State history, Hyasyoda executives have always been conservative and cautious. As a result, the corporation has informally claimed as theirs the age old Caldari saying that “only the paranoid survive.”

messages.epicMission.journalText.complet.text: I successfully brought the Corporate Police Force investigation to an end by destroying the facility they were offsetting up for their base. Isha tells me it will be some weeks before they can fully resume their inquiries. He is confident that we will have dropped off the radar long before then.

messages.mission.accepted.agentsays.text: Good, then. Remember, {[character]player.name}: The Logistics Center is your only target. You can limit the loss of life here by taking it down quickly and then getting the hell out. If you linger, they will most likely swarm you with reinforcements and pin you down. Don't get complacent just because they're mercs — Hyasyoda is funding them and will make damn sure they get their money's worth.

messages.mission.briefing.text:

messages.mission.completed.agentsays.text:

Take some time to relax and recuperate. When you are ready, our real work can finally begin.
